NO-PEACE-001.name_zh: 纳恩森/布兰特兰：和平外交与难民救助
NO-PEACE-001.description_zh: 弗里乔夫·纳恩森 (1861-1930) 是挪威探险家、科学家、外交家，首任国际联盟难民事务高级专员，发明"纳恩森护照"拯救数十万无国籍难民；格罗·哈莱姆·布兰特兰 (1939-) 挪威首位女首相、世卫组织总干事，推动可持续发展委员会《我们共同的未来》报告。两人跨越时代，共同体现北欧和平外交传统：小国通过道德权威与制度创新在大国间开辟生存空间。
NO-PEACE-001.description_en: Fridtjof Nansen (1861-1930), Norwegian explorer, scientist, diplomat, first League of Nations High Commissioner for Refugees, invented "Nansen passport" saving hundreds of thousands of stateless refugees; Gro Harlem Brundtland (1939-), Norway's first female PM, WHO Director-General, drove the Brundtland Commission's "Our Common Future" report. Across eras, both embody Nordic peace diplomacy: small nations leveraging moral authority and institutional innovation to carve survival space among great powers.
NO-PEACE-001.reason_zh: 纳恩森确立了"小国道德大国"外交范式，布兰特兰将其延伸为可持续发展全球治理；两人跨时代接力，完美诠释北欧信任资本 (M151) 与乌班图式共识 (M146) 在国际制度建设中的复利效应。
NO-PEACE-001.reason_en: Nansen established the "small nation as moral great power" diplomatic paradigm; Brundtland extended it into global sustainable development governance. Their cross-generational relay perfectly exemplifies the compounding effect of Nordic Trust Capital (M151) and Ubuntu-style consensus (M146) in international institution-building.
steps_zh: 确立道德权威：以科学成就/人道行动奠定超越地缘政治的合法性基础
发明制度工具：创造纳恩森护照/可持续发展框架等可复制的国际公共品
动员跨国联盟：超越国家边界组织科学家、NGO、国际组织共同行动
锁定长期机制：将临时人道行动转化为永久性国际法/治理架构
代际传承与复利：布兰特兰接力纳恩森，将和平外交升维为星球级治理
steps_en: Establish moral authority: ground legitimacy beyond geopolitics in scientific/humanitarian achievement
Invent institutional tools: create replicable international public goods like Nansen passport/sustainable development framework
Mobilize transnational coalitions: organize scientists, NGOs, IOs across borders for collective action
Lock in long-term mechanisms: convert ad hoc humanitarian action into permanent international law/governance architecture
Intergenerational transmission & compounding: Brundtland relayed Nansen, upgrading peace diplomacy to planetary governance
NO-PEACE-001.expected_zh: 在大国博弈夹缝中，小国通过道德权威+制度创新获得战略自主；建立可复制的国际公共品供给模式，实现代际信任资本复利。
NO-PEACE-001.expected_en: In great power interstices, small nations gain strategic autonomy via moral authority + institutional innovation; establish replicable international public goods supply model, achieving intergenerational trust capital compounding.
NO-PEACE-001.case_zh: 1922年纳恩森护照让40万俄国/亚美尼亚难民获得法律身份；1987年布兰特兰报告确立"可持续发展"成为全球共识，直接催生1992年里约峰会与《巴黎协定》框架。
NO-PEACE-001.case_en: 1922 Nansen passport gave 400k Russian/Armenian refugees legal identity; 1987 Brundtland Report made "sustainable development" global consensus, directly birthing 1992 Rio Summit & Paris Agreement framework.
NO-PEACE-001.cross_cultural_impact: Nansen passport precedent for modern refugee law; Brundtland Commission defined sustainable development globally
NO-PEACE-001.colonial_history: Norway independent 1905; no colonial empire but whaling/Arctic presence
NO-PEACE-001.diaspora_influence: Norwegian-American community shaped US Midwest politics
NO-PEACE-001.indigenous_knowledge_system: Sami traditional knowledge recognized in later Nordic governance (not directly in these figures)

NO-ENER-001.name_zh: 斯塔托/埃克森：北海石油与主权财富基金治理
NO-ENER-001.name_en: Statoil/Equinor: North Sea Oil & Sovereign Wealth Governance
NO-ENER-001.description_zh: 挪威国家石油公司 (Statoil, 1972成立，2018更名 Equinor) 是北海石油开发的主力，其利润直接注入挪威政府养老基金全球 (GPFG)，规模超1.5万亿美元，成为世界最大主权财富基金。核心治理模式：资源租金100%归国家、道德准则委员会排除不符合伦理投资、跨党派政治共识锁定"只花收益不花本金"。这体现了北欧信任资本 (M151) 在资源诅咒缓解 (M168) 中的制度化复利。
NO-ENER-001.description_en: Norway's state oil company (Statoil, founded 1972, renamed Equinor 2018) led North Sea development; profits flow directly into the Government Pension Fund Global (GPFG), now >$1.5T, world's largest SWF. Core governance: 100% resource rent to state, Ethics Council excludes unethical investments, cross-party consensus locks "spend only returns not principal". This exemplifies Nordic Trust Capital (M151) institutionalized for resource curse mitigation (M168) with intergenerational compounding.
NO-ENER-001.reason_zh: 挪威避免了"荷兰病"和资源诅咒，核心在于将地质运气转化为制度红利：透明度+道德约束+代际契约。Equinor 从石油向海上风电/碳捕获/氢能转型，展示 M169 后资源转型治理。
NO-ENER-001.reason_en: Norway avoided Dutch disease & resource curse by turning geological luck into institutional dividends: transparency + ethical constraints + intergenerational contract. Equinor's pivot from oil to offshore wind/CCS/hydrogen demonstrates M169 post-resource transition governance.
steps_zh: 资源国有化确权：1963年大陆架法确立国家对海底资源主权
建立国家石油公司：Statoil 100%国有，技术自主+利润上缴
立法锁定收益流向：1990年养老基金法，只花实质回报率3%
道德准则外部监督：独立委员会可排除烟草/武器/严重环保违规企业
转型锚定长期主义：2020年气候路线图，2050净零，海上风电装机目标12-16GW
steps_en: Resource sovereignty: 1963 Continental Shelf Act established state ownership of seabed resources
Create NOC: Statoil 100% state-owned, technical autonomy + profit upstreaming
Legislate revenue lock-in: 1990 Pension Fund Act, spend only 3% real return
Ethical oversight: independent council can exclude tobacco/weapons/severe ESG violators
Transition anchored in long-termism: 2020 climate roadmap, net-zero 2050, 12-16GW offshore wind target
NO-ENER-001.expected_zh: 资源型小国实现跨代际财富保值增值，避免荷兰病，建立可复制的资源治理黄金标准。
NO-ENER-001.expected_en: Resource-rich small nation achieves intergenerational wealth preservation/growth, avoids Dutch disease, establishes replicable gold standard for resource governance.
NO-ENER-001.case_zh: GPFG 2023年市值15.6万亿挪威克朗，人均约290万克朗；Equinor 2023年可再生能源投资占比超30%，Dogger Bank风电场成全球最大。
NO-ENER-001.case_en: GPFG 2023 value NOK 15.6T, ~NOK 2.9M per capita; Equinor 2023 renewables >30% capex, Dogger Bank world's largest wind farm.
NO-ENER-001.cross_cultural_impact: Global SWF governance model; Santiago Principles co-author; resource curse avoidance case study worldwide
NO-ENER-001.colonial_history: Norway independent 1905; no colonies but Arctic whaling history
NO-ENER-001.resource_curse_mitigation: 100% resource rent to SWF; 3% spending rule; Ethics Council exclusion list; full transparency (EITI founding member)

DK-FLEX-001.name_zh: 科尔内/拉斯马斯克/扬·布拉格·延森：灵活保障模式与福利国家创新
DK-FLEX-001.description_zh: 丹麦"灵活保障"模式由三位跨党派领袖跨越三十年共建： Poul Schlüter (保守党, 1982-93) 推动劳动市场改革； Poul Nyrup Rasmussen (社民党, 1993-2001) 将其制度化为"灵活保障"四支柱(灵活解雇+慷慨失业金+主动劳动政策+终身学习)； Helle Thorning-Schmidt (社民党, 2011-15) 引入数字化公共服务与绿色转型。核心逻辑：企业享有解雇灵活性，工人享有收入保障与再培训权利，国家承担调节成本。这体现了北欧信任资本 (M151) 的制度化——高信任降低交易成本，使"灵活"不演变为"不安定"。
DK-FLEX-001.description_en: Denmark's "flexicurity" model built by three cross-party leaders over 30 years: Poul Schlüter (Conservative, 1982-93) drove labor reforms; Poul Nyrup Rasmussen (Social Dem, 1993-2001) institutionalized four pillars (flexible firing + generous unemployment + active labor policy + lifelong learning); Helle Thorning-Schmidt (Social Dem, 2011-15) added digital public services & green transition. Core logic: firms get firing flexibility, workers get income security & retraining rights, state bears adjustment costs. This exemplifies Nordic Trust Capital (M151) institutionalized—high trust lowers transaction costs so "flexibility" doesn't become "insecurity".
DK-FLEX-001.reason_zh: 灵活保障是北欧模式在全球化冲击下的自我进化：用制度化信任替代刚性保护，实现企业竞争力与工人安全的动态平衡。三位领袖跨党派接力，展示 M34 制度化制度与 M52 长期主义的复利。
DK-FLEX-001.reason_en: Flexicurity is Nordic model's self-evolution under globalization: institutionalized trust replaces rigid protection, achieving dynamic balance of firm competitiveness & worker security. Three leaders' cross-party relay shows compounding of M34 Institutionalization & M52 Long-termism.
steps_zh: 共识建立：雇主联合会+工会联合会+政府三方协商，锁定核心原则
立法锚定：1994/1998/2002 三轮改革法，将四支柱写入法律
主动劳动政策机构化：市镇级就业中心、强制激活措施、技能升级账户制
终身学习融资：成人教育补贴、职业学院网络、企业培训税收抵扣
数字化与绿色延伸：NemID/数字邮箱普及、2030气候法锁定70%减排目标
steps_en: Consensus building: Employer confederation + union confederation + government tripartite lock core principles
Legislative anchoring: 1994/1998/2002 three reform acts writing four pillars into law
Institutionalize ALMP: municipal job centers, mandatory activation, skills upgrade accounts
Lifelong learning finance: adult education subsidies, vocational college network, corporate training tax credits
Digital & green extension: NemID/digital post universal, 2030 Climate Act locks 70% emissions cut
DK-FLEX-001.expected_zh: 失业率长期低于欧盟平均，劳动参与率高，企业创新指数领跑，福利国家在开放经济中可持续。
DK-FLEX-001.expected_en: Unemployment consistently below EU average, high labor participation, firm innovation index leading, welfare state sustainable in open economy.
DK-FLEX-001.case_zh: 2008金融危机丹麦失业率峰值仅6.2%（欧盟10%+），2年内恢复；COVID-19期薪资补贴方案2周上线，保住90%岗位。
DK-FLEX-001.case_en: 2008 GFC Denmark unemployment peak 6.2% (EU 10%+), recovered in 2 years; COVID wage subsidy live in 2 weeks, saved 90% jobs.
DK-FLEX-001.cross_cultural_impact: EU flexicurity principles 2007; ILO model; OECD benchmark for labor market resilience
DK-FLEX-001.spiritual_tradition: Lutheran work ethic + Grundtvigian folk high school tradition
DK-FLEX-001.colonial_history: Greenland/Faroe Islands autonomous; historical Caribbean/India trade posts
DK-FLEX-001.diaspora_influence: Danish-American community in US Midwest; shipping diaspora global
DK-FLEX-001.indigenous_knowledge_system: Inuit traditional knowledge in Greenland self-governance (indirect)

DK-DES-001.name_zh: 保罗·亨宁/乐高/邦·奥尔森：设计工程商业化与系统性创新
DK-DES-001.name_en: Paul Henningsen/LEGO/Børge Olsen: Design Engineering Commercialization & Systemic Innovation
DK-DES-001.description_zh: 丹麦设计工程传统由三代跨越百年传承：保罗·亨宁 (1894-1967) 以 PH 灯系统确立"功能决定形式、光学科学化"的设计工程范式；乐高集团 (1932创立，高德弗雷·克里斯蒂安森 1958 专利积木) 将模块化标准化推向极致，构建"玩具即平台"的生态系统；邦·奥尔森 (1928-2018) 以系统家具 (1960s) 推动工业化住宅与办公空间标准化。三者共同体现 M158 通才整合——跨光学/材料/制造/商业/人因工程的全息原型验证。核心机制：模块化标准→平台生态→用户共创→品牌护城河。
DK-DES-001.description_en: Danish design engineering tradition across three generations: Poul Henningsen (1894-1967) established PH lamp system—"function determines form, optics scientized"; LEGO Group (founded 1932, Godtfred Christiansen 1958 brick patent) took modular standardization to extreme, building "toy as platform" ecosystem; Børge Olsen (1928-2018) with system furniture (1960s) drove industrialized housing/office standardization. All three exemplify M158 Polymath Integration—holographic prototype validation across optics/materials/manufacturing/commerce/human-factors. Core mechanism: modular standard → platform ecosystem → user co-creation → brand moat.
DK-DES-001.reason_zh: 丹麦设计非单纯美学，而是"工程化美学"：科学原理(光学/人因)→模块化标准→工业化制造→商业平台。三代人跨百年接力，展示 M158 通才整合与 M151 信任资本在商业生态中的复利。
DK-DES-001.reason_en: Danish design is not mere aesthetics but "engineered aesthetics": scientific principles (optics/ergonomics) → modular standards → industrial manufacturing → commercial platform. Three generations century-long relay shows M158 Polymath Integration & M151 Trust Capital compounding in business ecosystems.
steps_zh: 科学原理先行：亨宁用对数螺旋线计算灯罩曲率，消除眩光（纯物理学）
模块化标准定义：乐高积木 1958 专利公差 0.002mm，反向兼容 60+ 年
平台化生态构建：乐高 Ideas/Technic/Education 让用户成共创者，IP 授权双向奔赴
系统家具工业化：奥尔森模块化储物/办公系统，适配丹麦福利国家公共建设采购
品牌护城河深化：设计博物馆收藏+版权保护+高端定价+教育渗透，形成文化壁垒
steps_en: Scientific principles first: Henningsen used logarithmic spiral for shade curvature, eliminating glare (pure physics)
Modular standard definition: LEGO brick 1958 patent tolerance 0.002mm, backward compatible 60+ years
Platform ecosystem building: LEGO Ideas/Technic/Education make users co-creators, IP licensing two-way
System furniture industrialization: Olsen modular storage/office systems fitted Danish welfare state public procurement
Brand moat deepening: Design museum acquisitions + IP protection + premium pricing + education permeation = cultural barrier
DK-DES-001.expected_zh: 小国非依靠自然资源，以"设计工程"为核心竞争力，构建全球品牌护城河，实现高值制造与文化输出双赢。
DK-DES-001.expected_en: Small nation without natural resources builds global brand moat via "design engineering" core competency, achieving high-value manufacturing & cultural export win-win.
DK-DES-001.case_zh: 乐高 2023 营收 659 亿丹麦克朗，品牌价值全球前十；PH 灯永久收藏 MoMA/蓬皮杜；奥尔森系统家具铺货全球机场/大学/政府。
DK-DES-001.case_en: LEGO 2023 revenue DKK 65.9B, brand value global top 10; PH lamps permanent MoMA/Centre Pompidou; Olsen systems in airports/universities/governments worldwide.
DK-DES-001.cross_cultural_impact: Global design education curriculum; modular platform business model; Scandinavian design brand equity
DK-DES-001.spiritual_tradition: Lutheran craft ethics + Grundtvigian democratic design
DK-DES-001.colonial_history: No direct colonial design legacy; Greenlandic craft influence contemporary
DK-DES-001.diaspora_influence: Danish designers shaped US mid-century modern (Eames collaboration)
DK-DES-001.indigenous_knowledge_system: Inuit material culture influences contemporary Arctic design (indirect)

FI-SISU-001.name_zh: 西尼海宁/林纳斯·托瓦兹：西斯坚韧与开源治理
FI-SISU-001.name_en: Sininheimo/Linus Torvalds: Sisu Resilience & Open Source Governance
FI-SISU-001.description_zh: 芬兰"西斯" (Sisu) 精神——极端逆境下的冷静坚毅、行动导向、不抱怨执行——在两位跨时代人物中得以代际传承：西尼海宁 (1888-1972) 冬季战争/继续战争指挥官，以寡击众守住曼纳海姆防线，体现军事西斯；林纳斯·托瓦兹 (1969-) 创建 Linux 内核，以"话少代码多"的暴力美学治理全球最大协作软件项目（2800万行代码，2万+贡献者），体现技术西斯。核心机制：极简规则 (内核邮件列表+维护者信任链) + 技术权威绝对化 + 拒绝官僚化。这体现 M151 北欧信任资本在代码层面的极致实现——信任不靠合同靠代码质量。
FI-SISU-001.description_en: Finnish "Sisu"—calm grit in extreme adversity, action-oriented, execution without complaint—transmitted across eras: Paavo Sininheimo (1888-1972), Winter/Continuation War commander, held Mannerheim Line against overwhelming odds, military Sisu; Linus Torvalds (1969-), created Linux kernel, governs world's largest collaborative software project (28M LOC, 20k+ contributors) with "talk less, code more" violent aesthetics, technical Sisu. Core mechanism: minimal rules (kernel mailing list + maintainer trust chain) + absolute technical authority + refusal of bureaucratization. This exemplifies M151 Nordic Trust Capital realized at code layer—trust via code quality not contracts.
FI-SISU-001.reason_zh: 西斯不是盲目坚持，而是"在绝望中理性行动"。西尼海宁在物资匮乏时精准计算弹道；托瓦兹在混乱贡献中建立严格合并标准。两人跨军事/技术领域，展示 M35 愚公移山与 M51 自主研发的深层同构。
FI-SISU-001.reason_en: Sisu isn't blind persistence but "rational action in despair". Sininheimo calculated ballistics precisely amid shortages; Torvalds established strict merge standards amid chaotic contributions. Cross military/tech domains, showing deep isomorphism of M35 Foolish Old Man Moves Mountains & M51 Autonomous R&D.
steps_zh: 承认现实极限：冬战苏军 4:1 优势 / 开源项目混乱无序，不逃避不幻想
聚焦可控变量：防线几何/弹药分配 / 代码合并标准/维护者层级，极简规则
暴力美学执行："不合并垃圾代码" / "撤退即按计划延缓敌人"，零容忍妥协
信任链构建：维护者树状授权 / 军官团分级指挥，信任靠交付不靠头衔
代际传承与开放：Linux 基金会中立托管 / 芬兰国防大学战略教学，西斯成可传承资产
steps_en: Acknowledge hard limits: Winter War USSR 4:1 superiority / open source chaos, no denial no fantasy
Focus on controllable variables: line geometry/ammo allocation / merge standards/maintainer hierarchy, minimal rules
Violent aesthetics execution: "no merging garbage code" / "retreat = planned enemy delay", zero tolerance compromise
Trust chain building: maintainer tree delegation / officer corps graded command, trust via delivery not title
Intergenerational transmission & openness: Linux Foundation neutral stewardship / Finnish Defence University strategic teaching, Sisu becomes transmissible asset
FI-SISU-001.expected_zh: 小国在大国夹缝/技术垄断中，以"极简规则+绝对技术权威+文化韧性"构建非对称生存优势，输出全球公共品 (Linux/国防战略)。
FI-SISU-001.expected_en: Small nation in great power squeeze/tech monopoly builds asymmetric survival advantage via "minimal rules + absolute technical authority + cultural resilience", outputting global public goods (Linux/defense strategy).
FI-SISU-001.case_zh: Linux 运行全球 90%+ 服务器/超算/安卓手机；芬兰 1939-44 两次战争保持独立，冷战期"芬兰化"成中立生存范式。
FI-SISU-001.case_en: Linux runs 90%+ world servers/supercomputers/Android; Finland 1939-44 two wars kept independence, Cold War "Finlandization" became neutral survival paradigm.
FI-SISU-001.intellectual_tradition: Finnish Sisu / Hacker Culture / Open Source Governance
FI-SISU-001.cross_cultural_impact: Linux governance model for decentralized collaboration; Sisu concept adopted in global resilience literature
FI-SISU-001.diaspora_influence: Finnish-American in Minnesota/Upper Peninsula mining communities
FI-SISU-001.indigenous_knowledge_system: Sami traditional knowledge recognized in Finnish law (limited)

SA-WAH-001.name_zh: 伊本·沙乌德/阿卜杜勒-阿齐兹：瓦哈比伊斯兰教法治理与国家建构
SA-WAH-001.name_en: Ibn Saud/Abdulaziz: Wahhabi Islamic Governance & State-Building
SA-WAH-001.description_zh: 阿卜杜勒-阿齐兹·本·阿卜杜勒-拉赫曼·阿勒沙特 (1875-1953) 即伊本·沙乌德，以瓦哈比教义为意识形态核心，通过 Najd 根据地→收复利雅得 (1902)→征服哈萨 (1913)→统一希贾兹 (1925)→建立沙特阿拉伯王国 (1932)。核心治理机制：瓦哈比教法 (Hanbali 学派严格字面主义) 即国家法律、乌里玛 (宗教学者集团) 通过舒拉 (协商) 制衡王权、部落联盟 (伊赫万) 作为军事动员基础、石油收益 (1938 年发现) 分配确立社会契约。体现 M161 瓦克夫式伊斯兰现代慈善治理——宗教捐赠永久化、收益专款专用、社区自治管理，以及 M168 石油地缘战略。
SA-WAH-001.description_en: Abdulaziz bin Abdulrahman Al Saud (1875-1953) aka Ibn Saud, with Wahhabi doctrine as ideological core, from Najd base -> recaptured Riyadh (1902) -> conquered Al-Hasa (1913) -> unified Hejaz (1925) -> established Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (1932). Core governance mechanism: Wahhabi fiqh (Hanbali strict literalism) as state law, Ulama (religious scholars) check royal power via Shura (consultation), tribal alliance (Ikhwan) as military mobilization base, oil revenue (discovered 1938) distribution establishing social contract. Exemplifies M161 Waqf-style Islamic Modern Philanthropic Governance—religious endowments perpetual, proceeds earmarked, community self-governance—and M168 Oil/Mineral Geostrategy.
SA-WAH-001.reason_zh: 沙特建国非单纯军事征服，而是"教义+部落+教法"三位一体国家建构：瓦哈比教义提供合法性，伊赫万提供军事力量，教法提供治理框架。M161+M168 结合，区隔于 M149 伊斯兰咨询(决策)、M173 哈希姆合法性(血统)，核心在于"教法即宪法、部落即军队、石油即社会契约"。
SA-WAH-001.reason_en: Saudi state-building not mere military conquest but trinity of "doctrine+tribe+fiqh": Wahhabi doctrine provides legitimacy, Ikhwan provides military force, fiqh provides governance framework. M161+M168 combined, distinct from M149 Islamic Shura (decision-making) and M173 Hashemite Legitimacy (lineage), core: "fiqh as constitution, tribe as army, oil as social contract".
steps_zh: 教义合法性确立：1744 年沙特-瓦哈比盟约，教义即政治纲领
部落军事动员：伊赫万定居点化游牧部落，宗教狂热转化为征服动力
教法治理制度化：乌里玛委员会审议立法、司法独立于行政、哈奈菲/罕百里并存
石油社会契约锚定：1938 年达曼一号井→阿美公司合资→收益分配/免税/福利国家
现代化转型管理：法赫德国王 (1975-1982) 基建/教育/工业化，阿卜杜拉 (2005-2015) 女性权利/司法改革/MBS 2030 愿景
steps_en: Doctrinal legitimacy establishment: 1744 Saudi-Wahhabi pact, doctrine as political platform
Tribal military mobilization: Ikhwan settlements sedentarize nomads, religious zeal converts to conquest drive
Fiqh governance institutionalization: Ulama council reviews legislation, judiciary independent from admin, Hanafi/Hanbali coexistence
Oil social contract anchoring: 1938 Dammam No.1 -> Aramco JV -> revenue distribution/tax-free/welfare state
Modernization transition management: Fahd (1975-82) infra/education/industrialization, Abdullah (2005-15) women rights/judicial reform/MBS Vision 2030
SA-WAH-001.expected_zh: 部落联盟以"教法即宪法、石油为契约"机制建立现代国家，在传统教义与现代化压力中实现政权延续与战略自主。
SA-WAH-001.expected_en: Tribal alliance builds modern state via "fiqh as constitution, oil as contract" mechanism, achieving regime continuity & strategic autonomy amid traditional doctrine & modernization pressures.
SA-WAH-001.case_zh: 1902 收复利雅得→1932 建国→1938 发现石油→1973 石油禁运确立能源超级大国地位→2016 Vision 2030 启动后石油转型，90 年政权零更迭。
SA-WAH-001.case_en: 1902 Riyadh recaptured -> 1932 state founded -> 1938 oil discovered -> 1973 oil embargo establishes energy superpower status -> 2016 Vision 2030 launches post-oil transition, 90 years zero regime change.
SA-WAH-001.cross_cultural_impact: Wahhabi model for Islamic governance; OPEC founding; petrodollar recycling; Vision 2030 reform benchmark
SA-WAH-001.colonial_history: Ottoman suzerainty nominal; British protectorate relations 1915-1927
SA-WAH-001.resource_curse_mitigation: Aramco 50/50 profit sharing (1950) -> full nationalization (1980); SAMA sovereign wealth management; Vision 2030 diversification

SA-OIL-001.name_zh: 阿赫迈德·扎基·亚马尼/石油部长：石油地缘战略与 OPEC 权力架构
SA-OIL-001.name_en: Ahmed Zaki Yamani/Oil Ministers: Oil Geostrategy & OPEC Power Architecture
SA-OIL-001.description_zh: 阿赫迈德·扎基·亚马尼 (1930-2021) 担任沙特石油部长 1962-1986，OPEC 核心架构师。核心战略：1973 年石油禁运作为地缘政治武器，确立"石油换安全"美沙同盟框架；推动 OPEC 从价格接受者转为价格制定者，建立产量配额/官方售价/收入分配机制；倡导"公平价格"平衡产消国利益，避免西方替代能源研发加速。体现 M168 石油地缘战略——资源主权国家通过联合垄断重塑全球能源秩序，以及 M169 后石油转型前瞻（亚马尼早期投资下游炼化/石化/可再生能源）。
SA-OIL-001.description_en: Ahmed Zaki Yamani (1930-2021) served as Saudi Oil Minister 1962-1986, OPEC chief architect. Core strategy: 1973 oil embargo as geopolitical weapon, establishing "oil for security" US-Saudi alliance framework; drove OPEC from price-taker to price-setter, establishing production quotas/official selling prices/revenue allocation mechanisms; advocated "fair price" balancing producer-consumer interests, avoiding accelerated Western alternative energy R&D. Exemplifies M168 Oil Geostrategy—resource sovereign states reshaping global energy order via collective monopoly—and M169 Post-Oil Transition foresight (Yamani early invested in downstream refining/petrochemicals/renewables).
SA-OIL-001.reason_zh: 亚马尼非单纯技术官僚，而是"石油外交大师"：以资源垄断杠杆撬动地缘政治重构。M168 区隔于 M39 鸟笼经济(通用)、M169 后资源转型(后石油)，核心在于"石油即外交货币、OPEC 即地缘联盟、价格即战略工具"。
SA-OIL-001.reason_en: Yamani not mere technocrat but "oil diplomacy master": leveraging resource monopoly to restructure geopolitics. M168 distinct from M39 Birdcage Economy (general) and M169 Post-Resource Transition (post-oil), core: "oil as diplomatic currency, OPEC as geopolitical alliance, price as strategic tool".
steps_zh: OPEC 制度化建设：1960 年巴格达成立→1970s 配额/官方价/收入分配三大支柱确立
1973 禁运地缘杠杆：阿拉伯产油国减产/禁运西方，油价 4 倍，西方经济震荡
"石油换安全"框架：美军保护沙特/海湾安全，沙特维持产能/美元计价/回流国债
下游产业链延伸：投资炼厂/石化/航运/可再生能源，捕获全产业链价值
人才与标准输出：沙特石油大学/阿美培训/技术标准阿拉伯化，区域人才磁场
steps_en: OPEC institutionalization: 1960 Baghdad founding -> 1970s quotas/official prices/revenue allocation three pillars established
1973 embargo geopolitical lever: Arab producers cut/embargo West, oil price 4x, Western economic shock
"Oil for security" framework: US military protects Saudi/Gulf security, Saudi maintains capacity/dollar pricing/Treasury recycling
Downstream value chain extension: invest in refineries/petrochemicals/shipping/renewables, capture full value chain
Talent & standards export: KFUPM/Aramco training/technical standards Arabization, regional talent magnet
SA-OIL-001.expected_zh: 资源主权国家以"垄断定价+地缘杠杆+产业链延伸"三位一体，将地质禀赋转化为战略自主与代际财富，重塑全球能源治理规则。
SA-OIL-001.expected_en: Resource sovereign states achieve strategic autonomy & intergenerational wealth from geological endowment via trinity of "monopoly pricing + geopolitical leverage + value chain extension", reshaping global energy governance rules.
SA-OIL-001.case_zh: 1973 石油危机油价 $3→$12/桶；OPEC 市场份额峰值 55%；亚马尼 1986 年被解职前主导 24 年；阿美公司 1980 年全面国有化。
SA-OIL-001.case_en: 1973 oil crisis price $3->$12/bbl; OPEC market share peak 55%; Yamani led 24 years until 1986 dismissal; Aramco fully nationalized 1980.
SA-OIL-001.cross_cultural_impact: OPEC model for commodity cartels; petrodollar recycling; energy security doctrine
SA-OIL-001.colonial_history: Ottoman/British influence; Aramco US consortium origin
SA-OIL-001.resource_curse_mitigation: OPEC quota discipline; downstream diversification; Yamani personal renewables investment

SA-VIS-001.name_zh: 穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼/2030愿景：后石油转型治理与技术主权
SA-VIS-001.name_en: Mohammed bin Salman/Vision 2030: Post-Oil Transition Governance & Tech Sovereignty
SA-VIS-001.description_zh: 穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼 (1985-) 2015 年任王储，2016 启动《2030 愿景》：三大支柱——活力社会(旅游/文化/娱乐/体育)、繁荣经济(PIF 主权基金 7 万亿+、NEOM/红海/吉达新城、绿色氢能/半导体/生物技术)、雄心政府(数字化/透明化/女性劳动参与率 30%+)。核心张力：威权现代化 vs 社会保守主义、外资依赖 vs 技术主权、区域霸权 vs 国际孤立风险 (卡舒吉案/也门战争)。体现 M169 后石油转型治理——主权基金再投资锚定知识经济，以及 M158 通才整合——跨能源/科技/金融/城市规划/社会工程的全谱系国家转型工程。
SA-VIS-001.description_en: Mohammed bin Salman (1985-) Crown Prince 2015, launched Vision 2030 2016: three pillars—vibrant society (tourism/culture/entertainment/sports), thriving economy (PIF SWF $7T+, NEOM/Red Sea/Jeddah new cities, green hydrogen/semiconductors/biotech), ambitious government (digitalization/transparency/female labor participation 30%+). Core tensions: authoritarian modernization vs social conservatism, foreign capital dependency vs tech sovereignty, regional hegemony vs international isolation risk (Khashoggi/Yemen war). Exemplifies M169 Post-Oil Transition Governance—SWF reinvestment anchoring knowledge economy, and M158 Polymath Integration—full-spectrum national transformation engineering across energy/tech/finance/urban planning/social engineering.
SA-VIS-001.reason_zh: MBS 试图在单代人内完成"从石油租金国家到知识经济强国"的跨越，这是 M169 的极限压力测试：PIF 作为国家风投，NEOM 作为绿地实验区，社会开放作为人才磁场。区隔于 M168(缓解)、M170(稳定)，核心在于"单代人跨越式转型+主权基金充当国家风投+绿地新城实验"。
SA-VIS-001.reason_en: MBS attempts single-generation leap from 'oil rentier state to knowledge economy powerhouse', M169's extreme stress test: PIF as national VC, NEOM as greenfield lab, social opening as talent magnet. Distinct from M168 (mitigation) and M170 (stability), core: 'single-generational leapfrog transition + SWF as national venture capital + greenfield new city experiment'.
steps_zh: PIF 国家风投化：资产从 $1500 亿增至 $7 万亿+，投资 Uber/软银/卢西德/电子游戏/绿色氢能
NEOM 绿地实验区：$5000 亿零碳城市，The Line 线性城市/氢能出口/生物技术/旅游
社会契约重写：女性驾驶/娱乐开放/劳动法改革/反腐(利兹酒店) 重塑精英契约
数字政府与透明化：Absher/App 服务/开放数据/采购透明化/绩效考核 KPI
区域外交重构：海湾和解/以色列关系正常化探索/也门停火/红海安全联盟
steps_en: PIF as national VC: assets from $150B to $7T+, investing in Uber/SoftBank/Lucid/gaming/green hydrogen
NEOM greenfield lab: $500B zero-carbon city, The Line linear city/hydrogen export/biotech/tourism
Social contract rewrite: women driving/entertainment opening/labor law reform/anti-corruption (Ritz-Carlton) reshaping elite pact
Digital government & transparency: Absher app services/open data/procurement transparency/KPI performance mgmt
Regional diplomacy restructuring: Gulf reconciliation/Israel normalization exploration/Yemen ceasefire/Red Sea security alliance
SA-VIS-001.expected_zh: 单代人内完成后石油转型，实现"石油租金->主权基金->知识经济->技术主权"闭环，或成或败，为资源型国家提供极限案例。
SA-VIS-001.expected_en: Single-generational post-oil transition achieving 'oil rent->SWF->knowledge economy->tech sovereignty' closed loop, success or failure provides extreme case for resource states.
SA-VIS-001.case_zh: PIF 2023 资产 $7000 亿+；NEOM 2024 启动建设；女性劳动参与率 2017 20%→2023 35%；非石油收入占比 2016 38%→2023 50%+；但也门战争/卡舒吉案/人权争议持续。
SA-VIS-001.case_en: PIF 2023 assets $700B+; NEOM 2024 construction started; female labor participation 2017 20%->2023 35%; non-oil revenue 2016 38%->2023 50%+; but Yemen war/Khashoggi/human rights controversies persist.
SA-VIS-001.cross_cultural_impact: Vision 2030 benchmark for Gulf diversification; NEOM urban experiment; PIF global investment model
SA-VIS-001.colonial_history: No direct colonial rule; British treaty relations 1915-1927
SA-VIS-001.resource_curse_mitigation: PIF diversification; NEOM green hydrogen; non-oil revenue target 50% by 2030; ESG reporting

IQ-CAL-001.name_zh: 哈里发·本·阿卜杜拉/巴格达哈里发：伊斯兰教法哈里发治理与帝国秩序
IQ-CAL-001.name_en: Caliph al-Mansur/Baghdad Caliphs: Islamic Legal Caliphate Governance & Imperial Order
IQ-CAL-001.description_zh: 阿布·贾法尔·阿卜杜拉·阿勒·曼苏尔 (714-775) 阿拔斯王朝第二任哈里发，建立巴格达圆城 (762)，确立"哈里发-维齐尔-迪万"三权分立雏形：哈里发掌握宗教/军事最高权、维齐尔(宰相)统领行政、迪万(部门)分司其职。核心治理技术：伊斯兰教法 (Fiqh) 立法/司法统一、巴伊特马尔(国库)财政中央化、马立克/哈乃非/沙斐仪/罕百里四大法学派共存竞争、巴伊阿(效忠誓约)政治合法性。体现 M160 伊斯兰教法/哈里发治理——以神圣法为宪法、以学者阶层为官僚体系、以效忠誓约为政治契约。
IQ-CAL-001.description_en: Abu Ja'far Abdullah al-Mansur (714-775), 2nd Abbasid Caliph, built Round City of Baghdad (762), established proto-separation of powers 'Caliph-Vizier-Diwan': Caliph holds supreme religious/military authority, Vizier (chief minister) heads administration, Diwan (departments) divide jurisdiction. Core governance tech: Islamic law (Fiqh) legislative/judicial unification, Bayt al-Mal (treasury) fiscal centralization, four Sunni madhhabs (Maliki/Hanafi/Shafi'i/Hanbali) coexist & compete, Bay'ah (oath of allegiance) as political legitimacy. Exemplifies M160 Islamic Legal/Caliphal Governance—divine law as constitution, scholar class as bureaucracy, oath of allegiance as political contract.
IQ-CAL-001.reason_zh: 阿拔斯哈里发国非神权专制，而是"教法宪法+学者官僚+效忠契约"三位一体：哈里发受教法约束、卡迪(法官)独立裁判、乌里玛制衡王权。M160 区隔于 M149 伊斯兰咨询(舒拉决策)、M161 瓦克夫慈善(资产永久化)，核心在于"教法即宪法、学者即官僚、效忠即契约"的帝国级治理操作系统。
IQ-CAL-001.reason_en: Abbasid Caliphate not theocratic autocracy but trinity of 'fiqh constitution + scholar bureaucracy + allegiance contract': Caliph bound by fiqh, Qadis independent adjudication, Ulama check caliphal power. M160 distinct from M149 Islamic Shura (consultative decision) and M161 Waqf Philanthropy (asset perpetuity), core: 'fiqh as constitution, scholars as bureaucracy, allegiance as contract' imperial-grade governance OS.
steps_zh: 圆城规划与象征权力：762 年巴格达圆城，几何秩序映射宇宙/教法秩序
维齐尔制行政专业化：伊斯兰历史上首创宰相制度，迪万部门化(税收/军务/邮政/司法)
教法立法与司法独立：卡迪任命/罢免权在哈里发但判决依教法不可干预，四大法学派竞争繁荣
国库中央化与币制改革：迪纳尔/迪尔汗标准化、土地税(哈拉吉)/人头税(吉兹亚)制度化
翻译运动与知识帝国：贝特·希克马(智慧院)翻译希腊/波斯/印度学术，阿拉伯语成科学通用语
steps_en: Round city planning & symbolic power: 762 Round Baghdad, geometric order mirroring cosmic/fiqh order
Vizierate administrative professionalization: Islamic history's first vizier system, Diwan departmentalization (tax/military/post/judicial)
Fiqh legislation & judicial independence: Qadi appointment/removal by Caliph but judgment per fiqh non-interferable, four madhhabs compete & flourish
Treasury centralization & currency reform: Dinar/Dirham standardization, land tax (kharaj)/poll tax (jizya) systematized
Translation movement & knowledge empire: Bayt al-Hikma (House of Wisdom) translates Greek/Persian/Indian learning, Arabic becomes scientific lingua franca
IQ-CAL-001.expected_zh: 早期伊斯兰帝国以"教法宪法+学者官僚+翻译运动"三位一体，实现跨族群/跨语言/跨文明的超大规模知识政治整合，治理模式延续 500 年。
IQ-CAL-001.expected_en: Early Islamic empire achieves trans-ethnic/trans-linguistic/trans-civilizational mega-scale knowledge-political integration via trinity of 'fiqh constitution + scholar bureaucracy + translation movement', governance model lasts 500 years.
IQ-CAL-001.case_zh: 762 巴格达建城→786-809 哈伦·拉希德盛世→813-833 马文·拉希德/穆阿台绥姆→945 布耶王朝实权夺取→1258 蒙古灭巴格达，哈里发制名存实亡但教法治理遗产延续至今。
IQ-CAL-001.case_en: 762 Baghdad founded -> 786-809 Harun al-Rashid golden age -> 813-833 Al-Ma'mun/Al-Mu'tasim -> 945 Buyids seize real power -> 1258 Mongols sack Baghdad, caliphate nominal but fiqh governance legacy continues today.
IQ-CAL-001.intellectual_tradition: Abbasid Fiqh Governance / Islamic Legal Theory
IQ-CAL-001.cross_cultural_impact: Madhhab system for Islamic law; Bayt al-Hikma translation model; Diwan administrative template for Ottoman/Mughal/Safavid
IQ-CAL-001.resource_curse_mitigation: Bayt al-Mal fiscal discipline; waqf endowments for public goods; agricultural tax reform

IQ-NAT-001.name_zh: 费萨尔一世/建国元勋：部落联邦制治理与伊拉克建国
IQ-NAT-001.name_en: Faisal I/Founding Fathers: Tribal Federal Governance & Iraqi State-Building
IQ-NAT-001.description_zh: 费萨尔一世 (1885-1933) 哈希姆王朝，阿拉伯大起义领袖，叙利亚短暂称王 (1920)，英属委任统治下任伊拉克首任国王 (1921-1933)。核心治理挑战：超部落/超教派/超族群建国——逊尼/什叶/库尔德/亚述/犹太/马安达教共存。治理机制：部落酋长纳入议会/内阁(部落联邦制)、逊尼王室平衡什叶多数(教派共治)、石油特许权 (1925 IPC) 换取基建/军队现代化、1930 年英伊条约换取名义独立加入国联。体现 M170 部落联邦制治理——部落自治+中央名义主权+外部保护伞的脆弱平衡。
IQ-NAT-001.description_en: Faisal I (1885-1933), Hashemite, Arab Revolt leader, briefly King of Syria (1920), installed as Iraq's first King under British Mandate (1921-1933). Core governance challenge: supra-tribal/sectarian/ethnic state-building—Sunni/Shia/Kurd/Assyrian/Jewish/Mandaean coexistence. Mechanisms: tribal sheikhs into parliament/cabinet (tribal federalism), Sunni monarchy balances Shia majority (sectarian power-sharing), oil concession (1925 IPC) trades for infra/military modernization, 1930 Anglo-Iraqi Treaty exchanges nominal independence for League of Nations entry. Exemplifies M170 Tribal Federal Governance—tribal autonomy + nominal central sovereignty + external security umbrella, fragile equilibrium.
IQ-NAT-001.reason_zh: 伊拉克建国是"人为边界+天然分裂"的极限拼图：赛克斯-皮科协定划线、奥斯曼三省(巴格达/巴士拉/摩苏尔)强行合并。费萨尔以哈希姆合法性+部落联邦制+外交平衡，在英/法/土/波/沙五强夹缝中争取生存空间。M170 区隔于 M173 哈希姆合法性(血统)、M149 伊斯兰咨询(决策)，核心在于"部落联邦制作为人为国家的生存操作系统"。
IQ-NAT-001.reason_en: Iraq's state-building is 'artificial borders + natural divisions' extreme puzzle: Sykes-Picot lines, three Ottoman vilayets (Baghdad/Basra/Mosul) forcibly merged. Faisal leverages Hashemite legitimacy + tribal federalism + diplomatic balancing to carve survival space among UK/France/Turkey/Iran/Saudi five-power squeeze. M170 distinct from M173 Hashemite Legitimacy (lineage) and M149 Islamic Shura (decision), core: 'tribal federalism as survival OS for artificial nation'.
steps_zh: 哈希姆合法性移植：叙利亚失位→伊拉克称王，血统合法性跨国迁移
部落联邦制制度化：酋长进入议会/内阁，部落法庭并行国家司法，税收分成
教派平衡艺术：逊尼王室/什叶多数/库尔德自治，内阁按教派比例分配 (穆哈萨萨雏形)
石油换基建/军队：1925 IPC 特许权→铁路/公路/皇家伊拉克军队，主权部分兑换
外交生存平衡：1930 英伊条约入国联→1933 费萨尔猝逝→加齐/阿卜杜勒-伊拉维摄政→1958 君主制倒台
steps_en: Hashemite legitimacy transplant: lost Syria -> installed in Iraq, lineage legitimacy cross-border transfer
Tribal federalism institutionalization: sheikhs in parliament/cabinet, tribal courts parallel state judiciary, revenue sharing
Sectarian balance art: Sunni monarchy/Shia majority/Kurdish autonomy, cabinet by sectarian quota (muhasasa prototype)
Oil for infra/military: 1925 IPC concession -> rail/road/Royal Iraqi Army, partial sovereignty exchange
Diplomatic survival balance: 1930 Anglo-Iraqi Treaty -> League of Nations -> 1933 Faisal sudden death -> Ghazi/Abdulilah regency -> 1958 monarchy fall
IQ-NAT-001.expected_zh: 人为边界国家以"部落联邦制+教派权力分享+外部保护伞"三支柱维持脆弱统一，为后殖民国家建国提供反面教材与生存范式。
IQ-NAT-001.expected_en: Artificial-border nation maintains fragile unity via trinity of 'tribal federalism + sectarian power-sharing + external security umbrella', providing both cautionary tale & survival paradigm for post-colonial nation-building.
IQ-NAT-001.case_zh: 1921 费萨尔加冕→1925 IPC 石油→1930 英伊条约入国联→1933 费萨尔猝逝→1958 卡西姆政变君主制终结，37 年王朝在部落/教派/外部裂隙中崩塌。
IQ-NAT-001.case_en: 1921 Faisal crowned -> 1925 IPC oil -> 1930 Anglo-Iraqi Treaty -> League of Nations -> 1933 Faisal sudden death -> 1958 Qasim coup monarchy ends, 37-year dynasty collapses in tribal/sectarian/external fissures.
IQ-NAT-001.cross_cultural_impact: Tribal federalism model for artificial states; Hashemite legitimacy transfer; mandate-to-independence template
IQ-NAT-001.spiritual_tradition: Sunni Islam (Hashemite) / Shia majority / Kurdish secular
IQ-NAT-001.colonial_history: Ottoman 1534-1918; British Mandate 1920-1932; British military presence 1932-1958
IQ-NAT-001.diaspora_influence: Iraqi Jewish diaspora (1950-51 airlift); Assyrian diaspora; Shia scholarly networks to Iran/Najaf

IQ-MOD-001.name_zh: 萨达姆·侯赛因/现代化独裁：资源民族主义强人治理与生存博弈
IQ-MOD-001.name_en: Saddam Hussein/Modernizing Dictator: Resource Nationalist Strongman Governance & Survival Games
IQ-MOD-001.description_zh: 萨达姆·侯赛因 (1937-2006) 1979-2003 统治伊拉克，以石油民族主义为核心合法性：1972 年伊拉克石油公司国有化、1970s-80s 石油收益支撑免费医疗/教育/妇女权利/工业化，同时发动两河战争 (1980-88)、入侵科威特 (1990)、遭受海湾战争 (1991)/制裁/2003 年美军入侵被推翻。核心生存逻辑：资源垄断→再分配合法性→军队/安全部队(特别共和卫队/费达因)绑定→外部冒险转移内部矛盾→情报渗透社会( mukhabarat)。体现 M171 资源民族主义强人治理——资源国有化+收益再分配+反帝叙事+安全部队绑定的闭环生存模式。
IQ-MOD-001.description_en: Saddam Hussein (1937-2006) ruled Iraq 1979-2003, core legitimacy via oil nationalism: 1972 IPC nationalization, 1970s-80s oil revenue funded free healthcare/education/women rights/industrialization, while launching Iran-Iraq War (1980-88), invading Kuwait (1990), suffering Gulf War (1991)/sanctions/2003 US invasion toppled. Core survival logic: resource monopoly -> redistribution legitimacy -> military/security binding (Special Republican Guard/Fedayeen) -> external adventurism diverting internal contradictions -> intel penetration (mukhabarat). Exemplifies M171 Resource Nationalist Strongman Governance—closed loop of resource nationalization + revenue redistribution + anti-imperial narrative + security binding.
IQ-MOD-001.reason_zh: 萨达姆模式是"资源民族主义+强人统治+外部冒险"三位一体：石油财富买社会契约，战争转移阶级矛盾，安全部队保政权安全。M171 区隔于 M168(缓解)、M170(稳定)，核心在于"对抗性资源夺取+再分配合法性+安全部队绑定"的极限生存博弈。
IQ-MOD-001.reason_en: Saddam model is trinity of 'resource nationalism + strongman rule + external adventurism': oil wealth buys social contract, wars divert class contradictions, security apparatus guards regime. M171 distinct from M168 (mitigation) and M170 (stability), core: 'confrontational resource seizure + redistribution legitimacy + security binding' extreme survival game.
steps_zh: 石油国有化夺权：1972 年伊拉克石油公司国有化，打破西方垄断，资源主权成核心叙事
收益再分配契约：免费医疗/教育/妇女权利/住房/工业化，石油换社会契约
安全部队绑定政权：特别共和卫队/费达因/穆哈巴拉特三重保护，忠诚置换专业
外部冒险转移矛盾：两河战争消耗什叶激进/科威特战争争阿拉伯领袖/制裁期走私生存
最终崩塌与遗产：2003 美军入侵/萨达姆绞刑/巴士党解体/去巴士党化/教派内战/ISIS 崛起/重建艰难
steps_en: Oil nationalization power grab: 1972 IPC nationalization, breaks Western monopoly, resource sovereignty as core narrative
Revenue redistribution contract: free healthcare/education/women rights/housing/industrialization, oil for social contract
Security apparatus binding regime: Special Republican Guard/Fedayeen/Mukhabarat triple protection, loyalty replaces competence
External adventurism diverting contradictions: Iran-Iraq War consumes Shia radicals/Kuwait War claims Arab leadership/sanctions-era smuggling survival
Final collapse & legacy: 2003 US invasion/Saddam executed/Ba'ath dissolved/de-Ba'athification/sectarian civil war/ISIS rise/rebuilding struggles
IQ-MOD-001.expected_zh: 资源民族主义强人模式在单一资源依赖+外部压力+内部教派裂痕三重夹击下崩塌，留下"资源诅咒+强人陷阱+外部干预"三重警示。
IQ-MOD-001.expected_en: Resource nationalist strongman model collapses under triple squeeze of single-resource dependency + external pressure + internal sectarian fissures, leaving triple warning of 'resource curse + strongman trap + external intervention'.
IQ-MOD-001.case_zh: 1972 国有化→1980-88 两河战争百万伤亡→1990 入侵科威特→1991 海湾战争/制裁 13 年→2003 伊拉克战争/萨达姆绞刑→教派内战/ISIS/重建至今，石油财富未转化为持久发展。
IQ-MOD-001.case_en: 1972 nationalization -> 1980-88 Iran-Iraq War 1M casualties -> 1990 Kuwait invasion -> 1991 Gulf War/sanctions 13 years -> 2003 Iraq War/Saddam executed -> sectarian war/ISIS/rebuilding ongoing, oil wealth never converted to lasting development.
IQ-MOD-001.cross_cultural_impact: Strongman survival playbook; resource curse case study; de-Ba'athification lessons; WMD intelligence failure
IQ-MOD-001.resource_curse_mitigation: Failed: oil revenue funded wars not development; post-2003 oil law stalled; corruption endemic

SY-DIP-001.name_zh: 阿萨德家族/外交坚持：少数派生存外交与地缘杠杆
SY-DIP-001.name_en: Assad Dynasty/Diplomatic Persistence: Minority Survival Diplomacy & Geopolitical Leverage
SY-DIP-001.description_zh: 哈菲兹·阿萨德 (1930-2000) 1970-2000 统治，巴沙尔·阿萨德 (1965-) 2000- 继位，阿拉维派 (占人口 12%) 在逊尼多数 (74%) 国家中以少数派身份维持政权半个世纪。核心生存策略：少数派内部团结(阿拉维派控制军队/安全部队/核心精英)→大国代理人平衡(苏/俄军事援助+伊朗轴心+黎真主党)→情报/技术非对称优势( mukhabarat 渗透/化学武器威慑/网络战)→流散网络杠杆(黎巴嫩/海外阿拉维派/巴勒斯坦派系)。体现 M172 少数派生存外交——生存即胜利，在大国夹缝中以非对称杠杆维持战略自主。
SY-DIP-001.description_en: Hafez al-Assad (1930-2000) ruled 1970-2000, Bashar al-Assad (1965-) succeeded 2000-, Alawite minority (12% pop) in Sunni majority (74%) state maintains regime half-century. Core survival strategy: minority internal cohesion (Alawites control military/security/core elite) -> great power proxy balancing (USSR/Russia military aid + Iran axis + Hezbollah) -> intel/tech asymmetric advantage (mukhabarat penetration/chemical deterrence/cyber) -> diaspora network leverage (Lebanon/overseas Alawites/Palestinian factions). Exemplifies M172 Minority Survival Diplomacy—survival is victory, maintaining strategic autonomy via asymmetric leverage in great power interstices.
SY-DIP-001.reason_zh: 阿萨德政权非单纯暴力维持，而是"少数派团结+大国平衡+非对称杠杆"三位一体：阿拉维派内部零背叛、俄伊双重保护伞、化武/网络威慑西方干预。M172 区隔于 M182 巴尔干生存(区域)、M1 战略预判(通用)，核心在于"身份少数性+非对称杠杆+大国代理人平衡"的极限生存工程。
SY-DIP-001.reason_en: Assad regime not mere violence but trinity of 'minority cohesion + great power balancing + asymmetric leverage': Alawite zero-defection internally, dual Russo-Iranian security umbrella, chem/cyber deterrence against Western intervention. M172 distinct from M182 Balkan Survival (regional) and M1 Strategic Foresight (general), core: 'identity minority + asymmetric leverage + great power proxy balancing' extreme survival engineering.
steps_zh: 少数派核心圈构建：阿拉维派家族/部落/姻亲网络垄断军队/安全部队/核心经济部门
大国代理人双重保险：苏联/俄罗斯塔尔图斯海军基地+伊朗/黎真主党陆桥，双重安全伞
非对称威慑建设：化学武器/弹道导弹/网络战/电子战，提高西方干预成本
流散与代理人网络：黎巴嫩阿拉维派/海外资金/巴勒斯坦派系(人民阵线/解放组织)作地域缓冲
2011 危机生存：俄军 2015 直接介入/伊朗民兵/化武红线/重夺领土，政权存续代价毁灭性
steps_en: Minority core circle construction: Alawite family/tribal/marital networks monopolize military/security/key economic sectors
Great power proxy dual insurance: USSR/Russia Tartus naval base + Iran/Hezbollah land bridge, dual security umbrellas
Asymmetric deterrence building: chemical weapons/ballistic missiles/cyber warfare/electronic warfare, raising Western intervention costs
Diaspora & proxy networks: Lebanese Alawites/overseas funding/Palestinian factions (PFLP/PFLP-GC) as territorial buffer
2011 crisis survival: Russian 2015 direct intervention/Iran militias/chemical red lines/territory recapture, regime survives at catastrophic cost
SY-DIP-001.expected_zh: 少数派政权以"内部零背叛+外部双重伞+非对称威慑"三重锁存续半世纪，但代价是国家毁灭/百万难民/国际孤立，为少数派统治提供极限案例。
SY-DIP-001.expected_en: Minority regime persists half-century via trinity of 'internal zero-defection + external dual umbrella + asymmetric deterrence', at cost of state destruction/million refugees/international isolation, extreme case for minority rule.
SY-DIP-001.case_zh: 1970 哈菲兹政变→1982 哈马屠杀→2000 巴沙尔继位→2011 阿拉伯之春/内战/俄伊介入→2024 重控 70% 领土，50 万+ 死亡/1300 万流离失所/基建毁灭。
SY-DIP-001.case_en: 1970 Hafez coup -> 1982 Hama massacre -> 2000 Bashar succession -> 2011 Arab Spring/civil war/Russo-Iranian intervention -> 2024 controls 70% territory, 500k+ dead/13M displaced/infrastructure destroyed.
SY-DIP-001.cross_cultural_impact: Minority regime survival playbook; chemical weapons deterrence; Russia-Iran alliance template; refugee crisis management
SY-DIP-001.resource_curse_mitigation: Oil modest; phosphate; war economy; reconstruction funding contested

LB-CON-001.name_zh: 纳比赫·贝里/黎巴嫩共识制：教派协商制与权力分享
LB-CON-001.name_en: Nabih Berri/Lebanese Consensus: Confessional Consultation & Power-Sharing
LB-CON-001.description_zh: 纳比赫·贝里 (1938-) 1992- 任黎巴嫩议长，阿迈勒运动领袖，什叶派核心人物。黎巴嫩"教派协商制" (Confessionalism) 核心架构：1943 年国民契约(马龙派总统/逊尼总理/什叶议长/正教副总统/德鲁兹参谋长) -> 1989 年塔伊夫协议(权力下放/什叶提权/叙利亚保证人) -> 2005 叙军撤出/2008 多哈协议(否决权/团结政府)。贝里作为什叶"门神"，长期主持议会协商、调解教派冲突、平衡亲西方/亲伊朗轴心。体现 M149 伊斯兰咨询制/教派协商——以配额制/否决权/共识门槛替代多数决，在深度分裂社会中实现精英层面的冲突管理。
LB-CON-001.description_en: Nabih Berri (1938-) Speaker since 1992, Amal Movement leader, Shia core figure. Lebanon's 'Confessionalism' core architecture: 1943 National Pact (Maronite President/Sunni PM/Shia Speaker/Orthodox VP/Druze Chief of Staff) -> 1989 Taif Agreement (devolution/Shia empowerment/Syria guarantor) -> 2005 Syrian withdrawal/2008 Doha Agreement (veto/unity gov). Berri as Shia 'gatekeeper' long presides parliamentary consultation, mediates sectarian conflicts, balances pro-West/pro-Iran axes. Exemplifies M149 Islamic Shura/Consultation & Confessional Power-Sharing - quota/veto/consensus thresholds replace majority rule, achieving elite-level conflict management in deeply divided society.
LB-CON-001.reason_zh: 黎巴嫩非民主制而是"教派协商制"：18 个教派按人口比例分配权力，决策需跨教派共识。贝里 30 年议长生涯展示 M149 在实战中的运作——配额制防多数暴政、否决权保少数利益、共识门槛迫使妥协。区隔于 M146 乌班图(非洲)、M172 少数派生存(叙利亚)，核心在于"制度化教派配额+精英协商+外部保证人"的脆弱平衡。
LB-CON-001.reason_en: Lebanon not democracy but 'confessional consultation': 18 sects allocated power by demographic quota, decisions require cross-sectarian consensus. Berri's 30-year speakership demonstrates M149 in action - quota prevents majority tyranny, veto protects minority interests, consensus threshold forces compromise. Distinct from M146 Ubuntu (Africa) and M172 Minority Survival (Syria), core: 'institutionalized sectarian quota + elite consultation + external guarantor' fragile equilibrium.
steps_zh: 国民契约配额锚定：1943/1989/2008 三版配额，什叶从边缘走向核心(议长/财长/卫生部)
议会协商程序化：贝里主持《议事规则》，法案需两大阵营(3月14日/3月8日)共识才能通过
否决权实战运用：什叶部长集体辞职/议会抵制/街头动员，迫使对手让步(2006/2008/2019)
外部保证人平衡：叙利亚(1990-2005)/伊朗(真主党)/沙特/法国/美国轮番施压，贝里周旋其间
危机生存与代价：内战(1975-90)/政治真空(2014-16/2022-)/金融崩溃(2019-)，共识制维持国家不崩解但治理瘫痪
steps_en: National Pact quota anchoring: 1943/1989/2008 three quota versions, Shia from margin to core (Speaker/Finance/Health)
Parliamentary consultation proceduralized: Berri presides 'Rules of Procedure', bills need both camps (March 14/March 8) consensus to pass
Veto power tactical deployment: Shia ministers mass resign/parliament boycott/street mobilization, forcing concessions (2006/2008/2019)
External guarantor balancing: Syria (1990-05)/Iran(Hezbollah)/Saudi/France/US rotate pressure, Berri navigates between
Crisis survival & cost: civil war (1975-90)/political vacuum (2014-16/2022-)/financial collapse (2019-), consensus keeps state from collapse but governance paralyzed
LB-CON-001.expected_zh: 深度分裂社会以"制度化配额+精英协商+否决权"三支柱避免内战复燃，但治理效能极低，为多教派社会提供"生存优于治理"的反面范式。
LB-CON-001.expected_en: Deeply divided society avoids civil war relapse via trinity of 'institutionalized quota + elite consultation + veto power', but governance effectiveness near zero, providing 'survival over governance' cautionary paradigm for multi-sectarian societies.
LB-CON-001.case_zh: 1992-2024 连任 8 届议长；2006 真主党战争/2008 多哈协议/2019 金融崩溃/2022 真空 13 个月，议会 4 年 0 法案通过常态化，国家机能靠外部援助维持。
LB-CON-001.case_en: 1992-2024 re-elected 8 terms Speaker; 2006 Hezbollah war/2008 Doha/2019 financial collapse/2022 13-month vacuum, parliament 4 years 0 bills passed normalized, state functions sustained by foreign aid.
LB-CON-001.cross_cultural_impact: Confessionalism model for Iraq/Bosnia/Cyprus; Shia political empowerment; consensus democracy theory
LB-CON-001.spiritual_tradition: Shia Islam (Amal/Hezbollah) / Maronite Catholic / Sunni / Druze / Orthodox
LB-CON-001.colonial_history: French Mandate 1920-1943; Ottoman Mount Lebanon autonomy
LB-CON-001.resource_curse_mitigation: No oil; banking secrecy (pre-2019); remittance dependency; port explosion 2020

JO-HAS-001.name_zh: 约旦·阿卜杜拉二世：哈希姆巴勒斯坦和平与水难民危机
JO-HAS-001.name_en: Jordan Abdullah II: Hashemite Palestine Peace & Water Refugee Crisis
JO-HAS-001.description_zh: 阿卜杜拉二世 (1962-) 约旦国王 (1999-)，哈希姆王朝守护耶路撒冷圣地，1994约旦以色列和平条约，巴勒斯坦难民占人口60%水资源极度匮乏，平衡美以巴三方博弈。
JO-HAS-001.description_en: Abdullah II (1962-) Jordan King (1999-), Hashemite dynasty guards Jerusalem holy sites, 1994 Jordan-Israel peace treaty, Palestinian refugees 60% population water extremely scarce, balances US-Israel-Palestine three-way game.
JO-HAS-001.reason_zh: 阿卜杜拉代表哈希姆王朝如何在巴以冲突核心地带通过和平条约与圣地监护维持合法性，展示了水资源匮乏与难民负担如何成为小国生存的硬约束，其平衡外交为地区稳定提供关键缓冲。
JO-HAS-001.reason_en: Abdullah represents how Hashemite dynasty maintains legitimacy in Israel-Palestine conflict core through peace treaty and holy site guardianship, demonstrating how water scarcity and refugee burden become small state survival hard constraints, his balancing diplomacy providing critical buffer for regional stability.
steps_zh: 研究阿卜杜拉早年英国军校与王储准备
分析1994年瓦迪阿拉巴和平条约与圣地监护权
探讨巴勒斯坦难民安置与水资源危机管理
评估阿拉伯春天约旦稳定与叙利亚难民涌入
总结哈希姆巴勒斯坦和平水难民对约旦生存空间的界定
steps_en: Study Abdullah early British military academy and crown prince preparation
Analyze 1994 Wadi Araba peace treaty and holy site guardianship
Explore Palestinian refugee settlement and water crisis management
Evaluate Arab Spring Jordan stability and Syrian refugee influx
Summarize Hashemite Palestine peace water refugee defining Jordan survival space
JO-HAS-001.expected_zh: 掌握哈希姆圣地监护与和平条约双重合法性来源，理解水难民双重危机如何重塑小国外交自主边界，评估约旦模式对黎巴嫩巴勒斯坦权力机构的示范与差异。
JO-HAS-001.expected_en: Master Hashemite holy guardianship and peace treaty dual legitimacy sources, grasp how water-refugee dual crisis reshapes small state diplomatic autonomy boundaries, evaluate Jordan model demonstration and divergence for Lebanon Palestinian Authority.
JO-HAS-001.case_zh: 1999 国王；1994 和平；水危机；难民60%。哈希姆巴勒斯坦和平水难民范式永存。
JO-HAS-001.case_en: 1999 King; 1994 peace; water crisis; refugees 60%. Hashemite Palestine peace water refugee paradigm endures.
JO-HAS-001.intellectual_tradition: Hashemite Monarchy / Peace Process / Water Diplomacy
JO-HAS-001.cross_cultural_impact: Peace treaty; holy sites; Palestinian refugees; water diplomacy

PS-NAT-001.name_zh: 阿拉法特/巴勒斯坦建国：民族建国与抵抗外交
PS-NAT-001.name_en: Arafat/Palestinian Nation-Building: National Liberation & Resistance Diplomacy
PS-NAT-001.description_zh: 亚西尔·阿拉法特 (1929-2004) 法塔赫创始人、巴解组织主席 (1969-2004)、巴勒斯坦民族权力机构首任主席 (1996-2004)。核心建国逻辑：武装斗争合法性(游击战/焦点理论)→流散动员(难民营/海外巴勒斯坦人/阿拉伯国家支持)→国际外交突围(1974 联大演讲/1988 宣布建国/1993 奥斯陆协议/1994 诺贝尔和平奖)→自治实体建设(巴权机构/安全部队/市政服务)。体现 M170 部落/民族建国——以游击战+流散网络+外交突围三位一体，在无领土/无主权/无军队极限条件下建构民族政治主体。
PS-NAT-001.description_en: Yasser Arafat (1929-2004) Fatah founder, PLO Chairman (1969-2004), PA first President (1996-2004). Core nation-building logic: armed struggle legitimacy (guerrilla/foco theory) -> diaspora mobilization (refugee camps/overseas Palestinians/Arab state support) -> international diplomatic breakout (1974 UNGA speech/1988 declaration of independence/1993 Oslo Accords/1994 Nobel Peace Prize) -> autonomy entity building (PA/security forces/municipal services). Exemplifies M170 Tribal/National Liberation Governance—trinity of guerrilla warfare + diaspora network + diplomatic breakout constructing national political subject under extreme conditions of no territory/no sovereignty/no army.
PS-NAT-001.reason_zh: 巴勒斯坦建国是"无地建国"极限案例：1948 纳克巴流散、1967 全境被占、无主权/无边界/无军队。阿拉法特以"枪杆子+外交舌头+流散网络"三位一体，在以色列/美国/阿拉伯/苏联四强夹缝中争取国际法主体资格。M170 区隔于 M173 哈希姆合法性(血统)、M149 伊斯兰咨询(决策)，核心在于"游击战建国+流散即领土+外交突围"的无地民族建构范式。
PS-NAT-001.reason_en: Palestinian nation-building is 'stateless state-building' extreme case: 1948 Nakba displacement, 1967 full occupation, no sovereignty/no borders/no army. Arafat with trinity of 'gun + diplomatic tongue + diaspora network' carved international legal personality in Israel/US/Arab/USSR four-power squeeze. M170 distinct from M173 Hashemite Legitimacy (lineage) and M149 Islamic Shura (decision), core: 'guerrilla state-building + diaspora as territory + diplomatic breakout' stateless nation-construction paradigm.
steps_zh: 武装斗争确立合法性：1965 法塔赫首次行动/1968 卡拉迈战役/1974 联大"枪与橄榄枝"演讲，游击战成民族代表权来源
流散网络动员领土化：难民营(约旦/黎巴嫩/叙利亚)成准领土、海外巴勒斯坦人(智利/洪都拉斯/欧美)成外交/资助网络、UNRWA 服务成准政府职能
外交突围与国际法主体化：1974 联大观察员/1988 阿尔及尔宣布建国/1993 奥斯陆互认/1994 诺奖/1996 当选主席
自治实体建设与局限：巴权机构/安全部队/市政/教育/卫生，但无主权/无边境控制/无耶路撒冷/定居点持续扩张
遗产与未竟：阿拉法特 2004 逝世/阿布·马祖恩继任/分裂(法塔赫/哈马斯)/两国方案停滞/国际法诉讼/ICC 调查持续
steps_en: Armed struggle establishes legitimacy: 1965 Fatah first op/1968 Karameh battle/1974 UNGA 'gun and olive branch' speech, guerrilla war as source of national representation

Diaspora network mobilizes as territory: refugee camps (Jordan/Lebanon/Syria) as quasi-territory, overseas Palestinians (Chile/Honduras/West) as diplomatic/funding network, UNRWA services as quasi-gov functions
Diplomatic breakout & international legal subjectivity: 1974 UNGA observer/1988 Algiers declaration/1993 Oslo mutual recognition/1994 Nobel/1996 elected President
Autonomy entity construction & limits: PA/security/municipal/education/health, but no sovereignty/no border control/no Jerusalem/settlements keep expanding
Legacy & unfinished: Arafat 2004 death/Abbas succession/split (Fatah/Hamas)/two-state stalled/ICJ proceedings/ICC investigation ongoing
PS-NAT-001.expected_zh: 无领土/无主权/无军队民族以"游击战+流散网络+外交突围"三位一体建构国际法主体，虽未完成建国但确立了巴勒斯坦民族不可逆的政治主体性。
PS-NAT-001.expected_en: Stateless/sovereign-less/army-less nation constructs international legal subjectivity via trinity of 'guerrilla warfare + diaspora network + diplomatic breakout', though statehood incomplete, established Palestinian nation's irreversible political subjectivity.
PS-NAT-001.case_zh: 1964 巴解成立→1969 阿拉法特任主席→1974 联大观察员→1988 宣布建国→1993 奥斯陆/1994 诺奖→2000 坎普大卫失败/第二次起义→2004 阿拉法特逝世→分裂/停滞至今。
PS-NAT-001.case_en: 1964 PLO founded -> 1969 Arafat chairman -> 1974 UNGA observer -> 1988 declaration -> 1993 Oslo/1994 Nobel -> 2000 Camp David failed/Second Intifada -> 2004 Arafat death -> split/stalemate ongoing.
PS-NAT-001.intellectual_tradition: Palestinian National Liberation / Armed Struggle Diplomacy
PS-NAT-001.cross_cultural_impact: National liberation movement template; diaspora as territory concept; armed struggle to diplomacy transition; ICC/ICJ precedent
PS-NAT-001.diaspora_influence: Palestinian diaspora 6M+ (Jordan/Lebanon/Syria/Chile/US/Europe); refugee camps as political units
PS-NAT-001.indigenous_knowledge_system: Palestinian oral history (Nakba testimony); fellahin agricultural calendar; keffiyeh symbolism

CA-CON-001.name_zh: 麦克唐纳/皮尔逊/联邦奠基人：联邦共识制与责任政府
CA-CON-001.name_en: Macdonald/Pearson/Federal Founders: Federal Consensus & Responsible Government
CA-CON-001.description_zh: 约翰·麦克唐纳 (1815-1891) 加拿大首任总理，主导 1867 《英属北美法案》建立联邦制，以"太平洋铁路"捆绑西部入盟；莱斯特·皮尔逊 (1897-1972) 推动《权利法案》前身、旗帜/医保/养老金、诺贝尔和平奖得主（苏伊士运河维和）。两人跨保守/自由党，共同体现 M164 联邦共识制——以"责任政府+联邦分权+跨党派妥协"三位一体，在英法双文化张力中构建可扩展的联邦契约。
CA-CON-001.description_en: John A. Macdonald (1815-1891) Canada's first PM, drove 1867 British North America Act establishing federation, bound West via "transcontinental railway"; Lester B. Pearson (1897-1972) advanced Bill of Rights precursor, flag/medicare/pensions, Nobel Peace laureate (Suez peacekeeping). Across Conservative/Liberal, both exemplify M164 Federal Consensus—trinity of "responsible government + federal devolution + cross-party compromise" building expandable federal contract amid Anglo-Franco cultural tension.
CA-CON-001.reason_zh: 加拿大非单一民族国家，联邦制源于"英法双文化妥协+原住民条约+移民多元化"三重契约。麦克唐纳奠定联邦骨架，皮尔逊将其现代化为多元文化福利国家。M164 区隔于 M149 伊斯兰咨询(舒拉)、M162 多元文化联邦(当代)，核心在于"责任政府+联邦分权"的渐进式契约扩展。
CA-CON-001.reason_en: Canada not a single-nation state, federation rooted in trinity of 'Anglo-Franco compromise + indigenous treaties + immigrant pluralism'. Macdonald laid federal skeleton, Pearson modernized into multicultural welfare state. M164 distinct from M149 Islamic Shura (consultation) and M162 Multicultural Federation (contemporary), core: 'responsible government + federal devolution' gradual contract expansion.
steps_zh: 1867 联邦奠基：英属北美法案确立联邦/省分权、君主立宪、责任政府
国家横贯铁路：CPR 1885 完工，物理捆绑不列颠哥伦比亚入盟，主权延伸至太平洋
双文化制度化：魁北克民法典/天主教学校权利联邦宪法保护，英语省普通法并存
皮尔逊现代化：1965 新旗帜/1966 医保/1967 养老金/《权利法案》前身，福利国家联邦化
1982 宪法本土化：特鲁多父主导《权利与自由宪章》、修正公式、原住民权利第 35 条
steps_en: 1867 Confederation founding: BNA Act establishes federal/provincial division, constitutional monarchy, responsible government
Transcontinental railway: CPR 1885 completed, physically binds BC entry, sovereignty extends to Pacific
Bicultural institutionalization: Quebec civil code/Catholic school rights constitutionally protected, common law provinces coexist
Pearson modernization: 1965 new flag/1966 medicare/1967 pensions/Bill of Rights precursor, welfare state federalized
1982 Constitution patriation: Trudeau père drives Charter of Rights/f amending formula/indigenous rights s.35
CA-CON-001.expected_zh: 以"责任政府+联邦分权+跨文化妥协"三位一体，实现从殖民地自治领到多元文化联邦国家的渐进式演进，零内战/零分裂。
CA-CON-001.expected_en: Trinity of 'responsible government + federal devolution + cross-cultural compromise' achieves gradual evolution from colonial dominion to multicultural federal state, zero civil war/zero secession.
CA-CON-001.case_zh: 1867 四省联邦→1870 魁北克/曼尼托巴→1871 BC→1873 PEI→1898 育空→1905 阿尔伯塔/萨省→1949 纽芬兰→1999 努纳武特，联邦弹性容纳 10 省 3 地。
CA-CON-001.case_en: 1867 four-province confederation -> 1870 QC/MB -> 1871 BC -> 1873 PEI -> 1898 Yukon -> 1905 AB/SK -> 1949 NL -> 1999 NU, federal elasticity accommodates 10 provinces 3 territories.
CA-CON-001.intellectual_tradition: Canadian Federalism / Responsible Government / Bicultural Compact
CA-CON-001.cross_cultural_impact: Federal model for diverse societies; bilingual constitutionalism; peaceful accommodation template
CA-CON-001.colonial_history: British/French colonial origins; Confederation 1867; gradual sovereignty
CA-CON-001.resource_curse_mitigation: Resource revenue sharing (equalization payments); provincial resource ownership (s.92A)
CA-CON-001.climate_adaptation: Northern infrastructure; permafrost engineering; ice road logistics

CA-MUL-001.name_zh: 特鲁多/多元文化主义先驱：多元文化联邦制与包容性公民身份
CA-MUL-001.name_en: Trudeau/Multiculturalism Pioneers: Multicultural Federation & Inclusive Citizenship
CA-MUL-001.description_zh: 皮埃尔·特鲁多 (1919-2000) 1971 年正式宣布"多元文化主义政策"，世界首创；1982 《权利与自由宪章》确立平等权/多元文化条款 (s.27)；贾斯汀·特鲁多 (1971-) 推进性别平衡内阁、原住民和解 (TRC)、难民接纳 (叙利亚 4 万+)。父子跨代共同体现 M174 多元文化联邦制——以"宪章权利+多元文化政策+移民积分制+原住民国家间关系"四支柱，将差异制度化为联邦粘合剂。
CA-MUL-001.description_en: Pierre Trudeau (1919-2000) declared 'Multiculturalism Policy' 1971, world first; 1982 Charter entrenched equality/multiculturalism (s.27); Justin Trudeau (1971-) advances gender-balanced cabinet, indigenous reconciliation (TRC), refugee intake (Syria 40k+). Father-son cross-generational jointly exemplify M174 Multicultural Federation—four pillars of 'Charter rights + multicultural policy + immigration points system + indigenous nation-to-nation relations' institutionalizing difference as federal glue.
CA-MUL-001.reason_zh: 加拿大多元文化非自然演变，而是"宪法权利+政策宣言+积分移民+原住民和解"四位一体工程建构。皮埃尔奠定法律基础，贾斯汀将其操作化为治理常态。M174 区隔于 M146 乌班图(非洲共同体)、M162 多元文化联邦(理论)，核心在于"宪法锚定差异包容+移民筛选机制+原住民自决"的治理三角。
CA-MUL-001.reason_en: Canadian multiculturalism not organic evolution but engineered trinity of 'constitutional rights + policy declaration + points immigration + indigenous reconciliation'. Pierre laid legal foundation, Justin operationalized as governance norm. M174 distinct from M146 Ubuntu (African communal) and M162 Multicultural Federation (theory), core: 'constitution-anchored difference inclusion + immigration screening + indigenous self-determination' governance triangle.
steps_zh: 1971 政策宣言：特鲁多父在下议院宣布多元文化主义为联邦政策，承认双语框架内的多元文化
1982 宪章锚定：权利与自由宪章 s.15 平等权 + s.27 多元文化解释条款，司法可强制执行
积分移民制度化：1967 积分制/2002 IRPA/2015 快速通道，技能/语言/适应性量化筛选，年均 30 万+

steps_en: 1971 Policy declaration: Trudeau père announces multiculturalism as federal policy in Commons, recognizing pluralism within bilingual framework
1982 Charter anchoring: Charter s.15 equality + s.27 multicultural interpretive clause, judicially enforceable
Points immigration institutionalization: 1967 points/2002 IRPA/2015 Express Entry, skills/language/adaptability quantified screening, 300k+ annually

Gender/refugee/climate extension: gender-balanced cabinet/Syrian refugees 40k+/carbon tax/2030 net-zero, inclusivity spills to global governance

CA-RES-001.name_zh: 资源联邦主义/北极治理先驱：资源联邦主义与西北航道主权
CA-RES-001.name_en: Resource Federalism/Arctic Governance Pioneers: Resource Federalism & Northwest Passage Sovereignty
CA-RES-001.description_zh: 加拿大资源联邦主义由三代建构者跨越百年共进：克里福德·西夫顿 (1861-1929) 劳里埃政府内阁部长，推动西部拓荒/移民/资源开发，奠定"资源联邦"经济基础；皮埃尔·特鲁多 (1919-2000) 1980 国家能源规划 (NEP) 试图联邦控制石油收益，虽失败但确立联邦能源管辖权；斯蒂芬·哈珀 (1959-) 推动北极主权军事化 (纳努维克基地/北极巡逻舰/北极演习)、西北航道内水主张、资源开发审批加速。三人跨自由/保守党，共同体现 M175 资源联邦主义——以"省有资源/联邦管辖/收益均等化/北极主权"四支柱，在联邦制框架内平衡资源民族主义与国家统一。
CA-RES-001.description_en: Canadian resource federalism built by three generations: Clifford Sifton (1861-1929) Laurier cabinet minister drove western settlement/immigration/resource development, laying 'resource federation' economic base; Pierre Trudeau (1919-2000) 1980 National Energy Program (NEP) attempted federal control of oil revenues, failed but entrenched federal energy jurisdiction; Stephen Harper (1959-) advanced Arctic sovereignty militarization (Nanisivik base/Arctic patrol ships/Arctic exercises), Northwest Passage internal waters claim, resource development fast-tracking. Across Liberal/Conservative, all three exemplify M175 Resource Federalism—four pillars of 'provincial resource ownership + federal jurisdiction + revenue equalization + Arctic sovereignty' balancing resource nationalism & national unity within federal framework.
CA-RES-001.reason_zh: 加拿大资源治理独特在于"省有资源(宪法 92A)+联邦管辖(贸易/环境/原住民)+均等化支付(宪法 36)+北极主权"四重锚定。西夫顿开发西部，特鲁多争联邦权，哈珀守北极主权。M175 区隔于 M39 鸟笼经济(通用)、M174 多元文化联邦(社会)、M176 北极治理(国际法)，核心在于"联邦制内的资源主权平衡+北极地缘战略"。
CA-RES-001.reason_en: Canadian resource governance unique in four anchors: 'provincial resource ownership (s.92A) + federal jurisdiction (trade/environment/indigenous) + equalization (s.36) + Arctic sovereignty'. Sifton opened West, Trudeau fought for federal power, Harper defended Arctic sovereignty. M175 distinct from M39 Birdcage Economy (general), M174 Multicultural Federation (social), M176 Arctic Governance (international law), core: 'resource sovereignty balance within federalism + Arctic geostrategy'.
steps_zh: 西部资源开发奠基：西夫顿 1896-1905 移民政策/铁路土地赠与/西部小麦经济，确立资源出口导向
国家能源规划冲突：1980 NEP 联邦税/价格控制/石油自给，阿省强烈反对，1985 取消但确立联邦能源权
均等化支付宪法化：1982 宪法 s.36 承诺"合理可比水平"公共服务，资源富省转移支付资源穷省
北极主权军事化：哈珀 2006-2015 纳努维克深水港/北极巡逻舰/年度北极演习/西北航道内水主张
原住民资源共治：影响评估法/自由事先知情同意 (FPIC)/现代条约资源收益分享，联邦制内共治
steps_en: Western resource development foundation: Sifton 1896-1905 immigration policy/railway land grants/wheat economy, establishing resource export orientation
National Energy Program conflict: 1980 NEP federal tax/price controls/oil self-sufficiency, Alberta fierce opposition, 1985 cancelled but federal energy jurisdiction entrenched
Equalization constitutionalization: 1982 Constitution s.36 commits to 'reasonably comparable' public services, resource-rich provinces transfer to resource-poor
Arctic sovereignty militarization: Harper 2006-2015 Nanisivik deepwater port/Arctic patrol ships/annual Arctic exercises/Northwest Passage internal waters claim
Indigenous resource co-governance: Impact Assessment Act/FPIC/modern treaty revenue sharing, co-governance within federalism
CA-RES-001.expected_zh: 以"省有资源+联邦管辖+均等化+北极主权"四重锚定，实现资源富省/资源穷省/北极原住民三方利益平衡，资源联邦主义指数全球领先。
CA-RES-001.expected_en: Four anchors of 'provincial resources + federal jurisdiction + equalization + Arctic sovereignty' achieve balance among resource-rich/provinces, resource-poor provinces, Arctic indigenous peoples, resource federalism index globally leading.
CA-RES-001.case_zh: 阿尔伯塔油砂/萨省钾肥/纽芬兰海上油田/北极矿产，省有联邦管；均等化支付 2023 $240 亿；北极演习 Operation NANOOK 年度化；西北航道争端美加管控。
CA-RES-001.case_en: AB oil sands/SK potash/NL offshore oil/Arctic minerals, provincial ownership federal jurisdiction; equalization 2023 $24B; Operation NANOOK annualized; Northwest Passage dispute US-Canada managed.
CA-RES-001.cross_cultural_impact: Resource federalism model for federations; Arctic sovereignty law; equalization payment design

CA-RES-001.diaspora_influence: Resource sector global talent; Canadian mining diaspora worldwide

CA-ART-001.name_zh: 玛格丽特·阿特伍德/原住民艺术家：离散叙事与加拿大书写
CA-ART-001.name_en: Margaret Atwood/Indigenous Artists: Diasporic Narrative & Canadian Writing
CA-ART-001.description_zh: 玛格丽特·阿特伍德 (1939-) 《使女的故事》/《盲刺客》/《奥丽克与克雷克》三部曲，以推想小说重构加拿大生存焦虑：严冬/荒野/殖民/性别/环境崩溃；原住民艺术家群体 (诺瓦利亚/肯·奥吉克/丽贝卡·贝尔莫) 以装置/行为/影像重构"龟岛"本体论——土地即法律、记忆即抵抗、创作即治愈。跨定居者/原住民两大传统，共同体现 M165 离散叙事书写——以"生存叙事+土地本体论+记忆导航"三重技法，在殖民创伤中重构文化主权。
CA-ART-001.description_en: Margaret Atwood (1939-) 'Handmaid's Tale'/'Blind Assassin'/'Oryx and Crake' trilogy, speculative fiction reconstructs Canadian survival anxieties: harsh winter/wilderness/colonialism/gender/ecological collapse; Indigenous artist collective (Norval Morrisseau/Kenojuak Ashevak/Rebecca Belmore) via installation/performance/video reconstruct 'Turtle Island' ontology—land as law, memory as resistance, creation as healing. Across settler/indigenous two traditions, jointly exemplify M165 Diasporic Narrative Writing—triple technique of 'survival narrative + land ontology + memory navigation' reconstructing cultural sovereignty amid colonial trauma.
CA-ART-001.reason_zh: 加拿大文学非单一民族书写，而是"定居者生存焦虑+原住民土地本体论"双重张力场。阿特伍德以推想小说投射集体无意识，原住民艺术家以土地本体论重构主权。M165 区隔于 M155 魔幻现实(拉美)、M154 梦境时间(澳洲)，核心在于"殖民创伤语境下的双重文化主权重构"。
CA-ART-001.reason_en: Canadian literature not single-nation writing but dual tension field of 'settler survival anxiety + indigenous land ontology'. Atwood projects collective unconscious via speculative fiction, indigenous artists reconstruct sovereignty via land ontology. M165 distinct from M155 Magical Realism (Latin America) and M154 Dreamtime Navigation (Australia), core: 'dual cultural sovereignty reconstruction under colonial trauma context'.
steps_zh: 生存叙事确立：阿特伍德《生存》确立加拿大文学核心主题——生存而非胜利，严冬/荒野/殖民者身份
推想小说投射焦虑：《使女的故事》神权极权/《奥丽克与克雷克》生物技术崩溃，技术/环境/性别三重恐惧
原住民土地本体论重构：莫里索《药轮》、奥吉克《因纽特母神》、贝尔莫《警觉》装置，土地即法律/记忆/主权
记忆导航与真相和解：TRC 94 项呼吁/寄宿学校档案/语言复振，创作成治愈/证言/抵抗三合一
跨文化对话与共同未来：阿特伍德支持原住民权利/原住民艺术家参与主流双年展，双重主权走向共生
steps_en: Survival narrative establishment: Atwood's 'Survival' defines Canadian lit core theme—survival not victory, harsh winter/wilderness/settler identity
Speculative fiction projecting anxieties: 'Handmaid's Tale' theocratic totalitarianism/'Oryx and Crake' biotech collapse, tech/environment/gender triple fear
Indigenous land ontology reconstruction: Morrisseau 'Medicine Wheel'/Ashevak 'Inuit Mother Goddess'/Belmore 'Vigil' installation, land as law/memory/sovereignty
Memory navigation & truth reconciliation: TRC 94 Calls/residential school archives/language revitalization, creation as healing/testimony/resistance triad
Cross-cultural dialogue & shared future: Atwood supports indigenous rights/indigenous artists in mainstream biennales, dual sovereignty toward symbiosis
CA-ART-001.expected_zh: 以"生存叙事+土地本体论+记忆导航"三重技法，在殖民创伤中重构定居者/原住民双重文化主权，加拿大文学国际话语权长期全球前列。
CA-ART-001.expected_en: Triple technique of 'survival narrative + land ontology + memory navigation' reconstructs settler/indigenous dual cultural sovereignty amid colonial trauma, Canadian literature international discourse power consistently global top tier.
CA-ART-001.case_zh: 阿特伍德 布克奖/总督奖/诺贝尔奖提名；原住民艺术家威尼斯双年展/多伦多双年展/国家美术馆收藏；加拿大文学研究全球学科标准。
CA-ART-001.case_en: Atwood Booker/Governor General/Nobel nomination; indigenous artists Venice Biennale/Toronto Biennial/National Gallery collections; Canadian literature studies global disciplinary standard.
CA-ART-001.intellectual_tradition: Canadian Diasporic Literature / Indigenous Land Ontology
CA-ART-001.cross_cultural_impact: Speculative fiction as social critique; indigenous art as sovereignty practice; TRC cultural dimension
CA-ART-001.diaspora_influence: Canadian literary diaspora global; Atwood global icon
CA-ART-001.indigenous_knowledge_system: Anishinaabe/Inuit/Cree/Métis land-based knowledge; oral storytelling; medicine wheel

CA-SMI-001.name_zh: 萨米议会/驯鹿游牧领袖：萨米协商制与驯鹿游牧自治
CA-SMI-001.name_en: Sami Parliament/Reindeer Herding Leaders: Sami Consultative Governance & Reindeer Pastoral Autonomy
CA-SMI-001.description_zh: 萨米议会 (Sámediggi) 1989 年在挪威成立，1993 瑞典、1996 芬兰跟进，是跨国原住民主权的先锋实验。核心治理机制：廷特 (Tingt) 协商会议制——村落代表通过共识决策放牧区轮牧/捕鱼配额/矿业协商；约伊克 (Joik) 口述传统编码生态知识；驯鹿放牧区 (Sameby) 集体所有制与轮牧制度。萨米议会虽无立法权，但拥有咨询权/否决权/预算权，强制国家在采矿/风电/铁路项目上进行自由事先知情同意 (FPIC)。体现 M176 萨米协商制——以"跨国议会+驯鹿游牧生计+约伊克知识编码"三位一体，在现代国家体系中实现原住民主权的制度化突围。
CA-SMI-001.description_en: Sami Parliament (Sámediggi) founded 1989 Norway, 1993 Sweden, 1996 Finland, pioneering transnational indigenous sovereignty experiment. Core governance mechanism: Tingt consultative councils—village representatives decide by consensus on grazing rotation/fishing quotas/mining negotiations; Joik oral tradition encodes ecological knowledge; reindeer grazing districts (Sameby) collective ownership with rotational grazing. Parliament lacks legislative power but holds consultation/veto/budget rights, forcing states to FPIC on mining/wind/rail projects. Exemplifies M176 Sami Consultative Governance—trinity of 'transnational parliament + reindeer pastoral livelihood + Joik knowledge encoding' achieving institutionalized indigenous sovereignty breakthrough in modern state system.
CA-SMI-001.reason_zh: 萨米人跨挪/瑞/芬/俄四国，无主权国家却拥有跨国议会，是"无国籍族群的议会制自治"独特范式。M176 区隔于 M148 毛利共识(新西兰单一)、M177 因纽特(北美/格陵兰)、M178 极地气候(工程)，核心在于"跨国议会制+游牧生计即主权基础+口述传统编码生态法"。
CA-SMI-001.reason_en: Sami across Norway/Sweden/Finland/Russia four states, no sovereign nation yet possess transnational parliament—unique paradigm of 'stateless nation parliamentary autonomy'. M176 distinct from M148 Māori Consensus (NZ single), M177 Inuit (NA/Greenland), M178 Polar Climate (engineering), core: 'transnational parliamentary system + pastoral livelihood as sovereignty base + oral tradition encoding ecological law'.
steps_zh: 萨米议会选举与跨国协调：四国议会各自选举、萨米议会会议协调共同立场，跨国族群民主实验
廷特协商决策制：村落代表共识决策放牧/捕鱼/狩猎/矿业，无投票仅共识，少数意见保护机制
驯鹿放牧区轮牧管理：Sameby 集体所有、季节性迁徙路线/围栏/补充喂养协商，生计即治理单元
约伊克口述传承生态法：约伊克旋律编码动物迁徙/植物物候/冰雪状况，长老传承非书面生态法律
FPIC 强制咨询权：风电/铁路/矿业项目强制萨米议会同意，绿色殖民抵抗与利益分享谈判
steps_en: Sami Parliament elections & transnational coordination: four national parliaments elected separately, Sami Parliamentary Conference coordinates common positions, transnational ethnic democracy experiment
Tingt consultative decision-making: village representatives consensus on grazing/fishing/hunting/mining, no voting only consensus, minority opinion protection
Reindeer grazing district rotational management: Sameby collective ownership, seasonal migration routes/fencing/supplementary feeding negotiated, livelihood as governance unit
Joik oral transmission of ecological law: Joik melodies encode animal migration/plant phenology/ice conditions, elder transmission of non-written ecological law
FPIC mandatory consultation: wind/rail/mining projects require Sami Parliament consent, green colonialism resistance & benefit-sharing negotiation
CA-SMI-001.expected_zh: 无主权原住民族以"跨国议会+游牧生计+口述生态法"三位一体，在现代国家体系中实现制度化自治，为全球原住民自治提供跨国范式。
CA-SMI-001.expected_en: Stateless indigenous nation achieves institutionalized autonomy via trinity of 'transnational parliament + pastoral livelihood + oral ecological law', providing transnational paradigm for global indigenous self-governance.
CA-SMI-001.case_zh: 挪威萨米议会 1989 成立/瑞典 1993/芬兰 1996/俄罗斯 2010 非官方；2021 挪威最高法院判决风电侵犯萨米权利拆除；约伊克 2018 入选非遗；驯鹿 20 万+。
CA-SMI-001.case_en: Norway Sami Parliament 1989/Sweden 1993/Finland 1996/Russia 2010 unofficial; 2021 Norway Supreme Court rules wind farms violate Sami rights order removal; Joik 2018 UNESCO ICH; reindeer 200k+.
CA-SMI-001.intellectual_tradition: Sami Consultative Governance / Reindeer Pastoralism / Joik Oral Tradition
CA-SMI-001.cross_cultural_impact: Transnational indigenous parliament model; FPIC implementation; green colonialism resistance; oral tradition as ecological law
CA-SMI-001.diaspora_influence: Sami diaspora in North America; international indigenous networks
CA-SMI-001.indigenous_knowledge_system: Reindeer pastoral ecology; Joik melodic encoding; snow/ice terminology 300+ terms
CA-SMI-001.oral_tradition: Joik melodic tradition; community authorization: Sami Parliament 2023

INU-NAV-001.name_zh: 因纽特航海/冰雪生存大师：因纽特生存智慧与极地适应
INU-NAV-001.name_en: Inuit Navigation/Ice Survival Masters: Inuit Survival Wisdom & Polar Adaptation
INU-NAV-001.description_zh: 因纽特人横跨加拿大/格陵兰/阿拉斯加/楚科奇半岛，以冰屋/雪屋建筑、海豹鲸鱼全身利用、犬拉雪橇/皮艇 (qajaq/kayak)、长老口述知识在极端北极环境中生存繁衍千年。核心生存技术体系：读冰导航 (识别冰龄/厚度/裂隙/压力脊) → 冰屋建造 (螺旋拱顶/热力学稳定/通风孔) → 猎物全身利用 (皮毛衣物/脂肪燃料/骨骼工具/肌腱线) → 犬拉雪橇/皮艇机动。知识通过长老口述、师徒实操、社区共享代际传承，无书面记录却高度系统化。体现 M177 因纽特生存智慧——以"海冰即领土、全身利用伦理、口述即法律"三位一体，在零基建/零文字/极寒环境中构建完备生存操作系统。
INU-NAV-001.description_en: Inuit across Canada/Greenland/Alaska/Chukotka survive millennia in extreme Arctic via igloo/snow architecture, seal/whale whole-utilization, dog sled/kayak (qajaq), elder oral knowledge. Core survival tech stack: ice-reading navigation (identify ice age/thickness/leads/pressure ridges) -> igloo construction (spiral dome/thermodynamic stability/ventilation) -> prey whole-utilization (fur clothing/blubber fuel/bone tools/sinew thread) -> dog sled/kayak mobility. Knowledge transmitted intergenerationally via elder oral teaching, apprentice practice, community sharing, zero written records yet highly systematized. Exemplifies M177 Inuit Survival Wisdom—trinity of 'sea ice as territory, whole-utilization ethics, oral as law' building complete survival OS in zero-infrastructure/zero-writing/extreme cold.
INU-NAV-001.reason_zh: 因纽特生存非原始本能，而是"海冰读数+热力学建筑+生态全身利用+口述知识编码"四位一体工程体系。M177 区隔于 M176 萨米协商(议会)、M178 极地气候(工程/法律)、M154 梦境时间(澳洲)，核心在于"海冰即可读地图、冰屋即热力学精密结构、猎物零浪费伦理、长老口述即生存法典"。
INU-NAV-001.reason_en: Inuit survival not primitive instinct but engineered quaternity of 'ice-reading + thermodynamic architecture + ecological whole-utilization + oral knowledge encoding'. M177 distinct from M176 Sami Consultation (parliament), M178 Polar Climate (engineering/law), M154 Dreamtime (Australia), core: 'sea ice as readable map, igloo as thermodynamic precision structure, prey zero-waste ethics, elder oral as survival codex'.
steps_zh: 读冰导航即地图：识别一年冰/多年冰/压力脊/裂隙/海豹呼吸孔，心理地图零误差穿越海冰
冰屋热力学精密建造：螺旋切块/拱顶自锁/冷沉热升通风/体热维持 0°C 内温，30 分钟建成
猎物全身利用伦理：海豹皮衣/鲸脂灯油/骨制鱼钩/肌腱缝合线/肠衣防水袋，零浪费敬畏生命
长老口述即生存法典：冰况术语 100+/狩猎路线歌谣/禁忌规范/紧急预案，社区授权长老教学
现代科技融合与传承：GPS 叠加传统路线/卫星冰图验证口述/皮艇材料现代化/青年长者配对教学
steps_en: Ice-reading as map: identify first-year/multi-year ice/pressure ridges/leads/seal breathing holes, mental map zero-error traverses sea ice
Igloo thermodynamic precision build: spiral cut blocks/self-locking dome/cold-sink-hot-rise ventilation/body heat maintains 0°C inside, 30-min build
Prey whole-utilization ethics: seal fur clothing/whale blubber lamp oil/bone fish hooks/sinew thread/intestine waterproof bags, zero waste reverence for life
Elder oral as survival codex: ice terminology 100+/hunting route songs/taboo norms/emergency protocols, community-authorized elder teaching
Modern tech fusion & transmission: GPS overlays traditional routes/satellite ice charts validate oral/kayak materials modernized/youth-elder paired teaching
INU-NAV-001.expected_zh: 以"海冰读数+冰屋热力学+全身利用伦理+口述法典"四位一体，在极端北极构建零基建生存文明，为极地工程/气候适应/太空生存提供技术范式。
INU-NAV-001.expected_en: Quaternity of 'ice-reading + igloo thermodynamics + whole-utilization ethics + oral codex' builds zero-infrastructure survival civilization in extreme Arctic, providing tech paradigm for polar engineering/climate adaptation/space survival.
INU-NAV-001.case_zh: 因纽特人口 18 万+ (加/格/美/俄)；冰屋建造技艺非遗；皮艇成现代 kayak 祖型；NASA 极地训练引入因纽特生存课程；努纳武特 1999 建置实现自治。
INU-NAV-001.case_en: Inuit population 180k+ (CA/GL/US/RU); igloo craft ICH; kayak ancestor of modern kayak; NASA polar training adopts Inuit survival curriculum; Nunavut 1999 established self-governance.
INU-NAV-001.intellectual_tradition: Inuit Survival Technology / Oral Ecological Knowledge
