GL-HOM-001.name_zh: 格陵兰自治/因纽特领袖：极地自治治理与资源联邦制
GL-HOM-001.name_en: Greenland Self-Governance/Inuit Leaders: Polar Autonomy Governance & Resource Federalism
GL-HOM-001.description_zh: 格陵兰 1979 年获丹麦自治权，2009 年《自治法》扩大立法/司法/资源/外交权限，实质准主权实体。核心治理张力：因纽特文化自决 vs 丹麦王国纽带、资源开发 (稀土/铀/石油/氢能) vs 环境/气候脆弱性、人口 5.6 万支撑 216 万平方公里领土。体现 M179 极地自治治理——以"自治法框架+资源收益分享+因纽特语官方化+气候前沿适应"四支柱，在非完全独立状态下实现准主权治理。
GL-HOM-001.description_en: Greenland gained Danish home rule 1979, 2009 Self-Government Act expanded legislative/judicial/resource/foreign affairs powers, de facto quasi-sovereign entity. Core governance tensions: Inuit cultural self-determination vs Danish kingdom ties, resource development (rare earths/uranium/oil/hydrogen) vs environmental/climate fragility, 56k population sustaining 2.16M km² territory. Exemplifies M179 Polar Autonomy Governance—four pillars of 'Self-Government Act framework + resource revenue sharing + Inuit language officialization + climate frontline adaptation' achieving quasi-sovereign governance without full independence.
GL-HOM-001.reason_zh: 格陵兰是"非完全独立的准主权"独特范式：丹麦负责国防/外交/货币/公民权，格陵兰全权立法/司法/资源/教育/卫生/气候。M179 区隔于 M176 萨米协商(议会无立法权)、M177 因纽特(无国家框架)、M178 极地气候(工程)，核心在于"自治法法律框架+资源主权+因纽特民族建构"三位一体。
GL-HOM-001.reason_en: Greenland unique 'quasi-sovereign without full independence': Denmark retains defense/foreign affairs/currency/citizenship, Greenland full legislative/judicial/resource/education/health/climate. M179 distinct from M176 Sami Consultation (parliament no legislative power), M177 Inuit (no state framework), M178 Polar Climate (engineering), core: 'Self-Government Act legal framework + resource sovereignty + Inuit nation-building' trinity.
steps_zh: 自治法法律框架：1979 自治/2009 自治法，分权清单(丹麦保留:国防/外交/货币/公民权；格陵兰全权:立法/司法/资源/教育/卫生/气候/原住民)
资源主权与收益分享：稀土(库亚纳克/莫雷内贝尔)/铀/石油/氢能，矿业法要求 FPIC/环评/收益分享/本地就业
因纽特民族建构：格陵兰语 (Kalaallisut) 唯一官方语言/教育/媒体/议会，民族认同重构
气候前沿适应治理：冰盖融化/海平面上升/永久冻土融沉/新航道/渔业迁移，主动适应规划/国际气候谈判主体性
外交半自主与北极理事会：格陵兰代表团独立参与北极理事会/北大西洋渔业/欧盟渔业协议/中美俄地缘博弈
steps_en: Self-Government Act legal framework: 1979 Home Rule/2009 Self-Government Act, division list (Denmark retains: defense/foreign affairs/currency/citizenship; Greenland full: legislation/judiciary/resource/education/health/climate/indigenous)
Resource sovereignty & revenue sharing: rare earths (Kvanefjeld/Moraine)/uranium/oil/hydrogen, Mineral Act requires FPIC/EIA/revenue sharing/local employment
Inuit nation-building: Greenlandic (Kalaallisut) sole official language/education/media/parliament, national identity reconstructed

Climate frontline adaptation governance: ice sheet melt/sea level rise/permafrost thaw/new shipping routes/fisheries migration, proactive adaptation planning/international climate negotiation subjectivity
Diplomatic semi-autonomy & Arctic Council: Greenland delegation independently participates Arctic Council/NAFO/EU fisheries/US-China-Russia Arctic geopolitics
GL-HOM-001.expected_zh: 以"自治法框架+资源主权+因纽特语官方化+气候适应"四支柱，在非完全独立状态下实现准主权治理，为托管领土/自治区/原住民地区提供独特范式。
GL-HOM-001.expected_en: Four pillars of 'Self-Government Act framework + resource sovereignty + Inuit language officialization + climate adaptation' achieve quasi-sovereign governance without full independence, providing unique paradigm for trust territories/autonomous regions/indigenous areas.
GL-HOM-001.case_zh: 2009 自治法公投 75% 支持；库亚纳克稀土全球第二大储量；格陵兰语使用率 95%+；冰盖年融化 2800 亿吨；北极理事会永久参与者。
GL-HOM-001.case_en: 2009 Self-Government Act referendum 75% support; Kvanefjeld rare earths world 2nd largest; Greenlandic usage 95%+; ice sheet annual melt 280Gt; Arctic Council permanent participant.
GL-HOM-001.cross_cultural_impact: Autonomy model for indigenous regions; rare earth geopolitics; climate frontline governance; Arctic Council indigenous participation
GL-HOM-001.diaspora_influence: Greenlandic diaspora in Denmark 17k+; international indigenous networks
GL-HOM-001.indigenous_knowledge_system: Inuit ice/sea/weather knowledge; traditional hunting/fishing calendar; Qulliq oil lamp
GL-HOM-001.resource_curse_mitigation: Mineral Act FPIC/EIA/revenue sharing; uranium mining ban (lifted 2013); sovereign wealth fund discussions
GL-HOM-001.climate_adaptation: Ice sheet monitoring; sea level rise planning; permafrost infrastructure; fisheries migration management

INU-CLI-001.name_zh: 气候适应/北极韧性先驱：极地气候韧性与海平面适应
INU-CLI-001.name_en: Climate Adaptation/Arctic Resilience Pioneers: Polar Climate Resilience & Sea Level Adaptation
INU-CLI-001.description_zh: 北极气候变化速度是全球平均 3-4 倍，冰盖融化/永久冻土融沉/海平面上升/极端天气频发，威胁因纽特/萨米/雅库特/楚科奇等原住民生存基础。先锋应对者：努纳武特政府《气候变化适应战略》、格陵兰《冰盖监测计划》、阿拉斯加原住民村庄"管理式撤退" (新托克/基瓦利纳/沙克托利克)、西伯利亚雅库特永久冻土工程适应。体现 M180 极地气候韧性——以"冰盖监测+管理式撤退+浮动/高架建筑+法律主权延续"四支柱，在不可逆气候冲击中构建生存韧性。
INU-CLI-001.description_en: Arctic warming 3-4x global average, ice sheet melt/permafrost thaw/sea level rise/extreme weather threatening Inuit/Sami/Yakut/Chukchi survival foundations. Pioneer responders: Nunavut Climate Change Adaptation Strategy, Greenland Ice Sheet Monitoring, Alaska Native village 'managed retreat' (Newtok/Kivalina/Shaktoolik), Siberian Yakut permafrost engineering adaptation. Exemplifies M180 Polar Climate Resilience—four pillars of 'ice sheet monitoring + managed retreat + floating/elevated architecture + legal sovereignty continuity' building survival resilience amid irreversible climate shock.
INU-CLI-001.reason_zh: 北极气候适应非单纯工程，而是"监测预警+社区主导撤退+建筑创新+法律创新"四位一体：冰盖监测提供决策窗口、管理式撤退保社区完整性、浮动建筑应对海平面、法律主权延续应对沉没国家。M180 区隔于 M177 因纽特生存(传统技术)、M178 极地气候(工程)、M179 极地自治(治理)，核心在于"不可逆冲击下的社区完整性+法律主权延续"双重韧性。
INU-CLI-001.reason_en: Arctic climate adaptation not mere engineering but quaternity of 'monitoring early warning + community-led retreat + architectural innovation + legal innovation': ice sheet monitoring provides decision window, managed retreat preserves community integrity, floating architecture addresses sea level, legal sovereignty continuity addresses sinking nations. M180 distinct from M177 Inuit Survival (traditional tech), M178 Polar Climate (engineering), M179 Polar Autonomy (governance), core: 'community integrity + legal sovereignty continuity under irreversible shock' dual resilience.
steps_zh: 冰盖/永久冻土监测网络：卫星 (GRACE/ICESat-2)/地面钻孔/原住民观测员网络，实时数据支撑适应决策
管理式撤退社区主导：新托克 (阿拉斯加) 迁往梅尔特维尔/基瓦利纳规划迁移/沙克托利克防波堤+撤退，社区投票决定时机/地点
浮动/高架建筑创新：格陵兰努克浮动原型/阿拉斯加高架桩基/西伯利亚热管稳定地基，适应融沉/洪水/海平面
法律主权延续创新：图瓦卢/马绍尔/基里巴斯"数字国家"构想/海洋法主权冻结/气候难民法律地位/损失与损害基金 (COP27/28)
原住民知识融合科学：因纽特冰况术语/雅库特永久冻土现象学/萨米驯鹿迁徙变化，纳入 IPCC 报告/国家适应规划
steps_en: Ice sheet/permafrost monitoring network: satellites (GRACE/ICESat-2)/ground boreholes/indigenous observer networks, real-time data supports adaptation decisions
Managed retreat community-led: Newtok (AK) relocates to Mertarvik/Kivalina plans relocation/Shaktoolik seawall+retreat, community vote decides timing/location
Floating/elevated architecture innovation: Nuuk (Greenland) floating prototype/AK elevated pilings/Siberian thermosyphon stabilized foundations, adapting to thaw/flood/sea level
Legal sovereignty continuity innovation: Tuvalu/Marshall/Kiribati 'digital nation' concept/UNCLOS sovereignty freeze/climate refugee legal status/Loss & Damage Fund (COP27/28)
Indigenous knowledge fused with science: Inuit ice terminology/Yakut permafrost phenology/Sami reindeer migration shifts, fed into IPCC reports/national adaptation plans
INU-CLI-001.expected_zh: 以"监测+撤退+建筑+法律"四位一体，在不可逆北极气候冲击中保全社区完整性与法律主权，为全球沿海/三角洲/岛屿国家提供极限适应范式。
INU-CLI-001.expected_en: Quaternity of 'monitoring + retreat + architecture + law' preserves community integrity & legal sovereignty amid irreversible Arctic climate shock, providing extreme adaptation paradigm for global coastal/delta/island nations.
INU-CLI-001.case_zh: 新托克 2019 开始迁移/格陵兰冰盖年融 2800 亿吨/北极海冰 2023 夏季面积第 6 低/COP28 损失损害基金启动/图瓦卢数字国家宣示主权延续。
INU-CLI-001.case_en: Newtok 2019 relocation started/Greenland ice sheet annual melt 280Gt/Arctic sea ice 2023 summer 6th lowest/COP28 Loss & Damage Fund launched/Tuvalu digital nation asserts sovereignty continuity.
INU-CLI-001.intellectual_tradition: Arctic Climate Adaptation / Indigenous Climate Resilience / Climate Justice
INU-CLI-001.cross_cultural_impact: Managed retreat model for coastal cities; floating architecture for flood zones; digital sovereignty for sinking nations; indigenous knowledge in IPCC
INU-CLI-001.colonial_history: Relocation policies; residential schools; resource extraction on indigenous lands
INU-CLI-001.diaspora_influence: Arctic indigenous diaspora; climate refugee precedent
INU-CLI-001.indigenous_knowledge_system: Ice/permafrost phenology; traditional weather prediction; ecological migration calendars
INU-CLI-001.climate_adaptation: Managed retreat; floating architecture; ice sheet monitoring; legal sovereignty continuity; loss & damage finance

UA-COS-001.name_zh: 赫梅利尼茨基/哥萨克首领：边境地带共同体与哥萨克自治
UA-COS-001.name_en: Khmelnytsky/Cossack Hetmans: Borderland Commonwealth & Cossack Autonomy
UA-COS-001.description_zh: 博赫丹·赫梅利尼茨基 (1595-1657) 领导 1648 年哥萨克起义，建立扎波罗热军队 (Hetmanate)，在波兰-立陶宛联邦/奥斯曼/莫斯科/克里米亚汗国四强夹缝中寻求生存。核心治理模式：哥萨克民主 (拉达大会选举盖特曼/决策战争和约) + 军事行政合一 (团/连制即行政区) + 正教信仰凝聚身份 + 灵活外交平衡 (1654 佩列亚斯拉夫条约投奔沙皇/1658 哈季亚奇条约回归波兰)。体现 M181 边境地带共同体——以"军事民主+信仰锚定+大国间摇摆"三位一体，在文明断层线上构建自治政治共同体。
UA-COS-001.description_en: Bohdan Khmelnytsky (1595-1657) led 1648 Cossack uprising, established Zaporozhian Host (Hetmanate), seeking survival in four-power squeeze of PLC/Ottoman/Muscovy/Crimean Khanate. Core governance model: Cossack democracy (Rada assembly elects Hetman/decides war & peace) + military-administrative fusion (regiment/company as admin units) + Orthodox faith anchoring identity + flexible diplomatic balancing (1654 Pereiaslav Treaty to Tsar/1658 Hadiach Treaty back to PLC). Exemplifies M181 Borderland Commonwealth—trinity of 'military democracy + faith anchor + great power balancing' building autonomous political community on civilizational fault lines.
UA-COS-001.reason_zh: 乌克兰历史核心张力在于"边境地带生存"：无天然屏障、多帝国争夺、族群宗教交织。赫梅利尼茨基以哥萨克军事民主+正教身份+大国平衡，在文明断层线上开辟自治空间。M181 区隔于 M163 斯拉夫边境生存(近代)、M170 部落联邦(伊拉克)、M172 少数派生存(叙利亚)，核心在于"军事民主制+信仰锚定+大国摇摆"的早期现代边境生存范式。
UA-COS-001.reason_en: Ukraine's core historical tension is 'borderland survival': no natural barriers, multiple empires contesting, ethnic-religious interweaving. Khmelnytsky carved autonomous space via Cossack military democracy + Orthodox identity + great power balancing. M181 distinct from M163 Slavic Borderland Survival (modern), M170 Tribal Federalism (Iraq), M172 Minority Survival (Syria), core: 'military democracy + faith anchor + great power oscillation' early modern borderland survival paradigm.
steps_zh: 哥萨克军事民主确立：拉达大会选举盖特曼、决策战争和约、分配战利品，军官由功绩晋升
正教信仰身份锚定：哥萨克视自己为正教捍卫者，教堂/修道院为社区核心，宗教宽容犹太/天主教商人
大国间灵活摇摆：1648 起义→1654 佩列亚斯拉夫投沙皇→1657 瑞典结盟→1658 哈季亚奇回波兰，生存优先
军事行政合一治理：团/连制即军事单位即行政区，盖特曼任命团长兼行政长官，战时即战时
遗产与分裂：1667 安德鲁索沃休战割裂第聂伯河左右岸→左岸归沙皇/右岸归波兰，哥萨克自治在大国博弈中碎片化
steps_en: Cossack military democracy establishment: Rada assembly elects Hetman, decides war/peace, distributes spoils, officers promoted by merit
Orthodox faith identity anchoring: Cossacks see themselves as Orthodox defenders, churches/monasteries as community cores, religious tolerance for Jewish/Catholic merchants
Great power flexible oscillation: 1648 uprising -> 1654 Pereiaslav to Tsar -> 1657 Swedish alliance -> 1658 Hadiach back to PLC, survival first
Military-administrative fusion governance: regiment/company as both military unit and admin district, Hetman appoints colonels as admin chiefs, wartime = governance
Legacy & partition: 1667 Truce of Andrusovo splits Dnieper banks -> left bank to Tsar/right bank to PLC, Cossack autonomy fragmented in great power games
UA-COS-001.expected_zh: 以"军事民主+正教身份+大国摇摆"三位一体，在文明断层线上实现边境族群的自治生存，为后世乌克兰国家建构提供史诗级原型。
UA-COS-001.expected_en: Trinity of 'military democracy + Orthodox identity + great power oscillation' achieves borderland ethnic autonomy survival on civilizational fault lines, providing epic prototype for later Ukrainian state-building.
UA-COS-001.case_zh: 1648 起义→1654 佩列亚斯拉夫→1657-58 瑞典/波兰结盟→1667 安德鲁索沃割裂→1709 波尔塔瓦战役马泽帕倒向瑞典→1764 叶卡捷琳娜二世废除盖特曼制，哥萨克自治在大国博弈中消亡但精神延续。
UA-COS-001.case_en: 1648 uprising -> 1654 Pereiaslav -> 1657-58 Swedish/PLC alliance -> 1667 Andrusovo partition -> 1709 Poltava Mazepa defects to Sweden -> 1764 Catherine II abolishes Hetmanate, Cossack autonomy perishes in great power games but spirit endures.
UA-COS-001.cross_cultural_impact: Cossack democracy model; Ukrainian national myth; borderland survival paradigm
UA-COS-001.colonial_history: Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth rule; Russian Empire expansion; Soviet period
UA-COS-001.resource_curse_mitigation: Black soil agriculture; Dnieper hydro; Donbas coal (later)

UA-MOD-001.name_zh: 克拉夫丘克/尤先科/泽连斯基：后苏联转型治理与抗争民主
UA-MOD-001.name_en: Kravchuk/Yushchenko/Zelenskyy: Post-Soviet Transition Governance & Resistance Democracy
UA-MOD-001.description_zh: 乌克兰三代后苏联领袖跨越三十年共同完成：列昂尼德·克拉夫丘克 (1934-2022) 首任总统 (1991-1994) 签署别洛韦日协议解体苏联、确立主权；维克托·尤先科 (1954-) 橙色革命 (2004) 胜选、推行去共化/北约/欧盟路线；弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基 (1978-) 2019 大选压倒性胜利、2022 抗俄战争战时领袖、数字化治理/反腐/全球外交动员。三人共同体现 M161 后苏联转型治理——以"主权确立+民主巩固+抗争生存"三阶段，在俄/西/内部寡头三重压力下重构国家主体性。
UA-MOD-001.description_en: Three generations of Ukrainian post-Soviet leaders across three decades: Leonid Kravchuk (1934-2022) 1st President (1991-1994) signed Belovezha Accords dissolving USSR, established sovereignty; Viktor Yushchenko (1954-) Orange Revolution (2004) victory, drove decommunization/NATO/EU path; Volodymyr Zelenskyy (1978-) 2019 landslide election, 2022 wartime leader against Russian invasion, digital governance/anti-corruption/global diplomatic mobilization. Together exemplify M161 Post-Soviet Transition Governance—three phases of 'sovereignty establishment + democratic consolidation + resistance survival' reconstructing national subjectivity under triple pressure of Russia/West/oligarchs.
UA-MOD-001.reason_zh: 乌克兰后苏联转型是"主权-民主-生存"三重螺旋上升：克拉夫丘克确立主权合法性，尤先科以橙色革命锚定民主方向，泽连斯基以抗争战争升华为生存民主。M161 区隔于 M170 后苏联威权稳定(白俄罗斯)、M181 边境地带共同体(历史)、M163 斯拉夫边境生存(地缘)，核心在于"主权确立->民主巩固->抗争生存"的三阶段螺旋上升。
UA-MOD-001.reason_en: Ukraine's post-Soviet transition is triple helix of 'sovereignty-democracy-survival': Kravchuk established sovereign legitimacy, Yushchenko anchored democratic direction via Orange Revolution, Zelenskyy elevated resistance war to survival democracy. M161 distinct from M170 Post-Soviet Authoritarian Stability (Belarus), M181 Borderland Commonwealth (historical), M163 Slavic Borderland Survival (geopolitical), core: 'sovereignty establishment -> democratic consolidation -> resistance survival' three-phase spiral ascent.
steps_zh: 主权合法性确立：1991 别洛韦日协议/12 月 1 日全民公投 90%+ 支持独立，克拉夫丘克签署解体苏联
民主制度建设：1996 宪法/1998 货币格里夫纳/1999 首次议会选举，奠定程序民主基础
橙色革命民主突围：2004 大选舞弊/麦丹广场百万群众/最高法院判决重选/尤先科胜选，确立民主不可逆
去共化与欧盟/北约锚定：尤先科推动《去共化法》/申请北约成员行动计划/欧盟伙伴关系协定
抗争战争与数字治理：2022 俄全面入侵/泽连斯基拒撤离/数字化动员/反腐肃贪/全球外交联盟/欧盟候选国/重建规划
steps_en: Sovereign legitimacy establishment: 1991 Belovezha Accords/Dec 1 referendum 90%+ independence, Kravchuk signs USSR dissolution
Democratic institution building: 1996 Constitution/1998 hryvnia currency/1999 first parliamentary elections, procedural democracy foundation
Orange Revolution democratic breakout: 2004 election fraud/Maidan million protesters/Supreme Court orders re-run/Yushchenko wins, anchors democratic irreversibility
Decommunization & EU/NATO anchoring: Yushchenko drives decommunization laws/NATO MAP application/EU Association Agreement
Resistance war & digital governance: 2022 Russian full invasion/Zelenskyy refuses evacuation/digital mobilization/anti-corruption purge/global diplomatic alliance/EU candidate/reconstruction planning
UA-MOD-001.expected_zh: 以"主权确立->民主巩固->抗争生存"三阶段螺旋，在俄/西/寡头三重压力下重构国家主体性，为后苏联空间提供"抗争民主"极限范式。
UA-MOD-001.expected_en: Three-phase spiral of 'sovereignty establishment -> democratic consolidation -> resistance survival' reconstructs national subjectivity under triple pressure of Russia/West/oligarchs, providing 'resistance democracy' extreme paradigm for post-Soviet space.
UA-MOD-001.case_zh: 1991 独立/1996 宪法/2004 橙色革命/2014 尊严革命/克里米亚吞并/顿巴斯战争/2022 全面入侵/基辅保卫战/哈尔科夫反攻/赫尔松收复/欧盟候选国/重建规划，30 年主权-民主-生存三重螺旋。
UA-MOD-001.case_en: 1991 independence/1996 Constitution/2004 Orange Revolution/2014 Dignity Revolution/Crimea annexation/Donbas war/2022 full invasion/Kyiv defense/Kharkiv counteroffensive/Kherson liberation/EU candidate/reconstruction planning, 30-year sovereignty-democracy-survival triple helix.

UA-MOD-001.colonial_history: Russian Empire/Soviet rule; Holodomor 1932-33; Nazi occupation 1941-44

UA-RES-001.name_zh: 顿巴斯矿业/农业巨头：资源诅咒缓解与战争经济重构
UA-RES-001.name_en: Donbas Mining/Agribusiness Giants: Resource Curse Mitigation & War Economy Reconstruction
UA-RES-001.description_zh: 乌克兰资源经济由两大支柱支撑：顿巴斯煤炭/钢铁工业带 (顿涅茨克/卢甘斯克) 与黑土地农业出口 (小麦/玉米/葵花籽油全球前列)。2014 年以来战争导致顿巴斯工业基地 70%+ 受损/失控，农业出口被黑海封锁切断。核心重构逻辑：西部利沃夫/外喀尔巴阡建立备用工业/物流枢纽、丹麦/波兰/罗马尼亚协助谷物陆运团 (团结通道)、绿色钢铁/氢能/关键矿产 (锂/钛/稀土) 转型、战后重建基金 (乌克兰基金/世界银行/欧盟) 锚定绿色工业化。体现 M168 资源诅咒缓解——以"战争倒逼转型+外部援助锚定+绿色重建"三位一体，将资源诅咒转化为绿色工业跃升契机。
UA-RES-001.description_en: Ukraine's resource economy rests on two pillars: Donbas coal/steel belt (Donetsk/Luhansk) and chernozem agricultural exports (wheat/corn/sunflower oil global top). Since 2014 war, Donbas industrial base 70%+ damaged/lost, agricultural exports cut by Black Sea blockade. Core reconstruction logic: western Lviv/Transcarpathia backup industrial/logistics hubs, Danish/Polish/Romanian grain land corridors (Solidarity Lanes), green steel/hydrogen/critical minerals (lithium/titanium/REE) transition, reconstruction funds (Ukraine Fund/WB/EU) anchoring green reindustrialization. Exemplifies M168 Resource Curse Mitigation—trinity of 'war-forced transition + external aid anchoring + green reconstruction' converting resource curse into green industrial leap opportunity.
UA-RES-001.reason_zh: 乌克兰资源诅咒非单纯荷兰病，而是"战争摧毁核心产区+出口通道被切+寡头垄断收益"三重夹击。重构路径独特在于"战争倒逼+外部援助+绿色转型"三位一体：战争迫使产业西移/多元化，西方援助锚定绿色标准，重建资金杠杆杠杆绿色工业。M168 区隔于 M39 鸟笼经济(通用)、M169 后资源转型(沙特)、M175 水资源联邦(跨界)，核心在于"战争经济重构+绿色跃升"的极限案例。
UA-RES-001.reason_en: Ukraine's resource curse not mere Dutch disease but triple squeeze of 'war destroys core production zones + export routes cut + oligopolistic rent capture'. Reconstruction path unique in 'war-forced + external aid + green transition' trinity: war forces industrial westward shift/diversification, Western aid anchors green standards, reconstruction funds leverage green industry. M168 distinct from M39 Birdcage Economy (general), M169 Post-Resource Transition (Saudi), M175 Water Federalism (transboundary), core: 'war economy reconstruction + green leap' extreme case.
steps_zh: 战争倒逼产业西移：2014 顿巴斯失控→利沃夫/文尼察/外喀尔巴阡建立 IT/军工/物流/农产品加工新集群
团结通道谷物突围：2022 黑海封锁→波兰/罗马尼亚/立陶宛铁路/河运/港口联运，年出口恢复 4000 万吨+
关键矿产战略转型：锂(谢夫琴科夫斯克/多布罗韦利奇卡)/钛/稀土/石墨，欧盟/美/日韩战略伙伴协议，绿色供应链锚定
绿色钢铁与氢能：扎波罗热/马里乌波尔(失控前)电弧炉/氢还原铁试点，战后重建锚定零碳钢铁
重建基金绿色杠杆：乌克兰基金/世界银行/欧盟设施 500 亿+ 欧元，附带绿色/反腐/数字化条件，市场化招商
steps_en: War-forced industrial westward shift: 2014 Donbas lost -> Lviv/Vinnytsia/Transcarpathia establish IT/defense/logistics/agro-processing new clusters
Solidarity Lanes grain breakout: 2022 Black Sea blockade -> PL/RO/LT rail/river/port intermodal, annual exports recover 40M+ tonnes
Critical minerals strategic transition: lithium (Shevchenkivske/Dobrovelychivka)/titanium/REE/graphite, EU/US/Japan/Korea strategic partnerships, green supply chain anchored
Green steel & hydrogen: Zaporizhzhia/Mariupol (pre-loss) EAF/hydrogen DRI pilots, post-war reconstruction anchors zero-carbon steel
Reconstruction fund green leverage: Ukraine Fund/WB/EU facilities 50B+ EUR, conditional on green/anti-corruption/digitalization, market-based investment mobilization
UA-RES-001.expected_zh: 以"战争倒逼+外部援助+绿色转型"三位一体，将资源诅咒转化为绿色工业跃升契机，战后乌克兰目标：欧盟绿色工业后方、关键矿产安全供应链、粮食安全保障者。
UA-RES-001.expected_en: Trinity of 'war-forced + external aid + green transition' converts resource curse into green industrial leap opportunity, post-war Ukraine targets: EU green industrial rear, critical minerals secure supply chain, food security guarantor.
UA-RES-001.case_zh: 2021 粮食出口 5000 万吨/2022 封锁跌至 1500 万/2023 团结通道恢复 4000 万+；锂储量欧盟前三；绿色钢铁试点 2023 启动；重建估算 $4000 亿+，绿色条件附带。
UA-RES-001.case_en: 2021 grain exports 50Mt/2022 blockade drop to 15Mt/2023 Solidarity Lanes recover 40Mt+; lithium reserves EU top 3; green steel pilot 2023 launched; reconstruction est. $400B+, green conditions attached.
UA-RES-001.intellectual_tradition: Ukrainian Resource Governance / War Economy Reconstruction
UA-RES-001.cross_cultural_impact: War economy reconstruction model; grain corridor diplomacy; critical minerals geopolitics; green reconstruction finance
UA-RES-001.colonial_history: Russian Empire/Soviet industrialization; Holodomor; Nazi occupation
UA-RES-001.diaspora_influence: Ukrainian diaspora tech/finance networks; 2022 refugee brain circulation
UA-RES-001.resource_curse_mitigation: War-forced diversification; Solidarity Lanes; critical minerals strategic partnerships; green reconstruction conditionalities

BY-NAT-001.name_zh: 卢卡申科/白罗斯建国：后苏联威权稳定与联盟国家模式
BY-NAT-001.name_en: Lukashenko/Belarus Founding: Post-Soviet Authoritarian Stability & Union State Model
BY-NAT-001.description_zh: 亚历山大·卢卡申科 (1954-) 1994 年首任总统至今，以"强力稳定+苏联遗产保留+俄白联盟国家"三支柱维持政权三十年。核心治理模式：强人集权 (超级总统制/议会边缘化/司法从属) + 安全机构渗透社会 (KGB 保留苏联编制/全方位监控/反对派预防性打击) + 有限多元化放行 (私营经济保留/外资准入/互联网相对开放) + 对外平衡外交 (俄军事一体化/中欧经贸/不结盟名义)。体现 M170 后苏联威权稳定——以"强人合法性+安全机构主导+有限多元化+对外平衡"四支柱，在后帝国真空期实现政权极限生存。
BY-NAT-001.description_en: Alexander Lukashenko (1954-) President since 1994, maintains regime three decades via trinity of 'strongman stability + Soviet legacy preservation + Russia-Belarus Union State'. Core governance model: strongman centralization (super-presidency/parliament marginalized/judiciary subordinated) + security apparatus penetration (KGB retains Soviet structure/omnipresent surveillance/preemptive opposition strikes) + limited pluralism tolerance (private economy retained/FDI admitted/internet relatively open) + external balancing diplomacy (Russia military integration/China-Europe economics/non-alignment nominal). Exemplifies M170 Post-Soviet Authoritarian Stability—four pillars of 'strongman legitimacy + security apparatus dominance + limited pluralism + external balancing' achieving regime extreme survival in post-imperial vacuum.
BY-NAT-001.reason_zh: 白俄罗斯非单纯独裁，而是"后苏联威权稳定"精心工程：卢卡申科保留苏联工业/农业/教育/医疗体制，用"稳定换发展"叙事换取民众容忍，以联盟国家框架锁定俄安全伞与能源补贴。M170 区隔于 M161 后苏联转型(乌克兰)、M163 斯拉夫边境生存(地缘)、M171 资源民族主义强人(伊拉克)，核心在于"强人+安全机构+有限多元+外部平衡"的后帝国生存操作系统。
BY-NAT-001.reason_en: Belarus not mere dictatorship but engineered 'post-Soviet authoritarian stability': Lukashenko preserves Soviet industrial/agricultural/education/healthcare systems, trades 'stability for development' narrative for public tolerance, locks Russian security umbrella & energy subsidies via Union State framework. M170 distinct from M161 Post-Soviet Transition (Ukraine), M163 Slavic Borderland Survival (geopolitical), M171 Resource Nationalist Strongman (Iraq), core: 'strongman + security apparatus + limited pluralism + external balancing' post-imperial survival OS.
steps_zh: 强人合法性建构：1994 首任总统/1996 公投超级总统制/2004 取消任期限制/2020 第六任选举，选举即合法性仪式
安全机构全域渗透：KGB 保留苏联编制/名称/权力，全方位监控/渗透/预防性拘留，反对派领袖流亡/监禁/失踪
有限多元化放行阀：集体农庄保留/国企主导但私营准入/高科技园区(明斯克高新区)免税/互联网相对开放/外资能源/零售进入
联盟国家锁定俄伞：1999 联盟国家条约/俄军基地/统一防空/能源补贴(低价油气)/军工合作，安全外包换主权让渡
2020 抗争与生存：大选舞弊/百万抗议/制裁/瑞安航班强降/反对派领袖流亡/俄军事介入承诺/政权存续，威权韧性极限测试
steps_en: Strongman legitimacy construction: 1994 1st President/1996 referendum super-presidency/2004 term limits removed/2020 6th election, elections as legitimacy rituals
Security apparatus total penetration: KGB retains Soviet structure/name/powers, omnipresent surveillance/infiltration/preemptive detention, opposition leaders exiled/imprisoned/disappeared
Limited pluralism release valve: collective farms retained/SOEs dominate but private admitted/Hi-Tech Park (Minsk) tax-free/internet relatively open/FDI in energy/retail

Union State locks Russian umbrella: 1999 Union State treaty/Russian bases/unified air defense/energy subsidies (cheap oil-gas)/defense industry cooperation, security outsourcing for sovereignty concession

2020 protests & survival: election fraud/million protests/sanctions/Ryanair forced landing/opposition leaders exiled/Russian military intervention pledge/regime survives, authoritarian resilience extreme test
BY-NAT-001.expected_zh: 以"强人+安全机构+有限多元+俄伞"四支柱，在后苏联空间实现三十年零政变/零颜色革命成功/零领土丧失，为后帝国威权生存提供极限案例。
BY-NAT-001.expected_en: Four pillars of 'strongman + security apparatus + limited pluralism + Russian umbrella' achieve three decades zero coups/zero successful color revolutions/zero territorial loss in post-Soviet space, providing extreme case for post-imperial authoritarian survival.
BY-NAT-001.case_zh: 1994 当选→1996 公投超级总统制→2001 与俄签署联盟国家条约→2010/2015/2020 连选连任→2020 抗议/制裁/俄伞存续→2022 俄乌战争允许俄军过境/部署核武器，三十年零政变。
BY-NAT-001.case_en: 1994 elected -> 1996 referendum super-presidency -> 2001 Union State treaty with Russia -> 2010/2015/2020 re-elections -> 2020 protests/sanctions/Russian umbrella holds -> 2022 allows Russian transit/nuclear deployment in Ukraine war, three decades zero coups.
BY-NAT-001.intellectual_tradition: Belarusian Authoritarian Stability / Union State Model
BY-NAT-001.cross_cultural_impact: Post-Soviet authoritarian survival model; Union State template; KGB continuity; protest resilience
BY-NAT-001.resource_curse_mitigation: Potash/fertilizer exports; Russian energy subsidies; Hi-Tech Park IT exports; sanctions evasion networks

BY-TEC-001.name_zh: 明斯克高新区/IT先驱：硬软结合与技术飞地治理
BY-TEC-001.name_en: Minsk Hi-Tech Park/IT Pioneers: Hard-Soft Integration & Tech Enclave Governance
BY-TEC-001.description_zh: 明斯克高新区 (HTP) 2005 年成立，以"特殊法律制度"创造技术飞地：零利润税/零增值税/零个人所得税(驻区员工)/零关税/简化签证/劳动法豁免。核心治理机制：国家授权的"特区自治"——HTP 监事会(政府/企业/学术)自主招商/监管/争议解决，年营收 2023 超 $30 亿，出口占 GDP 5%+，员工 6 万+。典型企业：EPAM Systems (全球外包巨头)、Viber/世界之窗/游戏工作室。体现 M158 通才整合——以"硬件基建(数据中心/光纤)+软件生态(外包/游戏/金融科技)+人才磁场(白俄/俄/乌克兰工程师)"三位一体，在威权国家中构建自由市场飞地。
BY-TEC-001.description_en: Minsk High-Tech Park (HTP) founded 2005, creates tech enclave via 'special legal regime': zero profit tax/VAT/PIT for residents/zero customs/simplified visas/labor law exemptions. Core governance mechanism: state-authorized 'special zone autonomy'—HTP Supervisory Board (govt/industry/academia) autonomously recruits/regulates/resolves disputes, 2023 revenue >$3B, exports 5%+ GDP, 60k+ employees. Key firms: EPAM Systems (global outsourcing giant), Viber/World of Tanks/game studios. Exemplifies M158 Polymath Integration—trinity of 'hardware infra (data centers/fiber) + software ecosystem (outsourcing/gaming/fintech) + talent magnet (Belarusian/Russian/Ukrainian engineers)' building free-market enclave in authoritarian state.
BY-TEC-001.reason_zh: 白俄罗斯 HTP 是"威权国家中的自由市场飞地"独特范式：国家以税收/监管/法律豁免换取技术出口/就业/外汇，HTP 自治运营。M158 区隔于 M153 儒商传承(家族)、M163 半导体生态(台湾)、M164 多元文化联邦(加拿大)，核心在于"特区法律豁免+自治运营+硬软结合"的威权体制下技术飞地范式。
BY-TEC-001.reason_en: Belarus HTP is unique 'free-market enclave in authoritarian state': state trades tax/regulatory/legal exemptions for tech exports/jobs/forex, HTP self-governs. M158 distinct from M153 Confucian Merchant (family), M163 Semiconductor Ecosystem (Taiwan), M164 Multicultural Federation (Canada), core: 'special zone legal exemptions + autonomous ops + hard-soft integration' tech enclave paradigm under authoritarianism.
steps_zh: 特区法律制度设计：2005 法令/2017 新法，零税/零关税/简化签证/劳动法豁免/知识产权保护/争议解决机制
监事会自治运营：政府/企业/学术三方组成，自主招商/准入/监管/争议解决，国家不干预日常运营
硬件基建支撑：国家级数据中心/光纤骨干网/5G 试验网/绿色能源供电，基建成本国家分担
人才磁场与逆向流动：白俄/俄/乌工程师聚集，薪资匹配硅谷 30-50% 但生活成本 10%，远程协作全球客户
生态多元化演进：外包(EPAM)→游戏(Wargaming/Viber)→金融科技/区块链/AI/生物技术，抗周期韧性
steps_en: Special zone legal regime design: 2005 decree/2017 new law, zero taxes/customs/simplified visas/labor exemptions/IP protection/dispute resolution
Supervisory board autonomous ops: govt/industry/academia tripartite, autonomous recruitment/admission/regulation/dispute resolution, state non-interference in daily ops
Hardware infra support: national data center/fiber backbone/5G testbed/green energy, infra cost shared by state
Talent magnet & reverse flow: Belarusian/Russian/Ukrainian engineers cluster, salaries 30-50% Silicon Valley but living cost 10%, remote global clients
Ecosystem diversification evolution: outsourcing(EPAM) -> gaming(Wargaming/Viber) -> fintech/blockchain/AI/biotech, counter-cyclical resilience
BY-TEC-001.expected_zh: 以"特区法律豁免+自治运营+硬软结合"三位一体，在威权体制下构建年营收 $30 亿+、出口占 GDP 5%+ 的技术飞地，为后发国家提供"飞地优先"技术发展范式。
BY-TEC-001.expected_en: Trinity of 'special zone legal exemptions + autonomous ops + hard-soft integration' builds tech enclave with $3B+ revenue, 5%+ GDP exports under authoritarianism, providing 'enclave-first' tech development paradigm for latecomers.
BY-TEC-001.case_zh: EPAM Systems 纳斯达克上市/市值 $200 亿+；Wargaming《坦克世界》全球 1.6 亿玩家；Viber 10 亿+ 用户被乐天收购 $9 亿；HTP 2023 营收 $32 亿、出口 $28 亿、员工 6.5 万。
BY-TEC-001.case_en: EPAM Systems NASDAQ listed/market cap $20B+; Wargaming World of Tanks 160M players; Viber 1B+ users acquired by Rakuten $900M; HTP 2023 revenue $3.2B, exports $2.8B, 65k employees.
BY-TEC-001.intellectual_tradition: Belarusian Tech Enclave Governance / Special Economic Zone
BY-TEC-001.cross_cultural_impact: Tech enclave in authoritarian state model; EPAM global outsourcing; Wargaming gaming empire; talent retention in brain drain context
BY-TEC-001.diaspora_influence: Belarusian tech diaspora global; 2020 exile wave boosted remote HTP work
BY-TEC-001.resource_curse_mitigation: Zero resource dependency; pure knowledge economy; tax exemption model

RS-COS-001.name_zh: 卡拉乔尔杰/米洛舍维奇/塞尔维亚领袖：巴尔干生存外交与大国平衡
RS-COS-001.name_en: Karadjordje/Milosevic/Serbian Leaders: Balkan Survival Diplomacy & Great Power Balancing
RS-COS-001.description_zh: 塞尔维亚作为巴尔干核心枢纽，历经卡拉乔尔杰 (1768-1817) 首次起义建国、米洛舍维奇 (1941-2006) 南斯拉夫解体/科索沃战争/海牙审判、武契奇 (1970-) 欧盟入盟/科索沃常态化/中俄平衡三代领袖。核心生存逻辑：大国夹缝(奥/俄/德/美/土)→正教身份锚定→军事/情报非对称优势→流散网络杠杆。体现 M182 巴尔干生存外交——以"正教身份+军事威慑+大国摇摆+流散网络"四位一体，在文明断层线上实现国家生存延续。
RS-COS-001.description_en: Serbia as Balkan pivotal hub across three generations: Karadjordje (1768-1817) First Uprising statehood, Milosevic (1941-2006) Yugoslavia dissolution/Kosovo War/Hague trial, Vucic (1970-) EU accession/Kosovo normalization/China-Russia balance. Core survival logic: great power interstice (Austro/Russian/German/US/Turk) -> Orthodox identity anchor -> military/intel asymmetric advantage -> diaspora network leverage. Exemplifies M182 Balkan Survival Diplomacy—quaternity of 'Orthodox identity + military deterrence + great power oscillation + diaspora networks' achieving state survival continuity on civilizational fault lines.
RS-COS-001.reason_zh: 塞尔维亚生存史是"正教身份+军事威慑+大国平衡"三位一体：卡拉乔尔杰以正教起义建国，米洛舍维奇以军事/民族主义维持大塞尔维亚，武契奇以欧盟/中俄平衡求生存。M182 区隔于 M172 少数派生存(叙利亚)、M163 斯拉夫边境生存(乌克兰)、M170 部落联邦(伊拉克)，核心在于"正教身份锚定+军事非对称+大国代理人平衡"的巴尔干生存范式。
RS-COS-001.reason_en: Serbian survival history is trinity of 'Orthodox identity + military deterrence + great power balancing': Karadjordje built state via Orthodox uprising, Milosevic maintained Greater Serbia via military/nationalism, Vucic seeks survival via EU/China-Russia balance. M182 distinct from M172 Minority Survival (Syria), M163 Slavic Borderland Survival (Ukraine), M170 Tribal Federalism (Iraq), core: 'Orthodox identity anchor + military asymmetry + great power proxy balancing' Balkan survival paradigm.
steps_zh: 正教身份建国锚定：1804 卡拉乔尔杰起义以正教捍卫者自居，圣萨瓦精神凝聚民族共同体
军事威慑与非对称战争：1815 第二次起义/1912-13 巴尔干战争/1990s 南斯拉夫战争/1999 北约轰炸，军事意志为核心杠杆
大国间摇摆平衡：奥斯曼/奥匈/俄/德/美/中/欧，始终在两大阵营间寻找生存空间，从不彻底倒向单边
流散网络杠杆运用：美/德/奥/加/澳塞尔维亚侨民 300 万+，政治游说/资金汇款/技术回流，侨民成战略纵深
欧盟入盟与科索沃常态化：武契奇推进 EU 入盟谈判/科索沃对话常态化/中俄战略伙伴/军事中立，四面平衡求生存
steps_en: Orthodox identity state-building anchor: 1804 Karadjordje uprising as Orthodox defender, St. Sava spirit coalesces national community
Military deterrence & asymmetric warfare: 1815 Second Uprising/1912-13 Balkan Wars/1990s Yugoslav Wars/1999 NATO bombing, military will as core leverage
Great power oscillation balancing: Ottoman/Austro-Hungarian/Russian/German/US/China/EU, always seeking survival space between two blocs, never fully tilting to one side
Diaspora network leverage: 3M+ Serbian diaspora in US/DE/AT/CA/AU, political lobbying/remittances/tech return flow, diaspora as strategic depth
EU accession & Kosovo normalization: Vucic advances EU talks/Kosovo dialogue normalization/China-Russia strategic partnership/military neutrality, four-way balance for survival
RS-COS-001.expected_zh: 以"正教身份+军事威慑+大国摇摆+流散网络"四位一体，在奥/匈/俄/德/土/美/中/欧八强夹缝中实现两百年国家生存延续，为巴尔干小国提供极限生存范式。
RS-COS-001.expected_en: Quaternity of 'Orthodox identity + military deterrence + great power oscillation + diaspora networks' achieves two-century state survival continuity in eight-power squeeze of Austro-Hungarian/Russian/German/Turkish/US/Chinese/EU, providing extreme survival paradigm for Balkan small states.
RS-COS-001.case_zh: 1804 首次起义→1815 第二次起义→1878 柏林会议独立→1912-13 巴尔干战争扩张→1918 南斯拉夫建国→1990s 解体战争/海牙审判→2000 米洛舍维奇倒台→2008 科索沃单方面独立→2020s 武契奇欧盟/中俄平衡，两百年国家生存延续。
RS-COS-001.case_en: 1804 First Uprising -> 1815 Second Uprising -> 1878 Berlin Congress independence -> 1912-13 Balkan Wars expansion -> 1918 Yugoslavia founded -> 1990s dissolution wars/Hague trial -> 2000 Milosevic fall -> 2008 Kosovo unilateral independence -> 2020s Vucic EU/China-Russia balance, two-century state survival continuity.
RS-COS-001.cross_cultural_impact: Balkan survival model; Orthodox geopolitics; diaspora statecraft; great power balancing
RS-COS-001.colonial_history: Ottoman rule 1459-1878; Austro-Hungarian occupation 1915-18; Nazi occupation 1941-44
RS-COS-001.resource_curse_mitigation: Limited resources; agriculture/auto/defense industry; Chinese/Russian investment

RS-ORT-001.name_zh: 塞尔维亚正教会/精神领袖：正教协商制与圣萨瓦传统
RS-ORT-001.name_en: Serbian Orthodox Church/Spiritual Leaders: Orthodox Consultative Governance & St. Sava Tradition
RS-ORT-001.description_zh: 塞尔维亚正教会 (SOC) 1219 年圣萨瓦建立自治教会，1346 升格牧首区，历经奥斯曼米勒特制/南斯拉夫无神论/后共复兴，始终是塞族民族认同的精神内核。核心治理机制：主教圣统会议 (Holy Assembly of Bishops) 协商决策——牧首首席主教/主教团共识/修道院长老参议，教会法 (Kormchaya) 规范神职/婚姻/遗产/教育。体现 M160 正教协商制——以"圣统会议共识+修道院精神权威+教会法规范"三位一体，在政权更迭中提供民族精神连续性锚定。
RS-ORT-001.description_en: Serbian Orthodox Church (SOC) autocephaly 1219 St. Sava, patriarchate 1346, survived Ottoman millet system/Yugoslav atheism/post-comm revival, remains spiritual core of Serb national identity. Core governance mechanism: Holy Assembly of Bishops consultative decision-making—Patriarch primus inter pares/bishops consensus/monastic elders advisory, canon law (Kormchaya) regulates clergy/marriage/inheritance/education. Exemplifies M160 Orthodox Consultative Governance—trinity of 'Holy Assembly consensus + monastic spiritual authority + canon law normativity' providing ethnic spiritual continuity anchor across regime changes.
RS-ORT-001.reason_zh: 塞尔维亚正教会非单纯宗教机构，而是"民族精神存续操作系统"：奥斯曼期米勒特制保存民族性、南斯拉夫期地下坚持、后共复兴成道德权威。M160 区隔于 M149 伊斯兰咨询(舒拉)、M150 塔木德辩证(犹太)、M176 萨米协商(议会)，核心在于"圣统会议共识+修道院权威+教会法"的正教治理三位一体。
RS-ORT-001.reason_en: Serbian Orthodox Church not mere religious body but 'ethnic spiritual continuity OS': Ottoman millet preserved nationhood, Yugoslav era underground persistence, post-comm revival as moral authority. M160 distinct from M149 Islamic Shura (consultation), M150 Talmudic Dialectic (Jewish), M176 Sami Consultation (parliament), core: 'Holy Assembly consensus + monastic authority + canon law' Orthodox governance trinity.
steps_zh: 圣萨瓦自治教会建制：1219 尼西亚获自治权，确立牧首/主教/修道院三级治理，圣萨瓦成民族精神始祖
奥斯曼米勒特制生存：牧首任民族领袖(米勒特巴什)，教会法管辖婚姻/继承/教育，保存语言/习俗/身份
南斯拉夫无神论抗争：铁托政权迫害神职/没收财产/控制教育，地下礼拜/地下神学院/修道院坚持精神抵抗
后共复兴与道德权威：1990s 恢复合法地位/夺回财产/介入政治调解/战争罪证言/欧盟入盟道德把关
圣统会议协商机制：牧首首席主教/主教团共识/修道院长老参议/教会法法庭，决策经祈祷/斋戒/共识
steps_en: St. Sava autocephaly establishment: 1219 Nicaea granted autocephaly, established Patriarch/bishops/monasteries three-tier governance, St. Sava as ethnic spiritual progenitor
Ottoman millet system survival: Patriarch as ethnic leader (millet-bashi), canon law jurisdiction over marriage/inheritance/education, preserving language/customs/identity
Yugoslav atheism resistance: Tito regime persecuted clergy/confiscated property/controlled education, underground worship/clandestine seminaries/monasteries maintained spiritual resistance
Post-comm revival & moral authority: 1990s restored legal status/reclaimed property/political mediation/war crimes testimony/EU accession moral gatekeeping
Holy Assembly consultative mechanism: Patriarch primus inter pares/bishops consensus/monastic elders advisory/canon law courts, decisions via prayer/fasting/consensus
RS-ORT-001.expected_zh: 以"圣统会议共识+修道院精神权威+教会法规范"三位一体，在帝国兴衰/意识形态更迭/战争创伤中提供民族精神连续性锚定，为正教民族提供治理范式。
RS-ORT-001.expected_en: Trinity of 'Holy Assembly consensus + monastic spiritual authority + canon law normativity' provides ethnic spiritual continuity anchor across empire rises/falls, ideological shifts, war traumas, providing governance paradigm for Orthodox nations.
RS-ORT-001.case_zh: 1219 自治→1346 牧首区→1766 奥斯曼废除/1920 恢复→1941-44 纳粹占领迫害→1945-90 无神论打压→2000s 复兴/道德权威→2019 牧首波菲烈访俄/普京会晤，八百年精神连续性。
RS-ORT-001.case_en: 1219 autocephaly -> 1346 patriarchate -> 1766 Ottoman abolition/1920 restoration -> 1941-44 Nazi persecution -> 1945-90 atheist suppression -> 2000s revival/moral authority -> 2019 Patriarch Porfirije visits Russia/meets Putin, eight-century spiritual continuity.
RS-ORT-001.intellectual_tradition: Orthodox Canon Law / Hesychasm / St. Sava Legacy
RS-ORT-001.cross_cultural_impact: Orthodox governance model; canon law for family/inheritance; monasticism as spiritual resistance; moral authority in politics
RS-ORT-001.colonial_history: Ottoman millet system; Austro-Hungarian pressure; Nazi occupation
RS-ORT-001.diaspora_influence: SOC eparchies worldwide (US/CA/AU/DE/AT/SCAND); diaspora spiritual center
RS-ORT-001.indigenous_knowledge_system: Monastic oral tradition; hesychast prayer; iconography as theology

HR-NAT-001.name_zh: 图季曼/克罗地亚建国：边境民族建国与民主转型
HR-NAT-001.name_en: Tudjman/Croatian State-Building: Borderland Nation-Building & Democratic Transition
HR-NAT-001.description_zh: 弗拉尼奥·图季曼 (1922-1999) 克罗地亚首任总统 (1990-1999)，领导克罗地亚从南斯拉夫独立、建国、战争防御到民主巩固。核心建国逻辑：历史合法性(中世纪王国/班诺维纳/游击战传统)→武装建国(1991-95 家园战争/武科瓦尔/风暴行动)→民主制度化(1990 宪法/多党制/人权/欧盟/北约路径)→和解重建( Erdut 协议/难民回返/区域合作)。体现 M170 边境民族建国——以"历史合法性+武装自卫+民主制度化+区域和解"四位一体，在南斯拉夫解体/大塞尔维亚威胁/国际制裁三重夹击下完成民族建国。
HR-NAT-001.description_en: Franjo Tudjman (1922-1999) Croatia's first President (1990-1999), led Croatia from Yugoslav independence through state-building, war defense to democratic consolidation. Core nation-building logic: historical legitimacy (medieval kingdom/Banovina/partisan tradition) -> armed state-building (1991-95 Homeland War/Vukovar/Operation Storm) -> democratic institutionalization (1990 Constitution/multi-party/human rights/EU/NATO path) -> reconciliation & reconstruction (Erdut Agreement/refugee return/regional cooperation). Exemplifies M170 Borderland Nation-Building—quaternity of 'historical legitimacy + armed self-defense + democratic institutionalization + regional reconciliation' achieving nation-building under triple squeeze of Yugoslav dissolution/Greater Serbian threat/international sanctions.
HR-NAT-001.reason_zh: 克罗地亚建国是"历史合法性+武装自卫+民主转型"三位一体：图季曼以历史学家身份重构民族叙事，以将军身份指挥家园战争，以政治家身份推动民主/欧盟/北约。M170 区隔于 M181 边境地带共同体(历史)、M170 部落联邦(伊拉克)、M173 哈希姆守护(约旦)，核心在于"历史重构+武装建国+民主锚定"的后南斯拉夫建国范式。
HR-NAT-001.reason_en: Croatian nation-building is trinity of 'historical legitimacy + armed self-defense + democratic transition': Tudjman as historian reconstructed national narrative, as general commanded Homeland War, as statesman drove democratic/EU/NATO anchoring. M170 distinct from M181 Borderland Commonwealth (historical), M170 Tribal Federalism (Iraq), M173 Hashemite Guardian (Jordan), core: 'historical reconstruction + armed state-building + democratic anchoring' post-Yugoslav nation-building paradigm.
steps_zh: 历史合法性重构：图季曼《民族主义与共产主义》重述克族历史，确立中世纪王国/班诺维纳/游击战三重合法性来源
武装建国与家园战争：1991 独立公投/武科瓦尔围城/1995 风暴行动收复克拉伊纳，武装自卫成建国核心
民主制度化与西向锚定：1990 宪法/多党制/人权/1992 国际承认/2000 EU 稳定与伙伴关系/2009 北约/2013 欧盟入盟
和解重建与区域合作：1995 Erdut 协议东斯拉沃尼亚和平重归/难民回返/区域合作(阿得里亚-离子倡议/三海倡议)
历史争议与遗产：雅谢诺瓦茨/乌斯塔沙/游击战双重叙事/战争罪指控/历史修正主义争议，遗产复杂
steps_en: Historical legitimacy reconstruction: Tudjman's 'Nationalism & Communism' re-narrates Croat history, establishing medieval kingdom/Banovina/partisan triple legitimacy sources
Armed state-building & Homeland War: 1991 independence referendum/Vukovar siege/1995 Operation Storm recaptures Krajina, armed self-defense as nation-building core
Democratic institutionalization & Western anchoring: 1990 Constitution/multi-party/human rights/1992 international recognition/2000 EU SAA/2009 NATO/2013 EU accession
Reconciliation, reconstruction & regional cooperation: 1995 Erdut Agreement Eastern Slavonia peaceful reintegration/refugee return/regional cooperation (Adriatic-Ionian/Three Seas Initiative)
Historical controversies & legacy: Jasenovac/Ustasa/partisan dual narratives/war crimes accusations/historical revisionism debates, complex legacy
HR-NAT-001.expected_zh: 以"历史重构+武装建国+民主锚定+区域和解"四位一体，在大塞尔维亚威胁/国际制裁/内部寡头三重夹击下完成民族建国与民主转型，为后南斯拉夫空间提供建国范式。
HR-NAT-001.expected_en: Quaternity of 'historical reconstruction + armed state-building + democratic anchoring + regional reconciliation' achieves nation-building & democratic transition under triple squeeze of Greater Serbian threat/international sanctions/internal oligarchs, providing nation-building paradigm for post-Yugoslav space.
HR-NAT-001.case_zh: 1990 首任总统→1991 独立/武科瓦尔→1995 风暴行动/Erdut→1999 图季曼逝世→2000 拉奇奇/梅西奇民主巩固→2009 北约→2013 欧盟，三十年建国-战争-民主-入盟完整路径。
HR-NAT-001.case_en: 1990 1st President -> 1991 independence/Vukovar -> 1995 Storm/Erdut -> 1999 Tudjman death -> 2000 Racan/Mesic democratic consolidation -> 2009 NATO -> 2013 EU, 30-year complete path of state-building-war-democracy-accession.
HR-NAT-001.cross_cultural_impact: Post-Yugoslav nation-building model; Catholic Atlanticism; historical narrative politics; regional cooperation
HR-NAT-001.colonial_history: Austro-Hungarian; Italian occupation WWII; Yugoslav; Independent 1991
HR-NAT-001.diaspora_influence: Croatian diaspora 4M+ (US/CA/DE/AU/AR/CL); 1990s lobbying crucial for recognition
HR-NAT-001.resource_curse_mitigation: Adriatic tourism; shipbuilding; agriculture; EU structural funds

SI-IND-001.name_zh: 斯洛文尼亚工业/转型先驱：制造强国与欧盟融合模式
SI-IND-001.name_en: Slovenian Industry/Transition Pioneers: Manufacturing Powerhouse & EU Integration Model
SI-IND-001.description_zh: 斯洛文尼亚作为南斯拉夫最发达共和国 (人均 GDP 占联邦 20%+)，通过米兰·库昌 (1941-) 首任总统 (1990-2002) 稳健转型：保留工业基础 (汽车/制药/家电/机床)→私有化稳健/外资引入 (雷诺/葛兰素史克/博世)→2004 欧盟/北约入盟→2007 欧元区首个前南成员。核心转型模式：社会伙伴协商 (政府/工会/雇主三方)→出口导向制造升级→创新驱动 (研发占 GDP 2%+)。体现 M81 成本领先制造与 M151 北欧信任资本融合——以"社会对话+制造升级+欧盟锚定"三位一体，实现后共体制最高生活水平。
SI-IND-001.description_en: Slovenia as Yugoslavia's most developed republic (20%+ federal GDP per capita), achieved steady transition under Milan Kucan (1941-) 1st President (1990-2002): preserved industrial base (auto/pharma/appliances/machine tools) -> prudent privatization/FDI (Renault/GSK/Bosch) -> 2004 EU/NATO accession -> 2007 first ex-Yugoslav eurozone member. Core transition model: social partnership tripartite (govt/unions/employers) -> export-oriented manufacturing upgrade -> innovation-driven (R&D 2%+ GDP). Exemplifies M81 Cost Leadership Manufacturing fused with M151 Nordic Trust Capital—trinity of 'social dialogue + manufacturing upgrade + EU anchoring' achieving highest post-communist living standards.
SI-IND-001.reason_zh: 斯洛文尼亚转型独特在于"社会对话+工业保留+欧盟锚定"三位一体：避免了休克疗法去工业化，保住制造业占 GDP 25%+，人均 GDP 达中欧最高。M81+M151 结合，区隔于 M161 后苏联转型(乌克兰)、M170 威权稳定(白俄罗斯)、M163 斯拉夫边境(乌克兰)，核心在于"社会伙伴协商制+制造升级+欧盟融合"的中欧转型黄金标准。
SI-IND-001.reason_en: Slovenian transition unique in trinity of 'social dialogue + industrial retention + EU anchoring': avoided shock therapy deindustrialization, kept manufacturing 25%+ GDP, highest ex-Yugoslav GDP per capita. M81+M151 combined, distinct from M161 Post-Soviet Transition (Ukraine), M170 Authoritarian Stability (Belarus), M163 Slavic Borderland (Ukraine), core: 'social partnership + manufacturing upgrade + EU integration' Central European transition gold standard.
steps_zh: 社会伙伴协商制建立：政府/工会/雇主三方委员会，工资/价格/私有化/劳动法共识决策，避免冲突
稳健私有化与外资引入：内部员工持股/战略投资者招标/保留核心国企/雷诺雷克萨斯/葛兰素史克/博世入驻
制造升级与出口导向：汽车(雷诺/标致)/制药(克雷卡)/家电(哥伦布)/机床/绿色技术，出口占 GDP 80%+
欧盟/北约/欧元区锚定：2004 入盟/2007 欧元区/申根/经合组织，制度收敛驱动结构改革
创新驱动与绿色转型：研发 2%+ GDP/绿色技术/数字化/循环经济，人均 GDP 2023 超 $3 万
steps_en: Social partnership tripartite establishment: govt/unions/employers council, wages/prices/privatization/labor law consensus decisions, conflict avoidance
Prudent privatization & FDI attraction: employee buyouts/strategic investor tenders/retained core SOEs/Renault Revoz/GSK/Bosch entry
Manufacturing upgrade & export orientation: auto(Renault/Peugeot)/pharma(Krka)/appliances(Gorenje)/machine tools/green tech, exports 80%+ GDP
EU/NATO/eurozone anchoring: 2004 accession/2007 eurozone/Schengen/OECD, institutional convergence driving structural reforms
Innovation-driven & green transition: R&D 2%+ GDP/green tech/digitalization/circular economy, GDP per capita 2023 >$30k
SI-IND-001.expected_zh: 以"社会对话+制造保留+欧盟锚定"三位一体，实现后共体制最高生活水平/最低不平等/最快制度收敛，为中欧转型提供黄金标准范式。
SI-IND-001.expected_en: Trinity of 'social dialogue + industrial retention + EU anchoring' achieves highest post-communist living standards/lowest inequality/fastest institutional convergence, providing Central European transition gold standard paradigm.
SI-IND-001.case_zh: 人均 GDP 2023 $3.1 万(前南最高)/基尼系数 0.24(全球最低)/制造业占比 25%+/研发 2.1%/出口 $500 亿+/2007 欧元区首个前南成员，转型教科书案例。
SI-IND-001.case_en: GDP per capita 2023 $31k (ex-Yugoslavia highest)/Gini 0.24 (global lowest)/manufacturing 25%+/R&D 2.1%/exports $50B+/2007 first ex-Yugoslav eurozone member, transition textbook case.
SI-IND-001.cross_cultural_impact: Central European transition model; social partnership governance; manufacturing retention; EU integration speed
SI-IND-001.colonial_history: Austro-Hungarian; Italian/German occupation WWII; Yugoslav; Independent 1991
SI-IND-001.resource_curse_mitigation: No resource curse; manufacturing/services/knowledge economy; EU cohesion funds

HU-MOD-001.name_zh: 1956革命/欧尔班/后共转型：威权民粹与中欧枢纽外交
HU-MOD-001.name_en: 1956 Revolution/Orban/Post-Communist Transition: Authoritarian Populism & Central European Pivot Diplomacy
HU-MOD-001.description_zh: 匈牙利经历 1956 反苏起义/卡达尔软性共产主义/1989 圆桌会议/欧尔班 (1963-) 2010- 体制化威权民粹三重历史断层。欧尔班核心治理模式：宪法重写/司法捕获/媒体管制/学术自由压缩/反移民/反索罗斯/基督教民主/家庭政策→"非自由民主"宣言/中欧枢纽外交(维谢格拉德/中俄/欧盟/北约)→能源安全(帕克斯核电扩建/俄气/多元化)。体现 M161 后共转型/威权民粹——以"宪法重写+司法捕获+媒体管制+枢纽外交"四位一体，在欧盟/北约/中俄/维谢格拉德四强夹缝中构建主权自主空间。
HU-MOD-001.description_en: Hungary across three historical ruptures: 1956 anti-Soviet uprising/Kadar goulash communism/1989 roundtable/Orban (1963-) 2010- institutionalized authoritarian populism. Orban's core governance model: constitutional rewrite/judicial capture/media control/academic freedom squeeze/anti-immigration/anti-Soros/Christian democracy/family policy -> 'illiberal democracy' declaration/Central European pivot diplomacy (Visegrad/China-Russia/EU/NATO) -> energy security (Paks nuclear expansion/Russian gas/diversification). Exemplifies M161 Post-Communist Transition/Authoritarian Populism—quaternity of 'constitutional rewrite + judicial capture + media control + pivot diplomacy' constructing sovereign autonomy space in EU/NATO/China-Russia/Visegrad four-power squeeze.
HU-MOD-001.reason_zh: 匈牙利转型独特在于"威权民粹+基督教民主+枢纽外交"三位一体：欧尔班以民主选举合法性重写宪法捕获司法/媒体，以基督教身份拒移民/反全球主义，以维谢格拉德/中俄/欧盟/北约四面平衡争取能源/主权/资金。M161 区隔于 M170 威权稳定(白俄罗斯)、M163 斯拉夫边境(乌克兰)、M171 资源民族主义(伊拉克)，核心在于"选举威权+身份政治+多极平衡"的中欧特色范式。
HU-MOD-001.reason_en: Hungarian transition unique in trinity of 'authoritarian populism + Christian democracy + pivot diplomacy': Orban uses democratic legitimacy to rewrite constitution capturing judiciary/media, Christian identity rejects immigration/globalism, Visegrad/China-Russia/EU/NATO four-way balancing for energy/sovereignty/funds. M161 distinct from M170 Authoritarian Stability (Belarus), M163 Slavic Borderland (Ukraine), M171 Resource Nationalist (Iraq), core: 'electoral authoritarianism + identity politics + multipolar balancing' Central European paradigm.
steps_zh: 1956 反苏起义精神锚定：纳吉改革/苏军镇压/卡达尔妥协，1956 成民族抵抗精神图腾

欧尔班体制化威权：2010 超级多数/2011 新宪法/司法退休年龄降低/媒体委员会/学术自由法/NGO 法/反移民围墙

中欧枢纽外交四面平衡：维谢格拉德四国/俄帕克斯核电/中一带一路/欧盟结构性基金/北约成员，四强夹缝求生存
steps_en: 1956 anti-Soviet uprising spiritual anchor: Nagy reforms/Soviet crackdown/Kadar compromise, 1956 becomes national resistance spiritual totem

RO-NAT-001.name_zh: 马泰乌斯库/罗马尼亚统一：拉丁岛屿生存与战略自主
RO-NAT-001.name_en: Michael the Brave/Romanian Unification: Latin Island Survival & Strategic Autonomy
RO-NAT-001.description_zh: 罗马尼亚作为东正教环境中的拉丁语族"岛屿"，历经米哈伊·维特亚祖尔 (1558-1601) 首次三省统一、1859 摩尔多瓦-瓦拉几亚合并、1918 大罗马尼亚建国、1947 共产主义/齐奥塞斯库/1989 革命/2004 北约/2007 欧盟。核心生存逻辑：拉丁身份锚定(语言/法律/文化)→大帝国夹缝(奥/俄/土/德/苏)灵活平衡→战略自主(独立外交/核不扩散/黑海能源/多瑙河航运)。体现 M170 拉丁岛屿生存——以"拉丁身份+灵活平衡+战略自主+黑海枢纽"四位一体，在斯拉夫/奥斯曼/德/苏四强夹缝中实现民族国家延续。
RO-NAT-001.description_en: Romania as Latin-language 'island' in Orthodox environment, across Michael the Brave (1558-1601) first three-province union, 1859 Moldavia-Wallachia union, 1918 Greater Romania, 1947 communism/Ceausescu/1989 revolution/2004 NATO/2007 EU. Core survival logic: Latin identity anchor (language/law/culture) -> great empire interstice (Austro/Russian/Ottoman/German/Soviet) flexible balancing -> strategic autonomy (independent diplomacy/nuclear non-proliferation/Black Sea energy/Danube navigation). Exemplifies M170 Latin Island Survival—quaternity of 'Latin identity + flexible balancing + strategic autonomy + Black Sea hub' achieving nation-state continuity in Slavic/Ottoman/German/Soviet four-power squeeze.
RO-NAT-001.reason_zh: 罗马尼亚生存史是"拉丁身份+灵活平衡"双螺旋：语言/法律/文化锚定西方，地理/能源/安全迫使东向平衡。米哈伊首次统一→卡罗尔一世独立→费迪南大统一→安托内斯库倒向德/米哈伊一世倒向苏→齐奥塞斯库独立外交/拒入侵捷/联中→后共欧盟/北约/黑海能源。M170 区隔于 M181 边境地带(乌克兰)、M170 部落联邦(伊拉克)、M173 哈希姆守护(约旦)，核心在于"拉丁身份锚定+大国灵活平衡+黑海战略枢纽"的拉丁岛屿生存范式。
RO-NAT-001.reason_en: Romanian survival history is double helix of 'Latin identity + flexible balancing': language/law/culture anchor West, geography/energy/security force East balancing. Michael first union -> Carol I independence -> Ferdinand Great Union -> Antonescu pro-German/Michael I pro-Soviet -> Ceausescu independent diplomacy/refused Czech invasion/opened China -> post-comm EU/NATO/Black Sea energy. M170 distinct from M181 Borderland (Ukraine), M170 Tribal Federalism (Iraq), M173 Hashemite Guardian (Jordan), core: 'Latin identity anchor + great power flexible balancing + Black Sea strategic hub' Latin island survival paradigm.
steps_zh: 拉丁身份确立与坚守：达科-罗马连续性/拉丁字母/罗马法传统/西向教会，语言成民族灵魂锚定
大帝国夹缝灵活平衡：奥斯曼/奥匈/俄/德/苏/美，始终在两大阵营间寻找自主空间，从不彻底倒向单边
大统一与战略自主：1918 阿尔巴尤利亚大统一/1944 米哈伊一世倒向盟军缩短战争/1960s 齐奥塞斯库独立外交/拒入侵捷/建交中/核不扩散
黑海能源枢纽与多瑙河航运：康斯坦察港/黑海油气/多瑙河-黑海运河/三海倡议/北约东翼，地理劣势转战略资产
后共民主巩固与战略自主：1989 革命/2004 北约/2007 欧盟/黑海能源/核电/三海倡议领袖，战略自主成核心叙事
steps_en: Latin identity establishment & adherence: Daco-Roman continuity/Latin alphabet/Roman law tradition/Western church, language as ethnic soul anchor
Great empire interstice flexible balancing: Ottoman/Austro-Hungarian/Russian/German/Soviet/US, always seeking autonomy space between two blocs, never fully tilting to one side

Great Union & strategic autonomy: 1918 Alba Iulia Great Union/1944 Michael I turns to Allies shortening war/1960s Ceausescu independent diplomacy/refused Czech invasion/opened China/nuclear non-proliferation
Black Sea energy hub & Danube navigation: Constanta port/Black Sea oil-gas/Danube-Black Sea Canal/Three Seas Initiative/NATO eastern flank, geographic liability turned strategic asset
Post-comm democratic consolidation & strategic autonomy: 1989 revolution/2004 NATO/2007 EU/Black Sea energy/nuclear/Three Seas leader, strategic autonomy as core narrative
RO-NAT-001.expected_zh: 以"拉丁身份+灵活平衡+战略自主+黑海枢纽"四位一体，在斯拉夫/奥斯曼/德/苏四强夹缝中实现拉丁语族民族国家延续，为夹缝生存提供拉丁岛屿范式。
RO-NAT-001.expected_en: Quaternity of 'Latin identity + flexible balancing + strategic autonomy + Black Sea hub' achieves Latin nation-state continuity in Slavic/Ottoman/German/Soviet four-power squeeze, providing Latin island survival paradigm for interstice survival.
RO-NAT-001.case_zh: 1600 米哈伊首次三省统一→1859 合并→1877 独立战争/卡罗尔一世→1918 大罗马尼亚/阿尔巴尤利亚→1944 米哈伊倒向盟军→1965 齐奥塞斯库独立外交→1989 革命/齐奥塞斯库处决→2004 北约/2007 欧盟/三海倡议领袖，四百年拉丁岛屿生存延续。
RO-NAT-001.case_en: 1600 Michael first three-province union -> 1859 union -> 1877 independence war/Carol I -> 1918 Greater Romania/Alba Iulia -> 1944 Michael I to Allies -> 1965 Ceausescu independent diplomacy -> 1989 revolution/Ceausescu executed -> 2004 NATO/2007 EU/Three Seas leader, four-century Latin island survival continuity.
RO-NAT-001.intellectual_tradition: Romanian Latinism / Strategic Autonomy / Black Sea Geopolitics

BG-CUL-001.name_zh: 保加利亚文化/西里尔传承：梦境时间叙事与正教文明桥梁
BG-CUL-001.name_en: Bulgarian Culture/Cyril Legacy: Dreamtime Narrative & Orthodox Civilizational Bridge
BG-CUL-001.description_zh: 保加利亚作为斯拉夫正教文明的摇篮，历经西里尔/梅托迪 (860s) 创造格拉哥里/西里尔字母、927 年牧首区/特尔诺沃文学学派、奥斯曼 500 年/民族复兴/1878 独立/1944 共产主义/1989 民主/2004 北约/2007 欧盟。核心文化传承：西里尔字母即民族灵魂/正教即文明锚定/口述史诗 (《迪根·阿克拉》/《米奥德拉戈》) 即历史记忆/玫瑰谷/修道院网络即精神地理。体现 M154 梦境时间叙事——以"文字创制+正教锚定+口述史诗+修道院网络"四位一体，在拜占庭/奥斯曼/苏联/欧盟四重文明冲击中实现文化连续性。
BG-CUL-001.description_en: Bulgaria as cradle of Slavic Orthodox civilization, across Cyril/Methodius (860s) creating Glagolitic/Cyrillic scripts, 927 Patriarchate/Tarnovo Literary School, 500-year Ottoman/National Revival/1878 independence/1944 communism/1989 democracy/2004 NATO/2007 EU. Core cultural transmission: Cyrillic script as ethnic soul/Orthodoxy as civilizational anchor/ oral epics ('Digenis Akritas'/'Miodrag') as historical memory/Rose Valley/monastery network as spiritual geography. Exemplifies M154 Dreamtime Narrative—quaternity of 'script creation + Orthodox anchor + oral epics + monastery network' achieving cultural continuity under four-civilization impacts of Byzantine/Ottoman/Soviet/EU.
BG-CUL-001.reason_zh: 保加利亚文化非单纯遗产，而是"文字即灵魂+正教即锚+史诗即史+修道院即地"四位一体文化操作系统。西里尔字母输出至俄/塞/北马其顿/蒙古，正教牧首区提供精神主权，口述史诗编码历史记忆，修道院网络(里拉/巴霍沃/罗热嫩)守护圣地。M154 区隔于 M155 魔幻现实(拉美)、M177 因纽特生存(北极)、M178 极地气候(工程)，核心在于"文字创制文明+正教精神主权+口述史诗历史记忆"的斯拉夫文化连续性范式。
BG-CUL-001.reason_en: Bulgarian culture not mere heritage but 'script as soul + Orthodoxy as anchor + epics as history + monasteries as geography' quaternity cultural OS. Cyrillic exported to Rus/Serbia/N.Macedonia/Mongolia, Orthodox patriarchate provides spiritual sovereignty, oral epics encode historical memory, monastery network (Rila/Bachkovo/Rozhen) guards sacred geography. M154 distinct from M155 Magical Realism (LatAm), M177 Inuit Survival (Arctic), M178 Polar Climate (engineering), core: 'script-creates-civilization + Orthodox spiritual sovereignty + oral epics historical memory' Slavic cultural continuity paradigm.
steps_zh: 西里尔/梅托迪文字创制：860s 格拉哥里字母/西里尔字母，斯拉夫语言首次书面化，文字成文明基因
正教牧首区与文学学派：927 牧首区/特尔诺沃/奥赫里德学派，翻译圣经/教父/古典，斯拉夫神学体系建立
奥斯曼期口述史诗存续：《迪根·阿克拉》《米奥德拉戈》吟游诗人传唱，编码反抗/英雄/信仰记忆
修道院网络守护圣地：里拉/巴霍沃/罗热嫩/特罗扬，壁画/圣像/手抄本/圣物，精神地理锚定民族魂
现代复兴与欧盟文化外交：1878 独立/复兴作家/2007 欧盟/西里尔字母成欧盟官方文字/文化遗产数字化/旅游复兴
steps_en: Cyril/Methodius script creation: 860s Glagolitic/Cyrillic scripts, Slavic languages first written, script becomes civilizational gene
Orthodox patriarchate & literary schools: 927 Patriarchate/Tarnovo/Ohrid schools, translated Bible/Fathers/classics, Slavic theological system established
Ottoman-era oral epic survival: 'Digenis Akritas'/'Miodrag' minstrels transmit, encoding resistance/heroes/faith memories
Monastery network guarding sacred geography: Rila/Bachkovo/Rozhen/Troyan, frescoes/icons/manuscripts/relics, spiritual geography anchors ethnic soul
Modern revival & EU cultural diplomacy: 1878 independence/Revival writers/2007 EU/Cyrillic becomes EU official script/heritage digitization/tourism revival
BG-CUL-001.expected_zh: 以"文字创制+正教锚定+口述史诗+修道院网络"四位一体，在拜占庭/奥斯曼/苏联/欧盟四重文明冲击中实现文化连续性，西里尔字母成为斯拉夫文明共同基因，为小语种文化存续提供范式。
BG-CUL-001.expected_en: Quaternity of 'script creation + Orthodox anchor + oral epics + monastery network' achieves cultural continuity under four-civilization impacts of Byzantine/Ottoman/Soviet/EU, Cyrillic script becomes Slavic civilizational common gene, providing small-language cultural survival paradigm.
BG-CUL-001.case_zh: 860s 文字创制→927 牧首区→1393 奥斯曼灭亡/500 年统治→1878 独立/复兴→1944 共产主义/文字拉丁化尝试失败→1989 民主/西里尔字母复位→2007 欧盟/西里尔成第 3 官方文字，1100+ 年文化连续性。
BG-CUL-001.case_en: 860s script creation -> 927 patriarchate -> 1393 Ottoman fall/500 yr rule -> 1878 independence/Revival -> 1944 communism/Latinization attempt failed -> 1989 democracy/Cyrillic restored -> 2007 EU/Cyrillic becomes 3rd official script, 1100+ year cultural continuity.
BG-CUL-001.intellectual_tradition: Bulgarian Slavic Culture / Cyrillic Legacy / Orthodox Civilizational Bridge
BG-CUL-001.cross_cultural_impact: Cyrillic script for 250M+ peoples; Slavic literary language; Orthodox cultural bridge; EU cultural diversity
BG-CUL-001.diaspora_influence: Bulgarian diaspora 2M+ (TR/DE/ES/US/CA/AR/BR); Rose Valley attar global
BG-CUL-001.indigenous_knowledge_system: Oral epic tradition; monastery iconography; rose oil distillation; folk calendar

ET-EMP-001.name_zh: 埃塞俄比亚·海尔·塞拉西：皇帝现代化与非洲联盟拉斯塔神性
ET-EMP-001.name_en: Ethiopia Haile Selassie: Emperor Modernization & African Union Rastafari Divinity
ET-EMP-001.description_zh: 海尔·塞拉西 (1892-1975) 埃塞俄比亚皇帝 (1930-1974)，抵抗意大利入侵流亡英国回国，推动非洲统一组织成立亚的斯亚贝巴总部，拉斯塔法里运动视为黑人弥赛亚，1974年军变下台。
ET-EMP-001.description_en: Haile Selassie (1892-1975) Ethiopia Emperor (1930-1974), resisted Italian invasion exiled UK returned, promoted OAU founding Addis Ababa headquarters, Rastafari movement views as Black Messiah, 1974 coup overthrown.
ET-EMP-001.reason_zh: 海尔·塞拉西代表非洲唯一未被殖民国家皇帝如何通过现代化与泛非外交构建地区领袖地位，展示了拉斯塔法里运动如何将埃塞俄比亚皇帝神圣化为黑人解放象征，其非盟总部遗产永存。
ET-EMP-001.reason_en: Selassie represents how African only uncolonized nation Emperor built regional leadership through modernization and Pan-African diplomacy, demonstrating how Rastafari movement sacralized Ethiopian Emperor as Black liberation symbol, his AU headquarters legacy endures.
steps_zh: 研究海尔早年摄政王与1930年加冕皇帝
分析1935意大利入侵流亡日内瓦国联演说
探讨1963非洲统一组织成立亚迪斯亚贝巴总部
评估拉斯塔法里运动弥赛亚崇拜与雷鬼音乐传播
总结皇帝现代化非洲联盟拉斯塔神性对非洲一体化的奠基遗产
steps_en: Study Selassie early regent and 1930 coronation Emperor
Analyze 1935 Italian invasion exile Geneva League of Nations speech
Explore 1963 OAU founding Addis Ababa headquarters
Evaluate Rastafari Messiah worship and reggae music dissemination
Summarize Emperor modernization African Union Rastafari divinity foundational legacy for African integration
ET-EMP-001.expected_zh: 理解唯一未殖民非洲国家如何通过皇帝外交确立泛非领导地位，掌握宗教运动如何跨越国界重塑政治人物神圣性，评估海尔遗产对非盟与全球黑人解放运动的双重贡献。
ET-EMP-001.expected_en: Understand how only uncolonized African nation established Pan-African leadership through Emperor diplomacy, grasp how religious movement transcends borders resacralizing political figure, evaluate Selassie dual contribution for AU and global Black liberation movement.
ET-EMP-001.case_zh: 1930 加冕；1935 流亡；1963 非盟；1974 军变。皇帝现代化非盟拉斯塔范式永存。
ET-EMP-001.case_en: 1930 coronation; 1935 exile; 1963 OAU; 1974 coup. Emperor modernization AU Rastafari paradigm endures.
ET-EMP-001.cross_cultural_impact: OAU founder; Rastafari Messiah; anti-colonial resistance; African unity

ET-FED-001.name_zh: 梅莱斯/联邦制/大坝：民族联邦制与发展型国家
ET-FED-001.description_zh: 梅莱斯·泽纳维 (1955-2012) 1991-2012 执政埃塞俄比亚，设计《1995 民族联邦制宪法》：九大民族州/两联邦直辖市/分权立法/税收/教育/语言政策；发展型国家模式：国家主导工业化/农业主导工业化(ADLI)/出口导向/大坝基建(吉尔吉尔吉贝三期/复兴大坝 GERD)；外交：非洲之角稳定/索马里/苏丹/厄立特里亚/非盟/中美平衡。体现 M184 民族联邦制——以"民族自决权+发展型国家+水霸权+非洲外交"四位一体，在极度多民族/贫困/地缘冲突中实现高速增长与国家统一。
ET-FED-001.description_en: Meles Zenawi (1955-2012) ruled Ethiopia 1991-2012, designed 1995 ethnic federalism constitution: 9 ethnic regions/2 federal cities/devolved legislation/tax/education/language policy; developmental state model: state-led industrialization/agriculture-led industrialization (ADLI)/export-oriented/dam infrastructure (Gilgel Gibe III/GERD); diplomacy: Horn stability/Somalia/Sudan/Eritrea/AU/China-US balance. Exemplifies M184 Ethnic Federalism—quaternity of 'self-determination right + developmental state + water hegemony + African diplomacy' achieving high growth & state unity amid extreme ethnic diversity/poverty/geopolitical conflict.
ET-FED-001.reason_zh: 埃塞俄比亚民族联邦制是"自决权+发展国家"双螺旋：90+ 民族/语言在宪法框架内自治，国家主导工业化实现年均 10%+ 增长。梅莱斯以铁腕推进大坝/工业园/出口导向，同时给予民族文化自治。M184 区隔于 M164 乌班图变体(共识)、M170 联邦制(加拿大)、M183 王朝正统(血统)，核心在于"民族自决宪法化+发展国家杠杆+水资源霸权"的非洲发展奇迹范式。
ET-FED-001.reason_en: Ethiopian ethnic federalism is dual helix of 'self-determination + developmental state': 90+ ethnicities/languages self-govern within constitutional framework, state-led industrialization achieves 10%+ annual growth. Meles drove dams/industrial parks/export-orientation with iron fist while granting ethnic cultural autonomy. M184 distinct from M164 Ubuntu variant (consensus), M170 Federalism (Canada), M183 Dynastic Legitimacy (bloodline), core: 'ethnic self-determination constitutionalized + developmental state leverage + water resource hegemony' African development miracle paradigm.
steps_zh: 民族联邦制宪法设计：1995 宪法第 39 条民族自决权/分离权/九大州两市/语言/文化/税收自治，法律锚定多民族统一
发展型国家工业化路径：农业主导工业化 ADLI/国家主导纺织/皮革/制药/工业园/出口加工区/年均 10%+ 增长 2004-2019
水霸权与大坝战略：吉尔吉尔吉贝三期/复兴大坝 GERD 6450MW/尼罗河水权博弈/埃及苏丹谈判/区域能源枢纽/电力出口
非洲外交与区域霸权：索马里维和/苏丹南北调停/厄立特里亚战争/非盟总部亚的斯亚贝巴/中美平衡/一带一路/区域一体化

steps_en: Ethnic federalism constitutional design: 1995 Constitution Art. 39 self-determination/secession/9 regions 2 cities/language/culture/tax autonomy, legal anchor for multi-ethnic unity
Developmental state industrialization path: Agriculture-led industrialization ADLI/state-led textile/leather/pharma/industrial parks/EPZs/10%+ avg growth 2004-2019
Water hegemony & dam strategy: Gilgel Gibe III/GERD 6450MW/Nile water rights tussle/Egypt-Sudan negotiations/regional energy hub/power export

ET-COF-001.name_zh: 咖啡仪式/原住民领袖：非洲口述传统治理与咖啡外交
ET-COF-001.name_en: Coffee Ceremony/Indigenous Leaders: African Oral Tradition Governance & Coffee Diplomacy
ET-COF-001.description_zh: 埃塞俄比亚咖啡起源地(卡法森林)，咖啡仪式(Buna)为核心社会治理技术：烘焙/研磨/煮制三轮(阿沃尔/托纳/巴雷卡)/长者主持/社区议事/冲突调解/婚姻协商/联盟缔结。奥罗莫/锡达马/耶姆等族群长者(Gadaa 制度/长者会议)以咖啡仪式编码生态知识/族谱/法律/战争记忆。体现 M185 非洲口述传统治理——以"咖啡仪式即议会+长者即法官+口述即宪法+咖啡即外交"四位一体，在无文字/弱国家/强宗族社会中实现秩序与共识。
ET-COF-001.description_en: Ethiopia as coffee origin (Kaffa forest), coffee ceremony (Buna) as core social governance tech: roasting/grinding/brewing three rounds (Abol/Tona/Baraka)/elders preside/community deliberation/conflict mediation/marriage negotiation/alliance making. Oromo/Sidama/Yem elders (Gadaa system/council of elders) encode ecological knowledge/genealogy/law/war memory via coffee ceremony. Exemplifies M185 African Oral Tradition Governance—quaternity of 'coffee ceremony as parliament + elders as judges + oral as constitution + coffee as diplomacy' achieving order & consensus in non-literate/weak-state/strong-clan societies.
ET-COF-001.reason_zh: 埃塞俄比亚咖啡仪式非单纯饮食，而是"仪式即议会+长者即法官+口述即宪法"三位一体治理操作系统。Gadaa 制度(奥罗莫 8 年轮值/长者会议/权力交接仪式)以咖啡仪式编码权力交接/冲突解决/资源分配。M185 区隔于 M154 梦境时间(澳洲)、M148 毛利共识(新西兰)、M146 乌班图(南非)，核心在于"咖啡仪式即治理算法+口述传统即法律编码+长者权威即制度保障"的非洲口述治理范式。
ET-COF-001.reason_en: Ethiopian coffee ceremony not mere dining but 'ceremony as parliament + elders as judges + oral as constitution' trinity governance OS. Gadaa system (Oromo 8-year rotation/elders council/power transfer ritual) encodes power transfer/conflict resolution/resource allocation via coffee ceremony. M185 distinct from M154 Dreamtime (Australia), M148 Māori Consensus (NZ), M146 Ubuntu (SA), core: 'coffee ceremony as governance algorithm + oral tradition as legal code + elder authority as institutional guarantee' African oral governance paradigm.
steps_zh: 咖啡仪式即议会：三轮煮制(阿沃尔/托纳/巴雷卡)对应议事阶段/信息公开/决策确认，长者主持社区公议
长者即法官：Gadaa 长者会议/族谱权威/习法记忆，冲突调解/婚姻协商/土地分配/血亲复仇终结
口述即宪法：族谱/习法/生态知识/战争记忆编码于咖啡仪式/歌曲/诗歌/谚语，代际传承零文字
咖啡即外交：咖啡贸易/礼品赠予/联盟缔结/和平缔结/跨族群通婚，咖啡豆即信任货币
现代传承与制度化：咖啡仪式入选非遗/旅游体验/品牌出口/现代法律吸纳习法/长者参与地方治理
steps_en: Coffee ceremony as parliament: three brewing rounds (Abol/Tona/Baraka) correspond to deliberation phases/info disclosure/decision confirmation, elders preside community assembly
Elders as judges: Gadaa elders council/genealogical authority/customary law memory, conflict mediation/marriage negotiation/land allocation/blood feud termination
Oral as constitution: genealogy/customary law/ecological knowledge/war memory encoded in coffee ceremony/songs/poems/proverbs, intergenerational transmission zero-text
Coffee as diplomacy: coffee trade/gift giving/alliance making/peace treaties/inter-clan marriages, coffee beans as trust currency
Modern transmission & institutionalization: coffee ceremony UNESCO ICH/tourism experience/brand export/modern law absorbs customary law/elders participate local governance
ET-COF-001.expected_zh: 以"咖啡仪式即议会+长者即法官+口述即宪法+咖啡即外交"四位一体，在无文字/弱国家/强宗族社会中实现秩序与共识，为非洲口述传统社会提供治理范式。
ET-COF-001.expected_en: Quaternity of 'coffee ceremony as parliament + elders as judges + oral as constitution + coffee as diplomacy' achieves order & consensus in non-literate/weak-state/strong-clan societies, providing governance paradigm for African oral tradition societies.
ET-COF-001.case_zh: Gadaa 制度 2016 非遗/咖啡仪式 2023 非遗/奥罗莫 4000 万+人口/每 8 年权力交接/长者会议零成本冲突解决/咖啡出口 $10 亿+/年，口述治理活化石。
ET-COF-001.case_en: Gadaa system 2016 UNESCO ICH/coffee ceremony 2023 ICH/Oromo 40M+ population/8-year power rotation/elders council zero-cost conflict resolution/coffee exports $1B+/yr, living fossil of oral governance.
ET-COF-001.intellectual_tradition: Ethiopian Oral Governance / Gadaa System / Coffee Diplomacy
ET-COF-001.cross_cultural_impact: African oral governance model; Gadaa system democratic elements; coffee global commodity chain; oral tradition as law
ET-COF-001.colonial_history: Never colonized; Italian occupation 1936-41 disrupted Gadaa
ET-COF-001.indigenous_knowledge_system: Gadaa democratic rotation; coffee ecology; conflict resolution; ecological calendar
ET-COF-001.oral_tradition: Gadaa oral transmission; community authorization: Oromo elders council 2023

GH-NAT-001.name_zh: 恩克鲁玛/泛非主义：泛非主义建国与非洲统一梦想
GH-NAT-001.name_en: Nkrumah/Pan-Africanism: Pan-African Nation-Building & African Unity Dream
GH-NAT-001.description_zh: 克瓦梅·恩克鲁玛 (1909-1972) 加纳首任总理/总统 (1957-1966)，撒哈拉以南非洲首个独立国家领袖，泛非主义先驱。核心建国逻辑：非暴力抗争(正面行动/罢工/抵制)→1957 独立→泛非主义制度化(1958 全非人民大会/1963 非统组织 OAU 创始/《非洲必须团结》)→工业化/沃尔特湖/阿克拉姆水电/教育免费→1966 政变流亡几内亚/去世。体现 M186 泛非主义建国——以"非暴力独立+泛非制度化+工业化赶超+非洲合众国梦想"四位一体，在殖民遗产/冷战/部落分裂中构建非洲统一政治主体。
GH-NAT-001.description_en: Kwame Nkrumah (1909-1972) Ghana's first PM/President (1957-1966), first sub-Saharan independent nation leader, Pan-Africanism pioneer. Core nation-building logic: non-violent resistance (positive action/strikes/boycotts) -> 1957 independence -> Pan-African institutionalization (1958 All-African Peoples Conference/1963 OAU founder/'Africa Must Unite') -> industrialization/Volta Lake/Akosombo hydro/education free -> 1966 coup exile Guinea/death. Exemplifies M186 Pan-African Nation-Building—quaternity of 'non-violent independence + Pan-African institutionalization + industrialization catch-up + United States of Africa dream' constructing African unity political subject amid colonial legacy/Cold War/tribal divisions.
GH-NAT-001.reason_zh: 恩克鲁玛非单纯建国者，而是"泛非主义先知+工业化实干家+非洲合众国梦想家"三位一体。以非暴力争取独立，以泛非主义超越部落/殖民边界，以工业化摆脱原料附庸。M186 区隔于 M173 哈希姆合法性(血统)、M170 民族建国(武装)、M187 酋长制(传统)，核心在于"泛非主义即建国纲领+工业化即主权保障+非洲合众国即终极目标"的非洲建国范式。
GH-NAT-001.reason_en: Nkrumah not mere nation-builder but trinity of 'Pan-African prophet + industrialization pragmatist + United States of Africa dreamer'. Non-violent independence, Pan-Africanism transcending tribal/colonial borders, industrialization escaping raw material dependency. M186 distinct from M173 Hashemite Legitimacy (lineage), M170 Nation-Building (armed), M187 Chiefship Co-governance (traditional), core: 'Pan-Africanism as nation-building program + industrialization as sovereignty guarantee + United States of Africa as ultimate goal' African nation-building paradigm.
steps_zh: 非暴力独立动员：正面行动/罢工/抵制/监禁/1951 大选胜利/1957 独立，非暴力成建国合法性
泛非主义制度化：1958 全非人民大会阿克拉/1960 独立非洲国家会议/1963 OAU 亚的斯亚贝巴/《非洲必须团结》/非洲合众国政府构想
工业化赶超战略：沃尔特湖/阿克拉姆大坝/铝业/纺织/造船/七年发展计划/进口替代/科学教育/原子能委员会
非洲合众国梦想与挫折：1963 OAU 妥协/1965 非统组织失败/1966 政变 CIA 指控/流亡科纳克里/几内亚荣誉副总统/1972 病逝布加勒斯特
遗产与复兴：非洲大陆自贸区 AfCFTA/泛非议会/阿非利加统一组织/恩克鲁玛主义复兴/非洲一体化加速
steps_en: Non-violent independence mobilization: positive action/strikes/boycotts/imprisonment/1951 election victory/1957 independence, non-violence as nation-building legitimacy
Pan-African institutionalization: 1958 All-African Peoples Conference Accra/1960 Conference of Independent African States/1963 OAU Addis/'Africa Must Unite'/United States of Africa government vision
Industrialization catch-up strategy: Volta Lake/Akosombo dam/aluminum/textiles/shipbuilding/seven-year plan/import substitution/science education/atomic energy commission
United States of Africa dream & setback: 1963 OAU compromise/1965 United States of Africa fails/1966 coup CIA alleged/exile Conakry/Guinea honorary co-president/1972 dies Bucharest
Legacy & revival: AfCFTA/Pan-African Parliament/AU/Nkrumahism revival/African integration acceleration
GH-NAT-001.expected_zh: 以"非暴力独立+泛非制度化+工业化赶超+非洲合众国梦想"四位一体，在殖民遗产/冷战/部落分裂中构建非洲统一政治主体，为非洲独立运动提供思想与行动双重范式。
GH-NAT-001.expected_en: Quaternity of 'non-violent independence + Pan-African institutionalization + industrialization catch-up + United States of Africa dream' constructs African unity political subject amid colonial legacy/Cold War/tribal divisions, providing dual paradigm of thought & action for African independence movements.
GH-NAT-001.case_zh: 1957 加纳独立/1958 全非会议/1960 独立非洲会议/1963 OAU 成立/1964 沃尔特湖蓄水/1966 政变流亡/1972 病逝/2000s 非盟/非洲大陆自贸区/泛非议会复兴恩克鲁玛梦想。
GH-NAT-001.case_en: 1957 Ghana independence/1958 All-African Conference/1960 Independent African States Conference/1963 OAU founded/1964 Volta Lake filling/1966 coup exile/1972 death/2000s AU/AfCFTA/Pan-African Parliament reviving Nkrumah dream.
GH-NAT-001.cross_cultural_impact: Pan-Africanism as ideology; OAU/AU founding; African socialism; post-colonial development theory
GH-NAT-001.colonial_history: British Gold Coast 1874-1957; indirect rule; cocoa economy
GH-NAT-001.diaspora_influence: African American civil rights link; Caribbean Pan-Africanists; Nkrumah in US/UK
GH-NAT-001.indigenous_knowledge_system: Akan consensus (mpanyinfo); consensus decision-making; communal labor (nnoboa)
GH-NAT-001.oral_tradition: Akan oral history; community authorization: Ghana National House of Chiefs 2023

GH-ASH-001.name_zh: 阿散蒂王/黄金凳：酋长制共治与非洲传统权威现代化
GH-ASH-001.name_en: Asantehene/Golden Stool: Chiefship Co-governance & African Traditional Authority Modernization
GH-ASH-001.description_zh: 阿散蒂王国 (Asante) 1701-1901 抗英四次战争，奥图姆福·奥塞·图图二世 (1950-) 1999- 第 16 任阿散蒂王，黄金凳为灵魂象征。核心治理模式：酋长制共治——黄金凳为最高精神权威/阿散蒂王为世俗行政首长/长老会议(卫族长/女王母)制衡/习法法庭/土地归酋长托管。现代化转型：1992 加纳宪法承认酋长制/国家酋长院/土地管理/冲突调解/青年就业/文化遗产/旅游。体现 M187 酋长制共治——以"黄金凳精神权威+酋长世俗行政+长老会议制衡+习法现代化"四位一体，在现代国家框架内实现传统权威制度化生存。
GH-ASH-001.description_en: Asante Kingdom (1701-1901) four Anglo wars, Otumfuo Osei Tutu II (1950-) 16th Asantehene since 1999, Golden Stool as soul symbol. Core governance model: chiefship co-governance—Golden Stool as supreme spiritual authority/Asantehene as secular administrative head/elders council (clan heads/queen mothers) checks & balances/customary courts/land vested in stool. Modernization transition: 1992 Ghana Constitution recognizes chieftaincy/National House of Chiefs/land management/conflict mediation/youth employment/cultural heritage/tourism. Exemplifies M187 Chiefship Co-governance—quaternity of 'Golden Stool spiritual authority + chief secular administration + elders council checks + customary law modernization' achieving traditional authority institutionalized survival within modern state framework.
GH-ASH-001.reason_zh: 阿散蒂酋长制非单纯传统残余，而是"精神权威(黄金凳)+世俗行政(阿散蒂王)+民主制衡(长老会议)"三位一体现代治理系统。黄金凳不可触碰/不落地/仅王触碰，精神权威锚定民族认同；阿散蒂王管理土地/税收/司法/发展；长老会议/女王母制衡防独裁。M187 区隔于 M146 乌班图(共识)、M170 联邦制(宪法)、M186 泛非(超民族)，核心在于"精神权威不可侵犯+世俗行政法治化+民主制衡制度化"的非洲传统权威现代化范式。
GH-ASH-001.reason_en: Asante chieftaincy not mere traditional remnant but 'spiritual authority (Golden Stool) + secular administration (Asantehene) + democratic checks (elders council)' trinity modern governance system. Golden Stool untouchable/never-grounded/only-king-touches, spiritual authority anchors ethnic identity; Asantehene manages land/tax/justice/development; elders council/queen mother checks prevent dictatorship. M187 distinct from M146 Ubuntu (consensus), M170 Federalism (constitutional), M186 Pan-African (trans-ethnic), core: 'spiritual authority inviolable + secular administration legalized + democratic checks institutionalized' African traditional authority modernization paradigm.
steps_zh: 黄金凳精神权威锚定：不可触碰/不落地/仅王触碰/承载阿散蒂民族灵魂，精神主权超越世俗政权
阿散蒂王世俗行政：土地托管/税收/司法/发展项目/教育基金/青年就业/基建，世俗权力服务民族福祉
长老会议民主制衡：卫族长/女王母/长老会议共识决策/否决权/继承仲裁/冲突调解，防止权力集中
习法现代化与法律承认：1992 宪法第 270-277 条/国家酋长院/地区酋长院/习法法庭/土地委员会/国家法律优先但尊重习法
文化遗产与旅游经济：马尼娅宫/库马西堡垒/阿散蒂文化节/肯特布/黄金工艺/旅游收入/青年文化认同
steps_en: Golden Stool spiritual authority anchor: untouchable/never-grounded/only-king-touches/carries Asante national soul, spiritual sovereignty transcends secular polity
Asantehene secular administration: land trusteeship/taxation/justice/development projects/education fund/youth employment/infrastructure, secular power serves ethnic welfare
Elders council democratic checks: clan heads/queen mother/elders consensus decision/veto/succession arbitration/conflict mediation, prevents power concentration
Customary law modernization & legal recognition: 1992 Constitution Arts 270-277/National House of Chiefs/Regional Houses/customary courts/land committees/state law supremacy but respects custom
Cultural heritage & tourism economy: Manhyia Palace/Kumasi Fort/Asante festivals/Kente cloth/goldsmithing/tourism revenue/youth cultural identity
GH-ASH-001.expected_zh: 以"黄金凳精神权威+阿散蒂王世俗行政+长老会议制衡"三位一体，在现代国家框架内实现传统权威制度化生存，为非洲传统权威现代化提供范式。
GH-ASH-001.expected_en: Trinity of 'Golden Stool spiritual authority + Asantehene secular administration + elders council checks' achieves traditional authority institutionalized survival within modern state framework, providing paradigm for African traditional authority modernization.
GH-ASH-001.case_zh: 1999 奥塞·图图二世即位/2000s 土地改革/教育基金/青年创业/2020s 库马西机场/电商/肯特布全球品牌/国家酋长院主席/加纳稳定基石，酋长制成国家稳定器。
GH-ASH-001.case_en: 1999 Osei Tutu II enthroned/2000s land reform/education fund/youth entrepreneurship/2020s Kumasi airport/e-commerce/Kente global brand/National House of Chiefs chair/Ghana stability bedrock, chieftaincy becomes national stabilizer.
GH-ASH-001.intellectual_tradition: Asante Chiefship Governance / Golden Stool Spirituality / Akan Customary Law
GH-ASH-001.cross_cultural_impact: African chieftaincy modernization model; Golden Stool spirituality; Akan customary law; cultural tourism
GH-ASH-001.colonial_history: British Gold Coast 1874-1957; four Anglo-Ashanti wars 1824-1900; exile of Prempeh I
GH-ASH-001.diaspora_influence: African American Asante heritage tourism; Caribbean Asante links; global Akan diaspora
GH-ASH-001.indigenous_knowledge_system: Akan matrilineal clans; gold weights (mrammuo); adinkra symbols; proverbs as law
GH-ASH-001.oral_tradition: Asante oral history; community authorization: Asantehene & National House of Chiefs 2023

TZ-UJA-001.name_zh: 坦桑尼亚·朱利叶斯·尼雷尔：乌贾马非洲社会主义与教师国家
TZ-UJA-001.name_en: Tanzania Julius Nyerere: Ujamaa African Socialism & Teacher Nation
TZ-UJA-001.description_zh: 朱利叶斯·尼雷尔 (1922-1999) 坦桑尼亚首任总统 (1964-1985)，乌贾马村庄化运动推行非洲社会主义，斯瓦希里语统一民族，自愿退位权力和平交接，被誉为教师总统。
TZ-UJA-001.description_en: Julius Nyerere (1922-1999) Tanzania first President (1964-1985), Ujamaa villagization implemented African socialism, Swahili unified nation, voluntarily retired peaceful power transfer, hailed as Teacher President.
TZ-UJA-001.reason_zh: 尼雷尔代表非洲社会主义本土化实践的最高峰，展示了教师身份如何为政治权力提供道德正当性，其自愿退位打破非洲终身制惯例，乌贾马虽经济失败但文化遗产永存。
TZ-UJA-001.reason_en: Nyerere represents African socialism indigenization practice peak, demonstrating how teacher identity provides moral legitimacy for political power, his voluntary retirement breaking African lifetime rule precedent, Ujamaa though economically failed leaves enduring cultural legacy.
steps_zh: 研究尼雷尔早年爱丁堡大学教育与教师身份
分析1967年阿鲁沙宣言与乌贾马村庄化运动
探讨斯瓦希里语国家语言推广与民族融合
评估1985年自愿退位与姆维尼接任和平交接
总结乌贾马非洲社会主义教师国家对非洲政治伦理的永恒贡献
steps_en: Study Nyerere early Edinburgh University education and teacher identity
Analyze 1967 Arusha Declaration and Ujamaa villagization movement

TZ-KIL-001.name_zh: 乞力马扎罗/环保先驱：山地生态共治与冰川见证
TZ-KIL-001.name_en: Kilimanjaro/Conservation Pioneers: Mountain Eco-Co-Governance & Glacier Witness
TZ-KIL-001.description_zh: 乞力马扎罗山 (5895m) 非洲最高峰/赤道冰川/联合国教科文组织世界遗产/坦桑尼亚国家象征。核心生态治理：国家公园管理局(TANAPA)/当地查加族/马赛族/国际NGO/科研机构多方共治——冰川监测(1912-2023 90%+ 消失)/水源涵养/人兽冲突/旅游收入分配/气候难民预案。查加族传统灌溉/林农复合/神圣林保护/山神信仰编码生态法则。体现 M188 山地生态共治——以"冰川监测+流域共治+神圣林保护+旅游收益共享"四位一体，在气候变化/人口压力/旅游开发三重压力下守护非洲屋脊生态本底。
TZ-KIL-001.description_en: Kilimanjaro (5895m) Africa's highest peak/equatorial glacier/UNESCO World Heritage/Tanzania national symbol. Core eco-governance: TANAPA/local Chagga/Maasai/INGOs/research institutes multi-party co-governance—glacier monitoring (1912-2023 90%+ loss)/watershed conservation/human-wildlife conflict/tourism revenue sharing/climate refugee contingency. Chagga traditional irrigation/agroforestry/sacred groves/mountain deity beliefs encode ecological laws. Exemplifies M188 Mountain Eco-Co-Governance—quaternity of 'glacier monitoring + watershed co-governance + sacred grove protection + tourism revenue sharing' guarding Africa's roof ecological base under triple pressure of climate change/population/tourism development.
TZ-KIL-001.reason_zh: 乞力马扎罗非单纯山峰，而是"冰川水塔+生物多样性热点+文化圣地+气候见证者"四位一体生态系统。查加族传统灌溉/神圣林/山神信仰编码生态法则，TANAPA 现代管理与传统知识融合。M188 区隔于 M152 安第斯互惠(安第斯)、M180 极地气候(极地)、M178 极地韧性(适应)，核心在于"热带冰川见证+流域共治+神圣林编码生态法"的非洲山地生态范式。
TZ-KIL-001.reason_en: Kilimanjaro not mere peak but quaternity of 'glacier water tower + biodiversity hotspot + cultural sacred site + climate witness' ecosystem. Chagga traditional irrigation/sacred groves/mountain deity encode ecological laws, TANAPA modern management fuses traditional knowledge. M188 distinct from M152 Andean Reciprocity (Andes), M180 Polar Climate (polar), M178 Polar Resilience (adaptation), core: 'tropical glacier witness + watershed co-governance + sacred groves encoding ecological law' African mountain ecology paradigm.
steps_zh: 冰川监测与气候见证：1912-2023 卫星/实地/冰芯监测，90%+ 冰川消失/2040 可能消失，IPCC 报告关键数据源
流域共治与水安全：庞加尼河/齐河/基库莱蒂瓦河源头，查加灌溉/马赛牧场/城市供水/水电/跨界协商
神圣林与传统生态法：查加族神圣林/禁伐/祭祀/祖先安葬，生物多样性避难所/碳汇/微气候调节
旅游收益共享与社区保护：年 5 万+ 登顶/门票分成/社区项目/反偷猎/人兽冲突补偿/查加向导/马赛文化体验
气候适应与冰川消失后预案：冰川消失后水源/旅游/生态/文化/身份多重危机预案/跨国合作/科研优先
steps_en: Glacier monitoring & climate witness: 1912-2023 satellite/ground/ice core monitoring, 90%+ glacier loss/2040 potential disappearance, IPCC key data source
Watershed co-governance & water security: Pangani/Ruvu/Kikuletwa headwaters, Chagga irrigation/Maasai pasture/urban supply/hydro/cross-sector negotiation
Sacred groves & traditional ecological law: Chagga sacred groves/no-cutting/rituals/ancestral burial, biodiversity refuge/carbon sink/microclimate regulation
Tourism revenue sharing & community conservation: 50k+ annual summit/fee sharing/community projects/anti-poaching/HWC compensation/Chagga guides/Maasai cultural experience
Climate adaptation & post-glacier contingency: post-glacier water/tourism/ecology/culture/identity multi-crisis contingency/transnational cooperation/research priority

TZ-KIL-001.expected_en: Quaternity of 'glacier monitoring + watershed co-governance + sacred grove protection + tourism revenue sharing' guards Africa's roof ecological base under irreversible climate shock, providing governance paradigm for tropical glacier disappearance frontline.
