CD-MOB-001.name_zh: 莫布图/扎伊尔/刚果河：大人制与河流霸权
CD-MOB-001.name_en: Mobutu/Zaire/Congo River: Big Man Rule & River Hegemony
CD-MOB-001.description_zh: 蒙博托·塞塞·塞科 (1930-1997) 1965-1997 统治扎伊尔 (今刚果金) 32 年，典型"大人制" (Big Man) 模式。核心统治逻辑：个人崇拜/蒙博图主义/独裁/贪腐/克宾沙/刚果河控制/矿产掠夺/外交平衡(西方/中苏/非洲)→1990s 冷战结束/内战/卢旺达种族灭绝溢出/1997 卡比拉推翻/流亡摩洛哥病逝。体现 M189 大人制/河流霸权——以"个人崇拜+河流控制+矿产掠夺+外交摇摆"四位一体，在资源诅咒/冷战/地理碎片化中实现个人极权统治。
CD-MOB-001.description_en: Mobutu Sese Seko (1930-1997) ruled Zaire (now DRC) 1965-1997 for 32 years, archetypal 'Big Man' rule. Core governance logic: personality cult/Mobutuism/dictatorship/corruption/Gbadolite/Congo River control/mineral plunder/diplomatic balancing (West/China-USSR/Africa) -> 1990s Cold War end/civil war/Rwandan genocide spillover/1997 Kabila overthrows/exile Morocco death. Exemplifies M189 Big Man Rule & River Hegemony—quaternity of 'personality cult + river control + mineral plunder + diplomatic oscillation' achieving personal absolute rule amid resource curse/Cold War/geographic fragmentation.
CD-MOB-001.reason_zh: 蒙博图非单纯独裁者，而是"大人制+河流霸权+资源掠夺"三位一体极权模式。刚果河为其命脉/军队/经济/外交核心资产；克宾沙宫殿象征个人权力巅峰；外交在美/苏/中/法/非洲间极限摇摆。M189 区隔于 M171 资源民族主义(伊拉克)、M170 威权稳定(白俄罗斯)、M190 矿区武装(卡比拉)，核心在于"个人崇拜即意识形态+河流控制即地缘命脉+矿产掠夺即经济基础"的非洲大人制极限范式。
CD-MOB-001.reason_en: Mobutu not mere dictator but 'Big Man rule + river hegemony + resource plunder' trinity totalitarian model. Congo River as lifeline/military/economy/diplomacy core asset; Gbadolite palace symbolizes personal power apex; diplomacy extreme oscillation between US/USSR/China/France/Africa. M189 distinct from M171 Resource Nationalist (Iraq), M170 Authoritarian Stability (Belarus), M190 Mining Zone Warlord (Kabila), core: 'personality cult as ideology + river control as geostrategic lifeline + mineral plunder as economic base' African Big Man extreme paradigm.
steps_zh: 个人崇拜意识形态化：蒙博图主义/真理之光/全民导师/头像无处不在/媒体垄断/教育灌输，个人即国家
刚果河绝对控制：河流即领土/军队/经济/外交，水运/水电/渔业/边界/战略纵深，控河即控国
矿产掠夺与克宾沙经济：铜/钴/钻石/钽/黄金/个人敛财/瑞士账户/克宾沙宫殿/跑道/野生动物园，国家财富私有化
外交极限摇摆：美/苏/中/法/比/南非/利比亚/安哥拉/卢旺达，冷战筹码/反共盾牌/法语非洲领袖/不结盟运动
崩塌与遗产：1990s 冷战结束/内战/卢旺达溢出/1996-97 第一次/第二次刚果战争/1997 卡比拉推翻/流亡摩洛哥病逝/国家碎片化/资源诅咒加深
steps_en: Personality cult ideologization: Mobutuism/Light of Truth/National Guide/portraits everywhere/media monopoly/education indoctrination, individual = state
Congo River absolute control: river as territory/military/economy/diplomacy, transport/hydro/fisheries/border/strategic depth, control river = control country
Mineral plunder & Gbadolite economy: copper/cobalt/diamonds/coltan/gold/personal enrichment/Swiss accounts/Gbadolite palace/runway/wildlife park, state wealth privatized
Diplomatic extreme oscillation: US/USSR/China/France/Belgium/South Africa/Libya/Angola/Rwanda, Cold War chip/anti-communist shield/Francophone Africa leader/Non-Aligned Movement
Collapse & legacy: 1990s Cold War end/civil war/Rwandan spillover/1996-97 First/Second Congo Wars/1997 Kabila overthrows/exile Morocco death/state fragmentation/resource curse deepened
CD-MOB-001.expected_zh: 以"个人崇拜+河流控制+矿产掠夺+外交摇摆"四位一体，在资源诅咒/冷战/地理碎片化中实现个人极权统治 32 年，留下国家碎片化/资源诅咒加深/刚果战争遗毒的警世遗产。
CD-MOB-001.expected_en: Quaternity of 'personality cult + river control + mineral plunder + diplomatic oscillation' achieves 32-year personal absolute rule amid resource curse/Cold War/geographic fragmentation, leaving legacy of state fragmentation/resource curse deepening/Congo Wars cautionary tale.
CD-MOB-001.case_zh: 1965 政变上台/1971 改国名扎伊尔/1973 锎赞比亚铜业/1977 克宾沙建成/1990s 冷战结束/1996-97 刚果战争/1997 卡比拉入金夏沙/摩洛哥病逝/刚果战争 500 万+ 死亡/资源诅咒延续，大人制极限警世。
CD-MOB-001.case_en: 1965 coup power/1971 renamed Zaire/1973 nationalized Zambian copper/1977 Gbadolite completed/1990s Cold War end/1996-97 Congo Wars/1997 Kabila enters Kinshasa/Morocco death/Congo Wars 5M+ deaths/resource curse continues, Big Man extreme cautionary tale.

CD-KAB-001.name_zh: 卡比拉/东部叛军：矿区武装治理与资源民族主义
CD-KAB-001.name_en: Kabila/Eastern Rebels: Mining Zone Warlord Governance & Resource Nationalism
CD-KAB-001.description_zh: 洛朗-德西雷·卡比拉 (1939-2001) 1996-97 卢旺达/乌干达支持发动第一次刚果战争推翻蒙博图，1997 夺权；约瑟夫·卡比拉 (1971-) 2001-2019 继位，第二次刚果战争(1998-2003) 九国卷入/500 万+ 死亡，东部矿区(基武/伊图里) 武装团伙/马伊马伊/卢旺达/乌干达代理人控制钴/钽/金/锡。体现 M190 矿区武装治理——以"武装控矿+代理人战争+资源民族主义+生存经济"四位一体，在国家崩塌/矿产诅咒/代理人战争中构建武装治理秩序。
CD-KAB-001.description_en: Laurent-Desire Kabila (1939-2001) Rwanda/Uganda backed 1996-97 First Congo War toppled Mobutu, seized power 1997; Joseph Kabila (1971-) succeeded 2001-2019, Second Congo War (1998-2003) nine nations/5M+ deaths, eastern mining zones (Kivu/Ituri) armed groups/Mai-Mai/Rwanda/Uganda proxies control cobalt/coltan/gold/tin. Exemplifies M190 Mining Zone Warlord Governance—quaternity of 'armed mineral control + proxy warfare + resource nationalism + survival economy' constructing armed governance order amid state collapse/mineral curse/proxy wars.
CD-KAB-001.reason_zh: 卡比拉父子非单纯继承者，而是"武装夺权+矿区控制+代理人平衡"三位一体矿区军阀模式。老卡比拉以卢旺达/乌干达支持推翻蒙博图，小卡比拉在九国战争中平衡中/俄/美/南非/安哥拉/卢旺达/乌干达，东部矿区成生存经济基础。M190 区隔于 M189 大人制(蒙博图)、M171 资源民族主义(伊拉克)、M168 资源诅咒缓解(智利)，核心在于"武装控矿即政权合法性+代理人战争即地缘生存+资源民族主义即经济基础"的刚果矿区治理极限范式。
CD-KAB-001.reason_en: Kabilas not mere successors but 'armed seizure + mining zone control + proxy balancing' trinity mining zone warlord model. Senior Kabila toppled Mobutu with Rwanda/Uganda support, junior Kabila balanced China/Russia/US/South Africa/Angola/Rwanda/Uganda in nine-nation war, eastern mining zones as survival economic base. M190 distinct from M189 Big Man (Mobutu), M171 Resource Nationalist (Iraq), M168 Resource Curse Mitigation (Chile), core: 'armed mineral control as regime legitimacy + proxy war as geostrategic survival + resource nationalism as economic base' Congo mining zone governance extreme paradigm.
steps_zh: 武装夺权与矿区立足：1996 卢旺达/乌干达支持 AFDL 进军金夏沙/1997 推翻蒙博图，东部矿区为军费/兵源/外交筹码

东部矿区武装治理：基武/伊图里钴/钽/金/锡/马伊马伊/FDLR/CNDP/M23 武装团伙控矿/走私/税收/保护费，矿区即政权
资源民族主义与生存经济：小卡比拉 2002 矿业法/审查合同/提高税收/本地加工/中国/西方投资博弈，矿产换生存
权力交接与遗产：2001 老卡比拉遇刺/小卡比拉继位/2006/2011 大选/2019 交权齐塞克迪/东部冲突持续/矿产诅咒未解，武装治理常态化
steps_en: Armed seizure & mining zone foothold: 1996 Rwanda/Uganda backed AFDL marched to Kinshasa/1997 toppled Mobutu, eastern mining zones as war funding/recruitment/diplomatic chips
Nine-nation proxy war balancing: 1998-2003 Second Congo War/Rwanda/Uganda/Angola/Zimbabwe/Namibia/Sudan/Chad/Libya/Congo-Brazza, Kabila balanced China/Russia/SA/Angola/Rwanda/Uganda
Eastern mining zone armed governance: Kivu/Ituri cobalt/coltan/gold/tin Mai-Mai/FDLR/CNDP/M23 armed groups control minerals/smuggling/taxation/protection fees, mining zone = regime
Resource nationalism & survival economy: Junior Kabila 2002 Mining Code/review contracts/raise taxes/local processing/China/Western investment games, minerals for survival

Power transition & legacy: 2001 senior Kabila assassinated/junior succeeds/2006/2011 elections/2019 handover to Tshisekedi/eastern conflict continues/mineral curse unresolved, armed governance normalized

CD-KAB-001.expected_en: Quaternity of 'armed mineral control + proxy warfare + resource nationalism + survival economy' constructs armed governance order amid state collapse/mineral curse/proxy wars, Congo eastern mining zones become global critical minerals supply chain frontline battlefield.

SN-SED-001.name_zh: 塞达尔·桑戈尔/诗歌政治：新黑人运动书写与文化外交
SN-SED-001.name_en: Senghor/Poetry Politics: Negritude Writing & Cultural Diplomacy
SN-SED-001.description_zh: 列奥波德·塞达尔·桑戈尔 (1906-2001) 塞内加尔首任总统 (1960-1980)，新黑人运动创始人，诗人政治家。核心思想：新黑人运动——黑人文化价值肯定/非洲人格尊严/文化多元主义/文明互补；政治实践：1960 独立/非洲社会主义/法语共同体/一党制/1980 主动退位/法兰西学院院士。体现 M165 新黑人运动书写——以"诗歌即政治+黑人文化即资产+文明互补即外交+退位即民主"四位一体，在殖民遗产/法语霸权/部落分裂中构建文化主权国家。
SN-SED-001.description_en: Leopold Sedar Senghor (1906-2001) Senegal first President (1960-1980), Negritude founder, poet-statesman. Core thought: Negritude—Black culture affirmation/African personality dignity/cultural pluralism/civilizational complementarity; political praxis: 1960 independence/African socialism/Francophonie/one-party/1980 voluntary retirement/Académie française member. Exemplifies M165 Negritude Writing—quaternity of 'poetry as politics + Black culture as asset + civilizational complementarity as diplomacy + retirement as democracy' constructing cultural sovereignty nation amid colonial legacy/French hegemony/tribal divisions.
SN-SED-001.reason_zh: 桑戈尔非单纯政治家，而是"诗人即政治家+黑人文化即外交资产+文明互补即世界观"三位一体。以诗歌重构黑人尊严，以文化外交超越法语霸权，以主动退位树立民主标杆。M165 区隔于 M155 魔幻现实(拉美)、M165 离散叙事(台湾)、M186 泛非(政治)，核心在于"诗歌即政治行动+黑人文化即文明资产+文明互补即外交策略"的知识分子政治范式。
SN-SED-001.reason_en: Senghor not mere politician but trinity of 'poet as politician + Black culture as diplomatic asset + civilizational complementarity as worldview'. Poetry reconstructs Black dignity, cultural diplomacy transcends French hegemony, voluntary retirement sets democratic benchmark. M165 distinct from M155 Magical Realism (LatAm), M165 Diasporic Narrative (Taiwan), M186 Pan-African (political), core: 'poetry as political action + Black culture as civilizational asset + civilizational complementarity as diplomatic strategy' intellectual politics paradigm.

SN-GOR-001.name_zh: 戈雷岛/奴隶贸易记忆：记忆导航修复与和解仪式
SN-GOR-001.name_en: Goree Island/Slave Trade Memory: Memory Navigation Repair & Reconciliation Rituals
SN-GOR-001.description_zh: 戈雷岛 (Gorée) 塞内加尔达喀尔近海，15-19 世纪大西洋奴隶贸易核心中转站，"无返之门" 象征非洲人被迫跨大西洋流离。核心记忆治理：联合国教科文组织世界遗产/戈雷岛博物馆/门户之旅/年度纪念/非洲侨民朝圣/记忆修复仪式(倾倒祭酒/呼唤名字/跨大西洋对话)。体现 M191 记忆导航修复——以"物理场所即记忆锚点+仪式即导航+侨民即见证+对话即修复"四位一体，在历史创伤/遗忘/否认中构建记忆正义与和解路径。
SN-GOR-001.description_en: Goree Island off Dakar, 15-19th century Atlantic slave trade core transit point, 'Door of No Return' symbolizes forced African diaspora. Core memory governance: UNESCO World Heritage/Goree Museum/Door of No Return/annual commemoration/African diaspora pilgrimage/memory repair rituals (libation/name calling/transatlantic dialogue). Exemplifies M191 Memory Navigation Repair—quaternity of 'physical site as memory anchor + ritual as navigation + diaspora as witness + dialogue as repair' constructing memory justice & reconciliation path amid historical trauma/amnesia/denial.
SN-GOR-001.reason_zh: 戈雷岛非单纯遗址，而是"物理门户+仪式导航+侨民见证+对话修复"四位一体记忆操作系统。"无返之门"作为物理/心理双重门槛，仪式引导访客/侨民完成记忆穿越，跨大西洋对话实现创伤对话。M191 区隔于 M154 梦境时间(澳洲)、M165 离散叙事(台湾)、M191 记忆修复(独特)，核心在于"物理场所锚定记忆+仪式导航穿越时空+侨民见证赋予尊严"的奴隶贸易记忆治理范式。
SN-GOR-001.reason_en: Goree not mere site but 'physical door + ritual navigation + diaspora witness + dialogue repair' quaternity memory OS. 'Door of No Return' as physical/psychological double threshold, rituals guide visitors/diaspora through memory crossing, transatlantic dialogue enables trauma dialogue. M191 distinct from M154 Dreamtime (Australia), M165 Diasporic Narrative (Taiwan), M191 Memory Repair (unique), core: 'physical site anchors memory + ritual navigates spacetime + diaspora witnesses confer dignity' slave trade memory governance paradigm.
steps_zh: 物理场所锚定记忆：无返之门/奴隶屋/大炮/博物馆展品，物理空间即记忆锚点，零距离触摸历史创伤
仪式导航穿越时空：倾倒祭酒/呼唤名字/敲鼓/诵读/跨大西洋视频连线，仪式引导参与者完成记忆穿越/情感释放
侨民见证赋予尊严：非裔美国/加勒比/巴西/欧洲侨民朝圣/见证/叙事/艺术创作，侨民见证将受害者从数字还原为人
跨大西洋对话修复：非洲/美洲/欧洲学者/艺术家/活动家对话/赔偿/道歉/记忆共享/教育课程/联合国奴隶制纪念日
教育传承与数字化：戈雷岛学校课程/虚拟现实体验/数字档案/青年大使/记忆传承代际化
steps_en: Physical site anchors memory: Door of No Return/slave houses/cannons/museum exhibits, physical space as memory anchor, zero-distance touch historical trauma
Ritual navigates spacetime: libation/name calling/drumming/recitation/transatlantic video links, rituals guide participants through memory crossing/emotional release
Diaspora witnesses confer dignity: African American/Caribbean/Brazilian/European diaspora pilgrimage/witness/narrative/artistic creation, diaspora witness restores victims from numbers to humans
Transatlantic dialogue repair: African/American/European scholars/artists/activists dialogue/reparations/apology/memory sharing/education curricula/UN Slavery Remembrance Day
Education transmission & digitalization: Goree school curricula/VR experience/digital archives/youth ambassadors/memory transmission intergenerational

SN-GOR-001.expected_en: Quaternity of 'physical site anchor + ritual navigation + diaspora witness + dialogue repair' constructs memory justice & reconciliation path amid slave trade historical trauma/amnesia/denial, providing global paradigm for Atlantic slave trade memory governance.

CI-COC-001.name_zh: 乌弗埃/可可/后殖民建设：资源诅咒缓解与出口导向工业化
CI-COC-001.name_en: Houphouet-Boigny/Cocoa/Post-Colonial Construction: Resource Curse Mitigation & Export-Oriented Industrialization
CI-COC-001.description_zh: 费利克斯·乌弗埃-博瓦尼 (1905-1993) 科特迪瓦首任总统 (1960-1993)，"非洲建国之父"。核心建国逻辑：可可/咖啡/木材出口导向/法资合作/政治稳定/阿比让奇迹/亚穆苏克罗迁都/大教堂/1990s 多党制/经济危机/1999 政变/内战。体现 M168 资源诅咒缓解——以"出口导向农业+法资深度绑定+政治稳定优先+基建显性化"四位一体，在单一作物依赖/法语非洲/冷战中实现相对繁荣与稳定。
CI-COC-001.description_en: Felix Houphouet-Boigny (1905-1993) Côte d'Ivoire first President (1960-1993), 'Father of African Nation-Building'. Core nation-building logic: cocoa/coffee/timber export orientation/French capital deep partnership/political stability priority/Abidjan miracle/Yamoussoukro relocation/basilica/1990s multi-party/crisis/1999 coup/civil war. Exemplifies M168 Resource Curse Mitigation—quaternity of 'export-oriented agriculture + deep French capital binding + political stability priority + visible infrastructure' achieving relative prosperity & stability amid single-crop dependency/Francophone Africa/Cold War.
CI-COC-001.reason_zh: 乌弗埃非单纯建国者，而是"可可外交+法资共生+稳定优先"三位一体务实建国者。以可可/咖啡换法资/技术/市场/安全，以政治稳定换经济增长/外资信心/区域领袖地位。M168 区隔于 M169 后石油转型(沙特)、M171 资源民族主义(伊拉克)、M189 大人制(蒙博图)，核心在于"出口农业+外资共生+稳定优先"的法语非洲务实建国范式。
CI-COC-001.reason_en: Houphouet-Boigny not mere nation-builder but 'cocoa diplomacy + French capital symbiosis + stability first' trinity pragmatic builder. Traded cocoa/coffee for French capital/tech/markets/security, traded political stability for growth/FDI confidence/regional leadership. M168 distinct from M169 Post-Oil Transition (Saudi), M171 Resource Nationalist (Iraq), M189 Big Man (Mobutu), core: 'export agriculture + foreign capital symbiosis + stability first' Francophone Africa pragmatic nation-building paradigm.
steps_zh: 可可/咖啡出口导向战略：世界第一可可出口国/咖啡第二/法资种植园/合作社/价格稳定基金/出口创汇支撑工业化
法资深度绑定与安全保障：法军驻防/技术援助/法郎区/双边条约/法国核保护伞/双边贸易顺差/法资企业垄断
政治稳定优先与一党制：PDCI 一党制/部落平衡/北方穆斯林/南方基督教/乌弗埃终身总统/反对派温和/政权零政变 33 年
基建显性化与首都迁移：阿比让港/高速公路/水电/亚穆苏克罗大教堂/总统府/和平基金会/显性成就巩固合法性
危机与遗产：1980s 可可价格暴跌/债务/结构调整/1990 多党制/1993 乌弗埃逝世/1999 政变/2002-2011 内战/后乌弗埃时代动荡，务实建国遗产存续性考验
steps_en: Cocoa/coffee export-oriented strategy: world #1 cocoa exporter/#2 coffee/French plantations/cooperatives/price stabilization fund/export earnings fuel industrialization
French capital deep binding & security guarantee: French troops stationed/technical aid/CFA franc zone/bilateral treaties/French nuclear umbrella/bilateral trade surplus/French firms dominant
Political stability priority & one-party rule: PDCI one-party/tribal balance/north Muslim/south Christian/Houphouet-Boigny president for life/moderate opposition/zero coups 33 years
Visible infrastructure & capital relocation: Abidjan port/highways/hydro/Yamoussoukro basilica/presidential palace/peace foundation/visible achievements legitimize rule

Crisis & legacy: 1980s cocoa price crash/debt/structural adjustment/1990 multi-party/1993 Houphouet-Boigny death/1999 coup/2002-2011 civil war/post-Houphouet-Boigny turmoil, pragmatic nation-building legacy sustainability test
CI-COC-001.expected_zh: 以"出口农业+法资共生+稳定优先+基建显性"四位一体，在单一作物依赖/法语非洲/冷战中实现相对繁荣与稳定 33 年，为法语非洲务实建国提供范式。
CI-COC-001.expected_en: Quaternity of 'export agriculture + French capital symbiosis + stability first + visible infrastructure' achieves relative prosperity & stability for 33 years amid single-crop dependency/Francophone Africa/Cold War, providing pragmatic nation-building paradigm for Francophone Africa.
CI-COC-001.case_zh: 1960 独立/1960s-70s 可可繁荣/阿比让奇迹/1983 亚穆苏克罗迁都/1993 乌弗埃逝世/1999 政变/2002-11 内战/2011 瓦塔拉上台/可可依赖未解/政治稳定脆弱，务实建国范式存续性挑战。

CI-PEA-001.name_zh: 古尔巴/和解/真相委员会：乌班图真相和解与后冲突重建
CI-PEA-001.name_en: Gbagbo/Reconciliation/Truth Commission: Ubuntu Truth & Reconciliation & Post-Conflict Reconstruction
CI-PEA-001.description_zh: 洛朗·古尔巴 (1945-) 科特迪瓦总统 (2000-2011)，2010-2011 后选举危机/内战/3000+ 死亡/国际刑事法院受审/无罪释放。查尔斯·布拉·古德 (1952-) 真相、对话与和解委员会 (CVR) 主席 (2013-2014)，推动受害者倾听/加害者认罪/社区和解/赔偿/制度改革。体现 M146 乌班图真相和解——以"受害者倾听+加害者认罪+社区和解+赔偿制度"四位一体，在选举暴力/民族冲突/国际审判三重阴影下构建本土和解路径。
CI-PEA-001.description_en: Laurent Gbagbo (1945-) Côte d'Ivoire President (2000-2011), 2010-2011 post-election crisis/civil war/3000+ deaths/ICC trial/acquitted. Charles Blé Goudé (1952-) Truth, Dialogue and Reconciliation Commission (CVR) Chair (2013-2014), drove victim hearings/perpetrator confessions/community reconciliation/reparations/institutional reforms. Exemplifies M146 Ubuntu Truth & Reconciliation—quaternity of 'victim listening + perpetrator confession + community reconciliation + reparations system' constructing indigenous reconciliation path amid election violence/ethnic conflict/international trial triple shadows.
CI-PEA-001.reason_zh: 科特迪瓦真相和解非单纯模仿南非，而是"受害者声音+社区仪式+传统调解+赔偿实质"四位一体本土化和解。CVR 走访村庄/听取证词/传统酋长主持/赔偿牛/钱/土地/公共服务。M146 区隔于 M146 乌班图(共识)、M191 记忆修复(戈雷岛)、M187 酋长制(阿散蒂)，核心在于"受害者倾听优先+社区仪式主导+传统调解介入+赔偿实质化"的后冲突本土和解范式。
CI-PEA-001.reason_en: Côte d'Ivoire truth & reconciliation not mere South Africa copy but 'victim voices + community rituals + traditional mediation + substantive reparations' quaternity indigenized reconciliation. CVR visited villages/heard testimonies/traditional chiefs presided/reparations cattle/money/land/public services. M146 distinct from M146 Ubuntu (consensus), M191 Memory Repair (Goree), M187 Chiefship (Asante), core: 'victim listening priority + community rituals lead + traditional mediation intervenes + reparations substantiated' post-conflict indigenous reconciliation paradigm.
steps_zh: 受害者倾听优先：CVR 走访 1000+ 村庄/收集 7 万+ 证词/受害者优先发言/心理支持/性暴力专门机制
社区仪式主导：传统酋长/长者/宗教领袖主持/倾倒祭酒/呼唤祖先/公开认罪/拥抱和解/社区宴席
传统调解介入：酋长法庭/长老会议/习法/赔偿标准/牛/钱/土地/公共服务/跨族群通婚
赔偿制度实质化：国家赔偿基金/受害者登记/医疗/教育/住房/就业/心理/象征性/物质性双轨
制度改革与防再发：选举法/宪法/安全部队改革/媒体/司法/土地/国籍/身份证/选民登记/预警机制
steps_en: Victim listening priority: CVR visited 1000+ villages/collected 70k+ testimonies/victims speak first/psychological support/sexual violence specialized mechanism
Community rituals lead: traditional chiefs/elders/religious leaders preside/libation/ancestor invocation/public confession/embrace reconciliation/community feast
Traditional mediation intervenes: chiefly courts/elders councils/customary law/reparation standards/cattle/money/land/public services/inter-clan marriages
Reparations system substantiated: state reparations fund/victim registry/medical/education/housing/employment/psychological/symbolic/material dual-track
Institutional reforms & non-recurrence: electoral law/constitution/security sector reform/media/judiciary/land/nationality/ID cards/voter registration/early warning mechanisms
CI-PEA-001.expected_zh: 以"受害者倾听+社区仪式+传统调解+赔偿实质"四位一体，在选举暴力/民族冲突/国际审判三重阴影下构建本土和解路径，为后冲突非洲国家提供非复制式和解范式。
CI-PEA-001.expected_en: Quaternity of 'victim listening + community rituals + traditional mediation + substantive reparations' constructs indigenous reconciliation path amid election violence/ethnic conflict/international trial triple shadows, providing non-copycat reconciliation paradigm for post-conflict African nations.

MZ-FRE-001.name_zh: 马谢尔/弗雷利莫/解放战争：游击解放治理与社会主义建设
MZ-FRE-001.name_en: Machel/FRELIMO/Liberation War: Guerrilla Liberation Governance & Socialist Construction
MZ-FRE-001.description_zh: 萨莫拉·马谢尔 (1933-1986) 莫桑比克首任总统 (1975-1986)，弗雷利莫 (FRELIMO) 创始领袖，领导 1964-1974 十年武装斗争反葡殖民，1975 独立后推行马克思列宁主义/农业合作社/识字运动/免费医疗/妇女解放/反部落主义。1977-1992 内战(雷纳莫/南非/罗得西亚支持)/马谢尔 1986 空难/查卡诺接任/1992 罗马和平协议/多党制/市场经济。体现 M192 游击解放治理——以"人民战争+社会主义建设+识字动员+妇女解放"四位一体，在殖民战争/冷战代理人/自然灾害中构建解放政权。
MZ-FRE-001.description_en: Samora Machel (1933-1986) Mozambique first President (1975-1986), FRELIMO founder, led 1964-1974 decade armed struggle against Portuguese colonialism, 1975 independence implemented Marxism-Leninism/agricultural cooperatives/literacy campaigns/free healthcare/women's liberation/anti-tribalism. 1977-1992 civil war (RENAMO/South Africa/Rhodesia backing)/Machel 1986 plane crash/Chissano succeeds/1992 Rome Peace Accords/multi-party/market economy. Exemplifies M192 Guerrilla Liberation Governance—quaternity of 'people's war + socialist construction + literacy mobilization + women's liberation' constructing liberation regime amid colonial war/Cold War proxy/natural disasters.
MZ-FRE-001.reason_zh: 马谢尔非单纯解放领袖，而是"人民战争+社会主义建设+新人塑造"三位一体革命政治家。以游击战建立政权合法性，以社会主义建设重构社会结构，以识字/妇女解放创造革命新人。M192 区隔于 M186 泛非(恩克鲁玛)、M171 资源民族主义(查韦斯)、M190 矿区武装(卡比拉)，核心在于"人民战争即建国合法性+社会主义即社会重构+新人塑造即革命延续"的南非解放范式。
MZ-FRE-001.reason_en: Machel not mere liberation leader but trinity of 'people's war + socialist construction + new human creation' revolutionary statesman. People's war established regime legitimacy, socialist construction restructured society, literacy/women's liberation created revolutionary new human. M192 distinct from M186 Pan-African (Nkrumah), M171 Resource Nationalist (Chavez), M190 Mining Warlord (Kabila), core: 'people's war as nation-building legitimacy + socialism as social reconstruction + new human creation as revolutionary continuity' southern African liberation paradigm.
steps_zh: 人民战争建立合法性：1964-74 武装斗争/弗雷利莫游击战/坦赞铁路/前线基地/国际团结/1975 独立，武装斗争即建国合法性
社会主义建设与社会重构：农业合作社/国有化/免费医疗/教育/妇女组织/青年旅/反部落/反酋长/新社会主义人塑造
识字动员与文化革命：1978 识字运动/成人教育/葡萄牙语/本土语言/革命文化/歌曲/戏剧/壁画/革命精神普及
妇女解放与性别革命：妇女组织(OMM)/婚姻法/继承权/堕胎权/反割礼/反多妻/政治参与/军队/政府/教育，性别革命深度
内战与遗产：1977-92 雷纳莫/南非/罗得西亚代理人战争/马谢尔 1986 空难/查卡诺 1990 放弃马克思/1992 罗马和约/多党/市场/马谢尔精神延续
steps_en: People's war establishes legitimacy: 1964-74 armed struggle/FRELIMO guerrilla/Tazara railway/frontline bases/international solidarity/1975 independence, armed struggle = nation-building legitimacy
Socialist construction & social reconstruction: agricultural cooperatives/nationalization/free healthcare/education/women's org/youth leagues/anti-tribal/anti-chief/new socialist human creation
Literacy mobilization & cultural revolution: 1978 literacy campaign/adult education/Portuguese/indigenous languages/revolutionary culture/songs/drama/murals/revolutionary spirit普及
Women's liberation & gender revolution: women's org (OMM)/marriage law/inheritance/abortion rights/anti-FGM/anti-polygamy/political participation/military/govt/education, gender revolution depth
Civil war & legacy: 1977-92 RENAMO/South Africa/Rhodesia proxy war/Machel 1986 plane crash/Chissano 1990 abandons Marxism/1992 Rome Peace Accords/multi-party/market/Machel spirit endures
MZ-FRE-001.expected_zh: 以"人民战争+社会主义建设+识字动员+妇女解放"四位一体，在殖民战争/冷战代理人/自然灾害中构建解放政权，留下革命道德权威超越政权的非洲领袖范式。
MZ-FRE-001.expected_en: Quaternity of 'people's war + socialist construction + literacy mobilization + women's liberation' constructs liberation regime amid colonial war/Cold War proxy/natural disasters, leaving revolutionary moral authority transcending regime African leader paradigm.
MZ-FRE-001.case_zh: 1964 武装斗争/1975 独立/1977-92 内战/1986 马谢尔空难/1992 罗马和约/多党制/市场经济/萨莫拉·马谢尔大桥/革命精神代际传承，解放政权在战争中存续。
MZ-FRE-001.case_en: 1964 armed struggle/1975 independence/1977-92 civil war/1986 Machel plane crash/1992 Rome Peace Accords/multi-party/market economy/Samora Machel Bridge/revolutionary spirit intergenerational transmission, liberation regime endures through war.
MZ-FRE-001.intellectual_tradition: Mozambican Liberation Socialism / Guerrilla Governance / New Human Creation
MZ-FRE-001.cross_cultural_impact: Southern African liberation model; guerrilla governance; literacy mobilization; women's liberation in revolution
MZ-FRE-001.colonial_history: Portuguese Mozambique 1498-1975; forced labor; assimilation policy
MZ-FRE-001.indigenous_knowledge_system: Traditional healing; communal labor; oral poetry; ecological calendar
MZ-FRE-001.oral_tradition: Machel speeches as oral tradition; community authorization: Mozambique Government 2023

AO-OIL-001.name_zh: 桑托斯/石油/内战结束：石油后冲突治理与多元化转型
AO-OIL-001.name_en: Santos/Oil/Post-Civil War: Post-Oil Conflict Governance & Diversification Transition
AO-OIL-001.description_zh: 若泽·爱德华多·多斯·桑托斯 (1942-2022) 安哥拉总统 (1979-2017) 38 年，1975 独立后即陷入内战(UNITA/南非/古巴/苏联/美国卷入)/2002 萨文比阵亡内战结束/石油主导经济(出口 90%+/GDP 50%+)/2017 交权若昂·洛伦索/反腐/多元化/改革。体现 M168 石油后冲突治理——以"内战结束+石油收益管理+反腐改革+多元化转型"四位一体，在资源诅咒/内战遗毒/单一经济中推动后石油转型。
AO-OIL-001.description_en: Jose Eduardo dos Santos (1942-2022) Angola President (1979-2017) 38 years, 1975 independence immediate civil war (UNITA/South Africa/Cuba/USSR/US involved)/2002 Savimbi death war ends/oil dominates economy (exports 90%+/GDP 50%+)/2017 handover to Joao Lourenco/anti-corruption/diversification/reforms. Exemplifies M168 Post-Oil Conflict Governance—quaternity of 'war ends + oil revenue management + anti-corruption reforms + diversification transition' driving post-oil transition amid resource curse/civil war legacy/single-commodity economy.
AO-OIL-001.reason_zh: 安哥拉非单纯石油国家，而是"内战结束+石油管理+反腐+多元化"四位一体后冲突转型试验。多斯·桑托斯以石油收益维持政权/重建基建/军队，洛伦索以反腐/多元化/改革打破石油依赖。M168 区隔于 M169 后石油转型(沙特)、M171 资源民族主义(伊拉克)、M189 大人制(蒙博图)，核心在于"内战结束即转型窗口+石油收益即转型资本+反腐即制度前提+多元化即战略目标"的非洲石油国家转型范式。
AO-OIL-001.reason_en: Angola not mere oil state but 'war ends + oil management + anti-corruption + diversification' quaternity post-conflict transition experiment. Dos Santos used oil revenue to maintain regime/rebuild infra/military, Lourenco drives anti-corruption/diversification/reforms breaking oil dependency. M168 distinct from M169 Post-Oil Transition (Saudi), M171 Resource Nationalist (Iraq), M189 Big Man (Mobutu), core: 'war end as transition window + oil revenue as transition capital + anti-corruption as institutional prerequisite + diversification as strategic goal' African oil state transition paradigm.
steps_zh: 内战结束开启转型窗口：2002 萨文比阵亡/卢安达备忘录/UNITA 非武装化/难民回流/国家统一，和平即发展前提
石油收益管理与主权财富基金：索纳格尔国有/国际油企分成/收入透明化(EITI)/主权财富基金(FSF)/基建/教育/医疗投入
反腐改革与制度重构：洛伦索 2017 上台/多斯·桑托斯家族/将军/索纳格尔高管调查/司法独立/公共采购透明/资产申报
多元化转型战略：农业/渔业/矿业/旅游/制造/物流/洛比托走廊/非洲大陆自贸区/可再生能源/数字经济，摆脱单一石油
区域融合与外交平衡：南共体/大湖区/葡语共同体/中美俄/欧盟/非盟/洛比托大西洋枢纽，区域稳定器
steps_en: War end opens transition window: 2002 Savimbi death/Luena MOU/UNITA demobilization/refugee return/national unity, peace as development prerequisite
Oil revenue management & SWF: Sonangol state-owned/IOC revenue sharing/transparency (EITI)/Sovereign Wealth Fund (FSF)/infra/education/health investment

Anti-corruption reforms & institutional reconstruction: Lourenco 2017 takes office/dos Santos family/generals/Sonangol executives investigated/judicial independence/public procurement transparency/asset declaration
Diversification transition strategy: agriculture/fisheries/mining/tourism/manufacturing/logistics/Lobito Corridor/AfCFTA/renewables/digital economy, escaping single-oil dependency
Regional integration & diplomatic balance: SADC/Great Lakes/CPLP/China-US-Russia/EU/AU/Lobito Atlantic hub, regional stabilizer
AO-OIL-001.expected_zh: 以"内战结束+石油管理+反腐+多元化"四位一体，在资源诅咒/内战遗毒/单一经济中推动后石油转型，为非洲石油国家提供冲突后转型范式。
AO-OIL-001.expected_en: Quaternity of 'war ends + oil management + anti-corruption + diversification' drives post-oil transition amid resource curse/civil war legacy/single-commodity economy, providing post-conflict transition paradigm for African oil states.
AO-OIL-001.case_zh: 1975 独立/1975-2002 内战/2002 和平/2017 洛伦索上台/反腐/多元化/洛比托走廊/非洲大陆自贸区/石油依赖 90%+→70% 目标，石油国家转型艰难前行。
AO-OIL-001.case_en: 1975 independence/1975-2002 civil war/2002 peace/2017 Lourenco takes office/anti-corruption/diversification/Lobito Corridor/AfCFTA/oil dependency 90%+->70% target, oil state transition difficult journey.
AO-OIL-001.intellectual_tradition: Angolan Post-Conflict Oil Governance / Diversification Transition
AO-OIL-001.cross_cultural_impact: African oil state post-conflict transition; Lobito Corridor geopolitics; anti-corruption in petro-state; diversification roadmap
AO-OIL-001.indigenous_knowledge_system: Traditional agriculture; river navigation; oral history; communal labor
AO-OIL-001.oral_tradition: Angolan oral history; community authorization: Angolan Government 2023

PE-INC-001.name_zh: 印加/阿塔瓦尔帕/安第斯帝国：安第斯互惠与垂直群岛
PE-INC-001.name_en: Inca/Atahualpa/Andean Empire: Andean Reciprocity & Vertical Archipelago
PE-INC-001.description_zh: 印加帝国 (1438-1533) 阿塔瓦尔帕 (1502-1533) 末代皇帝，构建安第斯历史上最大帝国。核心治理技术：垂直群岛 — 在不同海拔生态带(海岸/山谷/高原/普纳)建立飞地殖民点，通过艾尼(互惠劳动)/明卡(社区共工)/米塔(轮班劳役)实现跨生态带资源互补；基普(结绳记事)编码人口/税收/军事/历法；查帕克纳纳(印加大道)连接帝国四方。体现 M165 安第斯互惠/印加 — 以"垂直群岛+艾尼互惠+明卡共工+基普编码"四位一体，在极端垂直地理中构建超大规模帝国治理。
PE-INC-001.description_en: Inca Empire (1438-1533) Atahualpa (1502-1533) last emperor, built largest empire in Andean history. Core governance tech: vertical archipelago — establishing exclave colonies across different altitudinal ecological zones (coast/valley/altiplano/puna), achieving cross-ecological resource complementarity via ayni (reciprocal labor)/minka (community work)/mita (rotational labor draft); khipu (knotted cords) encoding population/tax/military/calendar; Qhapaq Ñan (Inca Road) connecting imperial four quarters. Exemplifies M165 Andean Reciprocity/Inca — quaternity of 'vertical archipelago + ayni reciprocity + minka communal labor + khipu encoding' building mega-empire governance in extreme vertical geography.
PE-INC-001.reason_zh: 印加帝国非单纯征服国家，而是"垂直群岛+互惠经济+结绳编码"三位一体生态帝国。在无文字/无轮子/无铁器条件下，以生态适应性实现百万平方公里/千万人口整合。M165 区隔于 M152 安第斯互惠(核心)、M181 边境地带(乌克兰)、M170 民族建国(伊拉克)，核心在于"垂直生态位互补+互惠劳动制+结绳信息系统"的安第斯帝国范式。
PE-INC-001.reason_en: Inca Empire not mere conquest state but 'vertical archipelago + reciprocal economy + khipu encoding' trinity ecological empire. Without writing/wheel/iron, achieved million-km²/10M+ population integration via ecological adaptivity. M165 distinct from M152 Andean Reciprocity (core), M181 Borderland (Ukraine), M170 Nation-Building (Iraq), core: 'vertical ecological niche complementarity + reciprocal labor system + khipu information system' Andean imperial paradigm.
steps_zh: 垂直群岛生态布局：海岸棉花/海产→山谷玉米/可可→高原藜麦/马铃薯→普纳羊驼/盐，跨带互补零贸易成本
艾尼互惠劳动制：家庭/社区/国家三级互惠，劳动即税收/福利/防御，零货币零市场
明卡社区共工与米塔国家劳役：基建/农业/军事三大领域，劳役即公民权/分配权/荣誉制
基普结绳信息系统：彩色/结位/间距编码人口/税收/军事/历法/法律，专业结绳师阶层垄断解码
印加大道与驿站网络：4万公里/查斯基接力跑者/塔姆博驿站/军事/行政/贸易三网合一，帝国神经中枢
steps_en: Vertical archipelago ecological layout: coast cotton/seafood -> valley maize/cocoa -> altiplano quinoa/potato -> puna llama/salt, cross-zone complementarity zero trade cost
Ayni reciprocal labor system: household/community/state three-tier reciprocity, labor as tax/welfare/defense, zero currency zero market
Minka community work & mita state labor draft: infrastructure/agriculture/military three domains, labor draft as citizenship/distribution right/honor system
Khipu knotted-cord information system: color/knot/spacing encoding population/tax/military/calendar/law, professional khipukamayuq caste monopolizes decoding
Inca road & tambos network: 40k km/chasqui relay runners/tambo waystations/military-admin-trade three networks unified, imperial nervous system
PE-INC-001.expected_zh: 以"垂直群岛+艾尼互惠+明卡共工+基普编码"四位一体，在极端垂直地理/无文字/无轮子/无铁器条件下构建百万平方公里/千万人口安第斯帝国，为极端地理帝国治理提供唯一范式。
PE-INC-001.expected_en: Quaternity of 'vertical archipelago + ayni reciprocity + minka communal labor + khipu encoding' builds million-km²/10M+ population Andean Empire under extreme vertical geography/no writing/no wheel/no iron, providing sole paradigm for extreme geography imperial governance.
PE-INC-001.case_zh: 1438 帕查库特克建帝/1493 瓦伊纳·卡帕克扩张/1532 阿塔瓦尔帕继位/1533 派萨罗俘虏阿塔瓦尔帕/1572 图帕克·阿马鲁末代皇帝处决/基普幸存 600+ 件/印加大道成世界遗产，垂直帝国在征服中崩塌但生态智慧永存。
PE-INC-001.case_en: 1438 Pachacuti founds empire/1493 Huayna Capac expands/1532 Atahualpa succeeds/1533 Pizarro captures Atahualpa/1572 Tupac Amaru last emperor executed/600+ khipus survive/Inca Road UNESCO/vertical empire collapses in conquest but ecological wisdom endures.
PE-INC-001.intellectual_tradition: Inca Imperial Ecology / Andean Reciprocity / Khipu Information System
PE-INC-001.cross_cultural_impact: Vertical archipelago model for mountain economies; khipu as pre-digital database; Andean reciprocity in modern cooperatives
PE-INC-001.colonial_history: Spanish conquest 1532-1572; encomienda; forced labor; cultural suppression
PE-INC-001.indigenous_knowledge_system: Khipu encoding; vertical ecology; ayni reciprocity; terrace agriculture; camelid pastoralism
PE-INC-001.oral_tradition: Quechua oral history; khipu reading tradition; community authorization: Peruvian Ministry of Culture 2023

PE-MOD-001.name_zh: 藤森/内战/民主修复：后冲突民主修复与新自由主义重构
PE-MOD-001.name_en: Fujimori/Civil War/Democratic Repair: Post-Conflict Democratic Repair & Neoliberal Restructuring
PE-MOD-001.description_zh: 阿尔韦托·藤森 (1938-2024) 秘鲁总统 (1990-2000)，1992 自我政变/新宪法/反光辉道路/新自由主义改革/2000 腐败逃亡/2007 引渡/2009 判刑/2023 赦免/2024 病逝。核心治理张力：威权稳定(反恐/新自治法/军警一体化)vs 民主破坏(自我政变/媒体控制/贪腐/人权侵犯)vs 经济奇迹(通胀 7000%→个位数/私有化/投资/出口)。体现 M193 后冲突民主修复 — 以"威权镇压+新自由主义重构+民主修复+真相和解"四位一体，在光辉道路恐怖主义/恶性通胀/民主崩塌三重危机中实现极限生存与部分修复。
PE-MOD-001.description_en: Alberto Fujimori (1938-2024) Peru President (1990-2000), 1992 self-coup/new constitution/defeat Shining Path/neoliberal reforms/2000 corruption flight/2007 extradition/2009 conviction/2023 pardon/2024 death. Core governance tensions: authoritarian stability (counter-terrorism/new organic law/military-police fusion) vs democratic destruction (self-coup/media control/corruption/human rights abuses) vs economic miracle (inflation 7000%->single digits/privatization/investment/exports). Exemplifies M193 Post-Conflict Democratic Repair — quaternity of 'authoritarian suppression + neoliberal restructuring + democratic repair + truth & reconciliation' achieving extreme survival & partial repair amid triple crisis of Shining Path terrorism/hyperinflation/democratic collapse.
PE-MOD-001.reason_zh: 藤森非单纯独裁者，而是"威权反恐+新自由主义经济奇迹+民主破坏"三位一体极限治理者。以军警铲除光辉道路(7万人死亡)，以休克疗法治愈恶性通胀，以自我政变摧毁民主制度。M193 区隔于 M171 资源民族主义(查韦斯)、M169 后资源转型(沙特)、M193 后民粹修复(委内瑞拉反对派)，核心在于"威权反恐即生存前提+新自由主义即经济重构+民主修复即道德代价"的秘鲁极限治理范式。
PE-MOD-001.reason_en: Fujimori not mere dictator but 'authoritarian counter-terrorism + neoliberal economic miracle + democratic destruction' trinity extreme governor. Military-police crushed Shining Path (70k deaths), shock therapy cured hyperinflation, self-coup destroyed democratic institutions. M193 distinct from M171 Resource Nationalist (Chavez), M169 Post-Resource Transition (Saudi), M193 Post-Populist Repair (Venezuela opposition), core: 'authoritarian counter-terrorism as survival prerequisite + neoliberalism as economic restructuring + democratic repair as moral cost' Peru extreme governance paradigm.
steps_zh: 威权反恐与自我政变：1992 解散国会/宪法法院/司法/媒体控制/军警一体化/1993 新宪法/连任合法化
新自由主义休克疗法：通胀 7649%→个位数/国企私有化/外资开放/贸易自由化/财政平衡/投资信心恢复
反光辉道路/图帕克·阿马鲁：情报/军警/农民自卫队/领袖古铁雷斯/拉莫斯捕获/恐怖主义基本铲除
贪腐体系与逃亡：蒙蒂诺斯情报网/贿赂媒体/司法/军警/国企/2000 录像曝光/藤森逃亡日本/国际通缉/2007 智利引渡
民主修复与真相和解：2001 托莱多上台/真相与和解委员会/藤森/蒙蒂诺斯判刑/受害者赔偿/制度改革/民主巩固
steps_en: Authoritarian counter-terrorism & self-coup: 1992 dissolved Congress/Constitutional Court/judiciary/media control/military-police fusion/1993 new constitution/reelection legalized
Neoliberal shock therapy: inflation 7649%->single digits/SOE privatization/FDI opening/trade liberalization/fiscal balance/investment confidence restored
Shining Path/MRTA defeat: intelligence/military-police/peasant self-defense/leaders Guzman/Ramos captured/terrorism largely eliminated
Corruption system & flight: Montesinos intel network/bribed media/judiciary/military/SOEs/2000 videotape exposed/Fujimori fled Japan/international warrant/2007 Chile extradition
Democratic repair & truth & reconciliation: 2001 Toledo takes office/Truth & Reconciliation Commission/Fujimori/Montesinos convicted/victim reparations/institutional reforms/democratic consolidation
PE-MOD-001.expected_zh: 以"威权反恐+新自由主义重构+民主修复+真相和解"四位一体，在恐怖主义/恶性通胀/民主崩塌三重危机中实现极限生存与部分修复，留下威权代价与民主修复双重遗产。
PE-MOD-001.expected_en: Quaternity of 'authoritarian suppression + neoliberal restructuring + democratic repair + truth & reconciliation' achieves extreme survival & partial repair amid triple crisis of terrorism/hyperinflation/democratic collapse, leaving dual legacy of authoritarian cost & democratic repair.
PE-MOD-001.case_zh: 1990 当选/1992 自我政变/1993 新宪法/1995 连任/2000 蒙蒂诺斯录像/逃亡/2007 引渡/2009 判刑 25 年/2017 人道赦免/2023 赦免/2024 病逝，威权-经济-民主三重遗产纠缠。
PE-MOD-001.case_en: 1990 elected/1992 self-coup/1993 new constitution/1995 reelected/2000 Montesinos tape/flight/2007 extradition/2009 25-year sentence/2017 humanitarian pardon/2023 pardon/2024 death, authoritarian-economic-democratic triple legacy entangled.
PE-MOD-001.intellectual_tradition: Peruvian Authoritarian Neoliberalism / Counter-Terrorism / Democratic Transition
PE-MOD-001.cross_cultural_impact: Authoritarian counter-terrorism model; neoliberal shock therapy; self-coup precedent; truth commission
PE-MOD-001.diaspora_influence: Peruvian diaspora 3M+ (US/JP/ES/IT/AR/CL); Fujimori Japan exile unique

VE-OIL-001.name_zh: 查韦斯/马杜罗/石油政治：石油民粹再分配与玻利瓦尔革命
VE-OIL-001.name_en: Chavez/Maduro/Oil Politics: Oil Populist Redistribution & Bolivarian Revolution
VE-OIL-001.description_zh: 乌戈·查韦斯 (1954-2013) 委内瑞拉总统 (1999-2013)，尼古拉斯·马杜罗 (1962-) 2013- 继位，玻利瓦尔革命核心。核心治理模式：石油租金再分配 — PDVSA 国有化/石油收入直拨社会任务(健康/教育/住房/粮食)/反帝反美/拉美一体化(ALBA/石油换医生)/21 世纪社会主义。2010s 油价暴跌/制裁/恶性通胀/移民潮/马杜罗争议连任/临时总统瓜伊多/人道危机。体现 M168 石油民粹再分配 — 以"石油国有化+社会任务再分配+反帝意识形态+军民融合"四位一体，在石油诅咒/美洲地缘/意识形态极化中构建民粹再分配政权。
VE-OIL-001.description_en: Hugo Chavez (1954-2013) Venezuela President (1999-2013), Nicolas Maduro (1962-) succeeded 2013-, Bolivarian Revolution core. Core governance model: oil rent redistribution — PDVSA nationalization/oil revenue direct-funded social missions (health/education/housing/food)/anti-imperialist anti-US/Latin American integration (ALBA/oil-for-doctors)/21st century socialism. 2010s oil price crash/sanctions/hyperinflation/migration wave/Maduro disputed reelection/interim president Guaido/humanitarian crisis. Exemplifies M168 Oil Populist Redistribution — quaternity of 'oil nationalization + social mission redistribution + anti-imperial ideology + civil-military fusion' constructing populist redistribution regime amid oil curse/Western Hemisphere geopolitics/ideological polarization.
VE-OIL-001.reason_zh: 查韦斯非单纯民粹主义者，而是"石油租金+社会任务+反帝意识形态"三位一体革命政治家。以 PDVSA 掌控石油命脉，以社会任务绕过腐败官僚直达贫民，以反美凝聚拉美左翼。M168 区隔于 M169 后石油转型(沙特)、M193 后冲突修复(秘鲁/委内瑞拉反对派)、M189 大人制(蒙博图)，核心在于"石油租金直拨民生+反帝凝聚区域左翼+军民融合守卫政权"的委内瑞拉石油民粹范式。
VE-OIL-001.reason_en: Chavez not mere populist but 'oil rent + social missions + anti-imperial ideology' trinity revolutionary statesman. PDVSA controlled oil lifeline, social missions bypassed corrupt bureaucracy reaching poor directly, anti-US rallied Latin American left. M168 distinct from M169 Post-Oil Transition (Saudi), M193 Post-Conflict Repair (Peru/Venezuela opposition), M189 Big Man (Mobutu), core: 'oil rent direct to livelihoods + anti-imperial rallies regional left + civil-military fusion guards regime' Venezuelan oil populism paradigm.
steps_zh: PDVSA 国有化与石油主权：1999 新宪法/2002-03 罢工镇压/2006 全面国有化/合资重谈/石油收入纳入国家预算
社会任务再分配体系：使命罗宾逊(扫盲)/使命巴里奥阿德恩托(古巴医生社区医疗)/使命比维恩达(住房)/使命阿尔门塔里奥(粮食)，直拨零中介
反帝意识形态与拉美一体化：ALBA/石油换医生/苏克雷虚拟货币/南方银行/联合国/不结盟/反美外交/拉美左翼领袖
军民融合与政权守卫：国民警卫队/民兵/集体/公社/军队商业/情报/反政变/2002 未遂政变/2019 瓜伊多挑战/军队忠诚
油价暴跌与危机演变：2014 油价暴跌/2017 制裁/恶性通胀 100万%+/500万+ 移民/人道危机/马杜罗争议连任/2020s 部分验美元化/PDVSA 重组
steps_en: PDVSA nationalization & oil sovereignty: 1999 new constitution/2002-03 strike crushed/2006 full nationalization/JV renegotiation/oil revenue into national budget

Social mission redistribution system: Mission Robinson (literacy)/Mission Barrio Adentro (Cuban doctors community health)/Mission Vivienda (housing)/Mission Alimentario (food), direct zero-intermediary
Anti-imperial ideology & Latin American integration: ALBA/oil-for-doctors/Sucre virtual currency/Bank of the South/UN/Non-Aligned/anti-US diplomacy/Latin American left leader
Civil-military fusion & regime defense: National Guard/militias/collectives/communes/military commerce/intel/anti-coup/2002 failed coup/2019 Guaido challenge/military loyalty
Oil price crash & crisis evolution: 2014 oil crash/2017 sanctions/hyperinflation 1M%+/5M+ migrants/humanitarian crisis/Maduro disputed reelection/2020s partial dollarization/PDVSA restructuring
VE-OIL-001.expected_zh: 以"石油国有化+社会任务+反帝意识形态+军民融合"四位一体，在石油诅咒/美洲地缘/意识形态极化中构建民粹再分配政权，留下石油依赖未解/制度脆弱/人道危机的警世遗产。
VE-OIL-001.expected_en: Quaternity of 'oil nationalization + social missions + anti-imperial ideology + civil-military fusion' constructs populist redistribution regime amid oil curse/Western Hemisphere geopolitics/ideological polarization, leaving cautionary legacy of unresolved oil dependency/institutional fragility/humanitarian crisis.

VE-OIL-001.case_en: 1999 elected/1999 new constitution/2002 coup/strike/2006 nationalization/2013 Chavez death/Maduro succeeds/2014 oil crash/2017 sanctions/2019 Guaido/2020s partial dollarization/humanitarian crisis continues, oil populism paradigm sustainability test.

VE-OPP-001.name_zh: 反对派/瓜伊多/民主斗争：后民粹民主修复与过渡正义
VE-OPP-001.name_en: Opposition/Guaido/Democratic Struggle: Post-Populist Democratic Repair & Transitional Justice
VE-OPP-001.description_zh: 胡安·瓜伊多 (1983-) 国民议会议长/2019 宣誓临时总统/50+ 国家承认/军事倒戈失败/2023 反对派初选/马查多/2024 大选/马杜罗争议连任。核心斗争逻辑：宪法第 233 条合法性/国际承认联盟/街头动员/制裁施压/军队分化/谈判对话(墨西哥/巴巴多斯/多哈)/选举条件/过渡正义设计。体现 M193 后民粹民主修复 — 以"宪法合法性+国际联盟+街头动员+谈判过渡"四位一体，在民粹巩固/军队控制/制裁疲劳/反对派分裂四重困境中寻求民主回归路径。
VE-OPP-001.description_en: Juan Guaido (1983-) National Assembly President/2019 swore interim president/50+ nations recognized/military defection failed/2023 opposition primary/Machado/2024 election/Maduro disputed reelection. Core struggle logic: Constitution Art. 233 legitimacy/international recognition alliance/street mobilization/sanctions pressure/military fracture/negotiated dialogue (Mexico/Barbados/Doha)/electoral conditions/transitional justice design. Exemplifies M193 Post-Populist Democratic Repair — quaternity of 'constitutional legitimacy + international alliance + street mobilization + negotiated transition' seeking democratic return path amid quadruple bind of populist consolidation/military control/sanctions fatigue/opposition fragmentation.
VE-OPP-001.reason_zh: 瓜伊多非单纯挑战者，而是"宪法条款+国际承认+街头+谈判"四位一体过渡架构师。以第 233 条填补权力真空，以 50 国承认构建外交壁垒，以街头动员维持压力，以谈判设计过渡条件。M193 区隔于 M193 后冲突修复(秘鲁)、M168 石油民粹(查韦斯)、M171 资源民族主义(查韦斯)，核心在于"宪法条款即合法性锚点+国际承认即外交杠杆+谈判即过渡工程"的后民粹民主修复范式。
VE-OPP-001.reason_en: Guaido not mere challenger but 'constitutional article + international recognition + streets + negotiations' quaternity transition architect. Art. 233 filled power vacuum, 50-nation recognition built diplomatic wall, street mobilization maintained pressure, negotiations designed transition conditions. M193 distinct from M193 Post-Conflict Repair (Peru), M168 Oil Populism (Chavez), M171 Resource Nationalist (Chavez), core: 'constitutional article as legitimacy anchor + international recognition as diplomatic leverage + negotiations as transition engineering' post-populist democratic repair paradigm.
steps_zh: 宪法第 233 条合法性锚点：总统空缺/国民议会议长代行/2019 1 月 23 日宣誓/法律/宪法/议会三重合法性
国际承认联盟构建：50+ 国家/欧盟/利马集团/OAS/联合国/资产保护/外交隔离马杜罗/人道援助走廊

谈判对话与过渡条件：墨西哥/巴巴多斯/多哈/选举时间表/观察员/政治犯释放/媒体准入/司法独立/过渡政府设计
反对派初选与大选博弈：2023 初选马查多胜出/最高法院取消资格/2024 大选马杜罗争议连任/反对派拒认/国际分歧/民主修复未完成

International recognition alliance construction: 50+ nations/EU/Lima Group/OAS/UN/asset protection/diplomatic isolation Maduro/humanitarian aid corridor
Street mobilization & military fracture: Saturday mass marches/military defection appeals/collectives/communes/intel/counter-intel/military core loyalty/grassroots wavering
Negotiated dialogue & transition conditions: Mexico/Barbados/Doha/election timeline/observers/political prisoner release/media access/judicial independence/transitional govt design
Opposition primary & election game: 2023 primary Machado wins/Supreme Court disqualifies/2024 election Maduro disputed reelection/opposition rejects/international split/democratic repair incomplete

CU-REV-001.name_zh: 古巴·菲德尔·卡斯特罗：革命导弹危机与医疗教育生存
CU-REV-001.name_en: Cuba Fidel Castro: Revolution Missile Crisis & Healthcare Education Survival
CU-REV-001.description_zh: 菲德尔·卡斯特罗 (1926-2016) 古巴革命领袖/总统 (1959-2008)，1959年推翻巴蒂斯塔，1962导弹危机核战争边缘，医疗教育免费全民覆盖，美国封锁六十年生存，2008年交权劳尔。
CU-REV-001.description_en: Fidel Castro (1926-2016) Cuba revolutionary leader/President (1959-2008), 1959 overthrew Batista, 1962 missile crisis nuclear war brink, healthcare education free universal coverage, US blockade sixty years survival, 2008 handover Raul.
CU-REV-001.reason_zh: 卡斯特罗代表拉美革命如何在美帝国主义全方位封锁下生存六十年，展示了医疗教育成就如何成为革命合法性核心支柱，导弹危机将古巴推向核战争中心舞台，其长寿统治重塑拉美左翼想象。
CU-REV-001.reason_en: Castro represents how Latin American revolution survives sixty years under US comprehensive blockade, demonstrating how healthcare education achievements become revolutionary legitimacy core pillar, missile crisis placed Cuba at nuclear war center stage, his longevity rule reshaping Latin American left imagination.
steps_zh: 研究卡斯特罗早年律师与蒙卡达兵营起义
分析1959年革命胜利与土地改革/识字运动
探讨1962年导弹危机核战争边缘与古巴生存
评估医疗国际主义/教育免费/生物技术成就
总结革命导弹危机医疗教育古巴生存对拉美左翼的三重遗产
steps_en: Study Castro early lawyer and Moncada Barracks uprising
Analyze 1959 revolution victory and land reform/literacy campaign
Explore 1962 missile crisis nuclear war brink and Cuba survival
Evaluate medical internationalism/education free/biotech achievements
Summarize revolution missile crisis healthcare education Cuba survival triple legacy for Latin American left
CU-REV-001.expected_zh: 理解革命如何在封锁中通过人力资本投资实现人类发展指标超越，掌握导弹危机作为核威慑博弈的极限案例，评估卡斯特罗模式对委内瑞拉玻利维亚尼加拉瓜等左翼政权的示范与代价。
CU-REV-001.expected_en: Understand how revolution achieves human development indicators surpassing through human capital investment under blockade, grasp missile crisis as nuclear deterrence game limit case, evaluate Castro model demonstration and costs for Venezuela Bolivia Nicaragua left regimes.
CU-REV-001.case_zh: 1959 革命；1962 导弹；医疗教育免费；2008 交权；2016 逝世。革命导弹医疗教育生存范式永存。
CU-REV-001.case_en: 1959 revolution; 1962 missile crisis; healthcare education free; 2008 handover; 2016 death. Revolution missile healthcare education survival paradigm endures.

CU-BIO-001.name_zh: 生物技术/医疗外交/古巴模式：医疗生态链主与全球南方健康
CU-BIO-001.name_en: Biotech/Medical Diplomacy/Cuban Model: Medical Ecosystem Chain-Master & Global South Health
CU-BIO-001.description_zh: 古巴生物技术产业 1980s 起步(干扰素/脑膜炎B疫苗/肺癌疫苗CIMAvax/Heberprot-P糖尿病足)/生物技术西方/出口 50+ 国/新冠疫苗(阿卜达拉/索贝拉纳)/医疗外交(5万+医生派驻 60+ 国)。核心模式：国家主导研发/封闭创新/南南合作/专利池/技术转让/人才留存。体现 M163 医疗生态链主 — 以"国家主导研发+封闭创新生态+南南技术转让+医生外交网络"四位一体，在封锁/资源匮乏/人才外流三重约束下构建全球南方医疗生态链主。
CU-BIO-001.description_en: Cuban biotech industry 1980s start (interferon/meningitis B vaccine/lung cancer vaccine CIMAvax/Heberprot-P diabetic foot)/biotech Western/exports 50+ countries/COVID vaccines (Abdala/Soberana)/medical diplomacy (50k+ doctors deployed 60+ countries). Core model: state-led R&D/closed innovation/South-South cooperation/patent pools/tech transfer/talent retention. Exemplifies M163 Medical Ecosystem Chain-Master — quaternity of 'state-led R&D + closed innovation ecosystem + South-South tech transfer + doctor diplomacy network' building Global South medical ecosystem chain-master amid blockade/resource scarcity/brain drain triple constraints.
CU-BIO-001.reason_zh: 古巴生物技术非单纯产业，而是"国家研发+封闭创新+南南合作+医生外交"四位一体生存战略。美封锁迫使自主研发，苏联解体迫使出口创汇，人才外流迫使国内留存机制。M163 区隔于 M158 通才整合(农牧+科技)、M168 资源诅咒(石油)、M192 游击解放(马谢尔)，核心在于"封锁倒逼自主+资源匮乏倒逼创新+南南合作倒逼开放"的封锁下创新范式。
CU-BIO-001.reason_en: Cuban biotech not mere industry but 'state R&D + closed innovation + South-South coop + doctor diplomacy' quaternity survival strategy. US blockade forced autonomous R&D, USSR collapse forced export revenue, brain drain forced retention mechanisms. M163 distinct from M158 Polymath Integration (agri+tech), M168 Resource Curse (oil), M192 Guerrilla Liberation (Machel), core: 'blockade forces autonomy + scarcity forces innovation + South-South forces openness' innovation-under-blockade paradigm.

BO-IND-001.name_zh: 玻利维亚·埃沃·莫拉莱斯：可可原住民总统与气候海洋权利
BO-IND-001.name_en: Bolivia Evo Morales: Coca Indigenous President & Climate Ocean Rights
BO-IND-001.description_zh: 埃沃·莫拉莱斯 (1959-) 玻利维亚首位原住民总统 (2006-2019)，可可种植合法化捍卫原住民文化，多民族国家宪法确立自治权，气候正义主张海洋出路权，2019年政变流亡墨西哥回归。
BO-IND-001.description_en: Evo Morales (1959-) Bolivia first indigenous President (2006-2019), coca legalization defended indigenous culture, plurinational constitution established autonomy rights, climate justice claimed ocean access right, 2019 coup exiled Mexico returned.
BO-IND-001.reason_zh: 莫拉莱斯代表原住民如何通过选举政治夺取国家权力并重写宪法，展示了可可文化权利与气候正义如何超越单一民族国家框架，其政变流亡与回归折射玻利维亚种族阶级博弈的深度。
BO-IND-001.reason_en: Morales represents how indigenous people seized state power through electoral politics and rewrote constitution, demonstrating how coca cultural rights and climate justice transcend mono-ethnic nation-state framework, his coup exile and return reflecting Bolivia racial-class struggle depth.
steps_zh: 研究莫拉莱斯早年可可农民与工会领袖崛起
分析2009年多民族国家宪法与原住民自治权
探讨可可合法化与单一公约条款冲突博弈
评估气候正义海洋出路权与智利领土争端
总结可可原住民总统气候海洋权利对拉美原住民政治的里程碑意义
steps_en: Study Morales early coca farmer and union leader rise
Analyze 2009 plurinational constitution and indigenous autonomy rights
Explore coca legalization and Single Convention clause conflict game
Evaluate climate justice ocean access right and Chile territorial dispute
Summarize coca indigenous president climate ocean rights milestone for Latin American indigenous politics
BO-IND-001.expected_zh: 掌握原住民选举夺权如何重写国家契约，理解可可文化权利与气候正义双重超越西方法律框架的逻辑，评估莫拉莱斯模式对厄瓜多尔秘鲁等安第斯原住民运动的示范。
BO-IND-001.expected_en: Master how indigenous electoral seizure rewrites national contract, grasp coca cultural rights and climate justice dual transcendence of Western legal frameworks, evaluate Morales model demonstration for Ecuador Peru Andean indigenous movements.
BO-IND-001.case_zh: 2006 总统；2009 宪法；2019 政变流亡；2020 回归。可可原住民总统气候海洋权利范式永存。
BO-IND-001.case_en: 2006 President; 2009 Constitution; 2019 coup exile; 2020 return. Coca indigenous president climate ocean rights paradigm endures.
BO-IND-001.intellectual_tradition: Andean Indigenous Politics / Plurinationalism / Climate Justice
BO-IND-001.cross_cultural_impact: Indigenous presidency; plurinational constitution; coca rights; climate justice; ocean access

BO-RES-001.name_zh: 锂三角/资源民族主义：资源诅咒缓解与绿色能源主权
BO-RES-001.name_en: Lithium Triangle/Resource Nationalism: Resource Curse Mitigation & Green Energy Sovereignty
BO-RES-001.description_zh: 玻利维亚乌尤尼盐湖拥有全球最大锂储量(2100 万吨/全球 25%+)，锂三角(玻利维亚/智利/阿根廷)主导全球锂供应。核心治理张力：资源民族主义(国有化/本地加工/电池产业链) vs 外资技术/资本/市场准入 vs 环境/水资源/原住民权益。体现 M168 资源诅咒缓解/绿色能源主权 — 以"锂主权国家化+本地化全产业链+环境水资源守护+原住民收益共享"四位一体，在绿色能源转型全球争夺/水资源匮乏/原住民权益三重约束中实现资源主权与产业升级双重目标。
BO-RES-001.description_en: Bolivia Uyuni salt flat holds world's largest lithium reserves (21Mt/25%+ global), Lithium Triangle (Bolivia/Chile/Argentina) dominates global lithium supply. Core governance tension: resource nationalism (nationalization/local processing/battery value chain) vs foreign tech/capital/market access vs environment/water/indigenous rights. Exemplifies M168 Resource Curse Mitigation/Green Energy Sovereignty — quaternity of 'lithium sovereignty nationalized + localized full value chain + environment/water guardianship + indigenous benefit sharing' achieving dual goals of resource sovereignty & industrial upgrading amid triple constraints of global green energy scramble/water scarcity/indigenous rights.
BO-RES-001.reason_zh: 玻利维亚锂非单纯资源，而是"主权+产业链+环境+原住民"四位一体绿色能源战略资产。莫拉莱斯/阿尔塞推行国有化/本地化/中资/俄资合作，拒绝单纯出口碳酸锂。M168 区隔于 M169 后石油转型(沙特)、M171 资源民族主义(委内瑞拉)、M189 大人制(蒙博图)，核心在于"锂主权即国家安全+本地化即产业升级+水资源即生存红线+原住民即权益主体"的绿色能源时代资源治理新范式。
BO-RES-001.reason_en: Bolivian lithium not mere resource but 'sovereignty + value chain + environment + indigenous' quaternity green energy strategic asset. Morales/Arce drive nationalization/localization/Chinese/Russian cooperation, refuse mere lithium carbonate export. M168 distinct from M169 Post-Oil (Saudi), M171 Resource Nationalist (Venezuela), M189 Big Man (Mobutu), core: 'lithium sovereignty as national security + localization as industrial upgrade + water as survival redline + indigenous as rights subjects' new resource governance paradigm for green energy era.
steps_zh: 锂主权国家化与 YLB 成立：2008 矿业法/2017 YLB 玻利维亚锂业公司/国家控股/合资谈判/技术转让条款/本地加工强制
本地化全产业链构建：碳酸锂→氢氧化锂→电池材料→电池芯→电动车/储能/中资/俄资/德资合作/技术转让/人才培养
水资源环境守护红线：乌尤尼盐湖卤水蒸发/淡水稀缺/原住民用水/生态监测/环评/气候变化/水权优先于锂利润
原住民收益共享与咨询权：2009 宪法咨询权/自由事先知情同意/FPIC/收益分成/社区项目/教育/医疗/基建/文化保护
绿色能源地缘博弈与未来：欧盟/美国/中国/电动车产业链/关键矿产安全/玻利维亚/智利/阿根廷/墨西哥/锂 OPEC 概念/产业链主权
steps_en: Lithium sovereignty nationalized & YLB creation: 2008 Mining Law/2017 YLB Bolivian Lithium Corp/state control/JV negotiations/tech transfer clauses/local processing mandatory

Localized full value chain construction: lithium carbonate -> lithium hydroxide -> battery materials -> battery cells -> EVs/storage/Chinese/Russian/German cooperation/tech transfer/talent development
Water resource environmental redline: Uyuni brine evaporation/freshwater scarcity/indigenous water use/ecological monitoring/EIA/climate change/water rights priority over lithium profits
Indigenous benefit sharing & consultation rights: 2009 Constitution consultation/FPIC/revenue sharing/community projects/education/health/infra/cultural protection
Green energy geopolitical game & future: EU/US/China/EV value chain/critical minerals security/Bolivia/Chile/Argentina/Mexico/Lithium OPEC concept/value chain sovereignty
BO-RES-001.expected_zh: 以"锂主权+本地化产业链+水资源红线+原住民权益"四位一体，在绿色能源转型全球争夺/水资源匮乏/原住民权益三重约束中实现资源主权与产业升级双重目标，为关键矿产资源治理提供绿色时代新范式。
BO-RES-001.expected_en: Quaternity of 'lithium sovereignty + localized value chain + water redline + indigenous rights' achieves dual goals of resource sovereignty & industrial upgrading amid triple constraints of global green energy scramble/water scarcity/indigenous rights, providing new resource governance paradigm for critical minerals in green energy era.
BO-RES-001.case_zh: 2008 矿业法/2017 YLB/2019 莫拉莱斯危机/2020 阿尔塞/中资/俄资/德资合作/2023 首批碳酸锂/电池级/产业链本地化进行时/水资源冲突持续，锂主权艰难前行。
BO-RES-001.case_en: 2008 Mining Law/2017 YLB/2019 Morales crisis/2020 Arce/Chinese/Russian/German cooperation/2023 first lithium carbonate/battery grade/value chain localization ongoing/water conflicts persist, lithium sovereignty difficult journey.
BO-RES-001.intellectual_tradition: Bolivian Resource Nationalism / Green Energy Sovereignty / Lithium Geopolitics
BO-RES-001.cross_cultural_impact: Critical minerals geopolitics; lithium value chain localization; water rights vs extraction; indigenous consent in mining

BO-RES-001.oral_tradition: Aymara oral history; community authorization: YLB & Indigenous Communities 2023

EC-DOL-001.name_zh: 美元化/科雷阿/安第斯共同体：美元化共识治理与主权货币博弈
EC-DOL-001.name_en: Dollarization/Correa/Andean Community: Dollarization Consensus Governance & Sovereign Currency Game
EC-DOL-001.description_zh: 厄瓜多尔 2000 年全面美元化(苏克雷崩溃/通胀 96%/银行危机)，拉斐尔·科雷阿 (1963-) 总统 (2007-2017) 公民革命/反新自由主义/宪法承认自然权利/亚苏尼ITT/中资基建/2008 债务违约/安第斯共同体(秘鲁/哥伦比亚/玻利维亚/厄瓜多尔)一体化推手。体现 M164 美元化共识治理 — 以"美元化锚定+公民革命再分配+自然权利宪法+区域一体化"四位一体，在无主权货币/外债/石油依赖/区域分歧四重约束中实现相对稳定与再分配。
EC-DOL-001.description_en: Ecuador full dollarization 2000 (sucre collapse/inflation 96%/banking crisis), Rafael Correa (1963-) President (2007-2017) Citizens' Revolution/anti-neoliberal/constitution recognizes rights of nature/Yasuni ITT/Chinese infra/2008 debt default/Andean Community (Peru/Colombia/Bolivia/Ecuador) integration driver. Exemplifies M164 Dollarization Consensus Governance — quaternity of 'dollarization anchor + Citizens Revolution redistribution + rights of nature constitution + regional integration' achieving relative stability & redistribution amid quadruple constraints of no sovereign currency/external debt/oil dependency/regional divisions.
EC-DOL-001.reason_zh: 厄瓜多尔美元化非单纯货币替代，而是"美元锚定+公民革命+自然权利"三位一体生存策略。无货币主权迫使财政纪律，科雷阿以再分配/基建/反帝平衡美元化紧缩。M164 区隔于 M168 资源诅咒(委内瑞拉)、M169 后石油(沙特)、M171 资源民族主义(玻利维亚)，核心在于"美元化即通胀锚点+公民革命即社会契约+自然权利即文明创新"的无主权货币国家治理范式。
EC-DOL-001.reason_en: Ecuador dollarization not mere currency substitution but 'dollar anchor + Citizens Revolution + rights of nature' trinity survival strategy. No monetary sovereignty forced fiscal discipline, Correa balanced dollarization austerity with redistribution/infra/anti-imperialism. M164 distinct from M168 Resource Curse (Venezuela), M169 Post-Oil (Saudi), M171 Resource Nationalist (Bolivia), core: 'dollarization as inflation anchor + Citizens Revolution as social contract + rights of nature as civilizational innovation' governance paradigm for non-sovereign currency nations.
steps_zh: 美元化锚定通胀终结：2000 年 1 月/苏克雷 25000:1 美元/通胀 96%→个位数/利率下降/存款回流/金融稳定
公民革命再分配与反新自由主义：2007 当选/2008 制宪/自然权利/水/健康/教育/住房权/社会支出翻倍/贫困率 38%→22%
自然权利宪法与亚苏尼 ITT：2008 宪法第 71 条自然权利/亚苏尼石油留地/国际众筹/2013 放弃/中资开采/生态/石油张力
安第斯共同体一体化推手：秘鲁/哥伦比亚/玻利维亚/厄瓜多尔/关税同盟/自由流动/南美洲国家联盟/太平洋联盟博弈/区域分歧
后科雷阿时代与美元化存续：2017 莫雷诺/2019 反紧缩抗议/2021 拉索/2023 诺沃亚/美元化成政治共识/无党提去美元化/石油/债务/中国/IMF 四面博弈
steps_en: Dollarization anchors inflation termination: Jan 2000/sucre 25000:1 USD/inflation 96%->single digits/rates fall/deposits return/financial stability
Citizens Revolution redistribution & anti-neoliberalism: 2007 elected/2008 constituent/rights of nature/water/health/education/housing/social spending doubled/poverty 38%->22%
Rights of nature constitution & Yasuni ITT: 2008 Constitution Art. 71 rights of nature/Yasuni oil underground/international crowdfunding/2013 abandoned/Chinese extraction/ecology/oil tension
Andean Community integration driver: Peru/Colombia/Bolivia/Ecuador/customs union/free movement/UNASUR/Pacific Alliance rivalry/regional divisions

Post-Correa era & dollarization persistence: 2017 Moreno/2019 anti-austerity protests/2021 Lasso/2023 Noboa/dollarization becomes political consensus/no party proposes de-dollarization/oil/debt/China/IMF four-way game

EC-DOL-001.expected_en: Quaternity of 'dollarization anchor + Citizens Revolution + rights of nature + regional integration' achieves relative stability & redistribution amid quadruple constraints of no sovereign currency/external debt/oil dependency/regional divisions, providing dollarization consensus governance paradigm for non-sovereign currency nations.
EC-DOL-001.case_zh: 2000 美元化/2007 科雷阿/2008 自然权利宪法/2008 债务违约/2013 亚苏尼放弃/2017 莫雷诺/2019 抗议/2021 拉索/2023 诺沃亚/美元化共识巩固/自然权利全球先例，无主权货币国家生存范式。
EC-DOL-001.case_en: 2000 dollarization/2007 Correa/2008 rights of nature constitution/2008 debt default/2013 Yasuni abandoned/2017 Moreno/2019 protests/2021 Lasso/2023 Noboa/dollarization consensus solidified/rights of nature global precedent, non-sovereign currency nation survival paradigm.
EC-DOL-001.intellectual_tradition: Ecuadorian Dollarization Consensus / Rights of Nature / Citizens Revolution
EC-DOL-001.cross_cultural_impact: Dollarization as governance paradigm; rights of nature constitutional first; Yasuni precedent; Andean integration

EC-IND-001.name_zh: 孔菲德拉西翁/原住民运动：安第斯联盟与乌班图式共识
EC-IND-001.name_en: CONAIE/Indigenous Movement: Andean Alliance & Ubuntu-Style Consensus
EC-IND-001.description_zh: 厄瓜多尔原住民民族联盟 (CONAIE) 1986 成立，历次起义(1990/1994/1997/2000/2005/2019/2022) 推动原住民权利/多民族国家/水权/反采掘/政治参与。核心动员模式：安第斯联盟 — 社区基础/轮值领袖/共识决策/明卡互助/安第斯宇宙观(帕查妈妈/苏马·考萨伊/美好生活)/跨阶级联盟(学生/工人/环保/左翼)。体现 M146 乌班图/安第斯共识 — 以"社区基础+轮值领袖+共识决策+安第斯宇宙观"四位一体，在国家精英/跨国公司/军队/媒体四强围剿中构建原住民主体性政治力量。
EC-IND-001.description_en: Ecuador Confederation of Indigenous Nationalities (CONAIE) founded 1986, multiple uprisings (1990/1994/1997/2000/2005/2019/2022) advanced indigenous rights/plurinational state/water rights/anti-extractivism/political participation. Core mobilization model: Andean Alliance — community base/rotating leadership/consensus decision/minka mutual aid/Andean cosmovision (Pachamama/Sumak Kawsay/Good Living)/cross-class alliances (students/workers/environmentalists/left). Exemplifies M146 Ubuntu/Andean Consensus — quaternity of 'community base + rotating leadership + consensus decision + Andean cosmovision' building indigenous political subjectivity amid quadruple siege of state elites/multinationals/military/media.
EC-IND-001.reason_zh: CONAIE 非单纯压力团体，而是"社区基础+轮值领袖+共识决策+安第斯宇宙观"四位一体政治主体。以社区为权力源头，轮值防精英化，共识超越多数决，宇宙观提供文明叙事。M146 区隔于 M146 乌班图(南非)、M164 美元化共识(厄瓜多尔)、M187 酋长制(加纳)，核心在于"社区即权力源头+轮值即反精英+共识即决策制+宇宙观即文明叙事"的安第斯原住民政治范式。
EC-IND-001.reason_en: CONAIE not mere pressure group but 'community base + rotating leadership + consensus decision + Andean cosmovision' quaternity political subject. Community as power source, rotation prevents elitization, consensus transcends majority vote, cosmovision provides civilizational narrative. M146 distinct from M146 Ubuntu (SA), M164 Dollarization Consensus (Ecuador), M187 Chiefship (Ghana), core: 'community as power source + rotation as anti-elite + consensus as decision rule + cosmovision as civilizational narrative' Andean indigenous political paradigm.
steps_zh: 社区基础与领土自治：社区(亚尤)/民族/联盟三级/领土自治/水/森林/矿产/教育/卫生/司法/自治权
轮值领袖与反精英机制：主席/副主席/秘书/轮值/任期/无连任/问责/社区监督/防止官僚化/领袖即仆人
共识决策与明卡互助：全体大会/讨论/共识/非多数决/明卡社区共工/互助/灾害/庆典/劳动即纽带
安第斯宇宙观与美好生活：帕查妈妈/大地母亲/苏马·考萨伊/美好生活/非GDP/和谐/互惠/生态/精神/文明替代性
跨阶级联盟与政治冲击：1990 起义/2000 马瓦恩/2005 帕拉西奥斯/2019 反紧缩/2022 反油气/拉索/诺沃亚/原住民议员/部长/政治重塑
steps_en: Community base & territorial autonomy: community (ayllu)/nationality/confederation three-tier/territorial autonomy/water/forest/minerals/education/health/justice/autonomy rights
Rotating leadership & anti-elite mechanism: president/VP/secretary/rotating/term/no re-election/accountability/community oversight/prevents bureaucratization/leader as servant
Consensus decision & minka mutual aid: general assembly/deliberation/consensus/not majority vote/minka community work/mutual aid/disaster/celebration/labor as bond
Andean cosmovision & Good Living: Pachamama/Mother Earth/Sumak Kawsay/Good Living/non-GDP/harmony/reciprocity/ecology/spiritual/civilizational alternative
Cross-class alliances & political impact: 1990 uprising/2000 Mahuad/2005 Palacio/2019 anti-austerity/2022 anti-oil/Lasso/Noboa/indigenous legislators/ministers/political reshaping

EC-IND-001.expected_en: Quaternity of 'community base + rotating leadership + consensus decision + Andean cosmovision' builds indigenous political subjectivity amid quadruple siege of state elites/multinationals/military/media, providing dual organizational & civilizational paradigm for Latin American indigenous movements.
EC-IND-001.case_zh: 1986 成立/1990 起义/1994 领土/2000 马瓦恩/2005 帕拉西奥斯/2008 宪法/2019 反紧缩/2022 反油气/原住民部长/议员/安第斯联盟存续，原住民政治主体性永存。
EC-IND-001.case_en: 1986 founded/1990 uprising/1994 territory/2000 Mahuad/2005 Palacio/2008 constitution/2019 anti-austerity/2022 anti-oil/indigenous ministers/legislators/Andean Alliance endures, indigenous political subjectivity endures.

UY-NAT-001.name_zh: 巴特列/福尔蒂/社会民主实验室：乌拉圭社会实验室与福利国家先锋
UY-NAT-001.name_en: Batlle/Forte/Social Democratic Laboratory: Uruguay Social Laboratory & Welfare State Pioneer
UY-NAT-001.description_zh: 何塞·巴特列·伊·奥尔多涅斯 (1856-1929) 乌拉圭总统 (1903-1907/1911-1915)，路易斯·巴特列·贝雷斯 (1897-1964) 继承者，构建拉美首个福利国家：八小时工作制/最低工资/养老金/免费教育/医疗/妇女权利/离婚/世俗化/1918 大学改革/合议制行政(1952-1967)。体现 M174 乌拉圭社会实验室 — 以"福利国家先锋+合议制行政+世俗化+大学自治"四位一体，在小国/农业出口/精英统治三重结构中构建拉美最早/最完整福利国家。
UY-NAT-001.description_en: Jose Batlle y Ordonez (1856-1929) Uruguay President (1903-1907/1911-1915), Luis Batlle Berres (1897-1964) successor, built Latin America's first welfare state: 8-hour workday/minimum wage/pensions/free education/healthcare/women's rights/divorce/secularization/1918 university reform/colegiado executive (1952-1967). Exemplifies M174 Uruguay Social Laboratory — quaternity of 'welfare state pioneer + colegiado executive + secularization + university autonomy' building Latin America's earliest/most complete welfare state amid triple structure of small nation/agricultural exports/elite rule.
UY-NAT-001.reason_zh: 乌拉圭非单纯福利国家，而是"巴特列主义+合议制+世俗化"三位一体社会实验室。以国家干预重构农业出口社会，以合议制防独裁，以世俗化分离教会。M174 区隔于 M164 美元化共识(厄瓜多尔)、M171 资源民族主义(玻利维亚)、M168 资源诅咒(委内瑞拉)，核心在于"福利国家即社会契约+合议制即权力制衡+世俗化即现代性"的拉美社会民主范式。
UY-NAT-001.reason_en: Uruguay not mere welfare state but 'Batllism + colegiado + secularization' trinity social laboratory. State intervention restructured agricultural export society, colegiado prevented dictatorship, secularization separated church. M174 distinct from M164 Dollarization Consensus (Ecuador), M171 Resource Nationalist (Bolivia), M168 Resource Curse (Venezuela), core: 'welfare state as social contract + colegiado as power check + secularization as modernity' Latin American social democratic paradigm.
steps_zh: 福利国家先锋立法：1915 八小时/1919 最低工资/1919 养老金/1913 离婚/1917 世俗化/免费教育/医疗/妇女选举权 1932
合议制行政权力制衡：1952 宪法/九人国家委员会/总统轮值/1967 恢复总统制/防独裁/权力分享/制度创新
世俗化与教会分离：1907 离婚/1913 世俗化婚姻/1917 宗教教育禁入公立/教会财产国有/拉美最早世俗国家
大学自治与 1918 改革：科尔多瓦改革波及/学生参治/学术自由/免费/公立/拉美大学自治先驱
后巴特列时代与存续：1973-85 军政府/1985 民主恢复/福利国家存续/前瞻指数拉美第一/透明度/人均 GDP 拉美高位
steps_en: Welfare state pioneer legislation: 1915 8-hour/1919 min wage/1919 pensions/1913 divorce/1917 secularization/free education/healthcare/women suffrage 1932
Colegiado executive power check: 1952 Constitution/9-member National Council/rotating presidency/1967 presidentialism restored/anti-dictatorship/power sharing/institutional innovation
Secularization & church-state separation: 1907 divorce/1913 secular marriage/1917 religious education banned from public/church property nationalized/Latin America's earliest secular state
University autonomy & 1918 reform: Cordoba reform spread/student co-governance/academic freedom/free/public/Latin America university autonomy pioneer
Post-Batllismo era & persistence: 1973-85 military govt/1985 democracy restored/welfare state persists/prosperity index Latin America #1/transparency/GDP per capita LatAm high

UY-NAT-001.expected_en: Quaternity of 'welfare state + colegiado + secularization + university autonomy' builds Latin America's earliest/most complete welfare state amid triple structure of small nation/agricultural exports/elite rule, providing laboratory paradigm for Latin American social democracy.

UY-TEC-001.name_en: Software Exports/Antil/Digital Nation: Polymath Integration & Agri-Tech Fusion

Core model: agri-tech fusion — traditional competitive industries (beef/wool/rice/soy) deeply fused with digital innovation (blockchain traceability/genomics/precision ag/agri-fintech). Exemplifies M158 Polymath Integration/Agri-Tech — quaternity of 'software exports leader + one laptop per child inclusion + agri-tech fusion + e-government transparency' achieving digital leap amid triple constraints of small nation/aging population/resource dependency.

UY-TEC-001.reason_en: Uruguay digitalization not mere industrial upgrade but 'software exports + inclusive education + agri-tech fusion' trinity national strategy. Plan Ceibal universalized digital literacy, software exports created high-wage jobs, agri-tech upgraded traditional strengths. M158 distinct from M158 Polymath Integration (core), M168 Resource Curse (Venezuela), M174 Social Laboratory (Batlle), core: 'software as new export engine + education as digital citizenship + agri-tech as traditional strength digitalization' small nation digital leap paradigm.

PY-HYD-001.name_zh: 伊泰普/水电/瓜拉尼含水层：水资源联邦主义与跨国能源共治
PY-HYD-001.name_en: Itaipu/Hydro/Guaraní Aquifer: Water Federalism & Transnational Energy Co-Governance
PY-HYD-001.description_zh: 伊泰普水电站 (伊泰普大坝) 巴拉圭/巴西共建/1984 运行/14000MW/世界第二/巴拉圭电力 90%+ 来自水电/出口巴西/瓜拉尼含水层(南美第二大/阿根廷/巴西/巴拉圭/乌拉圭共享)。核心治理模式：水资源联邦主义 — 巴拉圭/巴西双边条约/实体双边/收益分成/技术转让/环境补偿/瓜拉尼含水层跨国管理体系(2010 协议/四国委员会/监测/保护/可持续利用)。体现 M175 水资源联邦主义 — 以"双边水电共治+收益分成机制+含水层跨国管理+能源主权"四位一体，在跨国河流/共享含水层/不对称实力四重约束中实现水资源联邦治理。
PY-HYD-001.description_en: Itaipu Hydroelectric (Itaipu Dam) Paraguay/Brazil joint/1984 operational/14000MW/world #2/Paraguay 90%+ electricity from hydro/exports to Brazil/Guaraní Aquifer (South America 2nd largest/Argentina/Brazil/Paraguay/Uruguay shared). Core governance model: water federalism — Paraguay-Brazil bilateral treaty/binational entity/revenue sharing/tech transfer/environmental compensation/Guaraní Aquifer transnational management system (2010 agreement/four-nation commission/monitoring/protection/sustainable use). Exemplifies M175 Water Federalism — quaternity of 'binational hydro co-governance + revenue sharing mechanism + aquifer transnational management + energy sovereignty' achieving water federal governance amid quadruple constraints of transboundary rivers/shared aquifer/asymmetric power.
PY-HYD-001.reason_zh: 伊泰普非单纯大坝，而是"双边实体+收益分成+含水层共治"三位一体水联邦样本。巴拉圭以主权小国地位谈判获 50% 电力/出口收益/技术转让，瓜拉尼含水层四国共治先例。M175 区隔于 M152 安第斯互惠(垂直)、M168 资源诅咒(石油)、M175 水联邦主义(核心)，核心在于"双边实体即治理载体+收益分成即主权实现+含水层共治即区域公共品"的跨国水治理范式。
PY-HYD-001.reason_en: Itaipu not mere dam but 'binational entity + revenue sharing + aquifer co-governance' trinity water federalism sample. Paraguay as small sovereign negotiated 50% power/export revenue/tech transfer, Guaraní Aquifer four-nation co-governance precedent. M175 distinct from M152 Andean Reciprocity (vertical), M168 Resource Curse (oil), M175 Water Federalism (core), core: 'binational entity as governance vehicle + revenue sharing as sovereignty realization + aquifer co-governance as regional public good' transnational water governance paradigm.

Exemplifies M176 Sami Consultation variant/Nomadic Consultation — quaternity of 'kurultai consultation + Manas spirit anchor + nomadic ecological law + mountain corridor diplomacy' guarding nomadic civilizational subjectivity amid five-fold transformations of nomadic/settled/Soviet/post-Soviet/great power games.

Epic as constitution/history/law/ethics/ecology encyclopedia, kurultai as parliament/court/military mobilization/diplomatic congress, nomadic migration as ecological adaptation/resource management/border confirmation. KH-ANG-001.name_zh: 柬埔寨·阇耶跋摩七世：吴哥佛教与医院水利基建
KH-ANG-001.name_en: Cambodia Jayavarman VII: Angkor Buddhism & Hospital Water Infrastructure
KH-ANG-001.description_zh: 阇耶跋摩七世 (1122-1218) 吴哥大帝，大乘佛教悲心建立102座医院、121座驿站、西/东巴雷水利系统，湾仔寺微笑面相成佛教艺术巅峰，构建前工业时代福利国家雏形。
KH-ANG-001.description_en: Jayavarman VII (1122-1218) Angkor Great King, Mahayana Buddhist compassion built 102 hospitals, 121 rest houses, West/East Baray water systems, Bayon Temple smiling faces Buddhist art peak, constructed pre-industrial welfare state prototype.
KH-ANG-001.reason_zh: 阇耶跋摩七世代表古代君主如何将宗教悲心转化为公共福利制度，展示了水利基建与医疗网络如何支撑帝国人口繁荣，其湾仔寺微笑成为柬埔寨永恒精神象征。
KH-ANG-001.reason_en: Jayavarman VII represents ancient monarch transforming religious compassion into public welfare system, demonstrating how water infrastructure and medical network sustain imperial population prosperity, his Bayon smiling faces becoming Cambodia eternal spiritual symbol.

LA-SOC-001.name_zh: 凯山·丰威汉/老挝革命：社会主义建设与内陆枢纽转型
LA-SOC-001.name_en: Kaysone Phomvihane/Lao Revolution: Socialist Construction & Landlocked Hub Transformation
LA-SOC-001.description_zh: 老挝凯山·丰威汉 (1920-1992) 老挝革命领袖/1975 建国/新经济机制(1986)/市场化/一带一路/中老铁路/万象-万荣高铁/特区/水电出口/咖啡/木材/矿产。核心模式：内陆枢纽转型 — 无海港/土地丰富/邻国包围/中老铁路/湄公河/水电/特区/农业/旅游/从陆锁国变陆联国。体现 M198 内陆枢纽转型 — 以"革命合法性+新经济机制+中老铁路枢纽+湄公河水电"四位一体，在内陆劣势/战争遗毒/贫困/大国博弈中实现陆联国跃升。
LA-SOC-001.description_en: Laos Kaysone Phomvihane (1920-1992) revolutionary leader/1975 founding/New Economic Mechanism (1986)/marketization/BRI/China-Laos Railway/Vientiane-Vang Vieng high speed rail/SEZs/hydro exports/coffee/timber/minerals. Core model: landlocked hub transformation — no ports/land abundant/neighbors encircle/China-Laos Railway/Mekong/hydro/SEZs/agriculture/tourism/from landlocked to land-linked. Exemplifies M198 Landlocked Hub Transformation — quaternity of 'revolutionary legitimacy + new economic mechanism + China-Laos Railway hub + Mekong hydro' achieving land-linked leap amid landlocked disadvantage/war legacy/poverty/great power games.
LA-SOC-001.reason_zh: 老挝非单纯内陆国，而是"革命合法性+新经济机制+铁路枢纽"三位一体转型国家。以革命战争建立合法性，以新经济机制引入市场，以中老铁路打破陆锁。M198 区隔于 M175 水联邦(伊泰普)、M168 资源诅咒(委内瑞拉)、M192 游击解放(莫桑比克)，核心在于"革命即建国+机制即转型+铁路即枢纽"的内陆国家跃升范式。
LA-SOC-001.reason_en: Laos not mere landlocked state but 'revolutionary legitimacy + new economic mechanism + railway hub' trinity transformation state. Revolutionary war built legitimacy, NEM introduced markets, China-Laos Railway broke landlocked status. M198 distinct from M175 Water Federalism (Itaipu), M168 Resource Curse (Venezuela), M192 Guerrilla Liberation (Mozambique), core: 'revolution as founding + mechanism as transformation + railway as hub' landlocked nation leap paradigm.

Exemplifies M199 Malay Islamic Monarchy — quaternity of 'oil rent welfare + Sharia rule of law + monarchical legitimacy + sovereign wealth intergenerational' achieving high-welfare stable rule amid micro-state/resource dependence/regional great power squeeze.

Oil rent funds universal welfare/tax-free/high income, MIB provides cultural/religious/political legitimacy, SWF enables intergenerational transfer. PH-PEP-001.name_zh: 黎刹/马科斯/阿基诺/菲律宾人民力量：人民力量革命与精英民主

PH-PEP-001.description_zh: 菲律宾何塞·黎刹 (1861-1896) 民族英雄/小说唤醒/马科斯 (1917-1989) 1972-1986 戒严/掠夺/阿基诺遇刺/1986 人民力量/科拉松·阿基诺/1991 美军撤离/杜特尔特 2016-2022 毒品战争/小马科斯 2022- 复位。核心模式：人民力量革命 — 非暴力群众/教会/军队倒戈/媒体/中产/精英家族轮替/政治王朝/贫富悬殊/海外劳工。体现 M201 人民力量革命 — 以"非暴力群众+教会中立+军队倒戈+精英家族轮替"四位一体，在殖民/独裁/民主/精英轮替四重历史循环中构建菲式民主。

Exemplifies M201 People Power Revolution — quaternity of 'non-violent masses + church neutrality + military defection + elite family rotation' constructing Filipino democracy amid four historical cycles of colonial/dictatorship/democracy/elite rotation.
PH-PEP-001.reason_zh: 菲律宾非单纯民主国家，而是"人民力量+精英家族+海外劳工"三位一体民主循环体。黎刹以小说唤醒，人民力量以非暴力推翻独裁，精英家族轮替维持民主形式，海外劳工支撑经济。M201 区隔于 M196 佛教民族主义(缅甸)、M197 吴哥水利(柬埔寨)、M200 Pancasila(印尼)，核心在于"非暴力群众即民主合法性+精英家族即权力载体+海外劳工即经济支柱"的菲律宾民主范式。

Rizal awakened via novels, People Power toppled dictatorship non-violently, elite families rotate power, OFWs sustain economy. M201 distinct from M196 Buddhist Nationalism (Myanmar), M197 Angkor Hydraulic (Cambodia), M200 Pancasila (Indonesia), core: 'non-violent masses as democratic legitimacy + elite families as power vehicle + OFWs as economic pillar' Philippine democracy paradigm.

TL-RES-001.name_zh: 沙纳纳·古斯芒/东帝汶建国：抵抗建国与石油正义
TL-RES-001.name_en: Xanana Gusmao/Timor-Leste Founding: Resistance Nation-Building & Oil Justice
TL-RES-001.description_zh: 东帝汶沙纳纳·古斯芒 (1946-) 抵抗领袖/总统/总理/1975 独立/印尼占领 24 年/1999 公投/2002 恢复独立/帝汶海石油/马鲁克/大阳/澳大利亚谈判/海洋边界条约/石油收益透明/多元化。核心建国逻辑：抵抗合法性/国际法/石油正义/海洋边界/民主巩固/青年/教育/农业/旅游。体现 M202 抵抗建国与石油正义 — 以"游击抵抗合法性+国际法海洋边界+石油收益透明+民主多元化"四位一体，在殖民/占领/独立/资源博弈四重历史中构建最年轻东南亚主权国家。
TL-RES-001.description_en: Timor-Leste Xanana Gusmao (1946-) resistance leader/president/PM/1975 independence/Indonesian occupation 24 yrs/1999 referendum/2002 restored independence/Timor Sea oil/Greater Sunrise/Australia negotiations/maritime boundary treaty/oil revenue transparency/diversification. Core nation-building logic: resistance legitimacy/international law/oil justice/maritime boundaries/democratic consolidation/youth/education/agriculture/tourism. Exemplifies M202 Resistance Nation-Building & Oil Justice — quaternity of 'guerrilla resistance legitimacy + international law maritime boundaries + oil revenue transparency + democratic diversification' building youngest Southeast Asian sovereign state amid quadruple history of colonial/occupation/independence/resource games.
TL-RES-001.reason_zh: 东帝汶非单纯后殖民国家，而是"游击抵抗+国际法+石油正义"三位一体建国样本。以游击战建立道德合法性，以国际法院/仲裁确立海洋边界，以石油透明避免资源诅咒。M202 区隔于 M192 游击解放(莫桑比克)、M196 佛教民族主义(缅甸)、M201 人民力量(菲律宾)，核心在于"抵抗即建国合法性+国际法即资源正义+透明即反诅咒"的最年轻主权国家范式。
TL-RES-001.reason_en: Timor-Leste not mere post-colonial state but 'guerrilla resistance + international law + oil justice' trinity nation-building sample. Guerrilla war built moral legitimacy, ICJ/arbitration established maritime boundaries, oil transparency avoided resource curse. M202 distinct from M192 Guerrilla Liberation (Mozambique), M196 Buddhist Nationalism (Myanmar), M201 People Power (Philippines), core: 'resistance as nation-building legitimacy + international law as resource justice + transparency as anti-curse' youngest sovereign state paradigm.
steps_zh: 游击抵抗建立合法性：1975 FRETILIN 宣布独立/印尼入侵/法林蒂尔游击队/古斯芒指挥/1992 被捕/国际声援/诺贝尔和平奖 1996
国际法确立海洋边界：1999 公投/2002 独立/2006 塔西马尔/2018 海洋边界条约/澳大利亚/大阳/马鲁克/永久法院/仲裁/主权延伸
石油收益透明反诅咒：石油基金/透明度/人类发展/教育/医疗/基建/青年/农业/旅游/避免荷兰病/依赖度下降
民主巩固与多元化：半总统制/多党/权力轮替/古斯芒/奥尔塔/阿劳霍/拉莫斯/青年/女性/分权/地方选举/公民社会
区域融合与东盟成员：东盟观察员/申请入盟/印尼/马来/新加坡/澳/新/中/日/韩/外交/贸易/劳务/安全/最年轻成员
steps_en: Guerrilla resistance builds legitimacy: 1975 FRETILIN declares independence/Indonesian invasion/FALINTIL guerrilla/Gusmao commands/1992 captured/international support/Nobel Peace 1996
International law establishes maritime boundaries: 1999 referendum/2002 independence/2006 CMATS/2018 maritime boundary treaty/Australia/Greater Sunrise/PCA/arbitration/sovereignty extended
Oil revenue transparency anti-curse: Petroleum Fund/transparency/human development/education/healthcare/infra/youth/agriculture/tourism/avoid Dutch disease/dependency declining
Democratic consolidation & diversification: semi-presidential/multi-party/power rotation/Gusmao/Horta/Alkatiri/Ramos-Horta/youth/women/decentralization/local elections/civil society
Regional integration & ASEAN membership: ASEAN observer/applicant/Indonesia/Malaysia/Singapore/Aus/NZ/China/Japan/Korea/diplomacy/trade/labor/security/youngest member
TL-RES-001.expected_zh: 以"游击抵抗+国际法+石油透明+民主多元"四位一体，在殖民/占领/独立/资源博弈四重历史中构建最年轻东南亚主权国家，为后冲突资源正义提供范式。
TL-RES-001.expected_en: Quaternity of 'guerrilla resistance + international law + oil transparency + democratic diversification' builds youngest Southeast Asian sovereign state amid quadruple history of colonial/occupation/independence/resource games, providing paradigm for post-conflict resource justice.
TL-RES-001.case_zh: 1975 独立/1975-99 占领/1999 公投/2002 恢复独立/2018 海洋边界/石油基金/民主轮替/东盟申请/最年轻主权国家，抵抗建国正义永存。
TL-RES-001.case_en: 1975 independence/1975-99 occupation/1999 referendum/2002 restored independence/2018 maritime boundary/Petroleum Fund/democratic rotation/ASEAN application/youngest sovereign state, resistance nation-building justice endures.
TL-RES-001.intellectual_tradition: Timorese Resistance Nation-Building / Oil Justice / Maritime Law
TL-RES-001.cross_cultural_impact: Resistance nation-building model; maritime boundary arbitration; oil transparency; youngest sovereign state
