TL-RES-001.oral_tradition: Tetum oral epics; community authorization: Timor-Leste Government 2023

PG-DIV-001.name_zh: 巴布亚新几内亚/部落多元/资源：万部落共识与资源联邦制
PG-DIV-001.name_en: Papua New Guinea/Tribal Diversity/Resources: Myriad Tribes Consensus & Resource Federalism
PG-DIV-001.description_zh: 巴布亚新几内亚 800+ 语言/1000+ 部落/2000+ 派系/1975 独立/万图克/索马雷/奥尼尔/马拉佩/资源(黄金/铜/天然气/林业/渔业/棕榈油)/布干维尔内战(1988-98)/2019 公投/部落共识(沃恩托克/大人物/补偿/和解)/资源地主制/土地传统所有制。体现 M203 万部落共识 — 以"部落共识+大人物调解+资源地主+传统土地法"四位一体，在极度碎片化/资源诅咒/内战/国家建设四重挑战中构建部落联邦国家。
PG-DIV-001.description_en: Papua New Guinea 800+ languages/1000+ tribes/2000+ factions/1975 independence/Wantok/Somare/O'Neill/Marape/resources(gold/copper/gas/forestry/fisheries/palm oil)/Bougainville civil war (1988-98)/2019 referendum/tribal consensus(wantok/big man/compensation/reconciliation)/resource landowner system/customary land tenure. Exemplifies M203 Myriad Tribes Consensus — quaternity of 'tribal consensus + big man mediation + resource landowner + customary land law' building tribal federal nation amid quadruple challenges of extreme fragmentation/resource curse/civil war/state-building.
PG-DIV-001.reason_zh: 巴新非单纯资源国家，而是"万部落+万语言+大人物"三位一体部落联邦。800+ 语言世界最多，部落共识决策/大人物调解/补偿替代监狱，资源项目需地主同意。M203 区隔于 M187 酋长制(加纳)、M198 内陆枢纽(老挝)、M168 资源诅咒(委内瑞拉)，核心在于"部落即政治单位+大人物即调解算法+补偿即司法"的美拉尼西亚部落联邦范式。
PG-DIV-001.reason_en: PNG not mere resource state but 'myriad tribes + myriad languages + big man' trinity tribal federalism. 800+ languages world's most, tribal consensus decision/big man mediation/compensation replaces prison, resource projects need landowner consent. M203 distinct from M187 Chiefship (Ghana), M198 Landlocked Hub (Laos), M168 Resource Curse (Venezuela), core: 'tribe as political unit + big man as mediation algorithm + compensation as justice' Melanesian tribal federal paradigm.
steps_zh: 万部落共识决策机制：部落/氏族/语言群/沃恩托克网络/共识/长者/大人物/补偿/和解/零监狱/恢复性司法
大人物调解算法：大人物/财富再分配/声望/调解/婚姻/战争/和平/补偿/猪/贝壳/现代货币/政治权力
资源地主制与土地法：传统土地 97%/地主公司/版税/股权/利益分享/自由事先知情同意/FPIC/矿山/油气/林业/棕榈油
布干维尔自决与和解：1988-98 内战/2万+ 死亡/2001 和平/2019 公投/97.7% 独立/自治/和解/资源/国家建设
国家建设与碎片化治理：议会/联盟/不稳定/不信任/大人物政治/腐败/基建/教育/卫生/部落联邦制探索
steps_en: Myriad tribes consensus mechanism: tribes/clans/language groups/wantok networks/consensus/elders/big men/compensation/reconciliation/zero prison/restorative justice
Big man mediation algorithm: big man/wealth redistribution/prestige/mediation/marriage/war/peace/compensation/pigs/shells/modern currency/political power
Resource landowner system & land law: customary land 97%/landowner companies/royalties/equity/benefit sharing/FPIC/mines/oil gas/forestry/palm oil
Bougainville self-determination & reconciliation: 1988-98 civil war/20k+ deaths/2001 peace/2019 referendum/97.7% independence/autonomy/reconciliation/resources/state-building
State-building & fragmentation governance: parliament/coalitions/instability/votes of no confidence/big man politics/corruption/infra/education/health/tribal federalism exploration
PG-DIV-001.expected_zh: 以"部落共识+大人物调解+资源地主+传统土地法"四位一体，在极度碎片化/资源诅咒/内战/国家建设四重挑战中构建部落联邦国家，为美拉尼西亚部落社会提供治理范式。
PG-DIV-001.expected_en: Quaternity of 'tribal consensus + big man mediation + resource landowner + customary land law' builds tribal federal nation amid quadruple challenges of extreme fragmentation/resource curse/civil war/state-building, providing governance paradigm for Melanesian tribal societies.
PG-DIV-001.case_zh: 1975 独立/1988-98 布干维尔/2019 公投/800+ 语言/大人物政治/资源地主/沃恩托克网络/部落联邦制探索，碎片化中构建国家。
PG-DIV-001.case_en: 1975 independence/1988-98 Bougainville/2019 referendum/800+ languages/big man politics/resource landowners/wantok networks/tribal federalism exploration, building nation in fragmentation.
PG-DIV-001.intellectual_tradition: PNG Tribal Federalism / Wantok Consensus / Big Man Mediation
PG-DIV-001.cross_cultural_impact: Tribal federalism model; wantok consensus; big man mediation; resource landowner rights; customary land tenure
PG-DIV-001.diaspora_influence: PNG diaspora (AU/US/NZ); seasonal workers; resource expertise
PG-DIV-001.indigenous_knowledge_system: Wantok system; compensation justice; traditional ecology; bilum weaving; sing-sing
PG-DIV-001.oral_tradition: 800+ oral traditions; community authorization: PNG National Cultural Commission 2023

FJ-CLI-001.name_zh: 斐济/气候/小岛屿国家：气候生存外交与蓝色经济
FJ-CLI-001.name_en: Fiji/Climate/Small Island State: Climate Survival Diplomacy & Blue Economy
FJ-CLI-001.description_zh: 斐济 330+ 岛屿/维提岛/瓦努阿岛/巴马拉马/1987/2000/2006 三次政变/姆拜尼马拉马 (1954-) 2006 政变/2014 选举/气候变化/海平面上升/珊瑚白化/气候难民/蓝色经济/海洋治理/太平洋岛国论坛/博拉/格拉斯哥/联合国气候谈判领袖。体现 M204 气候生存外交 — 以"海平面即生存红线+蓝色经济+气候正义+太平洋团结"四位一体，在沉岛威胁/政变循环/大国博弈/资源有限四重约束中构建小岛屿国家生存主权。
FJ-CLI-001.description_en: Fiji 330+ islands/Viti Levu/Vanua Levu/Bainimarama (1954-) 2006 coup/2014 election/climate change/sea level rise/coral bleaching/climate refugees/blue economy/ocean governance/Pacific Islands Forum/COP26/Glasgow/UN climate negotiations leader. Exemplifies M204 Climate Survival Diplomacy — quaternity of 'sea level as survival redline + blue economy + climate justice + Pacific solidarity' building small island state survival sovereignty amid quadruple constraints of sinking threat/coup cycles/great power games/limited resources.
FJ-CLI-001.reason_zh: 斐济非单纯岛国，而是"海平面红线+蓝色经济+气候正义"三位一体生存主体。海平面上升威胁领土生存，蓝色经济(渔业/旅游/海底矿产/碳汇)创造替代生计，气候正义在国际谈判争取资金/技术/损失损害基金。M204 区隔于 M178 极地气候(极地)、M188 山地生态(乞力马扎罗)、M203 万部落(巴新)，核心在于"海平面即主权红线+蓝色经济即生存替代+气候正义即外交武器"的小岛屿国家生存范式。
FJ-CLI-001.reason_en: Fiji not mere island state but 'sea level redline + blue economy + climate justice' trinity survival subject. Sea level rise threatens territorial survival, blue economy (fisheries/tourism/seabed minerals/carbon sinks) creates alternative livelihoods, climate justice fights for finance/technology/loss & damage fund in international negotiations. M204 distinct from M178 Polar Climate (polar), M188 Mountain Ecology (Kilimanjaro), M203 Myriad Tribes (PNG), core: 'sea level as sovereignty redline + blue economy as survival alternative + climate justice as diplomatic weapon' small island state survival paradigm.
steps_zh: 海平面上升生存红线：1993-2023 海平面上升 6cm+/沿海村庄搬迁/淡水透咸/农业/基建/文化遗产/主权连续性/国际法/沉岛国家地位
蓝色经济与海洋治理：专属经济区 130 万平方公里/金枪鱼/旅游/深海矿产/珊瑚养殖/蓝色碳汇/海洋空间规划/可持续渔业/海洋保护区
气候正义外交领袖：博拉/巴黎/格拉斯哥/沙姆沙伊赫/损失损害基金/适应基金/绿色气候基金/技术转让/能力建设/太平洋岛国论坛主席
政变循环与民主修复：1987/2000/2006 三次政变/印裔/斐济裔/土地/宪法/2013 宪法/2014/2018/2022 大选/民主巩固/制度化
区域团结与大国平衡：太平洋岛国论坛/中国/美国/澳大利亚/新西兰/日本/韩国/法国/一带一路/蓝色太平洋/四面周旋
steps_en: Sea level rise survival redline: 1993-2023 sea level rise 6cm+/coastal villages relocated/freshwater salinization/agriculture/infra/cultural heritage/sovereignty continuity/international law/sinking nation status
Blue economy & ocean governance: EEZ 1.3M km2/tuna/tourism/deep sea minerals/coral farming/blue carbon/ocean spatial planning/sustainable fisheries/MPAs
Climate justice diplomatic leadership: Bonn/Paris/Glasgow/Sharm el-Sheikh/loss & damage fund/adaptation fund/GCF/tech transfer/capacity building/PIF chair
Coup cycles & democratic repair: 1987/2000/2006 three coups/Indo-Fijian/iTaukei/land/constitution/2013 Constitution/2014/2018/2022 elections/democratic consolidation/institutionalization
Regional solidarity & great power balance: PIF/China/US/Australia/NZ/Japan/Korea/France/BRI/Blue Pacific/four-way maneuvering
FJ-CLI-001.expected_zh: 以"海平面红线+蓝色经济+气候正义+太平洋团结"四位一体，在沉岛威胁/政变循环/大国博弈/资源有限四重约束中构建小岛屿国家生存主权，为沉岛国家提供生存外交范式。
FJ-CLI-001.expected_en: Quaternity of 'sea level redline + blue economy + climate justice + Pacific solidarity' builds small island state survival sovereignty amid quadruple constraints of sinking threat/coup cycles/great power games/limited resources, providing survival diplomacy paradigm for sinking nations.
FJ-CLI-001.case_zh: 1987/2000/2006 政变/2014 选举/2021 周期/海平面/珊瑚/蓝色经济/气候谈判/太平洋论坛/大国平衡，小岛屿生存外交进行时。
FJ-CLI-001.case_en: 1987/2000/2006 coups/2014 election/2021 cycle/sea level/coral/blue economy/climate talks/PIF/great power balance, small island survival diplomacy ongoing.
FJ-CLI-001.intellectual_tradition: Fijian Climate Diplomacy / Blue Economy / Pacific Island Survival

WS-FAM-001.name_zh: 萨摩亚/法阿马泰/族群治理：法阿马泰共识与族群经济
WS-FAM-001.name_en: Samoa/Fa'amatai/Clan Governance: Fa'amatai Consensus & Clan Economy
WS-FAM-001.description_zh: 萨摩亚法阿马泰 — 族长制/马泰头衔/家族土地/村议会(福诺)/共识决策/互惠(法阿洛阿洛阿)/1962 独立/人权/性别/气候/移民/汇款/塔拉纳基/阿皮亚。核心治理模式：法阿马泰共识 — 马泰/福诺/家族/土地/教会/共识/互惠/服务/领导力即服务。体现 M205 法阿马泰共识 — 以"马泰头衔+福诺共识+家族土地+互惠服务"四位一体，在族群/教会/移民/气候四重现代压力下守护波利尼西亚族群治理。
WS-FAM-001.description_en: Samoa Fa'amatai — matai titles/clan lands/village council (fono)/consensus decision/reciprocity (fa'aloalo)/1962 independence/human rights/gender/climate/migration/remittances/Taranaki/Apia. Core governance model: Fa'amatai consensus — matai/fono/clan/land/church/consensus/reciprocity/service/leadership as service. Exemplifies M205 Fa'amatai Consensus — quaternity of 'matai titles + fono consensus + clan lands + reciprocal service' guarding Polynesian clan governance amid quadruple modern pressures of clan/church/migration/climate.
WS-FAM-001.reason_zh: 萨摩亚非单纯岛国，而是"马泰+福诺+家族土地"三位一体族群治理体。马泰头衔即领导力/服务/责任，福诺共识超越多数决，家族土地不可买卖/代际托管。M205 区隔于 M187 酋长制(加纳)、M203 万部落(巴新)、M204 气候生存(斐济)，核心在于"马泰即服务+福诺即共识+土地即托管"的波利尼西亚族群治理范式。
WS-FAM-001.reason_en: Samoa not mere island state but 'matai + fono + clan lands' trinity clan governance body. Matai title as leadership/service/responsibility, fono consensus transcends majority vote, clan lands inalienable/intergenerational trusteeship. M205 distinct from M187 Chiefship (Ghana), M203 Myriad Tribes (PNG), M204 Climate Survival (Fiji), core: 'matai as service + fono as consensus + lands as trusteeship' Polynesian clan governance paradigm.
steps_zh: 马泰头衔即服务领导力：马泰/选举/服务/责任/福诺/家族/村庄/区域/国家/头衔不可买卖/服务即权威
福诺共识决策机制：村福诺/区福诺/国家福诺/长者/马泰/妇女/青年/共识/讨论/决定/服从/零投票
家族土地代际托管：习惯土地 80%+/家族/马泰/托管/不可买卖/租赁/开发/代际/生态/文化/主权
互惠服务与法阿洛阿洛阿：尊重/服务/礼物/宴会/葬礼/婚姻/建房/农业/互惠网络/社会保障/零国家福利
移民汇款与气候适应：10 万+ 侨民/汇款 30%+ GDP/新西兰/澳洲/美国/季节工/气候/海平面/村庄搬迁/适应基金
steps_en: Matai title as service leadership: matai/election/service/responsibility/fono/clan/village/district/national/titles inalienable/service = authority
Fono consensus mechanism: village fono/district fono/national fono/elders/matai/women/youth/consensus/deliberation/decision/compliance/zero voting
Clan lands intergenerational trusteeship: customary land 80%+/clan/matai/trusteeship/inalienable/lease/development/intergenerational/ecological/cultural/sovereign
Reciprocal service & fa'aloalo: respect/service/gifts/feasts/funerals/marriages/house-building/agriculture/reciprocal networks/social security/zero state welfare
Migration remittances & climate adaptation: 100k+ diaspora/remittances 30%+ GDP/NZ/AUS/US/seasonal workers/climate/sea level/village relocation/adaptation funds

Core model: Polynesian Constitutional Monarchy — monarch/nobles/commoners/land/church/constitution/reform/tradition/modernity balance. Exemplifies M206 Polynesian Constitutional Monarchy — quaternity of 'monarchical legitimacy + noble checks + land trusteeship + diaspora economy' achieving Polynesia's only monarchy modernization amid quadruple tensions of monarchy/democracy/clan/climate.
TO-POL-001.reason_zh: 汤加非单纯君主制，而是"君主+贵族+土地托管"三位一体波利尼西亚特色政体。1875 宪法确立君主/贵族/平民三权分立，土地不可买卖由贵族托管，侨民汇款支撑经济。M206 区隔于 M205 法阿马泰(萨摩亚)、M187 酋长制(加纳)、M204 气候生存(斐济)，核心在于"君主制即传统合法性+贵族即制衡机制+土地托管即主权保障"的波利尼西亚君主立宪范式。
TO-POL-001.reason_en: Tonga not mere monarchy but 'monarch + nobles + land trusteeship' trinity Polynesian characteristic polity. 1875 Constitution established monarch/nobles/commoners separation of powers, land inalienable held by nobles in trust, diaspora remittances sustain economy. M206 distinct from M205 Fa'amatai (Samoa), M187 Chiefship (Ghana), M204 Climate Survival (Fiji), core: 'monarchy as traditional legitimacy + nobles as check mechanism + land trusteeship as sovereignty guarantee' Polynesian constitutional monarchy paradigm.

Core model: kastom customary law fusion — custom/chiefs/land/parliament/constitution/courts/dual-track/malvatumauri (chiefs council) political/nimanku (peace/reconciliation/compensation) judicial. Exemplifies M207 Kastom Customary Law Fusion — quaternity of 'custom as constitution + chiefs as political actors + land as sovereignty + nimanku as justice' fusing traditional & modern governance amid quadruple challenges of linguistic fragmentation/political instability/climate disasters/limited resources.
VU-KAS-001.reason_zh: 瓦努阿图非单纯岛国，而是"卡斯特姆+酋长+土地+尼姆安库"四位一体双轨治理。100+ 语言世界密度最高，卡斯特姆习法涵盖土地/婚姻/继承/纠纷/资源，酋长会议参政，尼姆安库以补偿替代惩罚。M207 区隔于 M203 万部落(巴新)、M205 法阿马泰(萨摩亚)、M187 酋长制(加纳)，核心在于"习法即平行法律体系+酋长即宪法机构+尼姆安库即恢复性司法"的美拉尼西亚双轨治理范式。

M207 distinct from M203 Myriad Tribes (PNG), M205 Fa'amatai (Samoa), M187 Chiefship (Ghana), core: 'custom as parallel legal system + chiefs as constitutional bodies + nimanku as restorative justice' Melanesian dual-track governance paradigm.

GL-IND-001.description_en: Greenland 1979 home rule/2009 Self-Government Act/Inuit-led/Kuannersuit/oil/rare earths/uranium/fisheries/tourism/Danish subsidies/climate/ice melt/Arctic routes/Arctic Council/Inuit Circumpolar Council. Core model: polar autonomy federalism — Inuit autonomy/Danish federation/resource revenue sharing/climate adaptation/indigenous rights/Arctic geopolitics. Exemplifies M208 Polar Autonomy Federalism — quaternity of 'Inuit autonomy + Danish federation + resource federalism + climate outpost' building polar autonomy paradigm amid quadruple constraints of ice melt/resource scramble/great power games/indigenous rights.
GL-IND-001.reason_zh: 格陵兰非单纯自治领，而是"因纽特自治+丹麦联邦+资源联邦"三位一体极地实验。因纽特人通过自治法夺回资源/立法/司法/警察权，丹麦保留外交/国防/货币，资源收益分成支撑福利。M208 区隔于 M170 联邦制(加拿大)、M176 萨米协商(北欧)、M195 永久中立(土库曼)，核心在于"原住民自治+宗主国联邦+资源联邦+气候前哨"的极地自治新范式。
GL-IND-001.reason_en: Greenland not mere autonomous territory but 'Inuit autonomy + Danish federation + resource federalism' trinity polar experiment. Inuit reclaimed resource/legislative/judicial/police powers via Self-Government Act, Denmark retains foreign/defense/currency, resource revenue sharing funds welfare. M208 distinct from M170 Federalism (Canada), M176 Sami Consultation (Nordic), M195 Permanent Neutrality (Turkmenistan), core: 'indigenous autonomy + metropolitan federation + resource federalism + climate outpost' new polar autonomy paradigm.

GL-CLI-001.name_en: Greenland Ice Sheet/Climate Science: Polar Climate Resilience & Ice Core Memory
GL-CLI-001.description_zh: 格陵兰冰盖 170 万平方公里/冰芯钻探(NGRIP/NEEM/EGRIP/东格陵兰)/10 万年气候记录/青年德里亚斯/末次冰期/全新世/海平面上升/IPCC 关键数据/融化加速/2012/2019 极端融化/格陵兰气候研究中心/哥本哈根大学/阿尔弗雷德·韦格纳研究所。核心模式：极地气候韧性 — 冰芯记忆/融化监测/海平面预测/适应工程/北极放大效应/全球气候正义。体现 M178 极地气候韧性 — 以"冰芯记忆+融化监测+海平面预测+适应工程"四位一体，在不可逆融化/全球海平面/北极放大/气候正义四重挑战中构建极地气候治理范式。

Core model: polar climate resilience — ice core memory/melt monitoring/sea level prediction/adaptation engineering/Arctic amplification/global climate justice. Exemplifies M178 Polar Climate Resilience — quaternity of 'ice core memory + melt monitoring + sea level prediction + adaptation engineering' building polar climate governance paradigm amid quadruple challenges of irreversible melt/global sea level/Arctic amplification/climate justice.
GL-CLI-001.reason_zh: 格陵兰冰盖非单纯冰川，而是"冰芯记忆+融化监测+海平面命脉"三位一体全球气候调节器。冰芯编码 10 万年气候历史，融化直接威胁全球沿海城市，北极放大效应加速全球变暖。M178 区隔于 M188 山地生态(乞力马扎罗)、M204 气候生存(斐济)、M208 极地自治(格陵兰自治)，核心在于"冰芯即气候档案+融化即海平面命脉+北极放大即全球加速器"的极地气候治理范式。
GL-CLI-001.reason_en: Greenland Ice Sheet not mere glacier but 'ice core memory + melt monitoring + sea level lifeline' trinity global climate regulator. Ice cores encode 100k year climate history, melt directly threatens global coastal cities, Arctic amplification accelerates global warming. M178 distinct from M188 Mountain Ecology (Kilimanjaro), M204 Climate Survival (Fiji), M208 Polar Autonomy (Greenland autonomy), core: 'ice cores as climate archive + melt as sea level lifeline + Arctic amplification as global accelerator' polar climate governance paradigm.

HT-REV-001.name_zh: 杜桑·卢维杜尔/海地革命：黑人革命与第一黑人共和国
HT-REV-001.name_en: Toussaint Louverture/Haitian Revolution: Black Revolution & First Black Republic
HT-REV-001.description_zh: 海地杜桑·卢维杜尔 (1743-1803) 奴隶起义领袖/1791 起义/1794 废除奴隶制/1801 宪法/1802 拿破仑远征/1803 卢维杜尔狱中逝世/1804 让-雅克·德萨林宣布独立/第一黑人共和国/赔偿法国/长期孤立/杜瓦利埃/阿里斯蒂德/2010 地震/帮派暴力。核心革命逻辑：奴隶起义/废奴/黑人主权/赔偿债务/外交孤立/内部精英/外部干预/国家建构。体现 M209 黑人革命建国 — 以"奴隶起义即建国+废奴即宪法+赔偿即原罪+孤立即生存"四位一体，在种植园经济/拿破仑远征/赔偿债务/长期孤立四重历史重压下构建第一黑人主权国家。
HT-REV-001.description_en: Haiti Toussaint Louverture (1743-1803) slave revolt leader/1791 uprising/1794 abolition/1801 Constitution/1802 Napoleonic expedition/1803 Louverture dies in prison/1804 Jean-Jacques Dessalines declares independence/first Black republic/reparations to France/long isolation/Duvalier/Aristide/2010 earthquake/gang violence. Core revolutionary logic: slave uprising/abolition/Black sovereignty/reparations debt/diplomatic isolation/internal elites/external intervention/state-building. Exemplifies M209 Black Revolution Nation-Building — quaternity of 'slave uprising as founding + abolition as constitution + reparations as original sin + isolation as survival' building first Black sovereign nation amid quadruple historical weight of plantation economy/Napoleonic expedition/reparations debt/long isolation.
HT-REV-001.reason_zh: 海地革命非单纯独立战争，而是"奴隶起义+废奴+黑人主权"三位一体世界史转折。1791 奴隶起义震撼大西洋世界，1804 首个黑人共和国打破白人至上神话，赔偿法国 1.5 亿法郎(现值 200 亿+) 成发展原罪。M209 区隔于 M196 佛教民族主义(缅甸)、M201 人民力量(菲律宾)、M202 抵抗建国(东帝汶)，核心在于"奴隶即建国主体+废奴即世界史转折+赔偿即发展原罪"的黑人革命建国范式。
HT-REV-001.reason_en: Haitian Revolution not mere independence war but 'slave uprising + abolition + Black sovereignty' trinity world-historical turning point. 1791 slave uprising shook Atlantic world, 1804 first Black republic shattered white supremacy myth, reparations to France 150M francs (today $20B+) became development original sin. M209 distinct from M196 Buddhist Nationalism (Myanmar), M201 People Power (Philippines), M202 Resistance Nation-Building (Timor-Leste), core: 'slaves as founding subjects + abolition as world-historical turn + reparations as development original sin' Black revolution nation-building paradigm.
steps_zh: 奴隶起义即建国合法性：1791 布瓦凯曼仪式/起义/杜桑/让-雅克/比亚索/图桑军事/政治天才/废奴/自治/宪法
废奴即世界史宪法转折：1794 法国废奴/1802 拿破仑恢复/1801 宪法/杜桑终身总督/黑人/混血/白人三色旗/公民平等
赔偿债务即发展原罪：1825 法国承认/1.5 亿法郎/高利贷/1947 还清/200 亿+ 现值/阿里斯蒂德索赔/法国拒付/发展窃取
外交孤立与内部精英：美国 1862 承认/杜瓦利埃父子/阿里斯蒂德/政变/联合国/非政府组织/帮派/国家脆弱/赔偿阴影
第一黑人共和国遗产：泛非主义/黑人尊严/赔偿正义/气候脆弱/帮派/青年/侨民/海地精神永存
steps_en: Slave uprising as founding legitimacy: 1791 Bois Caïman ceremony/uprising/Louverture/Jean-Jacques/Biassou/Toussaint military-political genius/abolition/autonomy/constitution
Abolition as world-historical constitutional turn: 1794 France abolishes/1802 Napoleon restores/1801 Constitution/Louverture governor-for-life/Black/mulatto/white tricolor/civic equality
Reparations debt as development original sin: 1825 France recognition/150M francs/usury/1947 paid off/$20B+ today/Aristide demanded reparations/France refused/development stolen
Diplomatic isolation & internal elites: US 1862 recognition/Duvalier dynasty/Aristide/coups/UN/NGOs/gangs/state fragility/reparations shadow
First Black Republic legacy: Pan-Africanism/Black dignity/reparations justice/climate fragility/gangs/youth/diaspora/Haitian spirit endures

Exemplifies M210 Diaspora-Driven Confucian Merchant Development — quaternity of 'baseball talent pipeline + diaspora remittance engine + Confucian merchant family networks + Haiti border economy' building diaspora-driven development model amid quadruple challenges of dictatorship legacy/Haiti conflict/middle-income trap/climate vulnerability.

Baseball provides mobility ladder for poor youth, diaspora remittances fund household consumption/investment/education, Confucian merchant families (Arab/Chinese/Jewish/local) vertically integrate trade/finance/industry/services. BB-TOU-001.description_zh: 巴巴多斯 米娅·莫特利 (1965-) 2018- 首位女总理/旅游/离岸金融/鲁姆/糖业/教育/医疗/2021 共和国/英联邦/气候/蓝色经济/布里奇敦倡议/债务重组/绿色债券/小国外交/联合国/英联邦/加共体/非洲/中国/美国/欧盟。核心模式：服务经济小国外交 — 旅游/金融/教育/外交/气候领袖/债务创新/共和国转型/性别/青年/数字化。体现 M212 服务经济小国外交 — 以"旅游金融双引擎+共和国主权+气候领袖外交+债务创新"四位一体，在小国/资源匮乏/气候脆弱/债务压力四重约束中构建服务经济韧性范式。
BB-TOU-001.description_en: Barbados Mia Mottley (1965-) 2018- first female PM/tourism/offshore finance/rum/sugar/education/healthcare/2021 republic/Commonwealth/climate/blue economy/Bridgetown Initiative/debt restructuring/green bonds/small state diplomacy/UN/Commonwealth/CARICOM/Africa/China/US/EU. Core model: service economy small state diplomacy — tourism/finance/education/diplomacy/climate leadership/debt innovation/republic transition/gender/youth/digitalization. Exemplifies M212 Service Economy Small State Diplomacy — quaternity of 'tourism-finance dual engine + republican sovereignty + climate leadership diplomacy + debt innovation' building service economy resilience paradigm amid quadruple constraints of small state/resource scarcity/climate vulnerability/debt pressure.
BB-TOU-001.reason_zh: 巴巴多斯非单纯旅游岛，而是"旅游金融+共和国主权+气候外交"三位一体小国强者。莫特利以布里奇敦倡议重塑全球债务架构，以共和国断殖民纽带，以气候领袖争大国话语权。M212 区隔于 M199 马来伊斯兰(文莱)、M211 狂欢节共识(特立尼达)、M204 气候生存(斐济)，核心在于"服务双引擎+主权断裂+气候话语权"的小国外交新范式。
BB-TOU-001.reason_en: Barbados not mere tourist island but 'tourism-finance + republican sovereignty + climate diplomacy' trinity small state powerhouse. Mottley reshaped global debt architecture via Bridgetown Initiative, severed colonial ties via republic, claimed great power voice via climate leadership. M212 distinct from M199 Malay Islamic (Brunei), M211 Carnival Consensus (Trinidad), M204 Climate Survival (Fiji), core: 'service dual engine + sovereignty rupture + climate discourse power' new small state diplomacy paradigm.

AR-PER-001.name_zh: 阿根廷·胡安·庇隆：庇隆主义工人埃维塔与石油流亡回归
AR-PER-001.name_en: Argentina Juan Peron: Peronism Workers Evita & Oil Exile Return
AR-PER-001.description_zh: 胡安·多明戈·庇隆 (1895-1974) 阿根廷总统 (1946-1955, 1973-1974)，庇隆主义工人运动基础，埃维塔女性权利象征，石油国家化与流亡西班牙，1973年回归第三次总统，遗产争议至今。
AR-PER-001.description_en: Juan Domingo Peron (1895-1974) Argentina President (1946-1955, 1973-1974), Peronism worker movement base, Evita women rights symbol, oil nationalization and Spanish exile, 1973 return third presidency, legacy controversy continues.
AR-PER-001.reason_zh: 庇隆代表拉美民粹主义如何通过工人-女性双重联盟构建持久政治运动，展示了石油资源民族化与流亡回归如何成为庇隆主义核心叙事，其遗产至今主导阿根廷政治光谱。
AR-PER-001.reason_en: Peron represents how Latin American populism builds enduring political movement through worker-women dual alliance, demonstrating how oil nationalization and exile-return become Peronism core narrative, his legacy still dominates Argentine political spectrum today.
steps_zh: 研究庇隆早年军官与1943年GOU政变劳工部长崛起
分析1946年当选与埃维塔女性投票权/工会权利推动
探讨石油国家化与1955年军事政变流亡西班牙
评估1973年回归第三次总统与伊莎贝尔继任
总结庇隆主义工人埃维塔石油流亡回归对阿根廷政治的永恒主导
steps_en: Study Peron early officer and 1943 GOU coup Labor Minister rise
Analyze 1946 election and Evita women suffrage/union rights push
Explore oil nationalization and 1955 military coup Spanish exile
Evaluate 1973 return third presidency and Isabel succession
Summarize Peronism workers Evita oil exile return eternal dominance over Argentine politics
AR-PER-001.expected_zh: 掌握工人-女性双重联盟如何构建跨阶级民粹运动，理解石油民族化与流亡回归作为政治符号的双重张力，评估庇隆主义对阿根廷民主化与经济危机周期性的决定性塑造。
AR-PER-001.expected_en: Master how worker-women dual alliance builds cross-class populist movement, grasp oil nationalization and exile-return as political symbols dual tension, evaluate Peronism decisive shaping of Argentine democratization and economic crisis cyclicality.

CL-NEO-001.name_zh: 皮诺切特/芝加哥男孩/智利新自由主义：新自由主义实验室与转型正义
CL-NEO-001.name_en: Pinochet/Chicago Boys/Chilean Neoliberalism: Neoliberal Laboratory & Transitional Justice
CL-NEO-001.description_zh: 智利奥古斯托·皮诺切特 (1915-2006) 1973 政变/芝加哥男孩/新自由主义休克疗法/私有化/开放/养老金/教育/医疗/1980 宪法/1988 公投/1990 民主转型/艾尔文/拉戈斯/巴切莱特/皮涅拉/博里奇/2022 宪法公投/2023 新宪法草案。核心张力：新自由主义实验室/不平等/转型正义/宪法重写/社会权利/养老金/教育/医疗/水权/原住民。体现 M214 新自由主义实验室与转型正义 — 以"休克疗法+芝加哥男孩+转型公约+宪法重写"四位一体，在独裁/新自由主义/民主转型/宪法进程四重历史层叠中构建智利特色转型范式。
CL-NEO-001.description_en: Chile Augusto Pinochet (1915-2006) 1973 coup/Chicago Boys/neoliberal shock therapy/privatization/opening/pensions/education/healthcare/1980 Constitution/1988 plebiscite/1990 democratic transition/Aylwin/Lagos/Bachelet/Pinera/Boric/2022 constitutional plebiscite/2023 new draft. Core tensions: neoliberal laboratory/inequality/transitional justice/constitutional rewriting/social rights/pensions/education/healthcare/water rights/indigenous. Exemplifies M214 Neoliberal Laboratory & Transitional Justice — quaternity of 'shock therapy + Chicago Boys + transition pact + constitutional rewrite' building Chilean characteristic transition paradigm amid quadruple historical layers of dictatorship/neoliberalism/democratic transition/constitutional process.
CL-NEO-001.reason_zh: 智利非单纯新自由主义实验场，而是"休克疗法+转型公约+宪法重写"三位一体转型样本。芝加哥男孩重塑经济，转型公约保障民主回归，宪法重写试图超越 1980 宪法。M214 区隔于 M169 后石油转型(沙特)、M193 后冲突修复(秘鲁)、M198 内陆枢纽(老挝)，核心在于"休克疗法即实验室+转型公约即政治契约+宪法重写即社会契约"的智利转型范式。
CL-NEO-001.reason_en: Chile not mere neoliberal laboratory but 'shock therapy + transition pact + constitutional rewrite' trinity transition sample. Chicago Boys reshaped economy, transition pact guaranteed democratic return, constitutional rewrite attempts to transcend 1980 Constitution. M214 distinct from M169 Post-Oil (Saudi), M193 Post-Conflict Repair (Peru), M198 Landlocked Hub (Laos), core: 'shock therapy as laboratory + transition pact as political contract + constitutional rewrite as social contract' Chilean transition paradigm.

Core model: Tribal Federalism Oil State — emirs/tribes/federation/oil/welfare/modernization/diplomatic balance/soft power. Exemplifies M170 Tribal Federalism — quaternity of 'emir consensus + oil welfare distribution + tribal autonomy + federal diplomacy' building Gulf federal miracle amid quadruple tensions of tribal tradition/oil wealth/modernization/regional geopolitics.
AE-ZAY-001.reason_zh: 阿联酋非单纯石油酋长国，而是"酋长共识+石油福利+部落自治"三位一体联邦实验。七酋长以部落共识建立联邦，石油财富支撑全民福利/免税/高收入，部落自治在联邦框架内保留。M170 区隔于 M170 双语联邦(喀麦隆)、M181 边境地带(乌克兰)、M183 原住民自决(玻利维亚)，核心在于"酋长共识即联邦契约+石油福利即社会契约+部落自治即治理基石"的海湾部落联邦范式。
AE-ZAY-001.reason_en: UAE not mere oil emirate but 'emir consensus + oil welfare + tribal autonomy' trinity federal experiment. Seven emirs built federation via tribal consensus, oil wealth funds universal welfare/tax-free/high income, tribal autonomy preserved within federal framework. M170 distinct from M170 Bilingual Federalism (Cameroon), M181 Borderland (Ukraine), M183 Indigenous Self-Determination (Bolivia), core: 'emir consensus as federal contract + oil welfare as social contract + tribal autonomy as governance foundation' Gulf tribal federal paradigm.

KW-SAB-001.reason_en: Kuwait not mere oil monarchy but 'constitutional parliament + oil welfare + sovereign wealth' trinity Gulf democracy sample. 1962 Constitution established parliament/monarch separation of powers, oil wealth funds universal welfare/SWF intergenerational, parliament checks monarch/dissolution/elections normalized. BN-BOL-001.description_zh: 哈桑纳尔·博尔基亚 (1946-) 文莱苏丹 (1967-)/石油/天然气/财富/沙里亚/法/福利/免费/医疗/教育/住房/无税/绝对/君主/马来/伊斯兰/君主/制/MIB/哲学/1984 独立/英国/保护/国/遗产/文莱/博尔基亚。核心模式：苏丹石油沙里亚福利 — 苏丹/石油/沙里亚/福利/绝对/君主/遗产/博尔基亚/文莱。体现 M305 苏丹/石油/沙里亚/福利/绝对 — 以"苏丹+石油+沙里亚+福利"四位一体，在资源/宗教/传统/现代四重融合中构建文莱苏丹石油沙里亚福利绝对范式。
BN-BOL-001.description_en: Hassanal Bolkiah (1946-) Brunei Sultan (1967-)/oil/gas/wealth/Sharia/law/welfare/free/healthcare/education/housing/tax-free/absolute/monarchy/Malay/Islamic/monarchy/MIB/philosophy/1984 independence/British/protectorate/legacy/Brunei/Bolkiah. Core model: Sultan Oil Sharia Welfare — Sultan/oil/Sharia/welfare/absolute/monarchy/legacy/Bolkiah/Brunei. Exemplifies M305 Sultan/Oil/Sharia/Welfare/Absolute — quaternity of 'Sultan + oil + Sharia + welfare' building Bruneian Sultan oil Sharia welfare absolute paradigm amid quadruple fusion of resources/religion/tradition/modernity.
BN-BOL-001.reason_zh: 博尔基亚非单纯石油苏丹，而是"苏丹+石油+沙里亚+福利"四位一体绝对君主。以石油财富支撑福利，以沙里亚法确立道德，以马来伊斯兰君主制(MIB)整合传统。M305 区隔于 M227 姆斯瓦蒂(斯威士兰)、M199 文莱(前)、M303 李光耀(法治)，核心在于"苏丹即传统锚点+石油即经济基石+沙里亚即道德法典+福利即社会契约"的文莱绝对君主范式。
BN-BOL-001.reason_en: Bolkiah not mere oil sultan but 'Sultan + oil + Sharia + welfare' quaternity absolute monarch. Oil wealth funds welfare, Sharia law establishes morality, Malay Islamic Monarchy (MIB) integrates tradition. M305 distinct from M227 Mswati (Eswatini), M199 Brunei (previous), M303 Lee Kuan Yew (rule of law), core: 'Sultan as traditional anchor + oil as economic base + Sharia as moral code + welfare as social contract' Bruneian absolute monarchy paradigm.

TL-GUS-001.name_zh: 东帝汶·沙纳纳古斯芒：游击总统诺贝尔与石油和解
TL-GUS-001.name_en: East Timor Xanana Gusmao: Guerrilla President Nobel & Oil Reconciliation
TL-GUS-001.description_zh: 沙纳纳·古斯芒 (1946-) 东帝汶首任总统 (2002-2007)/总理 (2007-2015)，游击队领袖抵抗印尼24年占领，1999公投独立，诺贝尔和平奖共享，推动石油收益公平分配与民族和解。
TL-GUS-001.description_en: Kay Rala Xanana Gusmao (1946-) East Timor first President (2002-2007)/PM (2007-2015), guerrilla leader resisted Indonesian 24-year occupation, 1999 referendum independence, Nobel Peace Prize shared, promoted oil revenue fair distribution and national reconciliation.
TL-GUS-001.reason_zh: 古斯芒代表游击领袖如何成功转型为建国总理，展示了最年轻主权国家如何通过诺贝尔道德权威与石油外交实现民族和解与经济主权，成为后冲突建国典范。
TL-GUS-001.reason_en: Gusmao represents how guerrilla leader successfully transforms into founding President, demonstrating how youngest sovereign state achieves national reconciliation and economic sovereignty through Nobel moral authority and oil diplomacy, becoming post-conflict nation-building paradigm.
steps_zh: 研究古斯芒早年弗雷蒂林游击队与沙纳纳化名抵抗
分析1999公投压倒性独立与联合国过渡行政
探讨2002独立首任总统与拉莫斯奥塔共享诺贝尔和平奖
评估总理转型蒂莫尔缺口石油谈判公平收益分配
总结游击总统诺贝尔和解石油对后冲突建国的三重支撑
steps_en: Study Gusmao early Fretilin guerrilla and Xanana pseudonym resistance
Analyze 1999 referendum overwhelming independence and UN transitional administration
Explore 2002 independence first President and Ramos-Horta shared Nobel Peace Prize
Evaluate PM transition Timor Gap oil negotiations fair revenue distribution
Summarize guerrilla president Nobel reconciliation oil triple support for post-conflict nation-building
TL-GUS-001.expected_zh: 理解游击战争如何转化为建国合法性，掌握诺贝尔道德权威与石油经济主权双重杠杆如何支撑后冲突和解，评估古斯芒模式对南苏丹巴布亚等后冲突地区的普遍启示。
TL-GUS-001.expected_en: Understand how guerrilla war transforms into nation-building legitimacy, grasp Nobel moral authority and oil economic sovereignty dual levers supporting post-conflict reconciliation, evaluate Gusmao model universal lessons for South Sudan Papua post-conflict regions.
TL-GUS-001.case_zh: 1946 出生；1975 游击；1999 公投；2002 总统；2007 总理。游击总统诺贝尔和解石油范式永存。

MN-NOM-001.name_zh: 成吉思汗/忽必烈/拖雷：蒙古游牧共识与大草原契约
MN-NOM-001.name_en: Genghis Khan/Kublai/Tolui: Mongol Nomadic Consensus & Great Steppe Contract
MN-NOM-001.description_zh: 成吉思汗 (1162-1227) 以库里台大会制、安达结义、大蒙古国大律札撒 (Yassa) 统一蒙古诸部，建立史上最大陆地帝国；忽必烈 (1215-1294) 完成南征、建元大都，推行行省制治理华夏；拖雷 (1193-1232) 作为监国、东征先锋，传承草原契约精神。三代君主跨越征服/治理/传承三阶段，共同体现 M159 蒙古游牧共识——流动性部落通过神圣契约 (Yassa) 与个人结义 (安达) 形成超稳定政治共同体，再以驿站制 (速把台) 实现跨欧亚大陆的资源调动与信息同步。
MN-NOM-001.description_en: Genghis Khan (1162-1227) unified Mongol tribes via Kurultai assembly, Anda oath, and Great Yassa law, building history's largest land empire; Kublai (1215-1294) completed southern conquest, established Dadu, implemented provincial governance over China; Tolui (1193-1232) as regent and eastern campaign vanguard transmitted steppe contract spirit. Three generations across conquest/governance/transmission phases jointly exemplify M159 Mongol Nomadic Consensus—fluid tribes form ultra-stable political community through sacred contract (Yassa) and personal oath (Anda), then via Yam relay system achieve cross-Eurasian resource mobilization and information synchronization.
MN-NOM-001.reason_zh: 蒙古帝国非靠强力维持，而是以"契约+结义+驿站"三位一体机制，将游牧流动性转化为政治稳定性。M159 独特区隔于 M146 乌班图(定居农耕)、M152 安第斯互惠(定居农耕)，核心在于"流动性+契约性"双重锚定。
MN-NOM-001.reason_en: Mongol Empire sustained not by force but by trinity of "contract+oath+relay", converting nomadic fluidity into political stability. M159 uniquely distinct from M146 Ubuntu (settled agrarian) and M152 Andean Reciprocity (settled agrarian), core distinction: "fluidity+contractuality" dual anchoring.
steps_zh: 库里台合法性确立：全体贵族大会选举大汗，程序正义先于血统
安达结义网络构建：跨部落/跨族群个人誓盟，建立超氏族信任图谱
大律札撒立法固化：成文法典规定军制/刑法/商税/宗教宽容，契约成文化
驿站制资源调动：速把台网络覆盖欧亚，实现军令/情报/商贸跨大陆同步
代际传承与分封：忽必烈行省制、四大汗国分治，契约框架下的多中心治理
steps_en: Kurultai legitimacy establishment: noble assembly elects Great Khan, procedural justice over bloodline
Anda oath network building: cross-tribal/ethnic personal oaths, constructing trans-clan trust graph
Great Yassa legislative codification: written code covering military/criminal/commerce/religious tolerance, contract textualized
Yam relay resource mobilization: speed-putai network spanning Eurasia, achieving cross-continental sync of orders/intel/trade
Intergenerational transmission & appanage: Kublai provincial system, four khanates division, multi-centric governance within contract framework
MN-NOM-001.expected_zh: 游牧文明以"流动性+契约性"机制实现超大规模政治整合，提供去中心化治理、跨文化资源调动的历史范式。
MN-NOM-001.expected_en: Nomadic civilization achieves ultra-large political integration via "fluidity+contractuality" mechanism, providing historical paradigm for decentralized governance & cross-cultural resource mobilization.
MN-NOM-001.case_zh: 1206年库里台选举成吉思汗→1219-1225西征花剌子模→1260忽必烈登基→1271建元大都→1294四大汗国名分确立，契约框架下162年帝国延续。
MN-NOM-001.case_en: 1206 Kurultai elects Genghis -> 1219-25 western campaign Khwarezm -> 1260 Kublai enthroned -> 1271 Yuan Dadu established -> 1294 four khanates legitimized, 162-year imperial continuity within contract framework.
MN-NOM-001.intellectual_tradition: Mongol Nomadic Governance / Yassa Legal Tradition
MN-NOM-001.cross_cultural_impact: Yam relay inspired postal systems; Yassa influenced Islamic/Christian steppe law; Pax Mongolica enabled East-West exchange
MN-NOM-001.resource_curse_mitigation: Pastoral wealth distribution via anda network; Yassa regulated herd taxation

MN-BUD-001.name_zh: 萨迦班智达/桑耶寺主持：藏传佛法治理与经教辩经
MN-BUD-001.name_en: Sakya Pandita/Samye Abbots: Tibetan Buddhist Governance & Doctrinal Dialectics
MN-BUD-001.description_zh: 萨迦班智达 (1182-1251) 以《理门宝鬘》《辨三誓论》确立萨迦派教法体系，受蒙古帝国册封为吐蕃教主，建立"萨迦政权"——政教合一的藩属治理模式；桑耶寺 (779建立) 历代堪布主持辩经度僧制（拉让巴格西），通过逻辑辩证选拔人才、仲裁教义争端，形成独特的"经教辩经"治理范式。核心机制：辩经即司法、戒律即宪法、寺院即行政单元、上师相授即权力传承。
MN-BUD-001.description_en: Sakya Pandita (1182-1251) established Sakya doctrinal system via 'Gateway to Logic' and 'Three Vows Discrimination', appointed by Mongol Empire as Tibet's religious ruler, creating 'Sakya Regime'—theocratic vassal governance model; Samye Monastery (founded 779) successive abbots presided over dialectical debate for monastic ordination (Lharampa Geshe), using logical dialectics for talent selection and doctrinal dispute resolution, forming unique 'doctrinal dialectics' governance paradigm. Core mechanism: debate = judiciary, vinaya = constitution, monastery = administrative unit, guru transmission = power succession.
MN-BUD-001.reason_zh: 藏传佛教非单纯信仰，而是以辩证逻辑为核心的治理技术：辩经度僧=人才选拔标准化、寺院网络=行政覆盖、转世系统=权力平稳传递。M160 区隔于 M149 伊斯兰咨询(舒拉协商)、M160 藏传佛法治理(辩证法为核心)，核心在于"逻辑辩证即治理算法"。
MN-BUD-001.reason_en: Tibetan Buddhism is not mere faith but governance technology centered on dialectical logic: dialectical debate for ordination = standardized talent selection, monastery network = administrative coverage, reincarnation system = smooth power transfer. M160 distinct from M149 Islamic Shura (consultative) and M160 Tibetan Buddhist governance (dialectics as core), core: "dialectical logic as governance algorithm".
steps_zh: 建立经教体系：班智达《释量论》注释确立因明逻辑为教法基石
辩经选拔人才：拉让巴格西考试，逻辑辩证胜出者获最高学位与职位
寺院行政管理：萨迦/哲蚌/色拉三大寺网络覆盖吐藏区，堪布即地方长官
政教协同传承：活佛转世系统（达赖/班禅）确保权力平稳跨代际传递
steps_en: Establish doctrinal system: Pandita's Pramanavarttika commentary establishes Buddhist logic as doctrinal foundation
Dialectical debate for talent selection: Lharampa Geshe exam, dialectical winners get highest degree & office
Monastery administrative management: Sakya/Drepung/Sera three great monasteries network covers Ü-Tsang, abbots as local governors
Religion-politics synergistic transmission: tulku reincarnation system (Dalai/Panchen) ensures smooth cross-generational power transfer
MN-BUD-001.expected_zh: 高原地区以"辩证逻辑+寺院网络+转世传承"三位一体实现跨族群/跨语言的长期稳定治理，提供宗教即治理技术的独特范式。
MN-BUD-001.expected_en: Plateau region achieves long-term stable governance across ethnicities/languages via trinity of "dialectical logic+monastery network+reincarnation transmission", providing unique paradigm of religion as governance technology.
MN-BUD-001.case_zh: 1244忽必烈册封班智达为吐蕃教主→1260萨迦政权建立→1642古什汗扶持格鲁派→1653顺治册封达赖喇嘛→1951十七条协议，政教模式延续700年。
MN-BUD-001.case_en: 1244 Kublai appoints Pandita as Tibet ruler -> 1260 Sakya Regime established -> 1642 Gushri Khan backs Gelug -> 1653 Shunzhi confirms Dalai Lama -> 1951 17-Point Agreement, theocratic model continues 700 years.
MN-BUD-001.cross_cultural_impact: Buddhist logic influenced Mongol/Yuan law; tulku system model for theocratic succession; Pramana logic in Central Asian curricula

MN-MOD-001.name_zh: 苏赫巴托尔/乔巴山：游牧转型治理与革命现代化
MN-MOD-001.name_en: Sukhbaatar/Choibalsan: Nomadic Transition Governance & Revolutionary Modernization
MN-MOD-001.description_zh: 达木丁·苏赫巴托尔 (1893-1923) 率领蒙古人民革命党游击队，在苏联红军支持下驱逐白俄/北洋军阀，建立蒙古人民共和国 (1924)；霍尔洛·乔巴山 (1895-1952) 推行集体化/工业化/文化革命，以"苏联模式"强力转型游牧社会。核心张力：游牧自由主义 vs 革命集权现代化；宗教权威 (活佛) vs 党国权威；部落忠诚 vs 阶级忠诚。乔巴山后期修正"左倾"错误，恢复宗教自由、保护游牧生计，体现 M159+M161 游牧契约在现代国家建构中的辩证生存。
MN-MOD-001.description_en: Damdiny Sukhbaatar (1893-1923) led MPRP guerrillas, with Soviet Red Army support expelled White Russians/Beiyang warlords, established Mongolian People's Republic (1924); Khorloogiin Choibalsan (1895-1952) pushed collectivization/industrialization/cultural revolution, forcefully transforming nomadic society via "Soviet model". Core tension: nomadic libertarianism vs revolutionary centralized modernization; religious authority (living Buddha) vs party-state authority; tribal loyalty vs class loyalty. Choibalsan later corrected "leftist" errors, restored religious freedom, protected nomadic livelihoods, exemplifying dialectical survival of M159+M161 nomadic contract in modern state-building.
MN-MOD-001.reason_zh: 蒙古 1921-1990 社会主义实验是游牧文明在现代性冲击下的极限压力测试：如何在保持 M159 游牧共识核心的同时，引入工业化/国家建构/意识形态现代化？苏赫巴托尔建立革命合法性，乔巴山完成国家建构但付出惨痛代价，1990和平民主转型最终回归 M159 契约精神。
MN-MOD-001.reason_en: Mongolia's 1921-1990 socialist experiment was nomadic civilization's extreme stress test under modernity: how to introduce industrialization/state-building/ideological modernization while preserving M159 nomadic consensus core? Sukhbaatar established revolutionary legitimacy, Choibalsan completed state-building at tragic cost, 1990 peaceful democratic transition ultimately returned to M159 contract spirit.
steps_zh: 革命合法性确立：1921年苏赫巴托尔游击战胜利，建立革命政权合法性
国家形式构建：1924年宪法确立人民共和国，废除封建贵族特权
强力现代化推进：乔巴山集体化牧场/建立工业/推行西里尔字母/镇压喇嘛教
错误修正与生存：1932年武装起义后修正左倾，恢复宗教/保护游牧生计
和平民主转型：1990年多党制/市场经济/新宪法，游牧契约精神回归现代治理
steps_en: Revolutionary legitimacy establishment: 1921 Sukhbaatar guerrilla victory, revolutionary regime legitimacy
State form construction: 1924 Constitution establishes People's Republic, abolishes feudal aristocratic privileges
Forced modernization push: Choibalsan collectivizes pastures/builds industry/imposes Cyrillic/suppresses lama Buddhism
Error correction & survival: 1932 armed uprising triggers leftist correction, restores religion/protects nomadic livelihoods
Peaceful democratic transition: 1990 multi-party/market economy/new constitution, nomadic contract spirit returns to modern governance
MN-MOD-001.expected_zh: 游牧文明在革命现代化冲击下经历毁灭性代价，最终以和平转型方式实现 M159 契约精神的现代性重构，为后发国家提供"革命-修正-回归"范式。
MN-MOD-001.expected_en: Nomadic civilization undergoes destructive costs under revolutionary modernity, ultimately achieves modern reconstruction of M159 contract spirit via peaceful transition, providing "revolution-correction-return" paradigm for late-developing nations.
MN-MOD-001.case_zh: 1921年革命胜利→1924年建国→1932年起义修正→1937-39大清洗→1990和平民主转型→1992新宪法，70年实验以 M159 契约精神收束。
MN-MOD-001.case_en: 1921 revolution victory -> 1924 state founded -> 1932 uprising correction -> 1937-39 great purge -> 1990 peaceful democratic transition -> 1992 new constitution, 70-year experiment concludes with M159 contract spirit.
MN-MOD-001.cross_cultural_impact: Only Asian Soviet-style socialist state to peacefully democratize; nomadic socialism case study
MN-MOD-001.resource_curse_mitigation: Soviet aid dependency; post-1990 mineral boom managed via SWF discussions

MN-ECO-001.name_zh: 奥云额尔登/矿业巨头：资源诅咒缓解与主权财富建设
MN-ECO-001.name_en: Oyun-Erdene/Mining Giants: Resource Curse Mitigation & Sovereign Wealth Building
MN-ECO-001.description_zh: 罗布勒·奥云额尔登 (1980-) 现任蒙古总理，主导《2020年愿景》与《新复苏政策》，推动陶陶陶铜金矿 (奥尤陶陶) 政府持股 34% 重谈、建立蒙古主权财富基金 (Fiscal Stability Fund/Future Heritage Fund)、推行矿产收益透明化 (EITI)、绿色转型 (戈壁风光/氢能)。核心挑战：单一矿产依赖 (GDP 25%+)、荷兰病风险、外资博弈 (力拓/中国铝业)、基建瓶颈。体现 M168 资源诅咒缓解与 M169 后资源转型治理在游牧文明语境下的实战：以"矿产换基建/技术/主权基金"三角博弈，力求将地质运气转化为代际财富。
MN-ECO-001.description_en: Luvsannamsrain Oyun-Erdene (1980-), current Mongolian PM, drives 'Vision 2050' & 'New Recovery Policy', renegotiating Oyu Tolgoi copper-gold mine (34% govt stake), establishing Mongolian SWF (Fiscal Stability Fund/Future Heritage Fund), implementing mineral revenue transparency (EITI), green transition (Gobi wind-solar/hydrogen). Core challenge: single mineral dependency (GDP 25%+), Dutch disease risk, foreign capital games (Rio Tinto/Chalco), infrastructure bottlenecks. Exemplifies M168 Resource Curse Mitigation & M169 Post-Resource Transition Governance in nomadic civilization context: "minerals for infrastructure/tech/sovereign wealth" triangular play, seeking to convert geological luck into intergenerational wealth.
MN-ECO-001.reason_zh: 蒙古拥有世界级铜/煤/稀土，却长期陷入"资源诅咒"。奥云额尔登以 40 岁总理身份，尝试在 M168 工具箱 (SWF/EITI/透明化/绿色转型) 中寻找蒙古解法：既要外资技术/资本，又要主权控制/收益公平/代际公平。这是 M159 游牧契约精神在现代资源治理中的投影——部落共识决定资源归属与分配。
MN-ECO-001.reason_en: Mongolia has world-class copper/coal/rare earths yet long trapped in 'resource curse'. Oyun-Erdene as 40-year-old PM attempts Mongolian solution within M168 toolkit (SWF/EITI/transparency/green transition): needing foreign tech/capital while demanding sovereign control/fair revenue/intergenerational equity. This projects M159 nomadic contract spirit onto modern resource governance—tribal consensus decides resource ownership & distribution.
steps_zh: 重谈陶陶陶合同：2022-23年谈判政府持股 34%、税收稳定、本地就业/采购比例
建立双主权基金：财政稳定基金(抗周期)+未来遗产基金(代际储蓄)，法定只花收益
EITI 透明化深化：矿业合同/收益/实控人公开，接受民间监督
绿色转型锚定：戈壁 10GW 风光+氢能出口走廊，矿区光伏治沙
人才与技术主权：蒙古矿业大学/理工大学建设、本地化技术标准、数据主权
steps_en: Renegotiate Oyu Tolgoi: 2022-23 negotiations for 34% govt stake, tax stability, local employment/procurement quotas
Establish dual SWF: Fiscal Stability Fund (counter-cyclical) + Future Heritage Fund (intergenerational savings), legally spend-only-returns
EITI transparency deepening: mining contracts/revenue/beneficial owners public, civil society oversight
Green transition anchoring: Gobi 10GW wind-solar + hydrogen export corridor, mine-site PV desert greening
Talent & tech sovereignty: Mongolian Univ of Mining/Sci-Tech building, localized tech standards, data sovereignty
MN-ECO-001.expected_zh: 资源型游牧国家实现"矿产财富->主权基金->绿色产业->代际福祉"全链条转化，避免荷兰病，建立可复制的后发资源治理范式。
MN-ECO-001.expected_en: Resource-rich nomadic nation achieves full-chain conversion "mineral wealth->sovereign wealth->green industry->intergenerational wellbeing", avoids Dutch disease, establishes replicable latecomer resource governance paradigm.
MN-ECO-001.case_zh: 陶陶陶铜金矿 2023 产铜 20 万吨/金 15 吨，政府分红超 $10 亿；财政稳定基金 2023 规模 $2.3 亿；EITI 验证蒙古达标；戈壁新能源装机 2023 突破 1GW。
MN-ECO-001.case_en: Oyu Tolgoi 2023 output 200kt Cu/15t Au, govt dividend >$1B; FSF 2023 size $230M; EITI validates Mongolia compliant; Gobi renewables 2023 >1GW installed.
MN-ECO-001.cross_cultural_impact: Landlocked resource nation SWF model; EITI implementation in weak institutions; green hydrogen from mining
MN-ECO-001.resource_curse_mitigation: Oyu Tolgoi 34% stake; Dual SWF (FSF+FHF); EITI compliant; 3% spending rule proposed; Green transition reinvestment

TW-SEM-001.name_zh: 莫里斯·张/台积电创始团队：半导体生态链主与科技儒商共生
TW-SEM-001.name_en: Morris Chang/TSMC Founding Team: Semiconductor Ecosystem Chain-Master & Tech-Confucian Merchant Symbiosis
TW-SEM-001.description_zh: 张忠谋 (1931-) 1987 年创立台积电 (TSMC)，开创"纯晶圆代工"模式，打破 IDM 垂直整合垄断，构建全球半导体产业新生态：设计公司(联发科/恩智浦/高通)专注设计，台积电专注制造，ASML/应用材料供设备，ARM/IP 提供架构。核心机制：开放创新平台 (OIP) + 可信代工承诺 + 先进制程技术领先 (3nm/2nm) + 客户共创生态。张忠谋以"科技儒商"身份跨越中美台三地，将儒家"诚信立业、师徒传承、家族治理"注入硅谷管理范式，体现 M160 台湾科技儒商共生模式——技术官僚理性+儒商长期主义+生态位主导。
TW-SEM-001.description_en: Morris Chang (1931-) founded TSMC in 1987, pioneering "pure-play foundry" model, breaking IDM vertical integration monopoly, constructing new global semiconductor ecosystem: design houses (MediaTek/NXP/Qualcomm) focus design, TSMC focuses manufacturing, ASML/Applied Materials supply equipment, ARM/IP provide architecture. Core mechanism: Open Innovation Platform (OIP) + trusted foundry commitment + advanced node leadership (3nm/2nm) + customer co-creation ecosystem. Chang as "tech-Confucian merchant" spanning US-China-Taiwan, infused Confucian "integrity in business, master-apprentice transmission, family governance" into Silicon Valley management paradigm, exemplifying M160 Taiwan Tech-Confucian Merchant Symbiosis—technocratic rationality + Confucian long-termism + ecosystem dominance.
TW-SEM-001.reason_zh: 台积电非单一企业，而是半导体产业的"操作系统"：掌握先进制程话语权，定义产业标准，分配产能红利。M160 独特区隔于 M153 儒商百年传承(家族)、M158 通才整合(个人)，核心在于"平台生态+国家战略+儒商伦理"三位一体。
TW-SEM-001.reason_en: TSMC is not a single firm but semiconductor industry's "operating system": controls advanced node discourse, defines industry standards, allocates capacity dividends. M160 uniquely distinct from M153 Confucian Merchant Legacy (family) and M158 Polymath Integration (individual), core: trinity of "platform ecosystem + national strategy + Confucian merchant ethics".
steps_zh: 模式创新与信任锚定：1987年纯代工模式，拒绝竞争客户设计，建立"可信中立"品牌承诺
开放创新平台构建：OIP/PDK/IP 联盟，降低客户设计门槛，锁定产业链上游
技术领先持续投入：研发占营收 8-10%，3nm/2nm/GAA 持续领先 1-2 代
生态位主导与标准制定：Advanced/Intel/AMD/Apple 绑定，台积电产能=全球芯片供给上限
儒商治理传承：张忠谋退休后魏哲家/蒋尚义接班，家族/师徒/校友网络治理，长期主义文化固化
steps_en: Model innovation & trust anchoring: 1987 pure foundry model, refuses competing with customer designs, establishes "trusted neutral" brand promise
Open Innovation Platform construction: OIP/PDK/IP alliance, lowers customer design barrier, locks upstream supply chain
Sustained tech leadership investment: R&D 8-10% revenue, 3nm/2nm/GAA persistent 1-2 gen lead
Ecosystem dominance & standard setting: Advanced/Intel/AMD/Apple bound, TSMC capacity = global chip supply ceiling
Confucian merchant governance transmission: Chang retirement -> C.C. Wei/S.C. Chiang succession, family/master-apprentice/alumni network governance, long-termist culture solidified
TW-SEM-001.expected_zh: 小岛经济体以"单一关键技术+平台生态+儒商治理"锁定全球产业命脉，实现技术主权与商业主权双赢。
TW-SEM-001.expected_en: Small island economy locks global industrial lifeline via "single critical tech + platform ecosystem + Confucian governance", achieving tech sovereignty & commercial sovereignty dual win.
TW-SEM-001.case_zh: 2023年台积电营收 2.16 兆新台币，市值全球前十，先进制程(7nm 以下) 市占率 >90%，全球 90%+ AI 芯片/手机芯片/高性能计算芯片产自台积电。
TW-SEM-001.case_en: 2023 TSMC revenue NT$2.16T, market cap global top 10, advanced node (<7nm) share >90%, 90%+ global AI/mobile/HPC chips from TSMC.
TW-SEM-001.intellectual_tradition: Taiwan Tech-Confucian Merchant / Pure-Play Foundry Model
TW-SEM-001.cross_cultural_impact: Global semiconductor supply chain reshaping; pure-play foundry model replication (GlobalFoundries/SMIC); tech sovereignty discourse
TW-SEM-001.diaspora_influence: Silicon Valley Taiwanese diaspora core; US-Taiwan tech alliance anchor

TW-POL-001.name_zh: 李登辉/蔡英文/民主先驱：民主转型共识与制度化和平移权
TW-POL-001.name_en: Lee Teng-hui/Tsai Ing-wen/Democratic Pioneers: Democratic Transition Consensus & Institutionalized Peaceful Transfer
TW-POL-001.description_zh: 李登辉 (1923-2020) "台湾民主之父"，主导 1991-1996 系列宪法修正、废除《动员戡乱条款》、首次总统直选 (1996)；蔡英文 (1956-) 首位女性总统，推动《促进转型正义条例》、原住民历史正义、性别平权、国防自主。跨蓝绿两代领袖共同完成：威权体制→程序民主→实质民主→转型正义。核心机制：宪法渐进修正(不废不立)→选举制度重构(单一选区两票制)→政党轮替常态化(2000/2008/2016)→历史清算程序化(促转会)。体现 M164 民主转型共识——以"程序正义替代实质对抗"，在深度分裂社会中建立跨党派共识基线。
TW-POL-001.description_en: Lee Teng-hui (1923-2020) "Father of Taiwan Democracy" led 1991-96 constitutional amendments, abolished Temporary Provisions, first direct presidential election (1996); Tsai Ing-wen (1956-) first female president, advanced Transitional Justice Act, indigenous historical justice, gender equality, defense autonomy. Across Blue/Green two generations: authoritarian regime → procedural democracy → substantive democracy → transitional justice. Core mechanism: incremental constitutional amendment (neither abolish nor enact) → electoral system restructuring (single-member district two-vote) → party rotation normalization (2000/2008/2016) → historical reckoning proceduralization (Transitional Justice Commission). Exemplifies M164 Democratic Transition Consensus—"procedural justice replaces substantive confrontation", establishing cross-party consensus baseline in deeply divided society.
TW-POL-001.reason_zh: 台湾民主转型非革命突变，而是"宪法渐进主义+选举工程+跨党派共识"三位一体：李登辉在国民党内部推动改革，蔡英文在民进党执政下深化转型正义。M164 区隔于 M149 伊斯兰咨询(舒拉)、M162 多元文化联邦(加拿大)，核心在于"程序正义替代实质对抗"的和平转型工程。
TW-POL-001.reason_en: Taiwan's democratic transition not revolutionary rupture but trinity of "constitutional gradualism + electoral engineering + cross-party consensus": Lee pushed reform from within KMT, Tsai deepened transitional justice under DPP. M164 distinct from M149 Islamic Shura (consultation) and M162 Multicultural Federation (Canada), core: "procedural justice replaces substantive confrontation" peaceful transition engineering.
steps_zh: 宪法渐进修正路径：1991-2005 七次增修条文，废除动员戡乱/省虚级化/冻结省议会
选举制度重构工程：1994 省长/市长直选→1996 总统直选→2005 单一选区两票制→2020 同票制
政党轮替常态化锚定：2000 陈水扁/2008 马英九/2016 蔡英文/2024 赖清德，四次和平轮替
转型正义程序化：2018 促转会成立→档案解密/不当判决撤销/威权象征移除/原住民道歉
跨海峡互动框架：李登辉"两国论"→蔡英文"九二共识不接受/现状维持"，务实避战
steps_en: Constitutional gradual amendment path: 1991-2005 seven amendment rounds, abolished Temporary Provisions/provincial streamlining/frozen provincial assembly
Electoral system restructuring engineering: 1994 governor/mayor direct election -> 1996 presidential direct election -> 2005 single-member district two-vote -> 2020 same-vote system
Party rotation normalization anchoring: 2000 Chen/2008 Ma/2016 Tsai/2024 Lai, four peaceful rotations
Transitional justice proceduralization: 2018 Transitional Justice Commission -> archives declassification/wrongful convictions overturned/authoritarian symbols removed/indigenous apology
Cross-strait interaction framework: Lee "two states theory" -> Tsai "reject 1992 Consensus/maintain status quo", pragmatic conflict avoidance
TW-POL-001.expected_zh: 深度分裂社会以"程序正义+选举工程+历史清算"三位一体实现和平民主化，避免革命暴力/内战/政权报复，为后发民主化提供"台湾模式"范式。
TW-POL-001.expected_en: Deeply divided society achieves peaceful democratization via trinity of "procedural justice + electoral engineering + historical reckoning", avoiding revolutionary violence/civil war/regime retaliation, providing "Taiwan model" paradigm for late democratization.
TW-POL-001.case_zh: 1996 首次总统直选→2000 首次政党轮替→2018 促转会成立→2024 第四次轮替，28 年零政变/零内战/零政治清洗，民主指数长期亚洲第一。
TW-POL-001.case_en: 1996 first direct presidential election -> 2000 first party rotation -> 2018 Transitional Justice Commission -> 2024 fourth rotation, 28 years zero coups/zero civil war/zero political purges, democracy index consistently Asia #1.
TW-POL-001.cross_cultural_impact: Taiwan model for peaceful democratization; Hong Kong/Thailand/Myanmar reference; constitutional gradualism theory
TW-POL-001.diaspora_influence: Taiwanese-American advocacy for Taiwan Relations Act; global democracy network
TW-POL-001.indigenous_knowledge_system: 16 indigenous peoples recognized; Tsai 2016 formal apology; Austronesian cultural revival

TW-LIT-001.name_zh: 白先勇/龙应台/陈芳明：离散叙事书写与乡愁现代性
TW-LIT-001.name_en: Pai Hsien-yung/Lung Ying-tai/Chen Fang-ming: Diasporic Narrative Writing & Nostalgic Modernity
TW-LIT-001.description_zh: 白先勇 (1937-) 《台北人》以文言/白话夹叙，重构大陆移民在台精英群像的"故园"记忆，奠基华语离散文学；龙应台 (1952-) 《大江大海一九四九》口述史访谈 200+ 位两岸受难者，以"大历史中的小人物"叙事伦理重塑跨海峡共同记忆；陈芳明 (1958-) 《台湾新文学史》建构台湾文学自主谱系，提出"乡愁不是回不去的过去，而是回不去的未来"。三人跨小说/散文/批评，共同体现 M165 离散叙事书写——以"记忆导航+多声部口述+谱系建构"三重技法，在政治分裂中重构文化连续性。
TW-LIT-001.description_en: Pai Hsien-yung (1937-) 'Taipei People' in classical/vernacular mix reconstructs mainland emigre elite's 'lost garden' memory, founding Sinophone diasporic literature; Lung Ying-tai (1952-) 'Big River Big Sea 1949' oral history interviews 200+ cross-strait victims, 'small figures in big history' narrative ethics reconstructs cross-strait shared memory; Chen Fang-ming (1958-) 'History of Taiwan New Literature' constructs autonomous Taiwan literary genealogy, proposes 'nostalgia is not the unreachable past but the unreachable future'. Across fiction/essay/criticism, all three exemplify M165 Diasporic Narrative Writing—triple technique of 'memory navigation + multi-voiced oral history + genealogical construction' reconstructing cultural continuity amid political division.
TW-LIT-001.reason_zh: 台湾文学非单纯本土书写，而是"大陆记忆+本土生长+国际视野"三重张力场域。白先勇重构精英记忆，龙应台发掘底层受难，陈芳明建构学科谱系。M165 区隔于 M155 魔幻现实(拉美)、M154 梦境时间(澳洲)，核心在于"政治分裂语境下的文化连续性重构"。
TW-LIT-001.reason_en: Taiwan literature not mere native writing but triple tension field of 'mainland memory + native growth + international vision'. Pai reconstructs elite memory, Lung excavates grassroots suffering, Chen constructs disciplinary genealogy. M165 distinct from M155 Magical Realism (Latin America) and M154 Dreamtime Navigation (Australia), core: 'cultural continuity reconstruction under political division context'.
steps_zh: 记忆导航与故园重构：白先勇《台北人》文言白话夹叙，重构大陆精英"故园"空间感
多声部口述历史伦理：龙应台访谈 200+ 受难者，"大历史中的小人物"叙事赋予边缘声音尊严
学科谱系建构与自主性：陈芳明《台湾新文学史》确立台湾文学自主标准，摆脱"中国文学分支"定位
跨海峡/跨代际对话：白先勇晚年返京/龙应台两岸巡讲/陈芳明两岸学术对话，记忆流动重塑共同体
乡愁现代性转向：从"回不去的过去"转向"回不去的未来"，记忆成为面向未来的批判资源
steps_en: Memory navigation & lost garden reconstruction: Pai's 'Taipei People' classical/vernacular mix reconstructs mainland elite 'lost garden' spatial sense
Multi-voiced oral history ethics: Lung interviews 200+ victims, 'small figures in big history' narrative grants dignity to marginal voices
Disciplinary genealogy construction & autonomy: Chen's 'History of Taiwan New Literature' establishes Taiwan literature autonomous criteria, shedding 'branch of Chinese literature' label
Cross-strait/intergenerational dialogue: Pai late return to Beijing / Lung cross-strait lectures / Chen cross-strait academic dialogue, memory fluidity reconstructs community
Nostalgic modernity pivot: from 'unreturnable past' to 'unreturnable future', memory becomes future-oriented critical resource
TW-LIT-001.expected_zh: 分裂社会中以"记忆导航+口述伦理+谱系建构"三重技法，将政治创伤转化为文化批判资源，构建跨越海峡/代际的文学共同体。
TW-LIT-001.expected_en: In divided society, triple technique of 'memory navigation + oral ethics + genealogical construction' converts political trauma into cultural critical resource, constructing literary community across strait/generations.
TW-LIT-001.case_zh: 《台北人》中文经典地位/《大江大海》两岸畅销百万册/《台湾新文学史》成学科教材标准，三人合力确立台湾文学国际话语权。
TW-LIT-001.case_en: 'Taipei People' Chinese classic status / 'Big River Big Sea' cross-strait million-copy bestseller / 'History of Taiwan New Literature' disciplinary textbook standard, trio jointly established Taiwan literature international discourse power.
TW-LIT-001.cross_cultural_impact: Sinophone literature framework; Hong Kong/Chinese diaspora reference; memory studies in divided societies
TW-LIT-001.diaspora_influence: Taiwanese-American literary circles; global Sinophone studies network
TW-LIT-001.indigenous_knowledge_system: Indigenous Taiwanese oral literature influence on nativist movement (limited)

TW-EDU-001.name_zh: 李远哲/吴大猷/科学教育家：科学普及公民化与科教融合治理
TW-EDU-001.name_en: Lee Yuan-tseh/Wu Ta-you/Science Educators: Science Popularization Citizenship & Science-Education Governance Fusion
TW-EDU-001.description_zh: 李远哲 (1936-) 诺贝尔化学奖得主，返台任中研院院长 (1994-2006)，推动"高中科学人文同重"、"科学教育白皮书"、"科普教育法"立法，确立"全民科学素养"国策；吴大猷 (1907-2000) "中国导弹之父"、中研院物理所创所所长，早年倡导"科学救国"、创办《科学》月刊普及科学方法。两代科学家跨诺奖实验/导弹工程/科教治理，共同体现 M166 科学普及公民化——以"科学方法即公民素养、科教融合即治理现代化"双重逻辑，将精英科学转化为公共决策基础设施。
TW-EDU-001.description_en: Lee Yuan-tseh (1936-) Nobel Chemistry laureate, returned as Academia Sinica President (1994-2006), pushed 'high school science-humanities equal weight', 'Science Education White Paper', 'Science Popularization Act' legislation, establishing 'universal scientific literacy' national policy; Wu Ta-you (1907-2000) 'Father of Chinese Missiles', founding director of Academia Sinica Physics Institute, early advocate 'science saves nation', founded 'Science' monthly for scientific method popularization. Two generations across Nobel experiment/missile engineering/science-education governance jointly exemplify M166 Science Popularization Citizenship—dual logic of 'scientific method = civic literacy, science-education fusion = governance modernization', converting elite science into public decision-making infrastructure.
TW-EDU-001.reason_zh: 台湾科教治理独特在于"诺奖级科学家直接参与公共政策"：李远哲以科学权威推动课程改革/科普立法/研究治理透明化。M166 区隔于 M63 学科建置(学术)、M58 实验验证(方法论)，核心在于"科学方法下沉为公民基本素养、科教体制上升为国家治理基建"。
TW-EDU-001.reason_en: Taiwan's science-education governance unique in 'Nobel-level scientists directly engaging public policy': Lee used scientific authority to drive curriculum reform/science popularization legislation/research governance transparency. M166 distinct from M63 Discipline Building (academic) and M58 Experimental Verification (methodology), core: 'scientific method sinks to civic basic literacy, science-education system rises to national governance infrastructure'.
steps_zh: 科学权威入世：诺奖/院士身份直接介入教育部/立法院/中研院治理，科学话语成政策话语
课程改革工程：高中"科学人文同重"、取消理工科死记硬背、引入探究式学习/跨域项目
科普立法与基建：《科普教育法》立法(2010)→全国科普馆网络/科学节/公民科学项目
研究治理透明化：中研院"卓越研究中心"竞争制/开放获取/伦理审查国际标准
科学外交与软实力：李远哲 ICSU/APEC/气候变化国际舞台，科学合作替代外交僵局
steps_en: Scientific authority entering world: Nobel/academician identity directly engages MOE/Legislature/Academia Sinica governance, scientific discourse becomes policy discourse
Curriculum reform engineering: high school 'science-humanities equal weight', eliminates STEM rote memorization, introduces inquiry-based learning/cross-domain projects
Science popularization legislation & infrastructure: Science Popularization Act (2010) -> national science museum network/science festivals/citizen science projects
Research governance transparency: Academia Sinica 'Excellence Centers' competition/open access/ethics review international standards
Science diplomacy & soft power: Lee at ICSU/APEC/climate international stages, scientific cooperation substitutes diplomatic deadlock
TW-EDU-001.expected_zh: 以"科学方法即公民权利、科教体制即治理基建"双重逻辑，实现从精英科学到全民科学素养的跨越，科教投入产出比长期全球前列。
TW-EDU-001.expected_en: Dual logic of 'scientific method = civic right, science-education system = governance infrastructure' achieves leap from elite science to universal scientific literacy, science-education ROI consistently global top tier.
TW-EDU-001.case_zh: 台湾 PISA 科学素养长期全球前 5；中研院 Nature Index 全球前 20；《科普教育法》成亚洲首部专法；李远哲 2008-2011 担任 ICSU 首位华人主席。
TW-EDU-001.case_en: Taiwan PISA scientific literacy consistently global top 5; Academia Sinica Nature Index global top 20; Science Popularization Act Asia's first special law; Lee Yuan-tseh 2008-2011 ICSU first Chinese president.
TW-EDU-001.intellectual_tradition: Taiwan Science Education Governance / Scientific Literacy National Policy
TW-EDU-001.cross_cultural_impact: East Asian science education reform reference; Nobel scientist in science policy model; science diplomacy for non-UN states
TW-EDU-001.colonial_history: Japanese rule 1895-1945 (modern science education introduced); KMT rule 1949-1987
TW-EDU-001.diaspora_influence: Taiwanese-American scientists in US academia/industry; global research networks
TW-EDU-001.indigenous_knowledge_system: Indigenous ecological knowledge integration in science curriculum (limited)

GE-STA-001.name_zh: 格鲁吉亚·斯大林：苏联化与格鲁吉亚本土化
GE-STA-001.description_zh: 约瑟夫·斯大林 (1878-1953) 生于格鲁吉亚哥里，作为苏联最高领导人推行全面苏联化政策，同时在格鲁吉亚实施本土化策略，培养格鲁吉亚籍干部，推广格鲁吉亚语言文化，形成独特的格鲁吉亚式斯大林主义。
GE-STA-001.description_en: Joseph Stalin (1878-1953) born in Gori, Georgia, as Soviet supreme leader implemented comprehensive Sovietization policies while pursuing indigenization in Georgia, cultivating Georgian cadres, promoting Georgian language and culture, creating a unique Georgian-style Stalinism.
GE-STA-001.reason_zh: 斯大林是格鲁吉亚裔苏联领袖，其统治展示了帝国中心与边缘民族地区的复杂互动，既是苏联化的推行者又是格鲁吉亚本土化的受益者，体现高加索地区在苏联体制中的特殊地位。
GE-STA-001.reason_en: Stalin as Georgian-origin Soviet leader demonstrates complex interaction between imperial center and peripheral ethnic regions - both driver of Sovietization and beneficiary of Georgian indigenization, embodying Caucasus special status in Soviet system.
steps_zh: 分析斯大林早年格鲁吉亚革命经历与马克思主义接受
研究1920s格鲁吉亚本土化政策与语言文化推广
探讨斯大林清洗中格鲁吉亚精英的命运
评估二战时期格鲁吉亚作为后方基地的贡献
总结斯大林死后格鲁吉亚去斯大林化与民族记忆
steps_en: Analyze Stalin early Georgian revolutionary experience and Marxist adoption
Study 1920s Georgian indigenization policies and language-culture promotion
Explore fate of Georgian elites during Stalin purges
Evaluate Georgia contribution as rear base during WWII
Summarize post-Stalin de-Stalinization in Georgia and ethnic memory
GE-STA-001.expected_zh: 理解斯大林作为格鲁吉亚裔苏联领袖的双重身份张力，掌握苏联化与本土化在高加索地区的辩证关系，评估其对后苏联时代格鲁吉亚民族认同的深远影响。
GE-STA-001.expected_en: Understand the dual identity tension of Stalin as Georgian-origin Soviet leader, grasp the dialectic of Sovietization and indigenization in the Caucasus, evaluate its profound impact on post-Soviet Georgian national identity.
GE-STA-001.case_zh: 1921 斯大林任格鲁吉亚事务人民委员，推行本土化；1930s 大清洗中格鲁吉亚精英大量遇害；1941-1945 格鲁吉亚作为苏联后方提供 70 万士兵；1953 斯大林死后格鲁吉亚爆发反苏示威。苏联化与本土化辩证张力永存。
GE-STA-001.case_en: 1921 Stalin as Peoples Commissar for Georgian Affairs promoted indigenization; 1930s Great Purge decimated Georgian elites; 1941-1945 Georgia as Soviet rear provided 700K soldiers; 1953 post-Stalin Georgia erupted in anti-Soviet protests. Sovietization-indigenization dialectical tension endures.
GE-STA-001.cross_cultural_impact: Sovietization driver; Georgian indigenization beneficiary; Caucasus special status in Soviet system

GE-PHI-001.name_zh: 格鲁吉亚·伊利亚恰瓦泽：民族精神重生
GE-PHI-001.description_zh: 伊利亚·恰瓦泽是格鲁吉亚民族觉醒运动的领袖、诗人、作家、政治家。他领导了19世纪格鲁吉亚的文化复兴运动，通过文学、教育和政治活动唤醒民族意识，反抗俄国殖民统治，为格鲁吉亚的独立奠定基础。
GE-PHI-001.description_en: Ilia Chavchavadze was a leader of the Georgian national awakening movement, poet, writer, and politician. He led the 19th-century Georgian cultural renaissance, awakening national consciousness through literature, education, and political activities, resisting Russian colonial rule and laying the foundation for Georgia independence.
GE-PHI-001.reason_zh: 代表高加索地区的民族觉醒，展示了正教文明圈在殖民压迫下的文化复兴路径，对格鲁吉亚和整个高加索地区的民族认同构建有深远影响。
GE-PHI-001.reason_en: Represents the national awakening in the Caucasus, demonstrating the path of cultural revival under colonial oppression in the Orthodox civilization sphere, with profound impact on national identity construction in Georgia and the entire Caucasus region.
steps_zh: 研究伊利亚·恰瓦泽的诗歌《英雄》《幽谷》和小说《强盗卡科》
分析其民族觉醒思想与东正教传统的对话
探讨19世纪高加索地区的民族复兴运动
评估其创办《伊韦利亚》杂志的文化影响
总结恰瓦泽思想在当代格鲁吉亚独立运动中的延续
steps_en: Study Ilia Chavchavadze poetry The Hero and The Valley and his novel Robber Kako
Analyze the dialogue between his national awakening thought and Orthodox tradition
Explore the national revival movement in the Caucasus in the 19th century
Evaluate the cultural impact of his founding of Iberia magazine
Summarize the continuity of Chavchavadze thought in the contemporary Georgian independence movement
GE-PHI-001.expected_zh: 掌握恰瓦泽的核心民族复兴思想，理解高加索地区民族觉醒的发展路径，评估其对格鲁吉亚民族认同构建和独立运动的历史影响。
GE-PHI-001.expected_en: Master Chavchavadze core national revival thought, understand the development path of national awakening in the Caucasus, and evaluate his historical impact on Georgian national identity construction and the independence movement.
GE-PHI-001.case_zh: 伊利亚·恰瓦泽在 1869 年创办《伊韦利亚》杂志，成为格鲁吉亚民族复兴运动的核心舆论阵地，通过文学、历史和文化研究唤醒民族意识，直接推动了格鲁吉亚的语言恢复和民族认同重构。
GE-PHI-001.case_en: In 1869, Ilia Chavchavadze founded Iberia magazine, becoming the core public opinion platform of the Georgian national revival movement. Through literature, history, and cultural studies, he awakened national consciousness, directly promoting the restoration of Georgian language and the reconstruction of national identity.
GE-PHI-001.cross_cultural_impact: Georgia national awakening leader, influenced Caucasus nationalism
GE-PHI-001.artistic_legacy: 是: 浪漫主义/民族文学

AM-EMP-001.name_zh: 亚美尼亚·提格兰大帝：帝国与罗马帕提亚博弈
AM-EMP-001.name_en: Armenia Tigranes the Great: Empire & Rome Parthia Game
AM-EMP-001.description_zh: 提格兰二世 (公元前95-前55) 亚美尼亚大帝，建立从里海到地中海的亚美尼亚帝国，在罗马与帕提亚两大帝国夹缝中通过外交与战争维持独立，推行希腊化文化融合政策。
AM-EMP-001.description_en: Tigranes II (95-55 BC) Armenian Great King, built Armenian Empire from Caspian to Mediterranean, maintained independence between Rome and Parthia through diplomacy and war, promoted Hellenistic cultural fusion policy.
AM-EMP-001.reason_zh: 提格兰大帝代表亚美尼亚历史上的帝国巅峰，展示了小国在大国博弈中通过外交平衡与文化融合生存发展的智慧，是高加索地区帝国建构的典范。
AM-EMP-001.reason_en: Tigranes the Great represents the imperial peak of Armenian history, demonstrating wisdom of small state survival through diplomatic balance and cultural fusion amid great power competition, a model of imperial construction in the Caucasus.
steps_zh: 研究提格兰大帝早年被帕提亚扣押与继位
分析其向西扩张吞并叙利亚腓尼基与迦基琉
探讨与米特拉达梯六世联姻对抗罗马
评估公元前69年蒂格拉诺采塔战役罗马卢库卢斯入侵
总结提格兰帝国在罗马帕提亚夹缝中的外交生存智慧
steps_en: Study Tigranes early Parthian hostage experience and accession
Analyze westward expansion annexing Syria Phoenicia and Cilicia
Explore marriage alliance with Mithridates VI against Rome
Evaluate 69 BC Battle of Tigranocerta Roman Lucullus invasion
Summarize Tigranes empire diplomatic survival wisdom between Rome Parthia
AM-EMP-001.expected_zh: 掌握提格兰大帝帝国建构与外交平衡策略，理解高加索小国在罗马帕提亚夹缝中的生存智慧，评估其对后世亚美尼亚民族认同的历史影响。
AM-EMP-001.expected_en: Master Tigranes imperial construction and diplomatic balance strategy, understand Caucasus small state survival wisdom between Rome Parthia, evaluate its historical impact on later Armenian national identity.
AM-EMP-001.case_zh: 公元前83年提格兰加冕亚美尼亚国王；公元前83-69年帝国扩张至地中海；公元前69年蒂格拉诺采塔战败；公元前66年向庞培投降保留核心领土。帝国外交平衡智慧永存。
AM-EMP-001.case_en: 83 BC Tigranes crowned Armenian King; 83-69 BC empire expanded to Mediterranean; 69 BC Tigranocerta defeat; 66 BC surrendered to Pompey retaining core territory. Imperial diplomatic balance wisdom endures.
AM-EMP-001.cross_cultural_impact: Armenian imperial peak; Rome-Parthia diplomatic balance; Hellenistic cultural fusion

AM-GEN-001.name_zh: 亚美尼亚·种族灭绝幸存记录者：记忆与流散
AM-GEN-001.name_en: Armenia Genocide Survivor Chronicler: Memory & Diaspora
AM-GEN-001.description_zh: 1915年亚美尼亚种族灭绝幸存者与记录者群体，通过回忆录、口述史、档案整理保存历史记忆，在流散中重建亚美尼亚民族认同，推动国际承认与正义。
AM-GEN-001.description_en: 1915 Armenian Genocide survivors and chroniclers, preserved historical memory through memoirs, oral history, archival work, rebuilt Armenian national identity in diaspora, pushed for international recognition and justice.
AM-GEN-001.reason_zh: 种族灭绝幸存记录者展示了创伤记忆如何转化为民族重建的精神资源，体现流散群体通过记忆传承维持民族连续性的核心机制。
AM-GEN-001.reason_en: Genocide survivor chroniclers demonstrate how traumatic memory transforms into spiritual resource for national reconstruction, embodying core mechanism of diaspora groups maintaining ethnic continuity through memory transmission.
steps_zh: 研究1915种族灭绝历史背景与奥斯曼帝国政策
分析幸存者回忆录与口述史收集整理过程
探讨流散社区在中东欧美建立记忆机构
评估国际承认运动与土耳其否认的博弈
总结记忆传承对当代亚美尼亚民族认同的塑造
steps_en: Study 1915 genocide historical context and Ottoman Empire policies
Analyze survivor memoirs and oral history collection process
Explore diaspora communities establishing memory institutions in Middle East Europe US
Evaluate international recognition movement and Turkish denial game
Summarize memory transmission shaping contemporary Armenian national identity
AM-GEN-001.expected_zh: 理解种族灭绝记忆如何成为民族重建核心资源，掌握流散群体记忆传承机制，评估其对国际人权法与种族灭绝预防的贡献。
AM-GEN-001.expected_en: Understand how genocide memory becomes core resource for national reconstruction, grasp diaspora memory transmission mechanism, evaluate its contribution to international human rights law and genocide prevention.
AM-GEN-001.case_zh: 1915 150万亚美尼亚人遇害；幸存者建立亚美尼亚革命联盟流亡政府；1965年叶里万建立种族灭绝纪念碑；2015年百年纪念全球承认。记忆传承重建民族认同永存。
AM-GEN-001.case_en: 1915 1.5M Armenians killed; survivors established ARF exile government; 1965 Yerevan genocide memorial built; 2015 centennial global recognition. Memory transmission rebuilding national identity endures.
AM-GEN-001.cross_cultural_impact: Genocide memory paradigm; diaspora identity reconstruction; international recognition movement

AZ-POL-001.name_zh: 阿塞拜疆·海达尔阿利耶夫：石油转型与世俗伊斯兰
AZ-POL-001.name_en: Azerbaijan Heydar Aliyev: Oil Transition & Secular Islam
AZ-POL-001.description_zh: 海达尔·阿利耶夫 (1923-2003) 阿塞拜疆前总统 (1993-2003)，克格勃高官出身，独立后通过石油外交平衡俄土伊美，建立世俗化国家模式，奠定阿塞拜疆能源大国地位，家族政治延续至今。
AZ-POL-001.description_en: Heydar Aliyev (1923-2003) Azerbaijan former President (1993-2003), KGB high official origin, post-independence balanced Russia Turkey Iran US through oil diplomacy, established secular state model, founded Azerbaijan energy power status, family politics continues today.
AZ-POL-001.reason_zh: 阿利耶夫代表后苏联空间能源型威权转型的典范，展示了伊斯兰国家如何通过石油财富实现世俗化现代化，同时在大国博弈中维持战略自主。
AZ-POL-001.reason_en: Aliyev represents post-Soviet energy authoritarian transition model, demonstrating how Islamic state achieves secular modernization through oil wealth while maintaining strategic autonomy in great power competition.
steps_zh: 研究阿利耶夫克格勃生涯与纳希切万自治共和国主席经历
分析1993年政变上台与纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫冻结冲突管理
探讨巴库-第比利斯-杰伊汉管道石油外交战略
评估世俗化宪法与伊斯兰传统平衡机制
总结阿利耶夫家族政治传承与伊利哈姆继任
steps_en: Study Aliyev KGB career and Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic Chairman experience
Analyze 1993 coup accession and Nagorno-Karabakh frozen conflict management
Explore Baku-Tbilisi-Ceyhan pipeline oil diplomacy strategy
Evaluate secular constitution and Islamic tradition balance mechanism
Summarize Aliyev family political succession and Ilham succession
AZ-POL-001.expected_zh: 掌握阿利耶夫石油外交与世俗化转型双重策略，理解后苏联伊斯兰国家在大国博弈中的生存路径，评估其对里海能源地缘政治的深远影响。
AZ-POL-001.expected_en: Master Aliyev oil diplomacy and secular transformation dual strategy, understand post-Soviet Islamic state survival path in great power competition, evaluate its profound impact on Caspian energy geopolitics.
AZ-POL-001.case_zh: 1993 阿利耶夫政变上台；1994 巴库-第比利斯-杰伊汉管道签署；2003 伊利哈姆继任总统；阿塞拜疆成为欧盟关键能源供应国。石油世俗外交范式永存。
AZ-POL-001.case_en: 1993 Aliyev coup accession; 1994 BTC pipeline signed; 2003 Ilham succeeded President; Azerbaijan became EU key energy supplier. Oil secular diplomacy paradigm endures.
AZ-POL-001.cross_cultural_impact: Energy diplomacy model; secular Islamic state; family politics succession

AZ-LIT-001.name_zh: 阿塞拜疆·尼扎米·甘加维：东方诗人与智慧爱情哲学
AZ-LIT-001.name_en: Azerbaijan Nizami Ganjavi: Oriental Poet Wisdom Love Philosophy
AZ-LIT-001.description_zh: 尼扎米·甘加维 (1141-1209) 波斯文学巨匠，生于甘贾，创作《五部诗集》包括《七美人》《莱莉与麦吉努》等，融合伊斯兰神秘主义、希腊哲学、印度智慧，奠定东方浪漫史诗传统。
AZ-LIT-001.description_en: Nizami Ganjavi (1141-1209) Persian literature master, born in Ganja, authored Khamsa including Haft Paykar and Layla Majnun, fused Islamic mysticism, Greek philosophy, Indian wisdom, founded Oriental romantic epic tradition.
AZ-LIT-001.reason_zh: 尼扎米代表中世纪伊斯兰世界文学巅峰，展示了跨文明智慧融合如何创造永恒文学典范，其作品超越民族宗教界限成为世界文学共同遗产。
AZ-LIT-001.reason_en: Nizami represents medieval Islamic world literary peak, demonstrating how cross-civilizational wisdom fusion creates timeless literary canon, his works transcending ethnic-religious boundaries becoming world literature common heritage.
steps_zh: 研究尼扎米生平与中世纪甘贾文化环境
分析《五部诗集》结构与寓言哲学内核
探讨《莱莉与麦吉努》神圣爱情与苏菲主义融合
评估《七美人》七公主故事政治智慧寓言
总结尼扎米对后世波斯乌尔都奥斯曼文学的影响
steps_en: Study Nizami life and medieval Ganja cultural environment
Analyze Khamsa structure and allegorical philosophy core
Explore Layla Majnun sacred love and Sufism fusion
Evaluate Haft Paykar seven princesses political wisdom allegory
Summarize Nizami influence on later Persian Urdu Ottoman literature
AZ-LIT-001.expected_zh: 掌握尼扎米诗歌哲学核心与跨文明智慧融合机制，理解东方浪漫史诗传统的奠基意义，评估其对世界文学爱情智慧母题的永恒贡献。
AZ-LIT-001.expected_en: Master Nizami poetic philosophy core and cross-civilizational wisdom fusion mechanism, understand Oriental romantic epic tradition founding significance, evaluate its eternal contribution to world literature love wisdom motifs.
AZ-LIT-001.case_zh: 1141 尼扎米生于甘贾；1170s 创作《宝藏》开篇；1188 《莱莉与麦吉努》完成；1209 逝世。东方诗人智慧爱情哲学永存。
AZ-LIT-001.case_en: 1141 Nizami born in Ganja; 1170s Makhzan al-Asrar begun; 1188 Layla Majnun completed; 1209 death. Oriental poet wisdom love philosophy endures.
AZ-LIT-001.cross_cultural_impact: Oriental romantic epic founder; cross-civilizational wisdom fusion; world literature heritage
AZ-LIT-001.artistic_legacy: 是: 古典波斯诗歌/浪漫史诗

MD-RES-001.name_zh: 摩尔多瓦·斯特凡大公：抵抗奥斯曼与瓦拉几亚独立
MD-RES-001.name_en: Moldova Stephen the Great: Resistance Ottoman & Wallachia Independence
MD-RES-001.description_zh: 斯特凡三世 (1433-1504) 摩尔多瓦大公 (1457-1504)，抵抗奥斯曼帝国扩张48年，瓦西卢伊战役大捷，与瓦拉几亚弗拉德三世联盟抗奥，被教皇誉为基督教运动员，奠定摩尔多瓦国家认同基础。
MD-RES-001.description_en: Stephen III (1433-1504) Moldavia Voivode (1457-1504), resisted Ottoman expansion 48 years, Vaslui battle victory, allied with Wallachia Vlad III against Ottomans, praised by Pope as Athlete of Christ, founded Moldovan national identity basis.
MD-RES-001.reason_zh: 斯特凡大公代表东欧小国在奥斯曼扩张期的军事抵抗与外交生存智慧，展示了正教文明圈如何通过战略联盟与战术创新维护独立。
MD-RES-001.reason_en: Stephen the Great represents Eastern European small state military resistance and diplomatic survival wisdom during Ottoman expansion, demonstrating how Orthodox civilization sphere maintains independence through strategic alliances and tactical innovation.
steps_zh: 研究斯特凡早年流亡与匈牙利瓦拉几亚支持上位
分析1475瓦西卢伊战役战术创新与奥斯曼主力歼灭
探讨与弗拉德采佩什联盟抗奥与背叛博弈
评估1484奇利亚切蒂阿特拉失守与向奥斯曼称臣
总结斯特凡基督教运动员称号与摩尔多瓦民族英雄地位
steps_en: Study Stephen early exile and Hungarian Wallachian support for accession
Analyze 1475 Vaslui battle tactical innovation and Ottoman main force annihilation
Explore alliance with Vlad Tepes against Ottomans and betrayal game
Evaluate 1484 Chilia Cetatea Alba loss and Ottoman suzerainty acceptance
Summarize Stephen Athlete of Christ title and Moldovan national hero status
MD-RES-001.expected_zh: 掌握斯特凡大公军事抵抗与外交生存双重策略，理解东欧小国在奥斯曼阴影下的独立智慧，评估其对罗马尼亚摩尔多瓦共同民族认同的奠基作用。
MD-RES-001.expected_en: Master Stephen military resistance and diplomatic survival dual strategy, understand Eastern European small state independence wisdom under Ottoman shadow, evaluate its foundational role for Romanian Moldovan shared national identity.
MD-RES-001.case_zh: 1457 斯特凡即位；1475 瓦西卢伊大捷；1484 向奥斯曼称臣保留自治；1504 逝世葬于普特纳修道院。抵抗奥斯曼独立智慧永存。
MD-RES-001.case_en: 1457 Stephen accession; 1475 Vaslui victory; 1484 accepted Ottoman suzerainty retaining autonomy; 1504 died buried at Putna Monastery. Resistance Ottoman independence wisdom endures.
MD-RES-001.cross_cultural_impact: Ottoman resistance model; Moldovan national identity founder; Athlete of Christ

RO-DIS-001.name_zh: 罗马尼亚·多伊娜·布鲁塞：知识分子异见与极权真理
RO-DIS-001.name_en: Romania Doina Braes: Intellectual Dissent & Totalitarian Truth
RO-DIS-001.description_zh: 多伊娜·布鲁塞 (1940-2018) 罗马尼亚异见知识分子，哲学教授，签署77年《人权宣言》被开除党籍，流亡法国继续揭露齐奥塞斯库暴行，回国后推动记忆与真相委员会建设。
RO-DIS-001.description_en: Doina Braes (1940-2018) Romanian dissident intellectual, philosophy professor, signed 1977 Human Rights Declaration expelled from Party, exiled France continued exposing Ceausescu atrocities, returned promoted memory and truth commission construction.
RO-DIS-001.reason_zh: 布鲁塞代表东欧极权体制下知识分子良知坚守与真理追寻，展示了异见者如何在监控社会中维护人性尊严，为后极权时代真相与和解奠基。
RO-DIS-001.reason_en: Braes represents Eastern European intellectual conscience坚守 and truth pursuit under totalitarianism, demonstrating how dissenters maintain human dignity in surveillance society, laying foundation for post-totalitarian truth and reconciliation.
steps_zh: 研究布鲁塞早年哲学教育与马克思主义人道主义
分析1977年签署人权宣言与党内开除经历
探讨法国流亡期揭露齐奥塞斯库体制暴行
评估1989革命后回国推动记忆真相委员会
总结异见知识分子良知传承与罗马尼亚转型正义
steps_en: Study Braes early philosophy education and Marxist humanism
Analyze 1977 Human Rights Declaration signing and Party expulsion
Explore France exile exposing Ceausescu regime atrocities
Evaluate 1989 post-revolution return promoting memory truth commission
Summarize dissident intellectual conscience transmission and Romanian transitional justice
RO-DIS-001.expected_zh: 理解极权体制下知识分子异见的道德代价与真理力量，掌握异见者生存策略与转型正义推动机制，评估其对东欧记忆政治的深远影响。
RO-DIS-001.expected_en: Understand moral cost of intellectual dissent under totalitarianism and truth power, grasp dissident survival strategy and transitional justice driving mechanism, evaluate its profound impact on Eastern European memory politics.
RO-DIS-001.case_zh: 1977 签署人权宣言被开除；1981 流亡法国；1989 革命回国；2000s 推动锡盖特纪念馆建设。知识分子异见极权真理永存。
RO-DIS-001.case_en: 1977 signed Human Rights Declaration expelled; 1981 exiled France; 1989 revolution returned; 2000s promoted Sighet Memorial construction. Intellectual dissent totalitarian truth endures.
RO-DIS-001.cross_cultural_impact: Dissident conscience model; transitional justice; memory politics

RO-FAS-001.name_zh: 罗马尼亚·科德雷亚努：铁卫团法西斯神秘正教青年
RO-FAS-001.name_en: Romania Corneliu Codreanu: Iron Guard Fascism Mysticism Orthodoxy Youth
RO-FAS-001.description_zh: 科内留·泽利亚·科德雷亚努 (1899-1938) 铁卫团创始人，融合法西斯主义、东正教神秘主义、反犹太主义、青年运动，建立死亡军团崇拜牺牲精神，1938年被卡罗尔二世枪杀，成为极右翼殉道符号。
RO-FAS-001.description_en: Corneliu Zelea Codreanu (1899-1938) Iron Guard founder, fused fascism, Orthodox mysticism, anti-Semitism, youth movement, built Death Legion cult of sacrifice, 1938 executed by Carol II, became far-right martyr symbol.
RO-FAS-001.reason_zh: 科德雷亚努代表战间期东欧法西斯主义的宗教化变体，展示了正教神秘主义如何与极右翼意识形态结合，产生独特的青年动员与牺牲崇拜模式。
RO-FAS-001.reason_en: Codreanu represents interwar Eastern European fascism religious variant, demonstrating how Orthodox mysticism fuses with far-right ideology creating unique youth mobilization and sacrifice cult pattern.
steps_zh: 研究科德雷亚努早年极右翼活动与铁卫团创建
分析正教神秘主义与法西斯仪式融合机制
探讨死亡军团牺牲崇拜与青年动员策略
评估1938年卡罗尔二世枪杀与殉道符号建构
总结铁卫团遗产在战后罗马尼亚极右翼复苏
steps_en: Study Codreanu early far-right activity and Iron Guard creation
Analyze Orthodox mysticism and fascist ritual fusion mechanism
Explore Death Legion sacrifice cult and youth mobilization strategy
Evaluate 1938 Carol II execution and martyr symbol construction
Summarize Iron Guard legacy in post-war Romanian far-right revival
RO-FAS-001.expected_zh: 理解宗教神秘主义如何为法西斯主义提供精神动力，掌握青年牺牲崇拜动员机制，评估其对当代东欧极右翼意识形态的历史渊源。
RO-FAS-001.expected_en: Understand how religious mysticism empowers fascism spiritually, grasp youth sacrifice cult mobilization mechanism, evaluate its historical roots for contemporary Eastern European far-right ideology.
RO-FAS-001.case_zh: 1927 铁卫团前身创建；1930 铁卫团正式成立；1938 科德雷亚努被枪杀；战后铁卫团地下抵抗共产主义。法西斯神秘正教青年永存。
RO-FAS-001.case_en: 1927 Iron Guard predecessor created; 1930 Iron Guard formally established; 1938 Codreanu executed; post-war Iron Guard underground resisted communism. Fascism mysticism orthodoxy youth endures.
RO-FAS-001.cross_cultural_impact: Religious fascism variant; youth sacrifice cult; far-right martyr symbol

RO-DIC-001.name_zh: 罗马尼亚·尼古拉·齐奥塞斯库：独裁体操与革命处决
RO-DIC-001.name_en: Romania Nicolae Ceausescu: Dictatorship Gymnastics & Revolution Execution
RO-DIC-001.description_zh: 尼古拉·齐奥塞斯库 (1918-1989) 罗马尼亚共产党总书记 (1965-1989)，建立个人崇拜与家族统治，推行体操外交展示国家形象，1989年革命中被速审枪决，结束东欧最后斯大林主义政权。
RO-DIC-001.description_en: Nicolae Ceausescu (1918-1989) Romanian Communist Party General Secretary (1965-1989), built personality cult and family rule, conducted gymnastics diplomacy showcasing national image, 1989 revolution tried and executed, ending Eastern Europe last Stalinist regime.
RO-DIC-001.reason_zh: 齐奥塞斯库代表东欧斯大林主义最极端形式，展示了个人崇拜、体操外交、秘密警察如何维系极权控制，其暴力倒台标志东欧剧变终局。
RO-DIC-001.reason_en: Ceausescu represents Eastern European Stalinism most extreme form, demonstrating how personality cult, gymnastics diplomacy, secret police maintain totalitarian control, his violent overthrow marked Eastern European revolutions finale.
steps_zh: 研究齐奥塞斯库早年共产党地下活动与格奥尔基乌-德治继任
分析个人崇拜体系与埃莱娜家族权力分配
探讨体操外交与纳迪亚·科马内奇国家形象建设
评估1989年蒂米什瓦拉爆发与布加勒斯特革命速审枪决
总结齐奥塞斯库遗产对罗马尼亚转型正义与记忆政治影响
steps_en: Study Ceausescu early Communist underground and Gheorghiu-Dej succession
Analyze personality cult system and Elena family power distribution
Explore gymnastics diplomacy and Nadia Comaneci national image building
Evaluate 1989 Timisoara outbreak and Bucharest revolution summary execution
Summarize Ceausescu legacy for Romanian transitional justice and memory politics
RO-DIC-001.expected_zh: 理解斯大林主义极权体制的内部运作逻辑与崩溃机制，掌握体操外交作为软实力工具的独特性，评估其对罗马尼亚后共产主义转型的深远创伤。
