RO-DIC-001.expected_en: Understand Stalinist totalitarian system internal logic and collapse mechanism, grasp gymnastics diplomacy uniqueness as soft power tool, evaluate its profound trauma for Romanian post-communist transition.
RO-DIC-001.case_zh: 1965 齐奥塞斯库掌权；1974 总统制确立；1989 12月革命爆发；12月25日布加勒斯特军事法庭速审枪决。独裁体操革命处决永存。
RO-DIC-001.case_en: 1965 Ceausescu took power; 1974 presidency established; 1989 Dec revolution erupted; Dec 25 Bucharest military tribunal summary execution. Dictatorship gymnastics revolution execution endures.
RO-DIC-001.cross_cultural_impact: Stalinism extreme form; gymnastics diplomacy; violent overthrow; transitional justice

KZ-NUC-001.name_zh: 哈萨克斯坦·纳扎尔巴耶夫：核放弃与首都迁移多楔外交
KZ-NUC-001.name_en: Kazakhstan Nazarbayev: Nuclear Abandonment & Capital Move Multi-Wedge Diplomacy
KZ-NUC-001.description_zh: 努尔苏丹·纳扎尔巴耶夫 (1940-2022) 哈萨克斯坦首任总统 (1990-2019)，继承世界第四大核武库，果断放弃核武器加入不扩散条约，迁都阿斯塔纳(努尔苏丹)，推行多楔外交平衡中俄美欧，建立稳定过渡模式。
KZ-NUC-001.description_en: Nursultan Nazarbayev (1940-2022) Kazakhstan first President (1990-2019), inherited world fourth largest nuclear arsenal, decisively abandoned nuclear weapons joined NPT, moved capital to Astana(Nur-Sultan), pursued multi-wedge diplomacy balancing China Russia US EU, established stable transition model.
KZ-NUC-001.reason_zh: 纳扎尔巴耶夫代表后苏联核国家无核化与和平权力交接的双重奇迹，展示了中亚大国如何通过核放弃换取国际地位、通过首都迁移重塑国家认同、通过多楔外交实现战略自主。
KZ-NUC-001.reason_en: Nazarbayev represents post-Soviet nuclear state denuclearization and peaceful power transition dual miracle, demonstrating how Central Asian great power achieves international status through nuclear abandonment, reshapes national identity through capital move, achieves strategic autonomy through multi-wedge diplomacy.
steps_zh: 研究纳扎尔巴耶夫早年冶金工人与苏共党内晋升
分析1991继承核武库与塞梅帕拉金斯克试验场关闭
探讨1994布达佩斯备忘录核放弃与安全保证
评估1997迁都阿斯塔纳与新首都象征意义
总结多楔外交平衡中俄美欧与2019和平交权托卡耶夫
steps_en: Study Nazarbayev early metallurgist and CPSU rise
Analyze 1991 nuclear arsenal inheritance and Semipalatinsk test site closure
Explore 1994 Budapest Memorandum nuclear abandonment and security assurances
Evaluate 1997 capital move to Astana and new capital symbolic meaning
Summarize multi-wedge diplomacy balancing China Russia US EU and 2019 peaceful handover to Tokayev
KZ-NUC-001.expected_zh: 掌握纳扎尔巴耶夫核放弃首都迁移多楔外交三重战略，理解后苏联核国家和平转型范式，评估其对中亚地缘政治稳定的核心贡献。
KZ-NUC-001.expected_en: Master Nazarbayev nuclear abandonment capital move multi-wedge diplomacy triple strategy, understand post-Soviet nuclear state peaceful transition paradigm, evaluate its core contribution to Central Asian geopolitical stability.
KZ-NUC-001.case_zh: 1991 继承1400枚核弹头；1994 布达佩斯备忘录放弃核武；1997 迁都阿斯塔纳；2019 和平交权。核放弃首都迁移多楔外交范式永存。
KZ-NUC-001.case_en: 1991 inherited 1400 nuclear warheads; 1994 Budapest Memorandum abandoned nukes; 1997 moved capital to Astana; 2019 peaceful handover. Nuclear abandonment capital move multi-wedge diplomacy paradigm endures.
KZ-NUC-001.cross_cultural_impact: Nuclear abandonment model; capital move symbolism; multi-wedge diplomacy; peaceful transition

KZ-PHI-001.name_zh: 哈萨克·阿拜·库南巴耶夫：草原哲学家与教育启蒙
KZ-PHI-001.name_en: Kazakh Abai Kunanbayev: Steppe Philosopher & Education Enlightenment
KZ-PHI-001.description_zh: 阿拜·库南巴耶夫 (1845-1904) 哈萨克伟大诗人、哲学家、教育家，创作《劝诫集》融合伊斯兰、儒家、俄国启蒙思想，推动哈萨克语言标准化、世俗教育普及，被誉为哈萨克民族精神之父。
KZ-PHI-001.description_en: Abai Kunanbayev (1845-1904) Kazakh great poet, philosopher, educator, authored Book of Words fusing Islamic, Confucian, Russian Enlightenment thought, promoted Kazakh language standardization, secular education popularization, hailed as father of Kazakh national spirit.
KZ-PHI-001.reason_zh: 阿拜代表草原文明向现代性转型的思想先驱，展示了游牧民族如何通过哲学反思与教育改革实现文化自觉与现代化转型，是中亚启蒙运动的灯塔。
KZ-PHI-001.reason_en: Abai represents steppe civilization transition to modernity intellectual pioneer, demonstrating how nomadic people achieve cultural self-awareness and modernization through philosophical reflection and education reform, a beacon of Central Asian Enlightenment.
steps_zh: 研究阿拜早年伊斯兰教育与俄国流亡接触启蒙思想
分析《劝诫集》融合伊斯兰儒家俄国启蒙三大传统
探讨阿拜推动哈萨克语标准化与阿拉伯字母改良
评估阿拜创办俄哈萨克语学校与世俗教育实践
总结阿拜思想对苏联时期哈萨克文化复兴与独立后民族建构的影响
steps_en: Study Abai early Islamic education and Russian exile contact with Enlightenment
Analyze Book of Words fusing Islamic Confucian Russian Enlightenment three traditions
Explore Abai promoting Kazakh language standardization and Arabic script reform
Evaluate Abai founding Russian-Kazakh schools and secular education practice
Summarize Abai thought impact on Soviet Kazakh cultural revival and post-independence nation-building
KZ-PHI-001.expected_zh: 掌握阿拜跨文明哲学融合与教育启蒙双重使命，理解游牧文明现代化转型的思想路径，评估其对哈萨克民族精神重塑的奠基作用。
KZ-PHI-001.expected_en: Master Abai cross-civilizational philosophical fusion and educational enlightenment dual mission, understand nomadic civilization modernization intellectual path, evaluate its foundational role in Kazakh national spirit reshaping.
KZ-PHI-001.case_zh: 1845 阿拜生于塞米巴拉金斯克；1880s 创作《劝诫集》；1904 逝世；1995 哈萨克斯坦设立阿拜纪念日。草原哲学家教育启蒙永存。
KZ-PHI-001.case_en: 1845 Abai born in Semipalatinsk; 1880s authored Book of Words; 1904 death; 1995 Kazakhstan established Abai Memorial Day. Steppe philosopher education enlightenment endures.
KZ-PHI-001.cross_cultural_impact: Kazakh language standardization; secular education; cross-civilizational synthesis
KZ-PHI-001.artistic_legacy: 是: 古典哈萨克诗歌/哲学散文

UZ-AUT-001.name_zh: 乌兹别克斯坦·卡里莫夫：铁腕棉花与水世俗治理
UZ-AUT-001.name_en: Uzbekistan Karimov: Iron Fist Cotton Water Secular Governance
UZ-AUT-001.description_zh: 伊斯拉姆·卡里莫夫 (1938-2016) 乌兹别克斯坦首任总统 (1991-2016)，以铁腕手段维持稳定，依靠棉花出口与水资源控制建立经济基础，推行世俗化压制伊斯兰激进主义，建立高度集权的后苏联治理模式。
UZ-AUT-001.description_en: Islam Karimov (1938-2016) Uzbekistan first President (1991-2016), maintained stability with iron fist, built economic base on cotton export and water control, enforced secularization suppressing Islamic radicalism, established highly centralized post-Soviet governance model.
UZ-AUT-001.reason_zh: 卡里莫夫代表后苏联中亚威权稳定模式，展示了资源型经济(棉花/水)如何支撑世俗独裁，同时在大国博弈中通过平衡外交维持战略自主。
UZ-AUT-001.reason_en: Karimov represents post-Soviet Central Asian authoritarian stability model, demonstrating how resource economy (cotton/water) supports secular dictatorship while maintaining strategic autonomy through balanced diplomacy in great power competition.
steps_zh: 研究卡里莫夫早年苏共机械工程师与党内晋升
分析1991独立后棉花单一经济与阿姆河锡尔河水资源控制
探讨安集延事件与伊斯兰激进主义镇压
评估世俗宪法与宗教事务委员会双重控制机制
总结2016逝世后米尔济约耶夫改革开放转型
steps_en: Study Karimov early Soviet mechanical engineer and Party rise
Analyze 1991 post-independence cotton mono-economy and Amu Darya Syr Darya water control
Explore Andijan events and Islamic radicalism suppression
Evaluate secular constitution and Religious Affairs Committee dual control mechanism
Summarize 2016 death and Mirziyoyev reform opening transition
UZ-AUT-001.expected_zh: 理解资源型威权如何通过世俗化实现稳定，掌握中亚水资源地缘政治博弈逻辑，评估卡里莫夫模式对后继者改革的制约与启示。
UZ-AUT-001.expected_en: Understand how resource authoritarianism achieves stability through secularization, grasp Central Asian water geopolitics logic, evaluate Karimov model constraints and lessons for successor reforms.
UZ-AUT-001.case_zh: 1991 卡里莫夫当选总统；1992 宪法确立世俗制；2005 安集延事件镇压；2016 逝世。铁腕棉花水世俗治理范式永存。
UZ-AUT-001.case_en: 1991 Karimov elected President; 1992 Constitution established secularism; 2005 Andijan events suppression; 2016 death. Iron fist cotton water secular governance paradigm endures.
UZ-AUT-001.cross_cultural_impact: Authoritarian stability model; cotton economy; water geopolitics; secularism enforcement

UZ-EMP-001.name_zh: 中亚·帖木儿：征服帝国与文化融合
UZ-EMP-001.name_en: Central Asia Timur: Conquest Empire & Cultural Fusion
UZ-EMP-001.description_zh: 帖木儿 (1336-1405) 帖木儿帝国建立者，以撒马尔罕为都，征服中东、南亚、高加索、伏尔加草原，建立跨越欧亚大陆帝国，同时推动伊斯兰建筑、天文学、波斯文学繁荣，形成独特的征服与文化融合双重遗产。
UZ-EMP-001.description_en: Timur (1336-1405) Timurid Empire founder, with Samarkand as capital, conquered Middle East, South Asia, Caucasus, Volga steppe, built trans-Eurasian empire, simultaneously promoted Islamic architecture, astronomy, Persian literature prosperity, forming unique conquest and cultural fusion dual legacy.
UZ-EMP-001.reason_zh: 帖木儿代表中亚游牧征服者向定居文明转型的巅峰，展示了军事征服如何与文化建设同步推进，其帝国虽短命但为后世莫卧儿帝国与乌兹别克汗国奠基。
UZ-EMP-001.reason_en: Timur represents Central Asian nomadic conqueror transition to settled civilization peak, demonstrating how military conquest advances simultaneously with cultural construction, his empire though short-lived founded later Mughal Empire and Uzbek Khanate.
steps_zh: 研究帖木儿早年巴尔拉斯部贵族与跛足传说
分析1370年库里台大会建立帝国与撒马尔罕建都
探讨征服德里苏丹国安纳托利亚奥斯曼与金帐汗国
评估帖木儿建筑风格与乌鲁格别克天文台科学遗产
总结帖木儿帝国分裂与后世莫卧儿乌兹别克双重传承
steps_en: Study Timur early Barlas tribe nobility and lameness legend
Analyze 1370 Kurultai conference established empire and Samarkand capital
Explore conquest of Delhi Sultanate Anatolia Ottomans and Golden Horde
Evaluate Timurid architecture and Ulugh Beg Observatory scientific legacy
Summarize Timurid empire fragmentation and later Mughal Uzbek dual inheritance
UZ-EMP-001.expected_zh: 理解征服者如何成为文化建设者，掌握中亚帝国建构的军事-文化双重逻辑，评估帖木儿对早期现代欧亚地缘政治的深远重塑。
UZ-EMP-001.expected_en: Understand how conqueror becomes culture builder, grasp Central Asian empire construction military-cultural dual logic, evaluate Timur profound reshaping of early modern Eurasian geopolitics.
UZ-EMP-001.case_zh: 1336 帖木儿生于沙赫里萨布兹；1370 称汗建都撒马尔罕；1405 远征中国途中逝世。征服帝国文化融合范式永存。
UZ-EMP-001.case_en: 1336 Timur born in Shakhrisabz; 1370 declared Khan capital Samarkand; 1405 died en route to China. Conquest empire cultural fusion paradigm endures.
UZ-EMP-001.cross_cultural_impact: Trans-Eurasian empire; Islamic architecture; astronomy; Mughal/Uzbek inheritance
UZ-EMP-001.artistic_legacy: 是: 帖木儿建筑/波斯细密画

KG-TUR-001.name_zh: 吉尔吉斯·阿拉马别科夫：图兰主义游牧与苏联独立
KG-TUR-001.name_en: Kyrgyz Atambayev: Turanism Nomadism & Soviet Independence
KG-TUR-001.description_zh: 阿拉马别科夫 (1956-) 吉尔吉斯斯坦总统 (2011-2017)，推行图兰主义泛突厥主义外交，平衡俄中美影响力，推动吉尔吉斯语言复兴与游牧文化传承，2017年和平交权打破中亚终身制惯例。
KG-TUR-001.description_en: Almazbek Atambayev (1956-) Kyrgyzstan President (2011-2017), pursued Turanism pan-Turkic diplomacy, balanced Russia China US influence, promoted Kyrgyz language revival and nomadic culture transmission, 2017 peaceful handover broke Central Asian lifetime rule precedent.
KG-TUR-001.reason_zh: 阿拉马别科夫代表后苏联中亚民主转型的罕见案例，展示了小国如何通过泛突厥身份外交与游牧文化复兴实现战略自主，同时实现权力和平交接。
KG-TUR-001.reason_en: Atambayev represents rare post-Soviet Central Asian democratic transition case, demonstrating how small state achieves strategic autonomy through pan-Turkic identity diplomacy and nomadic culture revival while achieving peaceful power transfer.
steps_zh: 研究阿拉马别科夫早年苏联经济官僚与反对派领袖经历
分析2010年革命上台与图兰主义外交战略
探讨马纳斯机场美军基地关闭与俄罗斯关系重塑
评估吉尔吉斯语复兴与游牧文化节庆制度化
总结2017年和平交权热恩别科夫与后续政治博弈
steps_en: Study Atambayev early Soviet economic bureaucrat and opposition leader experience
Analyze 2010 revolution accession and Turanism diplomacy strategy
Explore Manas Airport US base closure and Russia relationship reset
Evaluate Kyrgyz language revival and nomadic culture festival institutionalization
Summarize 2017 peaceful handover to Jeenbekov and subsequent political game
KG-TUR-001.expected_zh: 掌握图兰主义外交与游牧文化复兴双重战略，理解中亚小国民主转型的艰难与可能性，评估和平交权对中亚政治文化的破冲意义。
KG-TUR-001.expected_en: Master Turanism diplomacy and nomadic culture revival dual strategy, understand Central Asian small state democratic transition difficulty and possibility, evaluate peaceful handover breakthrough significance for Central Asian political culture.
KG-TUR-001.case_zh: 2010 革命上台；2011 当选总统；2014 关闭马纳斯美军基地；2017 和平交权。图兰主义游牧苏联独立范式永存。
KG-TUR-001.case_en: 2010 revolution accession; 2011 elected President; 2014 closed Manas US base; 2017 peaceful handover. Turanism nomadism Soviet independence paradigm endures.
KG-TUR-001.cross_cultural_impact: Democratic transition model; pan-Turkic diplomacy; nomadic culture; peaceful handover

KG-EPI-001.name_zh: 吉尔吉斯·玛纳斯史诗：口述英雄与统一
KG-EPI-001.name_en: Kyrgyz Manas Epic: Oral Hero & Unification
KG-EPI-001.description_zh: 《玛纳斯》史诗是吉尔吉斯民族宏大口述史诗，讲述英雄玛纳斯统一四十部落、抗击卡尔吕克外敌、建立吉尔吉斯汗国的传奇，通过玛纳斯奇(说唱艺人)代际口述传承，成为吉尔吉斯民族认同核心与文化基因。
KG-EPI-001.description_en: Manas Epic is Kyrgyz grand oral epic, narrates hero Manas uniting forty tribes, resisting Karluk foreign enemies, establishing Kyrgyz Khanate legend, transmitted intergenerationally through Manaschi(reciters), becoming Kyrgyz national identity core and cultural gene.
KG-EPI-001.reason_zh: 玛纳斯史诗代表游牧民族口述传统的巅峰，展示了没有文字记录的民族如何通过口述表演维持历史记忆、民族认同与文化连续性，是联合国非遗代表作。
KG-EPI-001.reason_en: Manas Epic represents nomadic oral tradition peak, demonstrating how peoples without written records maintain historical memory, ethnic identity and cultural continuity through oral performance, a UNESCO Intangible Heritage masterpiece.
steps_zh: 研究玛纳斯史诗八万行规模与三部曲结构(玛纳斯、塞梅泰、塞耶特)
分析玛纳斯奇说唱艺人代际传承与即兴创作机制
探讨史诗中游牧法制、婚姻习俗、部落政治的完整呈现
评估苏联时期史诗民族主义化与独立后国家象征建构
总结玛纳斯史诗对吉尔吉斯语言标准化与民族认同的奠基作用
steps_en: Study Manas Epic 80000 lines scale and trilogy structure (Manas, Semetey, Seytek)
Analyze Manaschi reciter intergenerational transmission and improvisational creation mechanism
Explore epic presentation of nomadic law, marriage customs, tribal politics
Evaluate Soviet period epic nationalization and post-independence state symbol construction
Summarize Manas Epic foundational role in Kyrgyz language standardization and national identity
KG-EPI-001.expected_zh: 理解口述传统如何承载民族历史记忆与政治智慧，掌握非物质文化遗产活态传承机制，评估玛纳斯史诗对中亚游牧文明现代性转型的文化支撑。
KG-EPI-001.expected_en: Understand how oral tradition carries national historical memory and political wisdom, grasp living intangible heritage transmission mechanism, evaluate Manas Epic cultural support for Central Asian nomadic civilization modernity transition.
KG-EPI-001.case_zh: 玛纳斯史诗八万行三部曲；玛纳斯奇代际口述传承；2009 列入联合国非遗；2017 吉尔吉斯斯坦建立玛纳斯研究院。口述英雄统一范式永存。
KG-EPI-001.case_en: Manas Epic 80000 lines trilogy; Manaschi intergenerational oral transmission; 2009 UNESCO Intangible Heritage; 2017 Kyrgyzstan established Manas Institute. Oral hero unification paradigm endures.
KG-EPI-001.cross_cultural_impact: Oral tradition peak; UNESCO heritage; nomadic law; national identity gene
KG-EPI-001.artistic_legacy: 是: 口述史诗/说唱艺术

TJ-CIV-001.name_zh: 塔吉克·拉赫蒙：内战与波斯认同水资源博弈
TJ-CIV-001.name_en: Tajikistan Rahmon: Civil War & Persian Identity Water Resource Game
TJ-CIV-001.description_zh: 埃莫马利·拉赫蒙 (1952-) 塔吉克斯坦总统 (1994-)，1992-1997年塔吉克内战幸存者，重建国家统一，推行波斯语言文化复兴确立区别于乌兹别克的民族认同，在阿姆河流域水资源博弈中捍卫上游国家权益。
TJ-CIV-001.description_en: Emomali Rahmon (1952-) Tajikistan President (1994-), 1992-1997 Tajik civil war survivor, rebuilt national unity, promoted Persian language culture revival establishing distinct national identity from Uzbekistan, defended upstream country rights in Amu Darya water resource competition.
TJ-CIV-001.reason_zh: 拉赫蒙代表后苏联中亚内战幸存与民族重建的双重挑战，展示了波斯语系小国如何在突厥语系主导区域通过语言文化复兴确立主体性，同时在水资源地缘政治中捍卫生存权益。
TJ-CIV-001.reason_en: Rahmon represents post-Soviet Central Asian civil war survival and national reconstruction dual challenge, demonstrating how Persian-language small nation establishes subjectivity through language-culture revival in Turkic-dominated region while defending survival rights in water geopolitics.
steps_zh: 研究拉赫蒙早年集体农庄主席与内战期间生存
分析1997年和平协议签署与国家统一重建
探讨波斯语复兴与阿拉伯字母恢复尝试
评估罗贡水电站与阿姆河水资源外交博弈
总结拉赫蒙长期执政与家族政治化治理模式
steps_en: Study Rahmon early collective farm chairman and civil war survival
Analyze 1997 peace agreement signing and national unity reconstruction
Explore Persian language revival and Arabic script restoration attempt
Evaluate Rogun Dam and Amu Darya water diplomacy game
Summarize Rahmon long-term rule and family politicized governance model
TJ-CIV-001.expected_zh: 掌握内战后民族重建与波斯认同复兴双重路径，理解中亚水资源地缘政治上下游博弈逻辑，评估拉赫蒙模式对塔吉克长期稳定的贡献与代价。
TJ-CIV-001.expected_en: Master post-civil war national reconstruction and Persian identity revival dual path, understand Central Asian water geopolitics upstream-downstream game logic, evaluate Rahmon model contributions and costs for Tajik long-term stability.
TJ-CIV-001.case_zh: 1992-1997 内战10万人亡；1997 和平协议；波斯语官方语言地位；罗贡水电站建设。内战波斯认同水博弈范式永存。
TJ-CIV-001.case_en: 1992-1997 civil war 100K dead; 1997 peace agreement; Persian official language status; Rogun Dam construction. Civil war Persian identity water game paradigm endures.
TJ-CIV-001.cross_cultural_impact: Civil war survival; Persian identity revival; water diplomacy; upstream rights

TJ-POE-001.name_zh: 塔吉克·鲁达基：波斯诗歌之父与宫廷语言
TJ-POE-001.name_en: Tajik Rudaki: Father of Persian Poetry & Court Language
TJ-POE-001.description_zh: 鲁达基 (约858-941) 被誉为波斯诗歌之父，萨曼王朝宫廷诗人，确立了新波斯语诗歌格律与主题，将阿拉伯字母书写的新波斯语确立为宫廷行政与文学语言，为后世菲尔多西、哈菲兹、萨迪奠基。
TJ-POE-001.description_en: Rudaki (c.858-941) hailed as father of Persian poetry, Samanid court poet, established New Persian poetry meter and themes, established Arabic-script New Persian as court administrative and literary language, laid foundation for later Ferdowsi, Hafez, Sadi.
TJ-POE-001.reason_zh: 鲁达基代表伊斯兰黄金时代波斯语文学复兴的奠基者，展示了被阿拉伯化征服的波斯文化如何通过诗歌语言重建民族认同，是整个波斯语文化圈的共同始祖。
TJ-POE-001.reason_en: Rudaki represents Islamic Golden Age Persian literary revival founder, demonstrating how Persian culture Arabized conquest rebuilt national identity through poetic language, the common ancestor of entire Persianate cultural sphere.
steps_zh: 研究鲁达基早年生活与萨曼王朝布哈拉宫廷环境
分析鲁达基确立新波斯语诗歌格律(马斯纳维、加扎勒、鲁拜)
探讨鲁达基将新波斯语从口语推向宫廷行政书面语
评估鲁达基失明后口述创作与《鲁达基诗集》编纂
总结鲁达基对菲尔多西《列王纪》、哈菲兹抒情诗的奠基影响
steps_en: Study Rudaki early life and Samanid Bukhara court environment
Analyze Rudaki establishing New Persian poetry meters (masnavi, ghazal, rubai)
Explore Rudaki elevating New Persian from vernacular to court administrative written language
Evaluate Rudaki blind oral composition and Diwan compilation
Summarize Rudaki foundational influence on Ferdowsi Shahnameh and Hafez lyric poetry
TJ-POE-001.expected_zh: 掌握鲁达基波斯语诗歌格律奠基与宫廷语言确立双重使命，理解被征服文化如何通过语言艺术实现精神解放，评估其对中亚波斯语文明千年传承的决定性贡献。
TJ-POE-001.expected_en: Master Rudaki Persian poetry meter foundation and court language establishment dual mission, understand how conquered culture achieves spiritual liberation through language art, evaluate its decisive contribution to millennium Persianate civilization transmission.
TJ-POE-001.case_zh: 约858 鲁达基生于潘吉肯特；900s 萨曼宫廷诗人；941 逝世。波斯诗歌之父宫廷语言范式永存。
TJ-POE-001.case_en: c.858 Rudaki born in Panjakent; 900s Samanid court poet; 941 death. Father of Persian poetry court language paradigm endures.
TJ-POE-001.cross_cultural_impact: Persian poetry meter founder; court language; Ferdowsi/Hafez ancestor
TJ-POE-001.artistic_legacy: 是: 古典波斯诗歌/格律奠基

TM-POE-001.name_zh: 土库曼·马格特姆古里：土库曼诗歌精神抵抗与统一
TM-POE-001.name_en: Turkmen Magtymguly: Turkmen Poetry Spirit Resistance & Unification
TM-POE-001.description_zh: 马格特姆古里·弗拉吉 (1724-1807) 土库曼民族诗人、苏菲哲学家，用查加台土库曼语创作抒情诗，表达对土库曼部落分裂的痛苦、对统一独立的渴望、对苏菲神秘真理的追寻，成为土库曼民族精神图腾与语言标准化奠基者。
TM-POE-001.description_en: Magtymguly Pyragy (1724-1807) Turkmen national poet, Sufi philosopher, composed lyric poetry in Chagatai Turkmen, expressed pain of Turkmen tribal fragmentation, longing for unification and independence, pursuit of Sufi mystical truth, becoming Turkmen national spiritual totem and language standardization founder.
TM-POE-001.reason_zh: 马格特姆古里代表中亚游牧部落文化向现代民族认同转型的精神先驱，展示了分裂部落如何通过共同诗歌语言构想统一民族共同体，是土库曼斯坦建国精神之父。
TM-POE-001.reason_en: Magtymguly represents Central Asian nomadic tribal culture transition to modern national identity spiritual pioneer, demonstrating how fragmented tribes construct unified imagined community through shared poetic language, the spiritual father of Turkmenistan founding.
steps_zh: 研究马格特姆古里早年伊斯兰教育与游历波斯奥斯曼俄国
分析其诗歌融合苏菲神秘主义与土库曼部落现实批判
探讨土库曼语语言标准化与阿拉伯字母适应过程
评估苏联时期马格特姆古里民族化改造与独立后国家象征
总结马格特姆古里对土库曼斯坦语言文字与民族认同的奠基
steps_en: Study Magtymguly early Islamic education and travels to Persia Ottoman Russia
Analyze his poetry fusing Sufi mysticism and Turkmen tribal reality critique
Explore Turkmen language standardization and Arabic script adaptation
Evaluate Soviet period Magtymguly nationalization and post-independence state symbol
Summarize Magtymguly foundational role in Turkmenistan language script and national identity
TM-POE-001.expected_zh: 掌握马格特姆古里苏菲诗歌与民族统一渴望双重内核，理解分裂游牧部落如何通过共同文学语言构建想象共同体，评估其对土库曼斯坦建国精神的永恒支撑。
TM-POE-001.expected_en: Master Magtymguly Sufi poetry and national unification longing dual core, understand how fragmented nomadic tribes build imagined community through shared literary language, evaluate its eternal support for Turkmenistan founding spirit.
TM-POE-001.case_zh: 1724 马格特姆古里生于哈杰雷；1770s 创作巅峰；1807 逝世。土库曼诗歌精神抵抗统一范式永存。
TM-POE-001.case_en: 1724 Magtymguly born in Hajji Qarah; 1770s creative peak; 1807 death. Turkmen poetry spirit resistance unification paradigm endures.
TM-POE-001.cross_cultural_impact: Turkmen language founder; Sufi mysticism; national unification spirit; spiritual totem
TM-POE-001.artistic_legacy: 是: 古典土库曼诗歌/苏菲抒情

TH-REF-001.name_zh: 泰国·拉玛五世朱拉隆功：奴隶废除与现代化改革
TH-REF-001.name_en: Thailand Rama V Chulalongkorn: Slavery Abolition & Modernization Reform
TH-REF-001.description_zh: 朱拉隆功 (1853-1910) 暹罗拉玛五世 (1868-1910)，废除奴隶制、腓特列制度，推行行政、法律、教育、铁路现代化，以灵活外交避免殖民，奠定泰国现代国家基础。
TH-REF-001.description_en: Chulalongkorn (1853-1910) Siam Rama V (1868-1910), abolished slavery and corvee, implemented administrative legal education railway modernization, avoided colonization through flexible diplomacy, laid modern Thai state foundation.
TH-REF-001.reason_zh: 朱拉隆功代表东南亚唯一未被殖民国家的现代化转型典范，展示了绝对君主如何通过自上而下改革实现国家主权保全与现代化双重目标。
TH-REF-001.reason_en: Chulalongkorn represents Southeast Asia only uncolonized nation modernization paradigm, demonstrating how absolute monarch achieves both sovereignty preservation and modernization through top-down reform.
steps_zh: 研究朱拉隆功早年蒙库特王父改革遗产与摄政期
分析1874废除腓特列与1905废除奴隶制渐进路径
探讨月圈改革行政划分与法律法典编纂
评估铁路建设与曼谷城市化现代化
总结灵活外交周旋英法殖民势力保全主权
steps_en: Study Chulalongkorn early Mongkut father reform legacy and regency
Analyze 1874 corvee abolition and 1905 slavery abolition gradual path
Explore Monthon reform administrative division and legal code compilation
Evaluate railway construction and Bangkok urbanization modernization
Summarize flexible diplomacy maneuvering British French colonial powers preserving sovereignty
TH-REF-001.expected_zh: 掌握朱拉隆功渐进改革与外交平衡双重策略，理解东南亚唯一独立国家现代化路径，评估其对当代泰国国家建构的奠基作用。
TH-REF-001.expected_en: Master Chulalongkorn gradual reform and diplomatic balance dual strategy, understand Southeast Asia only independent nation modernization path, evaluate its foundational role for contemporary Thai state construction.
TH-REF-001.case_zh: 1868 即位；1874 废除腓特列；1905 废除奴隶制；1910 逝世。奴隶废除现代化改革范式永存。
TH-REF-001.case_en: 1868 accession; 1874 corvee abolished; 1905 slavery abolished; 1910 death. Slavery abolition modernization paradigm endures.
TH-REF-001.cross_cultural_impact: Uncolonized modernization model; slavery abolition; railway; legal reform

TH-UPR-001.name_zh: 泰国·披耶·巴玛：学生起义与民主军事循环
TH-UPR-001.name_en: Thailand Phibun: Student Uprising & Democracy Military Cycle
TH-UPR-001.description_zh: 披耶·巴玛 (1897-1964) 泰国元帅总理 (1938-1944, 1948-1957)，1932年推翻绝对君主制建立立宪君主制，二战亲日倒向盟友，战后美国支持反共独裁，1973/1992学生起义推翻军政府，民主-军事循环至今。
TH-UPR-001.description_en: Phibun Phahon (1897-1964) Thailand Field Marshal PM (1938-1944, 1948-1957), 1932 overthrew absolute monarchy established constitutional monarchy, WWII pro-Japan then switched to Allies, post-war US-backed anti-communist dictatorship, 1973/1992 student uprisings overthrew military juntas, democracy-military cycle continues.
TH-UPR-001.reason_zh: 披耶代表泰国民主-军事循环的核心人物，展示了立宪君主制如何在军人政治、学生运动、美苏冷战博弈中反复震荡，至今未形成稳定民主巩固机制。
TH-UPR-001.reason_en: Phibun represents Thailand democracy-military cycle core figure, demonstrating how constitutional monarchy oscillates among military politics, student movements, US-Soviet Cold War competition, still lacking stable democratic consolidation mechanism today.
steps_zh: 研究披耶早年军官与1932年立宪革命领袖角色
分析1938-1944首相期亲日政策与泰国收复领土
探讨1947年政变回归与美国反共军事援助
评估1957年萨立特政变下台与1973/1992学生起义循环
总结泰国民主军事循环至今未解的结构性困境
steps_en: Study Phibun early officer and 1932 constitutional revolution leader role
Analyze 1938-1944 PM pro-Japan policy and Thailand territorial recovery
Explore 1947 coup return and US anti-communist military aid
Evaluate 1957 Sarit coup ousting and 1973/1992 student uprising cycle
Summarize Thailand democracy-military cycle structural dilemma unresolved today
TH-UPR-001.expected_zh: 理解泰国立宪君主制下军人政治与学生民主运动的反复博弈，掌握冷战地缘政治对东南亚民主化进程的深度塑造，评估泰国民主巩固的根本障碍。
TH-UPR-001.expected_en: Understand Thai constitutional monarchy military politics and student democratic movement repeated game, grasp Cold War geopolitics deep shaping of Southeast Asian democratization, evaluate Thailand democratic consolidation fundamental obstacles.
TH-UPR-001.case_zh: 1932 立宪革命；1938 首相；1944 辞职；1948 再任；1957 下台；1973/1992 学生起义循环。民主军事循环范式永存。
TH-UPR-001.case_en: 1932 constitutional revolution; 1938 PM; 1944 resigned; 1948 re-PM; 1957 ousted; 1973/1992 student uprising cycle. Democracy military cycle paradigm endures.
TH-UPR-001.cross_cultural_impact: Democracy-military cycle; constitutional monarchy; student uprisings; Cold War proxy

MY-DEV-001.name_zh: 马来西亚·马哈蒂尔：发展主义与多元种族治理
MY-DEV-001.description_zh: 马哈蒂尔·莫哈末 (1925-2024) 马来西亚第四/七任首相 (1981-2003, 2018-2020)，推行"向东看"工业化、多媒体超级走廊、双峰塔建设，实施土著优惠政策平衡种族关系，22年执政创造亚洲四小虎奇迹。
MY-DEV-001.description_en: Mahathir Mohamad (1925-2024) Malaysia 4th/7th PM (1981-2003, 2018-2020), implemented Look East industrialization, Multimedia Super Corridor, Petronas Towers, Bumiputera affirmative action balancing racial relations, 22-year rule created Asian Tiger miracle.
MY-DEV-001.reason_zh: 马哈蒂尔代表后殖民多种族国家通过发展主义实现种族平衡与经济腾飞的典范，展示了威权发展主义如何在多元社会中维持稳定与增长，其眼镜标志性形象象征务实理性。
MY-DEV-001.reason_en: Mahathir represents post-colonial multiracial nation achieving racial balance and economic takeoff through developmentalism, demonstrating how authoritarian developmentalism maintains stability and growth in diverse society, his iconic glasses symbolizing pragmatic rationality.
steps_zh: 研究马哈蒂尔早年医生与马来亚大学学生运动
分析1981年上台与向东看工业化战略
探讨土著优惠政策与华商资本合作共生机制
评估1997亚洲金融风暴拒绝IMF方案自主应对
总结1998安华事件与2018年93岁二度上台创纪录
steps_en: Study Mahathir early doctor and UM student activism
Analyze 1981 accession and Look East industrialization strategy
Explore Bumiputera affirmative action and Chinese capital symbiosis mechanism
Evaluate 1997 Asian financial crisis IMF rejection autonomous response
Summarize 1998 Anwar affair and 2018 93-year-old second term record
MY-DEV-001.expected_zh: 掌握马哈蒂尔发展主义与种族平衡双重治理艺术，理解后殖民多元社会经济腾飞与社会稳定的辩证关系，评估其对东南亚发展模式的深远影响。
MY-DEV-001.expected_en: Master Mahathir developmentalism and racial balance dual governance art, understand post-colonial diverse society economic takeoff and social stability dialectic, evaluate its profound impact on Southeast Asian development model.
MY-DEV-001.case_zh: 1981 首相；1982 向东看；1996 双峰塔；1997 拒绝IMF；2003 交权；2018 二度上台；2024 逝世。发展主义多元眼镜长寿范式永存。
MY-DEV-001.case_en: 1981 PM; 1982 Look East; 1996 Petronas Towers; 1997 rejected IMF; 2003 handover; 2018 second term; 2024 death. Developmentalism diversity glasses longevity paradigm endures.
MY-DEV-001.cross_cultural_impact: Developmentalism model; racial affirmative action; Asian financial crisis; longevity record

MY-IND-001.name_zh: 马来亚·东姑阿都拉曼：温和独立与联邦种族平衡
MY-IND-001.name_en: Malaya Tunku Abdul Rahman: Moderate Independence & Federal Racial Balance
MY-IND-001.description_zh: 东姑阿都拉曼 (1903-1990) 马来亚首任首相 (1957-1970)，通过谈判而非武装斗争实现独立，建立马来西亚联邦(1963)，设计种族平衡宪法(马来特权/华印公民权)，被誉为独立之父。
MY-IND-001.description_en: Tunku Abdul Rahman (1903-1990) Malaya first PM (1957-1970), achieved independence through negotiation not armed struggle, established Malaysia Federation (1963), designed racial balance constitution (Malay privileges/Chinese Indian citizenship), hailed as Father of Independence.
MY-IND-001.reason_zh: 东姑代表东南亚温和过渡独立的典范，展示了精英协商如何在多种族社会中建立权力分享契约，避免了印尼越南式暴力独立代价，奠定马来西亚联邦制基础。
MY-IND-001.reason_en: Tunku represents Southeast Asia moderate transition independence paradigm, demonstrating how elite negotiation builds power-sharing compact in multiracial society, avoiding Indonesia/Vietnam violent independence costs, laying Malaysia federal foundation.
steps_zh: 研究东姑早年王室背景与英国教育精英路径
分析1955年大选胜利与1957年独立谈判
探讨1963年马来西亚联邦成立与新加坡分离(1965)
评估种族暴乱(1969)与东姑下台权力交接
总结温和独立联邦种族平衡模式对东南亚的示范意义
steps_en: Study Tunku early royal background and British education elite path
Analyze 1955 election victory and 1957 independence negotiation
Explore 1963 Malaysia Federation formation and Singapore separation (1965)
Evaluate 1969 racial riots and Tunku resignation power transfer
Summarize moderate independence federal racial balance model demonstration for Southeast Asia
MY-IND-001.expected_zh: 理解精英协商独立如何构建多种族权力分享契约，掌握联邦制与种族平衡宪法设计的核心逻辑，评估其对马来西亚长期稳定的奠基与局限。
MY-IND-001.expected_en: Understand how negotiated independence builds multiracial power-sharing compact, grasp federalism and racial balance constitutional design core logic, evaluate its foundational role and limits for Malaysia long-term stability.
MY-IND-001.case_zh: 1955 大选胜利；1957 独立；1963 联邦成立；1965 新加坡分离；1970 下台。温和独立联邦种族平衡范式永存。
MY-IND-001.case_en: 1955 election win; 1957 independence; 1963 Federation formed; 1965 Singapore separation; 1970 resignation. Moderate independence federal racial balance paradigm endures.
MY-IND-001.cross_cultural_impact: Negotiated independence; federalism; racial balance; Singapore separation

MM-IND-001.name_zh: 缅甸·昂山：独立将军与女儿民主军事张力
MM-IND-001.name_en: Myanmar Aung San: Independence General & Daughter Democracy Military Tension
MM-IND-001.description_zh: 昂山 (1915-1947) 缅甸独立之父，三十同志创始人，二战初期与日军合作后倒向英军，1947年庞隆协议实现少数民族联邦，同年遇刺，女儿昂山素季继承民主事业与军政府博弈三十年。
MM-IND-001.description_en: Aung San (1915-1947) Myanmar independence father, Thirty Comrades founder, initially cooperated with Japanese then switched to British, 1947 Panglong Agreement achieved ethnic federalism, assassinated same year, daughter Aung San Suu Kyi inherited democracy cause wrestling with military junta for thirty years.
MM-IND-001.reason_zh: 昂山代表缅甸独立与联邦建构的双重未竟事业，展示了少数民族联邦制如何在军人政治、意识形态分裂、外部干预中反复破裂，父女两代悲剧折射缅甸国家建构核心困境。
MM-IND-001.reason_en: Aung San represents Myanmar independence and federal construction dual unfinished business, demonstrating how ethnic federalism fractures repeatedly amid military politics, ideological division, external intervention, father-daughter dual tragedy reflecting Myanmar state-building core dilemma.
steps_zh: 研究昂山早年学生领袖与三十同志日本军官训练
分析1945年反法西斯人民自由同盟倒向英军
探讨1947年庞隆协议少数民族联邦构想与遇刺
评估昂山素季继承遗产与1988/2021军政府对抗
总结父女两代独立将军女儿民主军事张力的历史宿命
steps_en: Study Aung San early student leader and Thirty Comrades Japanese officer training
Analyze 1945 Anti-Fascist Peoples Freedom League switch to British
Explore 1947 Panglong Agreement ethnic federalism vision and assassination
Evaluate Aung San Suu Kyi inheritance and 1988/2021 military junta confrontation
Summarize father-daughter independence general daughter democracy military tension historical destiny
MM-IND-001.expected_zh: 理解缅甸少数民族联邦制为何在军人政治中反复破裂，掌握独立领袖遗产如何在女儿身上转化为民主符号与军政府攻击靶子，评估缅甸联邦民主化的根本障碍。
MM-IND-001.expected_en: Understand why Myanmar ethnic federalism repeatedly fractures under military politics, grasp how independence leader legacy transforms into democracy symbol and military junta target on daughter, evaluate Myanmar federal democratization fundamental obstacles.
MM-IND-001.case_zh: 1941 三十同志；1945 倒向英军；1947 庞隆协议/遇刺；1988 素季领导起义；2021 政变入狱。独立将军女儿民主军事范式永存。
MM-IND-001.case_en: 1941 Thirty Comrades; 1945 switched to British; 1947 Panglong/assassination; 1988 Suu Kyi led uprising; 2021 coup imprisoned. Independence general daughter democracy military paradigm endures.
MM-IND-001.cross_cultural_impact: Independence father; federalism vision; daughter democracy icon; military junta tension

MM-SOC-001.name_zh: 缅甸·吴努：佛教社会主义与民主政变僧侣
MM-SOC-001.name_en: Myanmar U Nu: Buddhist Socialism & Democracy Coup Monks
MM-SOC-001.description_zh: 吴努 (1907-1995) 缅甸首任总理 (1948-1958, 1960-1962)，推行佛教社会主义福利政策，1958年主动移权给内阁看守，1960年大选回归，1962年奈温政变下台，晚年流亡发动8888起义支持。
MM-SOC-001.description_en: U Nu (1907-1995) Myanmar first PM (1948-1958, 1960-1962), implemented Buddhist socialism welfare policy, 1958 voluntarily handed power to caretaker cabinet, 1960 election returned, 1962 Ne Win coup ousted, late exile supported 8888 uprising.
MM-SOC-001.reason_zh: 吴努代表佛教伦理与社会主义经济的独特融合尝试，展示了民主领袖如何在军人政治阴影下通过道德权威治国，其主动移权罕见展现民主成熟度，却终究无法阻挡军事政变。
MM-SOC-001.reason_en: U Nu represents unique fusion of Buddhist ethics and socialist economics, demonstrating how democratic leader governs through moral authority under military politics shadow, his voluntary handover rare showing democratic maturity yet ultimately unable to stop military coup.
steps_zh: 研究吴努早年学生领袖与反英斗争
分析1948-1958首相期佛教社会主义立法
探讨1958年主动移权看守内阁罕见民主操作
评估1962年奈温政变与吴努流亡晚年
总结佛教社会主义民主政变僧侣模式对缅甸政治文化的深远烙印
steps_en: Study U Nu early student leader and anti-British struggle
Analyze 1948-1958 PM Buddhist socialism legislation
Explore 1958 voluntary handover to caretaker cabinet rare democratic operation
Evaluate 1962 Ne Win coup and U Nu exile late years
Summarize Buddhist socialism democracy coup monks model profound imprint on Myanmar political culture
MM-SOC-001.expected_zh: 理解佛教伦理如何为社会主义提供道德正当性，掌握民主领袖道德权威与军事强权的不对称博弈，评估吴努模式对后世缅甸民主运动的启示与局限。
MM-SOC-001.expected_en: Understand how Buddhist ethics legitimize socialism morally, grasp democratic leader moral authority and military power asymmetric game, evaluate U Nu model implications for later Myanmar democracy movements.
MM-SOC-001.case_zh: 1948 总理；1958 移权；1960 回归；1962 政变下台；1988 支持起义。佛教社会主义民主政变僧侣范式永存。
MM-SOC-001.case_en: 1948 PM; 1958 handover; 1960 return; 1962 coup ousted; 1988 supported uprising. Buddhist socialism democracy coup monks paradigm endures.
MM-SOC-001.cross_cultural_impact: Buddhist socialism; voluntary power transfer; military coup; monk politics

MM-MIL-001.name_zh: 缅甸·奈温：军事隔离与佛教迷信经济自毁
MM-MIL-001.name_en: Myanmar Ne Win: Military Isolation & Buddhist Superstition Economy Self-Destruction
MM-MIL-001.description_zh: 奈温 (1911-2002) 缅甸军事独裁者 (1962-1988)，建立缅甸式社会主义孤立经济，1987年废除货币依迷信数字(9的倍数)，引发8888起义，晚年居家监禁，军事隔离与经济自毁导致缅甸从东南亚富庶沦为最不发达。
MM-MIL-001.description_en: Ne Win (1911-2002) Myanmar military dictator (1962-1988), built Burmese Way to Socialism isolated economy, 1987 demonetized currency based on superstition number (multiples of 9), triggered 8888 uprising, late house arrest, military isolation and economic self-destruction reduced Myanmar from Southeast Asia prosperity to LDC.
MM-MIL-001.reason_zh: 奈温代表军事独裁与经济愚昧的毁灭性结合，展示了迷信决策如何摧毁国家经济基础，其"缅甸式社会主义"成为发展经济学反面教材，军事隔离导致国家彻底边缘化。
MM-MIL-001.reason_en: Ne Win represents destructive fusion of military dictatorship and economic folly, demonstrating how superstitious decision-making destroys national economic foundation, his Burmese Way to Socialism became development economics cautionary tale, military isolation led to complete national marginalization.
steps_zh: 研究奈温早年三十同志与昂山副手关系
分析1962年政变建立革命委员会与缅甸式社会主义
探讨1964年国有化与1987年迷信废币灾难
评估8888起义与1988年辞职权力交接给素貌
总结军事隔离佛教迷信经济自毁对缅甸发展的世纪创伤
steps_en: Study Ne Win early Thirty Comrades and Aung San deputy relationship
Analyze 1962 coup established Revolutionary Council and Burmese Way to Socialism
Explore 1964 nationalization and 1987 superstitious demonetization disaster
Evaluate 8888 uprising and 1988 resignation power transfer to Saw Maung
Summarize military isolation Buddhist superstition economy self-destruction century trauma for Myanmar development
MM-MIL-001.expected_zh: 理解军事强权如何通过意识形态合法化经济愚昧，掌握迷信决策在封闭体制中放大破坏力的机制，评估奈温遗产对缅甸当代经济重建的深度阻碍。
MM-MIL-001.expected_en: Understand how military power legitimizes economic folly through ideology, grasp superstition decision-making amplification mechanism in closed system, evaluate Ne Win legacy deep hindrance for Myanmar contemporary economic reconstruction.
MM-MIL-001.case_zh: 1962 政变；1964 国有化；1987 迷信废币；1988 8888起义辞职；2002 逝世。军事隔离佛教迷信经济自毁范式永存。
MM-MIL-001.case_en: 1962 coup; 1964 nationalization; 1987 superstitious demonetization; 1988 8888 uprising resignation; 2002 death. Military isolation Buddhist superstition economy self-destruction paradigm endures.
MM-MIL-001.cross_cultural_impact: Military isolation; economic self-destruction; superstition policy; LDC decline

MM-ETH-001.name_zh: 缅甸·罗兴亚族群：种族清洗与无国籍海上幸存
MM-ETH-001.name_en: Myanmar Rohingya: Ethnic Cleansing & Stateless Sea Survival
MM-ETH-001.description_zh: 罗兴亚是缅甸若开邦穆斯林少数民族，1982年公民法剥夺国籍，2012/2016/2017年军方发动清洗行动，百万人逃往孟加拉难民营或漂流安达曼海，成为当代最严重无国籍群体危机。
MM-ETH-001.description_en: Rohingya are Myanmar Rakhine Muslim minority, 1982 Citizenship Law stripped nationality, 2012/2016/2017 military cleansing operations, millions fled to Bangladesh camps or drifted Andaman Sea, becoming contemporary most severe stateless population crisis.
MM-ETH-001.reason_zh: 罗兴亚代表当代种族清洗与无国籍危机的极端案例，展示了公民法如何被武器化剥夺少数民族生存权，海上漂流求生画面震撼世界良知，国际法保护机制却反应迟缓无效。
MM-ETH-001.reason_en: Rohingya represents contemporary ethnic cleansing and stateless crisis extreme case, demonstrating how citizenship law weaponized to deprive minority survival rights, sea drifting survival images shocked world conscience, international law protection mechanisms responded slowly and ineffectively.
steps_zh: 研究罗兴亚历史渊源与若开邦地理隔离
分析1982公民法剥夺国籍法律机制
探讨2017年清洗行动与安达曼海漂流危机
评估国际法院/ICC诉讼与孟加拉难民营现状
总结种族清洗无国籍海上幸存对国际保护责任的挑战
steps_en: Study Rohingya historical roots and Rakhine geographic isolation
Analyze 1982 Citizenship Law stripping nationality legal mechanism
Explore 2017 cleansing operations and Andaman Sea drifting crisis
Evaluate ICJ/ICC litigation and Bangladesh refugee camp status
Summarize ethnic cleansing stateless sea survival challenge to international protection responsibility
MM-ETH-001.expected_zh: 理解公民法如何成为种族清洗法律工具，掌握无国籍群体海上求生与国际保护责任的现实鸿沟，评估罗兴亚危机对缅甸民主化与国际法的双重考验。
MM-ETH-001.expected_en: Understand how citizenship law becomes ethnic cleansing legal tool, grasp stateless population sea survival and international protection responsibility reality gap, evaluate Rohingya crisis dual test for Myanmar democratization and international law.
MM-ETH-001.case_zh: 1982 公民法剥夺国籍；2017 清洗70万逃亡；安达曼海漂流；海牙法院诉讼。种族清洗无国籍海上幸存范式永存。
MM-ETH-001.case_en: 1982 Citizenship Law stripped nationality; 2017 cleansing 700K fled; Andaman Sea drifting; ICJ litigation. Ethnic cleansing stateless sea survival paradigm endures.
MM-ETH-001.cross_cultural_impact: Citizenship law weaponization; stateless crisis; sea survival; international law failure

VN-TRA-001.name_zh: 越南·陈兴道：抗蒙军事与游击水战天才
VN-TRA-001.name_en: Vietnam Tran Hung Dao: Anti-Mongol Military & Guerrilla Naval Genius
VN-TRA-001.description_zh: 陈兴道 (1228-1300) 陈朝大将，三次抗元战争白藤江决战以桩阵水战歼灭蒙古舰队，著《兵书要诀》奠定越南军事思想传统。
VN-TRA-001.description_en: Tran Hung Dao (1228-1300) Tran Dynasty general, three anti-Yuan wars Bach Dang River decisive battle used stake trap naval warfare annihilated Mongol fleet, authored Book of Military Principles founding Vietnamese military thought tradition.
VN-TRA-001.reason_zh: 陈兴道代表农业文明通过水战非对称优势击败游牧帝国军事机器的奇迹，展示了地理环境如何转化为军事战略决定性优势，其兵法思想影响越南千年抗外传统。
VN-TRA-001.reason_en: Tran Hung Dao represents agricultural civilization defeating nomadic empire military machine through naval asymmetric advantage miracle, demonstrating how geography transforms into decisive military strategic advantage, his military thought influencing Vietnamese millennium anti-foreign tradition.
steps_zh: 研究陈兴道早年儒将教育与陈朝军事改革
分析1258/1285/1288三次抗元战争战术演进
探讨1288白藤江桩阵水战战术创新与心理战
评估《兵书要诀》游击战思想与越南军事传统
总结抗蒙军事天才对越南民族认同的奠基作用
steps_en: Study Tran Hung Dao early Confucian general education and Tran Dynasty military reform
Analyze 1258/1285/1288 three anti-Yuan wars tactical evolution
Explore 1288 Bach Dang stake trap naval warfare tactical innovation and psychological warfare
Evaluate Book of Military Principles guerrilla thought and Vietnamese military tradition
Summarize anti-Mongol military genius foundational role for Vietnamese national identity
VN-TRA-001.expected_zh: 掌握水战非对称战术与游击战思想双重创新，理解地理决定论在军事史上的极致体现，评估陈兴道对越南千年抗外传统的决定性奠基。
VN-TRA-001.expected_en: Master naval asymmetric tactics and guerrilla thought dual innovation, understand geographical determinism ultimate embodiment in military history, evaluate Tran Hung Dao decisive foundation for Vietnamese millennium anti-foreign tradition.
VN-TRA-001.case_zh: 1228 出生；1258 首战；1288 白藤江大捷；1300 逝世。抗蒙军事游击水战范式永存。
VN-TRA-001.case_en: 1228 birth; 1258 first battle; 1288 Bach Dang victory; 1300 death. Anti-Mongol military guerrilla naval paradigm endures.
VN-TRA-001.cross_cultural_impact: Naval warfare innovation; stake trap; anti-Mongol victory; military tradition

LA-RED-001.name_zh: 老挝·苏发努冯：红王子中立与三王子联合
LA-RED-001.name_en: Laos Souphanouvong: Red Prince Neutrality & Three Princes Unity
LA-RED-001.description_zh: 苏发努冯 (1909-1995) 老挝红王子，巴特寮领袖，1957/1962/1973三次联合政府，坚持中立外交在美苏中三大阵营夹缝生存，1975年胜利任主席推动民族和解。
LA-RED-001.description_en: Souphanouvong (1909-1995) Laos Red Prince, Pathet Lao leader, 1957/1962/1973 three coalition governments, insisted neutral diplomacy surviving in US-Soviet-China three camps squeeze, 1975 victory became President promoted national reconciliation.
LA-RED-001.reason_zh: 苏发努冯代表冷战夹缝小国通过中立外交与王室身份实现共产主义革命与民族和解的双重奇迹，展示了红色王子如何转化阶级矛盾为民族团结。
LA-RED-001.reason_en: Souphanouvong represents Cold War squeeze small state achieving communist revolution and national reconciliation dual miracle through neutral diplomacy and royal identity, demonstrating how Red Prince transformed class contradiction into national unity.
steps_zh: 研究苏发努冯王子身份与越南革命洗礼
分析1950年巴特寮成立与武装斗争
探讨三次联合政府(1957/1962/1973)权力分享机制
评估1975年胜利主席任内民族和解与经济建设
总结红王子中立三王子联合对老挝生存智慧的贡献
steps_en: Study Souphanouvong prince identity and Vietnam revolutionary baptism
Analyze 1950 Pathet Lao founding and armed struggle
Explore three coalition governments (1957/1962/1973) power sharing mechanism
Evaluate 1975 victory President term national reconciliation and economic construction
Summarize Red Prince neutrality three princes unity contribution to Laos survival wisdom
LA-RED-001.expected_zh: 理解王室身份如何为共产革命提供合法性保护，掌握中立外交在大国夹缝中生存空间拓展逻辑，评估三王子联合模式对分裂社会愈合的普遍启示。
LA-RED-001.expected_en: Understand how royal identity provides legitimacy protection for communist revolution, grasp neutral diplomacy survival space expansion logic in great power squeeze, evaluate three princes unity model universal lessons for divided society healing.
LA-RED-001.case_zh: 1909 王子出生；1950 巴特寮；1957/62/73 联合；1975 胜利主席。红王子中立三王子联合范式永存。
LA-RED-001.case_en: 1909 prince birth; 1950 Pathet Lao; 1957/62/73 coalitions; 1975 victory President. Red Prince neutrality three princes unity paradigm endures.
LA-RED-001.cross_cultural_impact: Royal communist leader; neutral diplomacy; coalition government; national reconciliation

LA-LAN-001.name_zh: 老挝·法昂：澜沧王国与万象佛教统一
LA-LAN-001.name_en: Laos Fa Ngum: Lan Xang Kingdom & Vientiane Buddhist Unity
LA-LAN-001.description_zh: 法昂 (1316-1393) 澜沧万象王国建立者，娶高棉公主请佛祖舍利入万象，确立上座部佛教国教，整合老挝泰族诸邦，奠定老挝民族疆域与文化认同基础。
LA-LAN-001.description_en: Fa Ngum (1316-1393) Lan Xang Vientiane Kingdom founder, married Khmer princess brought Buddha relics to Vientiane, established Theravada Buddhism state religion, integrated Lao Tai principalities, founded Lao national territory and cultural identity basis.
LA-LAN-001.reason_zh: 法昂代表东南亚佛教王国建构典范，展示了佛教如何作为跨部落文化粘合剂整合分散政体，其澜沧王国疆域大致对应现代老挝版图。
LA-LAN-001.reason_en: Fa Ngum represents Southeast Asian Buddhist kingdom construction paradigm, demonstrating how Buddhism serves as cross-tribal cultural glue integrating fragmented polities, his Lan Xang Kingdom territory roughly corresponds to modern Laos map.
steps_zh: 研究法昂早年高棉宫廷成长与娶公主请舍利
分析1353年万象起兵建立澜沧万象王国

KH-KIN-001.name_zh: 柬埔寨·西哈努克：国王舞者外交与中立生存
KH-KIN-001.name_en: Cambodia Sihanouk: King Dancer Diplomacy & Neutral Survival
KH-KIN-001.description_zh: 诺罗敦·西哈努克 (1922-2012) 柬埔寨国王/亲王/首相，1953谈判独立，1955退位从政，1970政变流亡北京，1975红色高棉软禁，1991巴黎协议复位，以舞者外交在五大势力夹缝生存半世纪。
KH-KIN-001.description_en: Norodom Sihanouk (1922-2012) Cambodia King/Prince/PM, 1953 negotiated independence, 1955 abdicated entered politics, 1970 coup exiled Beijing, 1975 Khmer Rouge house arrest, 1991 Paris Agreement restored, dancer diplomacy survived half century in five powers squeeze.
KH-KIN-001.reason_zh: 西哈努克代表冷战东南亚小国君主通过多重身份转换与艺术外交在大国博弈中生存的奇迹，展示了国王-舞者-外交官三位一体如何拆解意识形态对立。
KH-KIN-001.reason_en: Sihanouk represents Cold War Southeast Asian small state monarch surviving in great power game through multiple identity shifts and artistic diplomacy miracle, demonstrating how King-Dancer-Diplomat trinity deconstructs ideological opposition.

探讨1970政变流亡北京与红色高棉复杂关系
评估1991巴黎协议1993复位与舞者外交遗产

Evaluate 1991 Paris Agreement 1993 restoration and dancer diplomacy legacy
Summarize King dancer diplomacy neutral survival universal lessons for squeeze small states
KH-KIN-001.expected_zh: 理解多重身份如何转化为生存外交杠杆，掌握艺术软实力在硬实力对抗中的非对称优势，评估西哈努克模式对当代柬埔寨政治文化的复杂遗产。
KH-KIN-001.expected_en: Understand how multiple identities convert to survival diplomatic leverage, grasp artistic soft power asymmetric advantage in hard power confrontation, evaluate Sihanouk model complex legacy for contemporary Cambodian political culture.
KH-KIN-001.case_zh: 1922 出生；1941 即位；1953 独立；1955 退位；1970 政变；1991 巴黎；1993 复位；2012 逝世。国王舞者外交中立范式永存。

KH-KHM-001.name_zh: 柬埔寨·波尔布特：农业乌托邦与阶级清洗自毁
KH-KHM-001.name_en: Cambodia Pol Pot: Agrarian Utopia & Class Purge Self-Destruction
KH-KHM-001.description_zh: 波尔布特 (1925-1998) 红色高棉领袖，1975-1979年零年政策清空城市废除货币市场学校家庭，170万人死于饥荒处决，1979越军推翻，留下人类历史最惨烈自毁实验。
KH-KHM-001.description_en: Pol Pot (1925-1998) Khmer Rouge leader, 1975-1979 Year Zero policy emptied cities abolished money markets schools family, 1.7M died starvation execution, 1979 Vietnamese invasion overthrew, left human history most horrific self-destruction experiment.
KH-KHM-001.reason_zh: 波尔布特代表意识形态狂热如何将乌托邦幻觉转化为毁灭性现实，展示了阶级清洗逻辑如何在封闭体系中自我放大至民族灭绝边缘，成为人类警世教材。
KH-KHM-001.reason_en: Pol Pot represents how ideological fanaticism transforms utopian illusion into destructive reality, demonstrating how class purge logic self-amplifies to ethnic extinction brink in closed system, becoming human cautionary textbook.
steps_zh: 研究波尔布特早年巴黎留学马列激进化

总结农业乌托邦阶级清洗自毁对人类文明的永恒警示

Summarize agrarian utopia class purge self-destruction eternal warning for human civilization
KH-KHM-001.expected_zh: 理解乌托邦工程如何必然导向反人类罪行，掌握封闭体制中意识形态自我放大毁灭机制，评估波尔布特遗产对后极权主义理论的核心反面教材价值。
KH-KHM-001.expected_en: Understand how utopian engineering inevitably leads to crimes against humanity, grasp closed system ideological self-amplification destruction mechanism, evaluate Pol Pot legacy core negative textbook value for post-totalitarian theory.
KH-KHM-001.case_zh: 1925 出生；1975 零年；1979 倒台；1998 逝世。农业乌托邦阶级清洗自毁范式永存。

KH-KHM-001.intellectual_tradition: Khmer Rouge Radical Marxism / Agrarian Utopianism
KH-KHM-001.cross_cultural_impact: Genocide warning; radical utopianism; ideological fanaticism; Year Zero concept

SG-LKY-001.name_zh: 新加坡·李光耀：从第三世界到第一与法治精英
SG-LKY-001.name_en: Singapore Lee Kuan Yew: From Third World to First & Rule of Law Elite
SG-LKY-001.description_zh: 李光耀 (1923-2015) 新加坡建国总理 (1959-1990)，1965被迫脱离马来西亚独立，零资源零腹地建立法治反腐精英治理模式，组屋双语种族和谐创造亚洲四小虎奇迹。
SG-LKY-001.description_en: Lee Kuan Yew (1923-2015) Singapore founding PM (1959-1990), 1965 forced separation from Malaysia independence, zero resources zero hinterland built rule of law anti-corruption elite governance model, HDB bilingual racial harmony created Asian Four Tigers miracle.
SG-LKY-001.reason_zh: 李光耀代表城市国家如何通过法治精英治理实现资源禀赋逆转，展示了第三世界后发国家如何通过制度创新超越西方发达国家，其务实主义哲学影响全球治理者。
SG-LKY-001.reason_en: Lee Kuan Yew represents how city-state achieves resource endowment reversal through rule of law elite governance, demonstrating how Third World latecomer surpasses Western developed nations through institutional innovation, his pragmatic philosophy influencing global leaders.

Explore CPIB zero tolerance anti-corruption and civil servant high pay clean governance
Evaluate HDB 80% ownership racial quota bilingual education social contract
Summarize From Third World to First Rule of Law Elite global paradigm for city-state governance
SG-LKY-001.expected_zh: 掌握零资源城市国家如何通过法治精英治理实现发达国家超越，理解务实主义如何超越意识形态成为治理核心逻辑，评估李光耀模式对迪拜深圳卢旺达等后发城市的全球示范。
SG-LKY-001.expected_en: Master how zero-resource city-state surpasses developed nations through rule of law elite governance, understand how pragmatism transcends ideology becoming governance core logic, evaluate Lee Kuan Yew model global demonstration for Dubai Shenzhen Rwanda latecomer cities.
SG-LKY-001.case_zh: 1923 出生；1959 总理；1965 分离；1990 卸任；2015 逝世。从第三世界到第一法治精英范式永存。
SG-LKY-001.case_en: 1923 birth; 1959 PM; 1965 separation; 1990 retirement; 2015 death. From Third World to First Rule of Law Elite paradigm endures.
SG-LKY-001.intellectual_tradition: Singaporean Pragmatism / Elite Governance / Rule of Law
SG-LKY-001.cross_cultural_impact: City-state governance; anti-corruption; public housing; bilingual education; water diplomacy

BN-SUL-001.reason_zh: 博尔基亚代表资源型绝对君主制如何通过福利再分配与宗教法治合法性双重支柱实现政权稳固，展示了小国如何在大国夹缝中通过石油杠杆维持战略自主。
BN-SUL-001.reason_en: Bolkiah represents resource-based absolute monarchy achieving regime stability through welfare redistribution and religious legal legitimacy dual pillars, demonstrating how small state maintains strategic autonomy in great power squeeze through oil leverage.

NP-MAO-001.name_zh: 尼泊尔·普拉昌达：毛派和平与共和国联邦过渡
NP-MAO-001.name_en: Nepal Prachanda: Maoist Peace & Republic Federal Transition
NP-MAO-001.description_zh: 普拉昌达 (1954-) 尼泊尔毛派领袖/总理 (2008-2009, 2016-2017, 2022-2023)，十年人民战争后签署和平协议，废除君主制建立联邦共和国，推动过渡正义与包容性宪法。
NP-MAO-001.description_en: Prachanda (1954-) Nepal Maoist leader/PM (2008-2009, 2016-2017, 2022-2023), signed peace agreement after decade Peoples War, abolished monarchy established federal republic, promoted transitional justice and inclusive constitution.
NP-MAO-001.reason_zh: 普拉昌达代表毛派武装革命如何通过和平协议转型为民主政党，展示了后冲突社会如何通过过渡正义处理战争遗恩，其三度总理经历折射尼泊尔民主巩固的曲折。
NP-MAO-001.reason_en: Prachanda represents how Maoist armed revolution transforms into democratic party through peace agreement, demonstrating how post-conflict society processes war legacy through transitional justice, his three premierships reflecting Nepal democratic consolidation tortuous path.

Explore 2008 Constituent Assembly abolishing monarchy establishing republic

NP-MON-001.name_zh: 尼泊尔·比伦德拉：国王屠杀与君主废除悲剧
NP-MON-001.name_en: Nepal Birendra: Royal Massacre & Monarchy Abolition Tragedy
NP-MON-001.description_zh: 比伦德拉 (1945-2001) 尼泊尔国王 (1972-2001)，2001年皇宫屠杀全家遇害，弟弟贾南德拉继位加速君主制合法性崩塌，2008年制宪会议废除君主制，悲剧重塑尼泊尔政治版图。
NP-MON-001.description_en: Birendra (1945-2001) Nepal King (1972-2001), 2001 royal palace massacre entire family killed, brother Gyanendra succession accelerated monarchy legitimacy collapse, 2008 Constituent Assembly abolished monarchy, tragedy reshaped Nepal political landscape.
NP-MON-001.reason_zh: 比伦德拉屠杀代表君主制神圣光环如何在瞬间崩塌，展示了皇室内部权力斗争如何成为制度变迁催化剂，其悲剧性结局直接推动了尼泊尔从印度教王国向世俗共和国转型。
NP-MON-001.reason_en: Birendra massacre represents how monarchy sacred aura collapses in instant, demonstrating how royal family internal power struggle becomes regime change catalyst, its tragic ending directly drove Nepal transition from Hindu kingdom to secular republic.
steps_zh: 研究比伦德拉早年哈佛教育与1972年继位
分析1990年人民运动恢复多党民主与国王妥协
探讨2001年皇宫屠杀迪彭德拉疯狂屠杀全家
评估贾南德拉继位专制倒行逆施加速共和

Explore 2001 royal palace massacre Dipendra madness killing entire family

Summarize royal massacre monarchy abolition tragedy decisive push for Nepal secular republic

NP-MON-001.expected_en: Understand how royal tragedy becomes regime change black swan event, grasp monarchy legitimacy collapse and republic establishment causal chain, evaluate Nepal secularization transition unique historical path.
NP-MON-001.case_zh: 1945 出生；1972 即位；2001 屠杀遇害；2008 君主废除。国王屠杀君主废除悲剧范式永存。
NP-MON-001.case_en: 1945 birth; 1972 accession; 2001 massacre death; 2008 monarchy abolished. Royal massacre monarchy abolition tragedy paradigm endures.
NP-MON-001.cross_cultural_impact: Royal massacre; monarchy abolition; secular republic; Hindu kingdom end

BT-DRK-001.name_zh: 不丹·吉格梅·凯萨尔：龙王民主与宪法幸福

BT-DRK-001.description_zh: 吉格梅·凯萨尔·纳姆耶尔·旺楚克 (1980-) 不丹第五世国王 (2006-)，2008年推行民主宪法改革，父亲吉格梅·辛格·旺楚克创立GNH国民幸福总值指标，退位让位年轻国王完成民主转型。

BT-DRK-001.reason_zh: 吉格梅五世代表君主制主动退让推动民主化的罕见案例，展示了GNH幸福指标如何作为发展替代范式指导国家政策，君主退位完成从绝对君主到立宪君主的和平转型。
BT-DRK-001.reason_en: Jigme V represents rare case of monarchy proactively yielding driving democratization, demonstrating how GNH happiness index guides national policy as development alternative paradigm, monarch abdication completing peaceful transition from absolute to constitutional monarchy.

分析2006年父亲退位与2008年民主宪法颁布
探讨GNH国民幸福总值四支柱九领域指标体系

BT-ZHA-001.name_zh: 不丹·扎布德隆：统一与宗堡佛教法王
BT-ZHA-001.name_en: Bhutan Zhabdrung: Unification & Dzong Buddhism Dharma King
BT-ZHA-001.description_zh: 扎布德隆·纳姆耶尔 (1594-1651) 不丹统一者，建立宗堡(堡垒寺院)双重政教体系，确立噶举派佛教国教，抵抗西藏/蒙古入侵，奠定不丹独特政教合一国家认同。
BT-ZHA-001.description_en: Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal (1594-1651) Bhutan unifier, established Dzong (fortress-monastery) dual secular-religious system, established Kagyu Buddhism state religion, resisted Tibetan/Mongol invasions, founded Bhutan unique theocratic national identity.
BT-ZHA-001.reason_zh: 扎布德隆代表喜马拉雅佛教政教合一国家建构典范，展示了宗堡系统如何同时作为军事防御、行政中心、宗教修行场所，其双重体系延续至今定义不丹国家性质。
BT-ZHA-001.reason_en: Zhabdrung represents Himalayan Buddhist theocratic state construction paradigm, demonstrating how Dzong system simultaneously serves military defense, administrative center, religious practice site, its dual system enduring today defining Bhutan state nature.
steps_zh: 研究扎布德隆早年西藏贵族与噶举派传承

OM-TRA-001.reason_zh: 蒂普代表印度洋商业网络如何通过伊巴德教派身份与斯瓦希里文化融合构建跨洲贸易帝国，展示了非国家行为体如何在殖民前非洲实现商业主权，其网络为后世东非经济一体化奠基。
OM-TRA-001.reason_en: Tippu Tip represents how Indian Ocean commercial network built trans-continental trade empire through Ibadi sect identity and Swahili culture fusion, demonstrating how non-state actor achieved commercial sovereignty in pre-colonial Africa, his network founding later East African economic integration.
steps_zh: 研究蒂普早年桑给巴尔商人家庭与伊巴德教育
分析象牙奴隶贸易路线从坦噶尼喀至卢阿拉巴
探讨与利奥波德二世刚果自由国博弈与合作
评估1890s德国东非公司收购其领地与退休
总结伊巴德伊玛目贸易东非赞比亚对印度洋商业文明的奠基
steps_en: Study Tippu Tip early Zanzibar merchant family and Ibadi education
Analyze ivory slave trade routes from Tanganyika to Lualaba
Explore Leopold II Congo Free State game and cooperation
Evaluate 1890s German East Africa Company acquisition of territories and retirement
Summarize Ibadi Imam trade East Africa Zambia foundational role for Indian Ocean commercial civilization
OM-TRA-001.expected_zh: 理解前殖民商业网络如何超越现代国界构建区域经济一体化，掌握伊巴德教派身份作为商业信用机制的独特作用，评估蒂普遗产对东非共同体经济整合的历史渊源。
OM-TRA-001.expected_en: Understand how pre-colonial commercial networks transcended modern borders building regional economic integration, grasp Ibadi sect identity unique role as commercial credit mechanism, evaluate Tippu Tip legacy historical roots for East African Community economic integration.
OM-TRA-001.case_zh: 1832 出生；1860s 象牙贸易巅峰；1890s 退休；1905 逝世。伊巴德伊玛目贸易东非赞比亚范式永存。
OM-TRA-001.case_en: 1832 birth; 1860s ivory trade peak; 1890s retirement; 1905 death. Ibadi Imam trade East Africa Zambia paradigm endures.
OM-TRA-001.intellectual_tradition: Indian Ocean Commercial Networks / Ibadi Cosmopolitanism
OM-TRA-001.cross_cultural_impact: Trans-continental trade; ivory/slave trade; Ibadi identity; Congo colonization

KW-OIL-001.name_zh: 科威特·贾比尔：石油福利议会与伊拉克入侵解放
KW-OIL-001.name_en: Kuwait Jaber: Oil Welfare Parliament & Iraq Invasion Liberation
KW-OIL-001.description_zh: 贾比尔·艾哈迈德·萨巴赫 (1926-2006) 科威特埃米尔 (1977-2006)，石油财富建立高福利议会制，1990年伊拉克入侵触发海湾战争，美国领军联军解放，战后重建确立小国安全依赖大国保护伞现实。
KW-OIL-001.description_en: Jaber Al-Ahmad Al-Sabah (1926-2006) Kuwait Emir (1977-2006), oil wealth built high-welfare parliamentary system, 1990 Iraq invasion triggered Gulf War, US-led coalition liberated, post-war reconstruction established small state security reliance on great power protection umbrella reality.
KW-OIL-001.reason_zh: 贾比尔代表海湾小国如何通过石油福利换取国内合法性、通过大国保护伞换取生存安全，展示了议会制在威权传统中的有限运作，其被入侵与解放经历定义了海湾安全架构核心逻辑。
KW-OIL-001.reason_en: Jaber represents how Gulf small state exchanges oil welfare for domestic legitimacy and great power umbrella for survival security, demonstrating parliamentary system limited operation in authoritarian tradition, his invasion and liberation experience defining Gulf security architecture core logic.
steps_zh: 研究贾比尔早年统治家族成员与1963年首个民选议会
分析石油收入支撑免费医疗教育住房福利国家
探讨1990年伊拉克入侵与科威特流亡政府外交
评估1991年沙漠风暴行动解放与战后环境灾难
总结石油福利议会伊拉克入侵解放对海湾小国安全模式的定型
steps_en: Study Jaber early ruling family member and 1963 first elected parliament
Analyze oil revenue supporting free healthcare education housing welfare state
Explore 1990 Iraq invasion and Kuwait exile government diplomacy
Evaluate 1991 Desert Storm liberation and post-war environmental disaster
Summarize oil welfare parliament Iraq invasion liberation shaping Gulf small state security model
KW-OIL-001.expected_zh: 掌握石油福利与大国保护双重支柱如何构成海湾小国生存逻辑，理解议会制在部落威权中的有限空间，评估科威特模式对卡塔尔巴林阿联酋等邻国的示范与局限。
KW-OIL-001.expected_en: Master how oil welfare and great power protection dual pillars constitute Gulf small state survival logic, grasp parliamentary system limited space in tribal authoritarianism, evaluate Kuwait model demonstration and limits for Qatar Bahrain UAE neighbors.
KW-OIL-001.case_zh: 1977 埃米尔；1990 入侵；1991 解放；2006 逝世。石油福利议会伊拉克入侵解放范式永存。
KW-OIL-001.case_en: 1977 Emir; 1990 invasion; 1991 liberation; 2006 death. Oil welfare parliament Iraq invasion liberation paradigm endures.
KW-OIL-001.cross_cultural_impact: Oil welfare state; Gulf War; parliamentary monarchy; liberation

BH-REF-001.name_zh: 巴林·哈马德：改革珍珠与什叶逊尼沙特桥梁
BH-REF-001.name_en: Bahrain Hamad: Reform Pearls & Shia-Sunni Saudi Bridge
BH-REF-001.description_zh: 哈马德·本·伊萨·阿勒哈利法 (1950-) 巴林国王 (1999-)，2001年宪法改革设立议会，珍珠产业历史转型金融中心，什叶多数逊尼统治张力常态化，沙特桥梁战略依赖，2011珍珠圆环镇压。
BH-REF-001.description_en: Hamad bin Isa Al Khalifa (1950-) Bahrain King (1999-), 2001 constitutional reform established parliament, pearl industry history transformed to financial hub, Shia majority Sunni ruling tension normalized, Saudi bridge strategic dependence, 2011 Pearl Roundabout crackdown.
BH-REF-001.reason_zh: 哈马德代表海湾君主国如何在什叶多数逊尼统治张力中通过改革与外部依赖维持统治，展示了珍珠经济向金融中心转型的结构性困境，其沙特桥梁依赖定义了巴林生存空间边界。
BH-REF-001.reason_en: Hamad represents how Gulf monarchy maintains rule amid Shia majority Sunni ruling tension through reform and external dependence, demonstrating pearl economy to financial hub structural dilemma, his Saudi bridge dependence defining Bahrain survival space boundaries.
steps_zh: 研究哈马德早年英国军校与1999年继位
分析2001年国家行动宪章与两院制议会建立
探讨珍珠产业衰退与离岸金融中心崛起
评估2011珍珠圆环抗议与沙特半岛盾牌部队干预
总结改革珍珠什叶逊尼沙特桥梁对巴林生存空间的界定
steps_en: Study Hamad early British military academy and 1999 accession
Analyze 2001 National Action Charter and bicameral parliament establishment
Explore pearl industry decline and offshore financial hub rise
Evaluate 2011 Pearl Roundabout protests and Saudi Peninsula Shield Force intervention
Summarize reform pearls Shia-Sunni Saudi bridge defining Bahrain survival space
BH-REF-001.expected_zh: 理解什叶逊尼张力如何在外部大国干预下固化为统治合法性危机，掌握经济转型与政治改革不同步的海湾困境，评估巴林模式对东部省沙特内部平衡的外溢影响。
BH-REF-001.expected_en: Understand how Shia-Sunni tension solidifies into ruling legitimacy crisis under external great power intervention, grasp Gulf dilemma of economic transformation and political reform asynchrony, evaluate Bahrain model spillover impact on Eastern Province Saudi internal balance.
BH-REF-001.case_zh: 1999 国王；2001 改革；2011 镇压；持续。改革珍珠什叶逊尼沙特桥梁范式永存。
BH-REF-001.case_en: 1999 King; 2001 reform; 2011 crackdown; ongoing. Reform pearls Shia-Sunni Saudi bridge paradigm endures.
BH-REF-001.cross_cultural_impact: Constitutional reform; pearl economy; Shia-Sunni tension; Saudi bridge

QA-GAS-001.name_zh: 卡塔尔·塔米姆：天然气半岛与世界杯调解小国外交
QA-GAS-001.name_en: Qatar Tamim: Natural Gas Peninsula & World Cup Mediation Small State Diplomacy
QA-GAS-001.description_zh: 塔米姆·本·哈马德·阿勒萨尼 (1980-) 卡塔尔埃米尔 (2013-)，天然气财富支撑半岛电视台/主权财富基金/2022世界杯，调解阿富汗/也门/黎巴嫩冲突，小国通过软硬实力组合实现战略自主。
QA-GAS-001.description_en: Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani (1980-) Qatar Emir (2013-), natural gas wealth funds Al Jazeera/sovereign wealth fund/2022 World Cup, mediates Afghanistan/Yemen/Lebanon conflicts, small state achieves strategic autonomy through soft-hard power combination.
QA-GAS-001.reason_zh: 塔米姆代表超级富裕小国如何通过媒体/金融/体育三重软实力配合能源硬实力超越地理局限，展示了调解者角色如何为小国赢得大国尊重与战略空间，其世界杯举办重塑国家品牌。
QA-GAS-001.reason_en: Tamim represents how super-rich small state transcends geographic limits through media/finance/sports triple soft power combined with energy hard power, demonstrating how mediator role wins great power respect and strategic space for small state, his World Cup hosting reshaped national brand.
steps_zh: 研究塔米姆早年英国军校与2013年父王禅位
分析天然气垄断支撑主权财富基金全球投资
探讨半岛电视台阿拉伯媒体话语权重塑
评估2022世界杯举办与阿富汗塔利班/也门/黎巴嫩调解
总结天然气半岛世界杯调解小国外交对微型国家战略自主的范式创新
steps_en: Study Tamim early British military academy and 2013 father abdication
Analyze natural gas monopoly supporting SWF global investment
Explore Al Jazeera Arab media discourse reshaping
Evaluate 2022 World Cup hosting and Afghanistan Taliban/Yemen/Lebanon mediation
Summarize natural gas peninsula World Cup mediation small state diplomacy paradigm innovation for micro-state strategic autonomy
QA-GAS-001.expected_zh: 掌握能源财富如何转化为媒体金融体育三重软实力杠杆，理解小国调解者角色如何突破大国垄断地区事务权力，评估卡塔尔模式对文莱新加坡等小国的示范与差异。
QA-GAS-001.expected_en: Master how energy wealth converts to media finance sports triple soft power levers, understand how small state mediator role breaks great power monopoly on regional affairs, evaluate Qatar model demonstration and divergence for Brunei Singapore small states.
QA-GAS-001.case_zh: 2013 埃米尔；天然气垄断；2022 世界杯；持续调解。天然气半岛世界杯调解范式永存。
QA-GAS-001.case_en: 2013 Emir; natural gas monopoly; 2022 World Cup; ongoing mediation. Natural gas peninsula World Cup mediation paradigm endures.
QA-GAS-001.intellectual_tradition: Gulf Rentier Mediator / Soft Power State
QA-GAS-001.cross_cultural_impact: Natural gas wealth; Al Jazeera; World Cup; mediation; small state autonomy

AE-FED-001.name_zh: 阿联酋·扎耶德：联邦石油宽容与女性太空火星愿景
AE-FED-001.name_en: UAE Zayed: Federation Oil Tolerance & Women Space Mars Vision
AE-FED-001.description_zh: 扎耶德·本·苏尔坦·阿勒纳哈扬 (1918-2004) 阿联酋建国总统 (1971-2004)，七酋长国联邦建立，石油财富分配免费福利，宽容政策吸引外籍人口达90%，女性权利先驱，火星探测愿景传承至子孙。
AE-FED-001.description_en: Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan (1918-2004) UAE founding President (1971-2004), seven emirates federation established, oil wealth distributed free welfare, tolerance policy attracted 90% expatriate population, women rights pioneer, Mars exploration vision inherited by descendants.
AE-FED-001.reason_zh: 扎耶德代表部落联邦如何通过石油财富与宽容政策建立现代国家，展示了女性赋权与太空愿景如何成为后石油时代国家品牌核心，其联邦模式为海湾合作提供制度蓝本。
AE-FED-001.reason_en: Zayed represents how tribal federation builds modern nation through oil wealth and tolerance policies, demonstrating how women empowerment and space vision become post-oil era national brand core, his federation model providing institutional blueprint for Gulf cooperation.
steps_zh: 研究扎耶德早年沙漠酋长与阿布扎比石油发现
分析1971年七酋长国联邦成立与石油财富分配
探讨宽容政策吸引外籍技术人才与女性权利立法
评估迪拜崛起与阿联酋火星探测器希望号发射
总结联邦石油宽容女性太空火星对后石油时代海湾国家的战略指引
steps_en: Study Zayed early desert chief and Abu Dhabi oil discovery
Analyze 1971 seven emirates federation and oil wealth distribution
Explore tolerance policy attracting expatriate talent and women rights legislation
Evaluate Dubai rise and UAE Mars Hope Probe launch
Summarize federation oil tolerance women space Mars strategic guidance for post-oil Gulf nations
AE-FED-001.expected_zh: 理解部落联邦如何通过石油再分配实现国家整合，掌握宽容与女性赋权作为后石油时代软实力的双重引擎，评估扎耶德愿景对阿联酋从石油经济向知识经济转型的决定性塑造。
AE-FED-001.expected_en: Understand how tribal federation achieves national integration through oil redistribution, grasp tolerance and women empowerment as post-oil era soft power dual engines, evaluate Zayed vision decisive shaping for UAE transition from oil to knowledge economy.
AE-FED-001.case_zh: 1918 出生；1971 联邦；2004 逝世；火星探测。联邦石油宽容女性太空火星范式永存。
AE-FED-001.case_en: 1918 birth; 1971 federation; 2004 death; Mars exploration. Federation oil tolerance women space Mars paradigm endures.
AE-FED-001.intellectual_tradition: Gulf Federal Monarchy / Post-Oil Vision / Tolerance Statecraft
AE-FED-001.cross_cultural_impact: Federation model; oil welfare; tolerance; women rights; space exploration

LB-SEC-001.name_zh: 黎巴嫩·蒙杰姆：宗派权力分享与内战诗人雪松
LB-SEC-001.name_en: Lebanon Gemayel: Sectarian Power Sharing & Civil War Poets Cedars
LB-SEC-001.description_zh: 巴希尔·杰马耶勒 (1947-1982) / 阿明·杰马耶勒 (1942-) 马龙派领袖/总统，1943国民契约确立宗派权力分享(马龙派总统/逊尼总理/什叶议长)，1975-1990内战雪松革命，诗歌与战争交织。
LB-SEC-001.description_en: Bashir Gemayel (1947-1982) / Amine Gemayel (1942-) Maronite leader/President, 1943 National Pact established sectarian power sharing (Maronite President/Sunni PM/Shia Speaker), 1975-1990 civil war Cedar Revolution, poetry and war intertwined.
LB-SEC-001.reason_zh: 杰马耶勒家族代表黎巴嫩宗派制如何通过权力分享维持脆弱平衡，展示了内战如何在宗派固化体制中反复爆发，雪松革命与诗歌抵抗成为民族和解的文化符号。
LB-SEC-001.reason_en: Gemayel family represents how Lebanese sectarianism maintains fragile balance through power sharing, demonstrating how civil war repeatedly erupts in sectarian solidified system, Cedar Revolution and poetic resistance becoming national reconciliation cultural symbols.
steps_zh: 研究杰马耶勒家族马龙派精英与法兰西银行财阀背景
分析1943国民契约宗派配额制与总统/总理/议长分配
探讨1975内战爆发与以色列入侵/叙利亚干预
评估1982巴希尔当选遇刺与1989塔伊夫协议调整
总结宗派权力分享内战诗人雪松对黎巴嫩共存模式的悲剧性定型
steps_en: Study Gemayel family Maronite elite and Banque Française wealth background
Analyze 1943 National Pact sectarian quota President/PM/Speaker allocation
Explore 1975 civil war outbreak and Israeli invasion/Syrian intervention
Evaluate 1982 Bashir election assassination and 1989 Taif Agreement adjustment
Summarize sectarian power sharing civil war poets cedars tragic shaping of Lebanese coexistence model
LB-SEC-001.expected_zh: 理解宗派配额如何既是建国基石又是冲突根源，掌握内战在固化体制中周期性爆发的机制，评估黎巴嫩模式对伊拉克波黑等后冲突权力分享的示范与警示。
LB-SEC-001.expected_en: Understand how sectarian quota is both state-building foundation and conflict root, grasp civil war periodic eruption mechanism in solidified system, evaluate Lebanese model demonstration and warning for Iraq Bosnia post-conflict power sharing.
LB-SEC-001.case_zh: 1943 国民契约；1975 内战；1989 塔伊夫；2005 雪松革命。宗派权力分享内战诗人雪松范式永存。
LB-SEC-001.case_en: 1943 National Pact; 1975 civil war; 1989 Taif; 2005 Cedar Revolution. Sectarian power sharing civil war poets cedars paradigm endures.
LB-SEC-001.cross_cultural_impact: Sectarian power sharing; civil war; Cedar Revolution; poetry resistance

SY-ALA-001.name_zh: 叙利亚·阿萨德：阿拉维内战与化武俄伊朗生存
SY-ALA-001.name_en: Syria Assad: Alawi Civil War & Chemical Weapons Russia Iran Survival
SY-ALA-001.description_zh: 巴沙尔·阿萨德 (1965-) 叙利亚总统 (2000-)，阿拉维派少数统治逊尼多数，2011阿拉伯春天演变内战，化武指控/俄伊军事介入/伊斯兰国崛起/难民海啸，以毁灭性代价维持政权生存。
SY-ALA-001.description_en: Bashar al-Assad (1965-) Syria President (2000-), Alawi minority ruling Sunni majority, 2011 Arab Spring evolved civil war, chemical weapons accusations/Russia Iran military intervention/ISIS rise/refugee tsunami, maintained regime survival at catastrophic cost.
SY-ALA-001.reason_zh: 阿萨德代表少数派统治如何通过暴力镇压与外部大国庇护在内战中生存，展示了化武红线如何在大国博弈中被模糊化处理，其生存代价是叙利亚国家半毁灭与百万难民。
SY-ALA-001.reason_en: Assad represents how minority rule survives civil war through violent suppression and external great power patronage, demonstrating how chemical weapons red line gets blurred in great power competition, his survival cost is Syria half-destruction and million refugees.
steps_zh: 研究阿萨德早年伦敦眼科医生与兄长巴塞勒意外去世继位
分析2011德拉抗议演变全国内战与自由军崛起
探讨2013古塔化武攻击与俄伊军事介入转折
评估伊斯兰国崛起与库尔德自治/土耳其干预/难民危机
总结阿拉维内战化武俄伊朗生存对叙利亚国家与地区秩序的毁灭性重塑
steps_en: Study Assad early London ophthalmologist and brother Bassel accidental death succession
Analyze 2011 Daraa protests evolved national civil war and FSA rise
Explore 2013 Ghouta chemical attack and Russia Iran military intervention turning point
Evaluate ISIS rise and Kurdish autonomy/Turkish intervention/refugee crisis
Summarize Alawi civil war chemical weapons Russia Iran survival destructive reshaping of Syria state and regional order
SY-ALA-001.expected_zh: 理解少数派政权如何通过大国庇护在内战中生存，掌握化武红线在大国博弈中失效的机制，评估叙利亚重建的不可能性与地区地缘政治的永久性改变。
SY-ALA-001.expected_en: Understand how minority regime survives civil war through great power patronage, grasp chemical weapons red line failure mechanism in great power competition, evaluate Syria reconstruction impossibility and regional geopolitics permanent alteration.
SY-ALA-001.case_zh: 2000 总统；2011 春天；2013 化武；俄伊介入；持续。阿拉维内战化武俄伊朗生存范式永存。
SY-ALA-001.case_en: 2000 President; 2011 Spring; 2013 chemical weapons; Russia Iran intervention; ongoing. Alawi civil war chemical weapons Russia Iran survival paradigm endures.
SY-ALA-001.intellectual_tradition: Alawi Authoritarianism / Civil War Survival / Great Power Proxy
SY-ALA-001.cross_cultural_impact: Civil war; chemical weapons; Russia/Iran proxy; refugee crisis; state destruction

IQ-SHI-001.name_zh: 伊拉克·西斯特拉尼：什叶大阿亚图拉政治调解与反美伊朗博弈
IQ-SHI-001.name_en: Iraq Sistani: Shia Grand Ayatollah Political Mediation & Anti-US Iran Game
IQ-SHI-001.description_zh: 阿里·西斯特拉尼 (1930-) 伊拉克什叶大阿亚图拉，2003萨达姆倒台后发布法特瓦指导政治过渡，反对美军占领拒绝会见布什，调解什叶派内部派系冲突，制衡伊朗影响力，成为伊拉克稳定最后防线。
IQ-SHI-001.description_en: Ali al-Sistani (1930-) Iraq Shia Grand Ayatollah, 2003 post-Saddam issued fatwa guiding political transition, opposed US occupation refused meeting Bush, mediated Shia internal faction conflicts, checked Iran influence, becoming Iraq stability last defense line.
IQ-SHI-001.reason_zh: 西斯特拉尼代表宗教权威如何在世俗政治真空中填补合法性缺口，展示了什叶神学如何通过法特瓦干预国家建构，其反美制衡伊朗双重立场定义了后萨达姆伊拉克政治光谱边界。
IQ-SHI-001.reason_en: Sistani represents how religious authority fills legitimacy vacuum in secular political void, demonstrating how Shia theology intervenes in state-building through fatwa, his anti-US checking Iran dual stance defining post-Saddam Iraq political spectrum boundaries.
steps_zh: 研究西斯特拉尼早年马什哈德神学教育与纳杰夫权威确立

NG-PAN-001.reason_en: Azikiwe represents how West African Pan-Africanism built nation-state through newspaper media and cross-ethnic elite alliance, demonstrating how Igbo commercial spirit transformed into political leadership, his first presidency symbolizing Nigeria transition from colony to sovereign state completion.
