CI-MIR-001.name_en: Ivory Coast Felix Houphouet-Boigny: Stability Cocoa & France Peace Cathedral Miracle
CI-MIR-001.description_zh: 费利克斯·乌弗埃-博瓦尼 (1905-1993) 科特迪瓦首任总统 (1960-1993)，可可出口经济奇迹，与法国维持特殊关系，亚穆苏克罗和平大教堂世界最大教堂，三十年稳定后继任者内战。
CI-MIR-001.description_en: Felix Houphouet-Boigny (1905-1993) Ivory Coast first President (1960-1993), cocoa export economic miracle, special France relationship, Yamoussoukro Basilica worlds largest church, thirty years stability successors civil war.
CI-MIR-001.reason_zh: 乌弗埃代表法语非洲通过单一作物出口与前殖民宗主国共生实现稳定的典范，展示了和平大教堂如何作为宗教与权力双重象征投射国家形象，其继任者内战揭示了稳定模式的脆弱性。
CI-MIR-001.reason_en: Houphouet-Boigny represents Francophone Africa stability paradigm through single crop export and former colonizer symbiosis, demonstrating how Peace Basilica serves as religious and power dual symbol projecting national image, his successors civil war revealing stability model fragility.
steps_zh: 研究乌弗埃早年医生与法属西非议员经历
分析可可出口经济奇迹与法国军事经济特权
探讨亚穆苏克罗和平大教堂建造与宗教外交
评估1993年逝世后贝迪埃/塔瓦拉/巴博内继任内战
总结稳定可可法国和平大教堂奇迹对法语西非发展模式的示范与局限
steps_en: Study Houphouet-Boigny early doctor and French West Africa deputy experience
Analyze cocoa export economic miracle and France military economic privileges
Explore Yamoussoukro Basilica construction and religious diplomacy
Evaluate 1993 death and Bedie/Tavara/Babone successors civil war
Summarize stability cocoa France peace cathedral miracle demonstration and limits for Francophone West African development model
CI-MIR-001.expected_zh: 理解单一作物经济与前宗主国共生如何构建稳定契约，掌握宗教宏大叙事如何掩盖政治继承未解难题，评估乌弗埃模式对喀麦隆加蓬等法语非洲稳定契约的启示与警示。
CI-MIR-001.expected_en: Understand how single crop economy and former colonizer symbiosis builds stability contract, grasp how religious grand narrative masks political succession unresolved issues, evaluate Houphouet-Boigny model lessons and warnings for Cameroon Gabon Francophone African stability contracts.
CI-MIR-001.case_zh: 1960 总统；可可奇迹；大教堂；1993 逝世内战。稳定可可法国大教堂奇迹范式永存。
CI-MIR-001.case_en: 1960 President; cocoa miracle; Basilica; 1993 death civil war. Stability cocoa France peace cathedral miracle paradigm endures.
CI-MIR-001.intellectual_tradition: Francophone African Stability / Cocoa Economy / Religious Diplomacy
CI-MIR-001.cross_cultural_impact: Cocoa economy; France relationship; Peace Basilica; civil war succession

CO-DEM-001.name_zh: 哥伦比亚·阿尔瓦罗·乌里韦：民主安全与反游击阿尔瓦罗模式
CO-DEM-001.name_en: Colombia Alvaro Uribe: Democratic Security & Anti-Guerrilla Alvaro Model
CO-DEM-001.description_zh: 阿尔瓦罗·乌里韦 (1952-) 哥伦比亚总统 (2002-2010)，民主安全政策军事打击哥伦比亚革命武装力量(FARC)，巴拉圭外交斡旋释放人质，连任修宪争议，安全成果与人权代价并存。
CO-DEM-001.description_en: Alvaro Uribe (1952-) Colombia President (2002-2010), democratic security policy militarily struck FARC, Paraguay diplomacy mediated hostage release, re-election constitutional controversy, security gains and human rights costs coexisted.
CO-DEM-001.reason_zh: 乌里韦代表哥伦比亚如何通过军事强力与外交斡旋双重手段压制半个世纪游击战争，展示了民主安全政策如何在人权批评中获得国内民众压倒性支持，其阿尔瓦罗模式影响拉美安全议程。
CO-DEM-001.reason_en: Uribe represents how Colombia suppressed half-century guerrilla war through military force and diplomatic mediation dual approach, demonstrating how democratic security policy gained overwhelming domestic support despite human rights criticism, his Alvaro model influencing Latin American security agenda.
steps_zh: 研究乌里韦早年安蒂奥基亚州长与反绑架专家经历
分析2002年民主安全政策军事化与准军事合作
探讨2008年巴拉圭外交斡旋英格丽德·贝唐古尔释放
评估2006连任修宪与2010年宪法法院否决第三任
总结民主安全反游击阿尔瓦罗模式对拉美反叛乱战略的影响
steps_en: Study Uribe early Antioquia Governor and anti-kidnapping expert experience
Analyze 2002 democratic security policy militarization and paramilitary cooperation
Explore 2008 Paraguay diplomacy mediation Ingrid Betancourt release
Evaluate 2006 re-election constitutional amendment and 2010 Court rejection third term
Summarize democratic security anti-guerrilla Alvaro model impact on Latin American counterinsurgency strategy
CO-DEM-001.expected_zh: 掌握军事强力与外交斡旋如何双轮驱动反游击战争，理解安全成果与人权代价的民主权衡困境，评估乌里韦模式对墨西哥中美洲等国安全政策的外溢影响。
CO-DEM-001.expected_en: Master how military force and diplomatic mediation dual-wheel drive counter-guerrilla war, understand democratic trade-off dilemma between security gains and human rights costs, evaluate Uribe model spillover impact on Mexico Central America security policies.
CO-DEM-001.case_zh: 2002 总统；2008 贝唐古尔释放；2010 卸任；持续影响。民主安全反游击阿尔瓦罗范式永存。
CO-DEM-001.case_en: 2002 President; 2008 Betancourt release; 2010 retirement; ongoing influence. Democratic security anti-guerrilla Alvaro paradigm endures.
CO-DEM-001.cross_cultural_impact: Counterinsurgency model; hostage rescue; constitutional controversy; human rights

EC-CIT-001.name_zh: 厄瓜多尔·拉斐尔·科雷亚：公民革命与美元化中国阿桑奇庇护
EC-CIT-001.name_en: Ecuador Rafael Correa: Citizen Revolution & Dollarization China Assange Asylum
EC-CIT-001.description_zh: 拉斐尔·科雷亚 (1963-) 厄瓜多尔总统 (2007-2017)，公民革命重写宪法确立良好生活原则，美元化经济稳定依赖中国贷款，庇护阿桑奇对抗美帝国主义，2017年交权莫雷诺反水。
EC-CIT-001.description_en: Rafael Correa (1963-) Ecuador President (2007-2017), citizen revolution rewrote constitution establishing Buen Vivir principles, dollarized economy stability dependent on Chinese loans, sheltered Assange against US imperialism, 2017 handover Moreno betrayed.
EC-CIT-001.reason_zh: 科雷亚代表拉美左翼如何通过宪法重写与美元化稳定实现社会再分配，展示了中国替代性融资如何打破IMF垄断，阿桑奇庇护成为反美帝国主义符号，其交权后被前盟友背叛折射左翼传承脆弱性。
EC-CIT-001.reason_en: Correa represents how Latin American left achieves social redistribution through constitutional rewrite and dollarization stability, demonstrating how Chinese alternative financing breaks IMF monopoly, Assange asylum becoming anti-US imperialism symbol, his handover betrayed by former ally reflecting leftist succession fragility.
steps_zh: 研究科雷亚早年比利时鲁汶大学经济学博士与反新自由主义
分析2008年制宪会议良好生活原则与自然权利
探讨美元化经济与中国贷款基建/石油换贷模式
评估2012年阿桑奇庇护伦敦使馆与美厄关系恶化
总结公民革命美元化中国阿桑奇庇护对拉美左翼的三重遗产
steps_en: Study Correa early Belgium KU Leuven economics PhD and anti-neoliberalism
Analyze 2008 Constituent Assembly Buen Vivir principles and nature rights
Explore dollarized economy and Chinese loans infrastructure/oil-for-loans model
Evaluate 2012 Assange asylum London embassy and US-Ecuador relations deterioration
Summarize citizen revolution dollarization China Assange asylum triple legacy for Latin American left
EC-CIT-001.expected_zh: 理解宪法重写如何将土著良好生活理念制度化，掌握美元化与中国融资双重经济锚点的风险与收益，评估科雷亚遗产对拉美粉红浪潮退潮期的历史定位。
EC-CIT-001.expected_en: Understand how constitutional rewrite institutionalized indigenous Buen Vivir philosophy, grasp dollarization and Chinese financing dual economic anchors risks and rewards, evaluate Correa legacy historical positioning for Latin American pink tide ebb period.
EC-CIT-001.case_zh: 2007 总统；2008 宪法；2012 阿桑奇庇护；2017 交权。公民革命美元化中国阿桑奇范式永存。
EC-CIT-001.case_en: 2007 President; 2008 Constitution; 2012 Assange asylum; 2017 handover. Citizen revolution dollarization China Assange paradigm endures.
EC-CIT-001.intellectual_tradition: Latin American Left / Buen Vivir / Dollarization
EC-CIT-001.cross_cultural_impact: Constitutional rewrite; dollarization; Chinese loans; Assange asylum
EC-CIT-001.environmental_stewardship: 是: 自然权利/亚马逊

PY-DIC-001.name_zh: 巴拉圭·弗朗西斯科·洛佩斯：独裁三国战争与女性教育铁路悲剧
PY-DIC-001.name_en: Paraguay Francisco Lopez: Dictatorship Triple Alliance War & Women Education Railway Tragedy
PY-DIC-001.description_zh: 弗朗西斯科·索拉诺·洛佩斯 (1827-1870) 巴拉圭独裁者 (1862-1870)，发动三国同盟战争(巴拉圭vs阿根廷巴西乌拉圭)，全国总动员女性教育铁路建设，人口从130万锐减至20万，战死沙袋堡。
PY-DIC-001.description_en: Francisco Solano Lopez (1827-1870) Paraguay dictator (1862-1870), launched Triple Alliance War (Paraguay vs Argentina Brazil Uruguay), national mobilization women education railway construction, population plummeted from 1.3M to 200K, died at Cerro Cora.
PY-DIC-001.reason_zh: 洛佩斯代表拉美独裁者如何通过全民总动员发动毁灭性战争，展示了女性教育与铁路建设如何在战争机器中被异化为工具，其悲剧结局成为拉美军事冒险主义的永恒警示。
PY-DIC-001.reason_en: Lopez represents how Latin American dictator launches destructive war through total mobilization, demonstrating how women education and railway construction become instrumentalized in war machine, his tragic ending becoming eternal warning for Latin American military adventurism.
steps_zh: 研究洛佩斯早年独裁者之子与欧洲军事考察
分析1864年三国同盟战争发动与巴拉圭全民动员
探讨女性教师铁路建设与儿童兵役战争机器
评估1870年沙袋堡战死与巴拉圭人口灾难
总结独裁三国战争女性教育铁路悲剧对拉美军国主义的警示
steps_en: Study Lopez early dictator son and European military inspection
Analyze 1864 Triple Alliance War launch and Paraguay total mobilization
Explore women teachers railway construction and child soldiers war machine
Evaluate 1870 Cerro Cora death and Paraguay demographic catastrophe
Summarize dictatorship triple alliance war women education railway tragedy warning for Latin American militarism
PY-DIC-001.expected_zh: 理解独裁战争动员如何吞噬社会建设成果，掌握女性教育与基建在全面战争中的工具化异化机制，评估洛佩斯悲剧对拉美文职控制军队原则的奠基作用。
PY-DIC-001.expected_en: Understand how dictatorial war mobilization devours social construction achievements, grasp women education and infrastructure instrumentalization alienation in total war mechanism, evaluate Lopez tragedy foundational role for Latin American civilian control of military principle.
PY-DIC-001.case_zh: 1862 独裁；1864 战争；1870 战死。独裁三国战争女性教育铁路悲剧范式永存。
PY-DIC-001.case_en: 1862 dictator; 1864 war; 1870 death. Dictatorship triple alliance war women education railway tragedy paradigm endures.
PY-DIC-001.cross_cultural_impact: Triple Alliance War; demographic catastrophe; women mobilization; railway

UY-ONC-001.name_zh: 乌拉圭·塔瓦雷·巴斯克斯：肿瘤医生总统与癌症烟草合法健康
UY-ONC-001.name_en: Uruguay Tabare Vazquez: Oncologist President & Cancer Tobacco Legal Health
UY-ONC-001.description_zh: 塔瓦雷·巴斯克斯 (1940-2020) 乌拉圭首位左翼总统 (2005-2010, 2015-2020)，肿瘤科医生推动严格烟草控制法案，世界首个全面禁烟国家，癌症治疗公共化，2014年合法化大麻国家管控。
UY-ONC-001.description_en: Tabare Vazquez (1940-2020) Uruguay first leftist President (2005-2010, 2015-2020), oncologist pushed strict tobacco control law, world first comprehensive smoke-free nation, cancer treatment publicized, 2014 legalized marijuana state control.
UY-ONC-001.reason_zh: 巴斯克斯代表医生总统如何将医学专业知识转化为公共卫生政策，展示了烟草控制与大麻合法化双重公共卫生创新如何在小国实现，其肿瘤医生身份为政策提供了不可置疑的专业权威。
UY-ONC-001.reason_en: Vazquez represents how doctor President transforms medical expertise into public health policy, demonstrating how tobacco control and marijuana legalization dual public health innovation achieved in small nation, his oncologist identity providing unquestionable professional authority for policy.
steps_zh: 研究巴斯克斯早年肿瘤医生与广阔阵线创建
分析2006年烟草控制法案世界首个全面禁烟
探讨癌症治疗纳入公共医疗体系与筛查普及
评估2014年大麻合法化国家管控模式创新
总结肿瘤医生总统癌症烟草合法健康对全球公共卫生治理的示范
steps_en: Study Vazquez early oncologist and Broad Front founding
Analyze 2006 tobacco control law world first comprehensive smoke-free
Explore cancer treatment public healthcare integration and screening普及
Evaluate 2014 marijuana legalization state control model innovation
Summarize oncologist president cancer tobacco legal health demonstration for global public health governance
UY-ONC-001.expected_zh: 掌握医学专业权威如何转化为公共政策立法动力，理解烟草禁令与大麻管控双重公共卫生创新的互补逻辑，评估巴斯克斯模式对智利阿根廷等邻国卫生政策的外溢影响。
UY-ONC-001.expected_en: Master how medical professional authority transforms into public policy legislative drive, grasp tobacco ban and marijuana control dual public health innovation complementary logic, evaluate Vazquez model spillover impact on Chile Argentina neighbors health policies.
UY-ONC-001.case_zh: 2005 总统；2006 禁烟；2014 大麻合法；2020 逝世。肿瘤医生总统癌症烟草合法范式永存。
UY-ONC-001.case_en: 2005 President; 2006 smoke-free; 2014 marijuana legal; 2020 death. Oncologist president cancer tobacco legal paradigm endures.
UY-ONC-001.cross_cultural_impact: Tobacco control; marijuana legalization; cancer care; doctor politician

AR-NEO-001.name_zh: 阿根廷·卡洛斯·梅内姆：改革货币板与私有化赦免里奥哈腐败
AR-NEO-001.name_en: Argentina Carlos Menem: Reform Currency Board & Privatization Amnesty Rioja Corruption
AR-NEO-001.description_zh: 卡洛斯·梅内姆 (1930-2021) 阿根廷总统 (1989-1999)，货币板制度1比1锚定美元遏制恶性通胀，大规模私有化国企，赦免军政府/庇隆主义者罪行，里奥哈家族腐败丑闻，1999年交权德拉鲁阿。
AR-NEO-001.description_en: Carlos Menem (1930-2021) Argentina President (1989-1999), currency board 1-to-1 dollar peg tamed hyperinflation, massive privatization, pardoned junta/Peronists crimes, Rioja family corruption scandal, 1999 handover De la Rua.
AR-NEO-001.reason_zh: 梅内姆代表新自由主义如何通过货币板与私有化快速稳定经济，展示了赦免过去暴行如何为转型提供政治润滑剂却埋下腐败种子，其货币板崩溃引发2001年阿根廷最大危机。
AR-NEO-001.reason_en: Menem represents how neoliberalism rapidly stabilizes economy through currency board and privatization, demonstrating how pardoning past atrocities provides political lubricant for transition but seeds corruption, his currency board collapse triggered 2001 Argentina worst crisis.
steps_zh: 研究梅内姆早年里奥哈州长与庇隆主义者身份
分析1991年可兑换法货币板1比1锚定美元
探讨石油/电信/航空私有化与赦免法案通过
评估里奥哈家族腐败与1999年交权德拉鲁阿
总结改革货币板私有化赦免里奥哈腐败对阿根廷2001危机的根源铺垫
steps_en: Study Menem early La Rioja Governor and Peronist identity
Analyze 1991 Convertibility Law currency board 1-to-1 dollar peg
Explore oil/telecom/aviation privatization and pardon laws passage
Evaluate Rioja family corruption and 1999 handover De la Rua
Summarize reform currency board privatization amnesty Rioja corruption root cause for Argentina 2001 crisis
AR-NEO-001.expected_zh: 理解货币板如何作为通胀止痛药掩盖结构性失衡，掌握赦免与私有化双重转型代价的长期累积，评估梅内姆遗产对阿根廷周期性危机的深度历史责任。
AR-NEO-001.expected_en: Understand how currency board as inflation painkiller masks structural imbalances, grasp pardon and privatization dual transition costs long-term accumulation, evaluate Menem legacy deep historical responsibility for Argentine cyclical crises.
AR-NEO-001.case_zh: 1989 总统；1991 货币板；1999 交权；2021 逝世。改革货币板私有化赦免腐败范式永存。
AR-NEO-001.case_en: 1989 President; 1991 currency board; 1999 handover; 2021 death. Reform currency board privatization amnesty corruption paradigm endures.
AR-NEO-001.cross_cultural_impact: Currency board; privatization; pardon; hyperinflation cure; 2001 crisis root

CL-SOC-001.name_zh: 智利·萨尔瓦多·阿连德：社会主义选举与政变自杀新自由主义开端
CL-SOC-001.name_en: Chile Salvador Allende: Socialist Election & Coup Suicide Neoliberal Dawn
CL-SOC-001.description_zh: 萨尔瓦多·阿连德 (1908-1973) 智利总统 (1970-1973)，拉美首位民选社会主义总统，人民团结联盟推行国有化改革，1973年皮诺切特政变空军轰炸总统府，阿连德自杀殉道，新自由主义实验开始。
CL-SOC-001.description_en: Salvador Allende (1908-1973) Chile President (1970-1973), Latin America first democratically elected socialist President, Popular Unity coalition implemented nationalization reforms, 1973 Pinochet coup air force bombed La Moneda, Allende suicide martyrdom, neoliberal experiment began.
CL-SOC-001.reason_zh: 阿连德代表民主道路通向社会主义的拉美尝试与美帝国主义干预的悲剧性终结，展示了民选政府如何在经济战与军事政变双重绞杀下崩溃，其自杀殉道成为拉美左翼永恒精神图腾，政变开启智利新自由主义实验室。
CL-SOC-001.reason_en: Allende represents Latin American democratic road to socialism tragic ending and US imperialist intervention, demonstrating how democratically elected government collapses under economic warfare and military coup dual stranglehold, his suicide martyrdom becoming Latin American left eternal spiritual totem, coup inaugurating Chilean neoliberal laboratory.
steps_zh: 研究阿连德早年医生与社会党参议员生涯
分析1970年人民团结联盟当选与铜矿国有化
探讨美国ITT/中央情报局经济战与卡车司机罢工
评估1973年9月11日政变拉莫内达宫自杀殉道
总结社会主义选举政变自杀新自由主义开端对拉美左翼的永恒创伤与警示
steps_en: Study Allende early doctor and Socialist Senator career
Analyze 1970 Popular Unity election and copper nationalization
Explore US ITT/CIA economic warfare and truckers strike
Evaluate 1973 Sep 11 coup La Moneda bombing suicide martyrdom
Summarize socialist election coup suicide neoliberal dawn eternal trauma and warning for Latin American left
CL-SOC-001.expected_zh: 理解民主社会主义如何在帝国主义干预与国内右翼联盟下崩溃，掌握政变如何为新自由主义实验铺平道路，评估阿连德遗产对智利转型正义与拉美左翼复兴的双重指引。
CL-SOC-001.expected_en: Understand how democratic socialism collapses under imperialist intervention and domestic right-wing alliance, grasp how coup paves way for neoliberal experiment, evaluate Allende legacy dual guidance for Chilean transitional justice and Latin American left revival.
CL-SOC-001.case_zh: 1970 总统；1973 政变自杀；皮诺切特17年；2023年宪法公投。社会主义选举政变自杀新自由范式永存。
CL-SOC-001.case_en: 1970 President; 1973 coup suicide; Pinochet 17 years; 2023 constitutional referendum. Socialist election coup suicide neoliberal paradigm endures.
CL-SOC-001.cross_cultural_impact: Democratic socialism; CIA coup; neoliberalism; suicide martyrdom; constitutional reform

MX-OIL-001.name_zh: 墨西哥·拉萨罗·卡德纳斯：石油国有化与土地改革卡德纳斯主义
MX-OIL-001.name_en: Mexico Lazaro Cardenas: Oil Nationalization & Land Reform Cardenismo
MX-OIL-001.description_zh: 拉萨罗·卡德纳斯 (1895-1970) 墨西哥总统 (1934-1940)，1938年石油国有化建立墨西哥石油公司(PEMEX)，大规模土地改革分配埃希多集体用地，奠定墨西哥革命制度化基础。
MX-OIL-001.description_en: Lazaro Cardenas (1895-1970) Mexico President (1934-1940), 1938 oil nationalization established PEMEX, large-scale land reform distributed ejido collective lands, founded Mexican Revolution institutionalization basis.
MX-OIL-001.reason_zh: 卡德纳斯代表墨西哥革命如何通过资源民族化与土地再分配实现制度化，展示了石油主权与农民利益双重合法性如何构建革命政党长期执政基础，其卡德纳斯主义影响拉美资源民族主义至今。
MX-OIL-001.reason_en: Cardenas represents how Mexican Revolution achieved institutionalization through resource nationalization and land redistribution dual legitimacy, demonstrating how oil sovereignty and peasant interests built revolutionary party long-term rule foundation, his Cardenismo influencing Latin American resource nationalism today.
steps_zh: 研究卡德纳斯早年革命将领与卡列斯冲突
分析1938年石油国有化与美英石油公司博弈
探讨埃希多集体土地分配与农民动员

GL-AUT-001.name_zh: 格陵兰·库普·克努森：自治渔业与稀土气候独立博弈
GL-AUT-001.name_en: Greenland Kuupik Kleist: Autonomy Fisheries & Rare Earth Climate Independence Game
GL-AUT-001.description_zh: 库普·克努森 (1958-) 格陵兰自治政府总理 (2009-2013)，推动自治法案扩大立法权，渔业主导经济寻求稀土矿产多元化，气候变化冰盖融化开辟航道资源竞争，与丹麦博弈独立时间表。
GL-AUT-001.description_en: Kuupik Kleist (1958-) Greenland Self-Government PM (2009-2013), promoted Self-Government Act expanding legislative powers, fisheries dominant economy seeking rare earth diversification, climate change ice melt opening shipping lanes resource competition, negotiating independence timeline with Denmark.
GL-AUT-001.reason_zh: 克努森代表北极原住民如何通过自治法律框架与资源主权争取独立主体性，展示了气候变化如何同时成为生存威胁与资源机遇双重悖论，其独立博弈重塑北极地缘政治版图。
GL-AUT-001.reason_en: Kleist represents how Arctic indigenous people pursue independent subjectivity through autonomy legal framework and resource sovereignty, demonstrating how climate change becomes both existential threat and resource opportunity paradox, his independence game reshaping Arctic geopolitical map.

总结自治渔业稀土气候冰盖独立丹麦博弈对北极原住民主权的前沿探索

Analyze 2009 Self-Government Act passage and legislative judicial powers expansion

Evaluate climate melt opening Northwest Passage and US-China-Russia Arctic game
Summarize autonomy fisheries rare earth climate ice independence Denmark game frontier exploration for Arctic indigenous sovereignty

GL-AUT-001.expected_en: Understand how autonomy legal framework provides institutional path for indigenous independence, grasp climate change as existential threat and resource opportunity dual paradox Arctic specificity, evaluate Greenland model demonstration for Nunavut Sami Arctic indigenous autonomy.

JP-MIT-001.name_zh: 石田三成/关原/三成判断/三敬茶/大名平衡
JP-MIT-001.name_en: Ishida Mitsunari/Sekigahara/Mitsunari Judgment/Three Bowls Tea/Daimyo Balance
JP-MIT-001.description_zh: 石田三成 (1560-1600) 丰臣政权五奉行之首，关原之战西军主帅。早年以'三敬茶'侍奉秀吉展现极致观察力与共情，推行'太阁检地'与'三成判断'确立行政理性，关原之战虽败犹显大名平衡术与情报决策。
JP-MIT-001.description_en: Ishida Mitsunari (1560-1600) Head of Toyotomi's Five Commissioners, Western Army commander at Sekigahara. Early 'Three Bowls of Tea' serving Hideyoshi demonstrated supreme observational empathy; implemented Taiko Land Survey and 'Mitsunari Judgments' establishing administrative rationality; Sekigahara defeat still revealed daimyo balance mastery and intelligence-driven decision-making.
JP-MIT-001.reason_zh: 三成代表'技术官僚型武将'如何通过极致观察共情(三敬茶)、制度建设(检地/判断)、情报博弈(关原布局)在乱世构建秩序。其悲剧性失败反而证明：纯理性行政在非理性武力面前的结构性脆弱，以及'三敬茶'式微观共情如何成为宏观决策的认知基石。
JP-MIT-001.reason_en: Mitsunari represents how 'technocratic warrior' built order through supreme observational empathy (Three Bowls Tea), institutional engineering (land survey/judgments), and intelligence games (Sekigahara layout). His tragic failure proves structural fragility of pure rational administration facing irrational force, and how 'Three Bowls Tea' micro-empathy becomes cognitive foundation for macro decisions.
steps_zh: 复盘三敬茶：热/温/凉三杯茶背后的体温感知与需求预判
解析太阁检地：从土地生产力测算到税制标准化的制度理性
研读三成判断：以证据为中心的行政裁决如何确立程序正义
推演关原布局：情报收集/大名劝说/地形选择的博弈树与风险对冲
总结三成模式：微观共情→制度理性→情报决策的认知闭环，及其在非理性武力面前的结构性失效
steps_en: Review Three Bowls Tea: body temp sensing & need anticipation behind hot/warm/cool tea
Analyze Taiko Land Survey: from productivity measurement to tax standardization institutional rationality
Study Mitsunari Judgments: evidence-centered administrative adjudication establishing procedural justice
Reenact Sekigahara Layout: intelligence gathering/daimyo persuasion/terrain selection game tree & risk hedging
Summarize Mitsunari Pattern: micro-empathy → institutional rationality → intelligence decision cognitive loop, and its structural failure against irrational force
JP-MIT-001.expected_zh: 掌握'三敬茶式观察共情'如何转化为'检地式制度理性'与'关原式情报决策'的认知升级路径；理解技术官僚在乱世中的建构性贡献与结构性悲剧；评估三成模式对现代行政裁决、情报决策、组织共情文化的双重启示。
JP-MIT-001.expected_en: Master cognitive upgrade path from 'Three Bowls Tea observational empathy' to 'Land Survey institutional rationality' to 'Sekigahara intelligence decision'; understand technocrat's constructive contribution and structural tragedy in chaos; evaluate Mitsunari pattern's dual lessons for modern administrative adjudication, intelligence decision-making, and organizational empathy culture.
JP-MIT-001.case_zh: 1590 三敬茶得秀吉赏识；1594 太阁检地确立税制；1598 三成判断确立程序正义；1600 关原之战败亡。三敬茶-检地-判断-关原认知闭环永存。
JP-MIT-001.case_en: 1590 Three Bowls Tea won Hideyoshi's favor; 1594 Taiko Land Survey established tax system; 1598 Mitsunari Judgments established procedural justice; 1600 Sekigahara defeat. Three Bowls Tea-Survey-Judgment-Sekigahara cognitive loop endures.
JP-MIT-001.intellectual_tradition: Sengoku Technocratic Administration / Japanese Bureaucratic Rationality
JP-MIT-001.cross_cultural_impact: Three Bowls Tea empathy; land survey institutionalization; evidence-based administrative judgment; intelligence-driven strategic decision; technocrat tragedy

JP-SOS-001.name_zh: 夏目漱石/明治/文豪/近代自我/猫视角/心理剖析
JP-SOS-001.name_en: Natsume Soseki/Meiji/Literary Master/Modern Self/Cat Perspective/Psychological Anatomy
JP-SOS-001.description_zh: 夏目漱石 (1867-1916) 日本近代文学奠基人，《我是猫》《心》《坊津》作者。以'猫视角'拟人化讽刺明治文明病理，'心'完成近代自我心理解剖，留学英国反思文明冲突，提出'then-and-now'文明批评框架，确立私小说心理实验传统。
JP-SOS-001.description_en: Natsume Soseki (1867-1916) Founder of modern Japanese literature, author of I Am a Cat, Kokoro, Botchan. Used 'cat perspective' anthropomorphic satire on Meiji civilization pathology; Kokoro completed modern self psychological anatomy; UK study reflected civilization clash; proposed 'then-and-now' civilization critique framework; established shishosetsu psychological experiment tradition.
JP-SOS-001.reason_zh: 漱石代表'近代自我'如何在文明剧变中通过文学实验完成心理解剖。其'猫视角'将读者置于旁观者位置重审文明荒谬；'心'以师生/父子/夫妻三重背叛完成近代伦理解体图谱；留学反思确立'文明批评'作为知识分子核心使命。私小说传统至今影响村上春树、东野圭吾等。
JP-SOS-001.reason_en: Soseki represents how 'modern self' completes psychological anatomy through literary experiment amid civilization upheaval. 'Cat perspective' places reader as observer re-examining civilization absurdity; Kokoro maps modern ethics disintegration via teacher-student/father-son/husband-wife triple betrayal; UK reflection established 'civilization critique' as intellectuals' core mission. Shishosetsu tradition influences Murakami, Higashino today.
steps_zh: 解构《我是猫》：拟人化讽刺如何将读者置于旁观位置解构文明荒谬
剖析《心》：师生/父子/夫妻三重背叛如何完成近代伦理解体图谱
追溯留学反思：伦敦两年'神经衰弱'如何转化为'then-and-now'文明批评框架
确立私小说：心理实验与自传融合如何开创'我小说'传统
总结漱石模式：猫视角解构→心理剖析解体→文明批评框架→私小说传承的文学认知闭环
steps_en: Deconstruct I Am a Cat: how anthropomorphic satire places reader as observer deconstructing civilization absurdity
Analyze Kokoro: how teacher-student/father-son/husband-wife triple betrayal maps modern ethics disintegration
Trace UK reflection: how two years London 'neurasthenia' transformed into 'then-and-now' civilization critique framework
Establish Shishosetsu: how psychological experiment + autobiography fusion created 'I-novel' tradition
Summarize Soseki pattern: cat perspective deconstruction → psychological anatomy disintegration → civilization critique framework → I-novel tradition cognitive loop
JP-SOS-001.expected_zh: 掌握'猫视角'如何作为文学手术刀解剖文明病理；理解'心'式心理剖析如何完成近代自我伦理拓扑；评估漱石文明批评框架对当代知识分子公共介入的方法论启示。
JP-SOS-001.expected_en: Master how 'cat perspective' serves as literary scalpel dissecting civilization pathology; understand how Kokoro-style psychological anatomy completes modern self ethical topology; evaluate Soseki civilization critique framework's methodological lessons for contemporary intellectuals' public engagement.
JP-SOS-001.case_zh: 1905 《我是猫》连载；1914 《心》发表；1916 病逝未完《明暗》。猫视角-心理剖析-文明批评-私小说范式永存。
JP-SOS-001.case_en: 1905 I Am a Cat serialized; 1914 Kokoro published; 1916 died unfinished Light and Darkness. Cat perspective-psychological anatomy-civilization critique-I-novel paradigm endures.
JP-SOS-001.intellectual_tradition: Modern Japanese Literature / Shishosetsu / Civilization Critique
JP-SOS-001.cross_cultural_impact: Cat perspective satire; psychological anatomy; civilization critique; I-novel tradition; modern self
JP-SOS-001.artistic_legacy: 是: 小说/文学批评/私小说传统

NL-WIL-001.name_zh: 威廉一世/荷兰/奥兰治/独立战争/东印度公司/海上马车夫
NL-WIL-001.name_en: William I/Netherlands/Orange/Independence War/East India Company/Sea Carrier
NL-WIL-001.description_zh: 威廉一世 (1772-1843) 荷兰首任国王，奥兰治-拿骚家族首领，领导荷兰独立战争摆脱法国统治，建立联合王国，扩张东印度公司 (VOC) 亚洲贸易网络，确立荷兰海上马车夫地位，加尔文主义宽容传统奠定国家基因。
NL-WIL-001.description_en: William I (1772-1843) Netherlands first king, Orange-Nassau family head, led Dutch independence war against French rule, established United Kingdom, expanded VOC Asian trade network, established Dutch sea carrier status, Calvinist tolerance tradition founded national genes.
NL-WIL-001.reason_zh: 威廉一世代表小国如何通过海上贸易与殖民网络成为全球经济枢纽，展示了加尔文主义宽容传统如何转化为商业竞争优势，其东印度公司模式开创了跨国公司先河。
NL-WIL-001.reason_en: William I represents how small nation becomes global economic hub through maritime trade and colonial network, demonstrating how Calvinist tolerance tradition transforms into commercial competitive advantage, his VOC model pioneering multinational corporation prototype.

分析1813年独立战争/1815年维也纳会议/联合王国建立
探讨VOC亚洲贸易网络/香料垄断/巴达维亚总督府

总结奥兰治精神/东印度公司/海上马车夫/加尔文宽容四重遗产

Explore VOC Asian trade network/spice monopoly/Batavia Governor-General
Evaluate Calvinist tolerance/religious freedom/commercial freedom tradition
Summarize Orange spirit/VOC/sea carriage/Calvinist tolerance quadruple legacy

NL-GRO-001.name_zh: 格劳秀斯/荷兰/国际法/海洋自由/自然法/阿姆斯特丹/法学之父
NL-GRO-001.name_en: Grotius/Netherlands/International Law/Freedom of Seas/Natural Law/Amsterdam/Father of International Law
NL-GRO-001.description_zh: 雨果·格劳秀斯 (1583-1645) 国际法奠基人，《战争与和平法》确立海洋自由原则，自然法理论超越教权构建世俗法理体系，阿姆斯特丹法学家为荷兰东印度公司辩护奠定海洋法基础，流亡巴黎撰写巨著影响至今。
NL-GRO-001.description_en: Hugo Grotius (1583-1645) Father of International Law, De Jure Belli ac Pacis established freedom of seas principle, natural law theory transcending ecclesiastical authority constructing secular legal system, Amsterdam jurist defending VOC laid maritime law foundation, Paris exile writing magnum opus influencing today.
NL-GRO-001.reason_zh: 格劳秀斯代表法学如何通过理性推演超越神权与主权界限，展示了海洋自由原则如何保护弱小国家贸易权利，其自然法体系为现代国际法/人道法/海洋法提供了共同语言基础。
NL-GRO-001.reason_en: Grotius represents how jurisprudence transcends divine right and sovereignty boundaries through rational deduction, demonstrating how freedom of seas protects weak nations trade rights, his natural law system providing common language basis for modern international law/humanitarian law/maritime law.
steps_zh: 研究格劳秀斯早年天才少年/莱顿大学/律师/东印度公司顾问
分析《自由海》海洋自由原则/自由贸易/无主物先占
探讨《战争与和平法》自然法/正义战争/国际法体系
评估流亡巴黎/瑞典/外交/法学巨著/法学之父
总结国际法/海洋自由/自然法/战争法/主权平等五重遗产

Analyze Mare Liberum freedom of seas/free trade/res nullius
Explore De Jure Belli ac Pacis natural law/just war/international law system
Evaluate Paris exile/Sweden diplomacy/legal magnum opus/father of intl law
Summarize international law/freedom of seas/natural law/war law/sovereign equality quintuple legacy

NL-GRO-001.expected_en: Master how natural law constructs universal jurisprudence transcending sovereignty, grasp freedom of seas protecting weak nations survival space, evaluate Grotius foundational contribution to modern intl law/humanitarian law/maritime law.

NL-GRO-001.cross_cultural_impact: International law; freedom of seas; natural law; just war; maritime law

NL-TOB-001.name_zh: 托贝/荷兰/三角洲工程/水利民主/北海防洪/水管理/气候适应
NL-TOB-001.name_en: Toebes/Netherlands/Delta Works/Water Democracy/North Sea Flood/Water Management/Climate Adaptation
NL-TOB-001.description_zh: 约汉·范·托贝 (1903-1989) 荷兰水利工程师，1953年北海大洪水后主导三角洲工程，建立水利民主决策模式，与水共生而非对抗，荷兰成为全球水管理/气候适应标杆，三角洲工程被誉为现代世界七大奇迹之一。
NL-TOB-001.description_en: Johan van Toebes (1903-1989) Dutch hydraulic engineer, led Delta Works after 1953 North Sea Flood, established water democracy decision model, living with water not against it, Netherlands became global water management/climate adaptation benchmark, Delta Works hailed as modern world seven wonders.
NL-TOB-001.reason_zh: 托贝代表低地国家如何通过技术工程与民主决策双重手段实现国家生存，展示了与水共生理念如何超越单纯工程对抗，其水利民主模式为全球沿海城市气候适应提供了治理范式。
NL-TOB-001.reason_en: Toebes represents how lowland nation achieves national survival through technical engineering and democratic decision dual approach, demonstrating how living-with-water philosophy transcends pure engineering confrontation, his water democracy model providing governance paradigm for global coastal cities climate adaptation.

NL-TOB-001.expected_en: Master how technical engineering combines with democratic decision for national survival, grasp living-with-water philosophy transcending engineering confrontation, evaluate Dutch water democracy model governance paradigm for global coastal cities climate adaptation.

NL-PHIL-001.name_zh: 菲利普斯/荷兰/电子/灯泡/医疗/研发/家族企业/埃因霍温
NL-PHIL-001.description_zh: 杰拉德·菲利普斯 (1858-1942) 与儿子安东，从灯泡起家建立电子帝国，埃因霍温研发基地孵化医疗/照明/消费电子创新，家族企业治理平衡技术理想与商业现实，二战期间保护犹太员工，战后重建欧洲电子工业基石。
NL-PHIL-001.description_en: Gerard Philips (1858-1942) and son Anton, built electronics empire from lightbulbs, Eindhoven R&D base incubated medical/lighting/consumer electronics innovations, family enterprise governance balanced tech ideals and commercial reality, WWII protected Jewish employees, postwar rebuilt European electronics industry foundation.

DE-ADO-001.description_zh: 康拉德·阿登纳 (1876-1967) 西德首任总理 (1949-1963)，推动西德融入西方阵营，巴黎条约/罗马条约奠定欧洲共同体基础，大西洋主义锚定美德关系，社会市场经济确立战后经济奇迹基础，年过七十仍执政十四年。
DE-ADO-001.description_en: Konrad Adenauer (1876-1967) West Germany first Chancellor (1949-1963), drove West Germany integration into Western bloc, Paris/Rome Treaties founded European Community basis, Atlanticism anchored US-Germany relations, social market economy established post-war economic miracle foundation, governed fourteen years past age seventy.
DE-ADO-001.reason_zh: 阿登纳代表战败国如何通过主动西向融入重塑国家身份，展示了社会市场经济如何平衡资本效率与社会公正，其大西洋主义与欧洲一体化双轮驱动奠定现代德国外交基石。
DE-ADO-001.reason_en: Adenauer represents how defeated nation reshapes national identity through proactive Western integration, demonstrating how social market economy balances capitalist efficiency and social justice, his Atlanticism and European integration dual-wheel driving modern German diplomacy foundation.

DE-BIS-001.name_zh: 俾斯麦/德国/铁血宰相/统一/保险/同盟
DE-BIS-001.description_zh: 奥托·冯·俾斯麦 (1815-1898) 普鲁士首相、德意志帝国首任铁血宰相，通过三次战争完成德意志统一，建立三帝同盟体系，创立世界首个社会保险体系（医疗/工伤/养老），实行铁血现实politik平衡欧洲大陆势力。
DE-BIS-001.description_en: Otto von Bismarck (1815-1898) Prussian Minister President, first Iron Chancellor of German Empire, achieved German unification through three wars, established Three Emperors League system, created world's first social insurance system (health/workers' comp/pension), practiced Realpolitik balancing European continental powers.
DE-BIS-001.reason_zh: 俾斯麦代表现实主义外交如何通过战争与外交双重手段完成民族统一，展示了社会保险如何作为国家整合工具安抚工人阶级，其均势外交体系维持欧洲和平四十年，铁血宰相模式影响现代地缘政治。
DE-BIS-001.reason_en: Bismarck represents how realist diplomacy achieves national unification through war and diplomacy dual approach, demonstrating how social insurance serves as state integration tool appeasing working class, his balance-of-power system maintained European peace for forty years, Iron Chancellor model influencing modern geopolitics.

DE-BRA-001.name_zh: 勃兰特/德国/东方政策/跪地谢罪/诺贝尔/社民党
DE-BRA-001.description_zh: 维利·勃兰特 (1913-1992) 西德总理 (1969-1974)，东方政策缓和与东欧关系，华沙跪地谢罪成为历史和解象征，诺贝尔和平奖肯定和解努力，社民党现代化确立福利国家新阶段，1974年因间谍案辞职。
DE-BRA-001.description_en: Willy Brandt (1913-1992) West German Chancellor (1969-1974), Ostpolitik detente with Eastern Europe, Warsaw kneeling apology became historical reconciliation symbol, Nobel Peace Prize affirmed reconciliation efforts, SPD modernization established welfare state new stage, 1974 resigned over spy scandal.
DE-BRA-001.reason_zh: 勃兰特代表战败国如何通过主动承认历史罪责实现道德重生，展示了东方政策如何通过接触而非隔离化解冷战对抗，其跪地谢罪成为转型正义全球范式，诺贝尔和平奖加冕道德权威。
DE-BRA-001.reason_en: Brandt represents how defeated nation achieves moral rebirth through proactive historical guilt admission, demonstrating how Ostpolitik resolves Cold War confrontation through engagement not isolation, his kneeling apology becoming transitional justice global paradigm, Nobel Peace Prize crowning moral authority.

DE-ENE-001.description_en: German Energiewende launched 2000 Renewable Energy Act (EEG), 2011 Fukushima accelerated nuclear phase-out (2023 last three closed), renewables exceed 50% electricity share, storage/hydrogen/grid digitalization support intermittent sources, industrial decarbonization drives steel/chemicals/cement green transition, target 2045 carbon neutrality.

DE-HAB-001.name_zh: 哈贝马斯/德国/公共领域/交往理性/宪法爱国/法兰克福
DE-HAB-001.description_zh: 于尔根·哈贝马斯 (1929-) 法兰克福学派第二代核心，《公共领域的结构转型》奠基媒介理论，交往理性超越工具理性构建批判理论新范式，宪法爱国主义超越民族主义构建后民族国家认同，介入德国统一/欧盟/公共辩论六十年公共知识分子典范。
DE-HAB-001.description_en: Jürgen Habermas (1929-) Frankfurt School second generation core, Structural Transformation of the Public Sphere founded media theory, communicative rationality transcending instrumental reason constructed critical theory new paradigm, constitutional patriotism transcending nationalism constructing post-nation-state identity, intervening German reunification/EU/public debate sixty years public intellectual paradigm.
DE-HAB-001.reason_zh: 哈贝马斯代表批判理论如何从工具理性批判转向交往理性建构，展示了公共领域如何作为民主合法性来源而非舆论操纵场所，其宪法爱国主义为后民族主义时代提供了超越血缘/文化的政治认同方案。
DE-HAB-001.reason_en: Habermas represents how critical theory shifts from instrumental reason critique to communicative rationality construction, demonstrating how public sphere serves as democratic legitimacy source not opinion manipulation venue, his constitutional patriotism providing post-nationalism era political identity solution transcending blood/culture.

DE-HEG-001.name_zh: 黑格尔/德国/辩证法/绝对精神/历史哲学/普鲁士国家
DE-HEG-001.description_zh: 格奥尔格·威廉·弗里德里希·黑格尔 (1770-1831) 德国古典哲学集大成者，辩证法三段论（正-反-合）奠定现代哲学基础，绝对精神自我展开构建历史哲学体系，普鲁士国家作为理性实现的最高形式，影响马克思/海德格尔/哈贝马斯百年传承。
DE-HEG-001.description_en: Georg Wilhelm Friedrich Hegel (1770-1831) German classical philosophy culminator, dialectical triad (thesis-antithesis-synthesis) founded modern philosophy basis, absolute spirit self-unfolding constructed philosophy of history system, Prussian state as highest form of reason realization, influenced Marx/Heidegger/Habermas century-long inheritance.
DE-HEG-001.reason_zh: 黑格尔代表哲学如何通过辩证法将历史纳入理性体系，展示了国家作为伦理实体如何超越个人主观性，其辩证法成为马克思历史唯物主义与西方现代哲学的共同母体。
DE-HEG-001.reason_en: Hegel represents how philosophy incorporates history into rational system through dialectic, demonstrating how state as ethical entity transcends individual subjectivity, his dialectic becoming common matrix for Marx historical materialism and Western modern philosophy.
steps_zh: 研究黑格尔早年图宾根/耶拿/海德堡教授生涯
分析《精神现象学》主奴辩证与绝对知识
探讨《法哲学原理》国家伦理与公民社会
评估黑格尔左派/右派分化与马克思继承
总结辩证法/绝对精神/国家理性三重哲学遗产

Analyze Phenomenology of Spirit master-slave dialectic and absolute knowledge

Summarize dialectic/absolute spirit/state reason triple philosophical legacy

DE-HEG-001.expected_en: Master how dialectical triad incorporates history into rational necessity, grasp state as objective spirit ethical entity status, evaluate Hegel philosophy decisive foundation for Marxism/existentialism/critical theory.

DE-HEG-001.case_en: 1807 Phenomenology; 1821 Philosophy of Right; 1831 cholera death. Dialectic/absolute spirit/state reason paradigm endures.

DE-HEG-001.cross_cultural_impact: Dialectic; absolute spirit; philosophy of history; Marxism; critical theory

EG-NAS-001.name_zh: 纳赛尔/埃及/泛阿拉伯/苏伊士/土地改革/阿拉伯社会主义/不结盟
EG-NAS-001.description_zh:
加马尔·阿卜杜勒·纳赛尔 (1918-1970) 是埃及政治家，曾任总统。他领导埃及进行苏伊士运河收复，推行土地改革和阿拉伯社会主义，建立泛阿拉伯运动，并推动不结盟运动。

纳赛尔是阿拉伯世界的重要领导人之一，他的理想是统一阿拉伯国家，实现民族复兴和独立。他的政治生涯充满了斗争和成就，从苏伊士运河危机到成立阿拉伯统一社会党，再到推动不结盟运动，他为阿拉伯人民的解放事业做出了巨大贡献。
EG-NAS-001.description_en:
Gamal Abdel Nasser (1918-1970) was an Egyptian politician who served as President. He led Egypt in Suez Canal recovery, implemented land reform and Arab socialism, established Pan-Arab movement, and promoted Non-Aligned movement.

Nasser was one of the most important leaders in the Arab world, whose ideal was to unify Arab countries, achieve national revival and independence. His political career was full of struggles and achievements, from the Suez Canal crisis to founding the Arab Socialist Union, to promoting the Non-Aligned Movement, he made tremendous contributions to the cause of Arab liberation.
EG-NAS-001.reason_zh: 核心思维：M544(泛阿拉伯/苏伊士运河/土地改革/阿拉伯社会主义/不结盟)、1(战略预判)、20(博弈论)、40(三衙分兵/军政分离)、67(战略敏捷)。纳赛尔体现了战略预判和博弈论精神，通过苏伊士运河收复实现国家独立，通过土地改革和阿拉伯社会主义实现社会进步，通过泛阿拉伯运动和不结盟运动推动区域合作。
EG-NAS-001.reason_en: Core thinking modes: M544(Pan-Arab/Suez Canal/Land Reform/Arab Socialism/Non-Aligned)、1(Strategic Foresight)、20(Game Theory)、40(Three-gate Separation/Military-Civilian Separation)、67(Strategic Agility). Nasser embodies strategic foresight and game theory spirit through Suez Canal recovery realizing national independence, land reform and Arab socialism realizing social progress, Pan-Arab movement and Non-Aligned movement promoting regional cooperation.

EG-NAS-001.case_zh: 1918 出生；1956-1970 任总统；1970 逝世；苏伊士运河/土地改革。泛阿拉伯/苏伊士运河/土地改革/阿拉伯社会主义/不结盟范式永存。
EG-NAS-001.case_en: 1918 birth; President 1956-1970; died 1970; Suez Canal/Land Reform. Pan-Arab/Suez Canal/Land Reform/Arab Socialism/Non-Aligned paradigm endures.

EG-SAD-001.name_zh: 萨达特/埃及/和平/以色列/诺贝尔/开放门户/十月战争/遇刺
EG-SAD-001.description_zh: 安瓦尔·萨达特 (1918-1981) 是埃及政治家，曾任总统。他领导埃及与以色列实现和平协议，赢得诺贝尔和平奖，但后来遇刺身亡。他的开放门户政策推动了埃及的经济和社会改革。
EG-SAD-001.description_en: Anwar Sadat (1918-1981) was an Egyptian politician who served as President. He led Egypt in signing peace agreement with Israel, winning Nobel Peace Prize, but was later assassinated. His Open Door policy promoted Egypt's economic and social reform.
EG-SAD-001.reason_zh: 核心思维：M545(埃及以色列和平/诺贝尔/开放门户/十月战争/遇刺)、1(战略预判)、20(博弈论)、40(三衙分兵/军政分离)、67(战略敏捷)。萨达特体现了战略预判和博弈论精神，通过和平协议实现区域稳定，通过开放门户推动经济改革，通过遇刺确保国家安全。
EG-SAD-001.reason_en: Core thinking modes: M545(Egypt-Israel Peace/Nobel/Open-Door/October-War/Assassination)、1(Strategic Foresight)、20(Game Theory)、40(Three-gate Separation/Military-Civilian Separation)、67(Strategic Agility). Sadat embodies strategic foresight and game theory spirit through peace agreement realizing regional stability, Open Door promoting economic reform, assassination ensuring national security.
steps_zh: 第1步：战略预判法——制定和平协议大计：制定以埃和平协议计划
第2步：博弈论法——和平博弈：通过外交手段实现区域稳定
第3步：三衙分兵法——军政分离：通过开放门户实现经济改革
第4步：战略敏捷法——灵活外交：通过遇刺确保国家安全
steps_en: Step 1: Strategic Foresight - Formulate peace agreement plan: Formulate Egypt-Israel peace agreement plan
Step 2: Game Theory - Peace game: Realize regional stability through diplomatic means
Step 3: Three-gate Separation - Military-civilian separation: Realize economic reform through Open Door
Step 4: Strategic Agility - Flexible diplomacy: Ensure national security through assassination
expected_zh: 推动经济改革和社会发展
expected_en: Promote economic reform and social development
EG-SAD-001.case_zh: 1918 出生；1970-1981 任总统；1981 遇刺身亡。埃及以色列和平/诺贝尔/开放门户/十月战争/遇刺范式永存。
EG-SAD-001.case_en: 1918 birth; President 1970-1981; assassinated 1981. Egypt-Israel Peace/Nobel/Open-Door/October-War/Assassination paradigm endures.

EG-MUB-001.name_zh: 穆巴拉克：长期稳定/阿拉伯之春/塔利班/塔利班/权力交接/军政关系
EG-MUB-001.name_en: Mubarak: Long-term Stability/Arab Spring/Taliban/Taliban/Power Transition/Military-Political Relations
EG-MUB-001.description_zh: 穆巴拉克是埃及的长期领导人，1928-2019年，在他的领导下，埃及实现了长期稳定，经济发展取得显著成就，但在2011年阿拉伯之春期间，他被迫下台，埃及经历了政治动荡和权力交接。穆巴拉克执政期间，埃及与塔利班关系复杂多变，但在2011年政治动荡后，埃及与塔利班的关系发生了显著变化。
EG-MUB-001.description_en: Mubarak was Egypt's long-term leader from 1928 to 2019. Under his leadership, Egypt achieved long-term stability and significant economic development. However, during the 2011 Arab Spring, he was forced to step down, and Egypt experienced political turmoil and power transitions. During Mubarak's tenure, Egypt's relations with the Taliban were complex, but after the 2011 political turmoil, the relationship between Egypt and the Taliban underwent significant changes.
EG-MUB-001.reason_zh: 穆巴拉克领导埃及实现长期稳定，但阿拉伯之春期间被迫下台，导致政治动荡。他与塔利班的关系复杂多变，但在2011年后埃及实现了权力交接，政治关系发生重大变化。
EG-MUB-001.reason_en: Mubarak led Egypt to achieve long-term stability but was forced to step down during the Arab Spring, causing political turmoil. His relations with the Taliban were complex, but after the 2011 political upheaval, Egypt underwent power transitions and the relationship with the Taliban changed significantly.
steps_zh: 学习穆巴拉克的长期稳定领导艺术，理解政治稳定的重要性
研究埃及阿拉伯之春的历史背景和2011年政治动荡，掌握社会动荡的外交策略
分析埃及与塔利班的复杂关系，探索区域安全合作的有效途径
探讨埃及权力交接的政治进程和改革经验，理解转型期的挑战
总结穆巴拉克执政时期的经验教训，阐述政治稳定与改革的辩证关系
steps_en: Study Mubarak’s long-term stability leadership art, understand the importance of political stability
Study the historical background of Egypt’s Arab Spring and the 2011 political turmoil, master diplomatic strategies for social upheavals
Analyze Egypt’s complex relations with the Taliban, explore effective paths for regional security cooperation
Explore Egypt’s power transition political process and reform experiences, understand challenges in transition periods
Summarize Mubarak’s experiences and the dialectical relationship between political stability and reform
EG-MUB-001.expected_zh: 掌握穆巴拉克长期稳定领导艺术，理解政治稳定的重要性，熟悉埃及阿拉伯之春和2011年政治动荡的历史背景，分析埃及与塔利班的关系，探讨埃及权力交接的政治进程和改革经验，培养学生对政治稳定与改革辩证关系的理解。
EG-MUB-001.expected_en: Master Mubarak’s long-term stability leadership art, understand the importance of political stability, be familiar with the historical background of Egypt’s Arab Spring and the 2011 political turmoil, analyze Egypt’s relations with the Taliban, explore Egypt’s power transition political process and reform experiences, cultivate students' understanding of the dialectical relationship between political stability and reform.
EG-MUB-001.case_zh: 2011年，埃及爆发了阿拉伯之春运动，大量民众走上街头，要求穆巴拉克下台。经过数周的示威和谈判，穆巴拉克于2月11日宣布辞职，将权力移交给军方。这标志着埃及长期稳定制度的结束，开始了新的政治过渡时期。
EG-MUB-001.case_en: In 2011, Egypt erupted in the Arab Spring movement, with large numbers of people taking to the streets to demand Mubarak’s resignation. After weeks of demonstrations and negotiations, Mubarak announced his resignation on February 11 and transferred power to the military. This marked the end of Egypt’s long-term stable system and the beginning of a new political transition period.
EG-MUB-001.cross_cultural_impact: Arab Spring inspiration, political transition models, Middle East security dynamics

PK-JIN-001.name_zh: 真纳：巴基斯坦建国/两国论/伊斯兰宪政/穆斯林联盟/真纳精神
PK-JIN-001.name_en: Jinnah: Pakistan Independence/Two-Nation Theory/Islamic Constitutionalism/Muslim League/Jinnah Spirit
PK-JIN-001.description_zh: 真纳是巴基斯坦的国父，1876-1948年，他领导印度次大陆上的穆斯林人民争取独立，提出了著名的"两国论", 主张印度教徒和穆斯林是两个不同的民族，应在地理上分割，建立独立的国家。1947年，英属印度分裂为印度和巴基斯坦，真纳成为巴基斯坦的首任总督。真纳推动了伊斯兰宪政建设，建立了民主制度，为巴基斯坦的独立和现代化奠定了基础。
PK-JIN-001.description_en: Jinnah was the founding father of Pakistan, from 1876 to 1948, he led the Muslim people of the Indian subcontinent to fight for independence, proposing the famous "Two-Nation Theory," arguing that Hindus and Muslims were two distinct nations and should be geographically divided into independent states. In 1947, British India was partitioned into India and Pakistan, with Jinnah becoming the first Governor-General of Pakistan. Jinnah promoted Islamic constitutionalism, established democratic systems, and laid the foundation for Pakistan's independence and modernization.
PK-JIN-001.reason_zh: 真纳领导印度次大陆上的穆斯林人民赢得独立，建立了巴基斯坦国，推动了伊斯兰宪政和民主制度建设，但他的国家分裂主张导致印巴冲突持续。他的精神成为巴基斯坦国家身份的重要组成部分。
PK-JIN-001.reason_en: Jinnah led the Muslim people of the Indian subcontinent to win independence and establish Pakistan, promoted Islamic constitutionalism and democratic systems, but his partition of India led to ongoing India-Pakistan conflicts. His spirit remains a crucial part of Pakistan's national identity.
steps_zh: 学习真纳的领导艺术和外交策略，理解国家建国的历史必然性
研究印巴分治的历史背景和谈判过程，掌握殖民时代民族解放的外交策略
分析真纳的宪政建设和民主制度，探索伊斯兰国家的现代化道路
探讨真纳的精神和遗产，理解领导者在国家建设中的作用
总结真纳的经验教训，阐述国家统一与分裂的辩证关系
steps_en: Study Jinnah's leadership art and diplomatic strategies, understand the historical inevitability of national independence
Study the historical background and negotiation process of the India-Pakistan partition, master diplomatic strategies for national liberation during colonial times
Analyze Jinnah's constitutional construction and democratic systems, explore paths for Islamic state modernization
Explore Jinnah's spirit and legacy, understand the role of leaders in national construction
Summarize Jinnah's experiences and the dialectical relationship between national unity and division
PK-JIN-001.expected_zh: 掌握真纳的国家建国领导艺术和外交策略，熟悉印巴分治的历史背景和谈判过程，理解伊斯兰宪政和民主制度的建设，分析真纳的精神和遗产，培养学生对国家建国历史和领导者责任的认识。
PK-JIN-001.expected_en: Master Jinnah's national independence leadership art and diplomatic strategies, be familiar with the historical background and negotiation process of the India-Pakistan partition, understand the construction of Islamic constitutionalism and democratic systems, analyze Jinnah's spirit and legacy, cultivate students' understanding of national construction history and leadership responsibilities.
PK-JIN-001.case_zh: 1947年，真纳领导巴基斯坦人民赢得独立，建立了巴基斯坦国，成为首任总督。印巴分治导致大量人口迁移和宗教冲突，但真纳的领导确保了巴基斯坦的顺利建国和初期稳定。
PK-JIN-001.case_en: In 1947, Jinnah led the Pakistani people to win independence and establish the state of Pakistan, becoming the first Governor-General. The India-Pakistan partition caused significant population migration and religious conflicts, but Jinnah's leadership ensured Pakistan's smooth establishment and initial stability.
PK-JIN-001.cross_cultural_impact: South Asian partition model, Islamic constitutionalism, Pakistan state-building template

PK-BHU-001.name_zh: 布托：伊斯兰社会主义/民粹动员/核威慑/妇女权利/布托主义
PK-BHU-001.name_en: Bhutto: Islamic Socialism/Populist Mobilization/Nuclear Deterrence/Women's Rights/Bhuttoism
PK-BHU-001.description_zh: 布托是巴基斯坦的伟大领导人，1928-2007年，他领导巴基斯坦实现独立，建立了民主制度。布托推行了伊斯兰社会主义政策，动员了广大民众的支持。他领导巴基斯坦获得了核武器，建立了强大的国防力量。布托重视妇女权利，推动了女性赋权，为巴基斯坦的现代化和民主化做出了重要贡献。他的政治遗产至今仍影响着巴基斯坦政治。
PK-BHU-001.description_en: Bhutto was a great Pakistani leader from 1928 to 2007, who led Pakistan to independence and established a democratic system. Bhutto implemented Islamic socialist policies and mobilized widespread popular support. He led Pakistan to obtain nuclear weapons and established a strong defense capability. Bhutto emphasized women's rights and promoted female empowerment, making significant contributions to Pakistan's modernization and democratization. His political legacy continues to influence Pakistani politics today.
PK-BHU-001.reason_zh: 布托推行伊斯兰社会主义和民粹动员，赢得了民众支持，但他的激进政策导致政治动荡。他领导巴基斯坦获得核武器，但这也引发了地区紧张局势。他的妇女权利运动推动了进步，但也引发了社会争议。他的政治遗产至今仍充满争议。
PK-BHU-001.reason_en: Bhutto implemented Islamic socialism and populist mobilization, winning popular support, but his radical policies caused political turmoil. He led Pakistan to obtain nuclear weapons, which also triggered regional tensions. His women's rights movement promoted progress but also caused social controversy. His political legacy remains highly controversial today.
steps_zh: 学习布托的领导艺术和政治动员能力，理解在殖民时代国家建国的历史必然性
研究巴基斯坦核武器获得的历史背景和国际影响，掌握核政策的制定和实施
分析布托的妇女权利运动和民粹主义政策，探索在专制环境下推动进步的有效途径
探讨布托的伊斯兰社会主义政策，理解意识形态在政治中的作用
总结布托的经验教训，阐述在专制环境下推动民主和进步的挑战
steps_en: Study Bhutto's leadership art and political mobilization abilities, understand the historical inevitability of national independence during colonial times
Study the historical background and international impact of Pakistan obtaining nuclear weapons, master the formulation and implementation of nuclear policies
Analyze Bhutto's women's rights movement and populist policies, explore effective paths for promoting progress in authoritarian environments
Explore Bhutto's Islamic socialist policies, understand the role of ideology in politics
Summarize Bhutto's experiences and the challenges of promoting democracy and progress in authoritarian environments
PK-BHU-001.expected_zh: 掌握布托的领导艺术和政治动员能力，熟悉巴基斯坦核武器获得的历史背景，理解伊斯兰社会主义和妇女权利运动的重要性，分析布托的民粹主义政策，培养学生对专制环境下推动民主和进步的理解和认识。
PK-BHU-001.expected_en: Master Bhutto's leadership art and political mobilization abilities, be familiar with the historical background of Pakistan obtaining nuclear weapons, understand the significance of Islamic socialism and women's rights movements, analyze Bhutto's populist policies, cultivate students' understanding and awareness of promoting democracy and progress in authoritarian environments.
PK-BHU-001.case_zh: 1971年，布托领导巴基斯坦人民赢得独立，成为首任总理。他推行了伊斯兰社会主义和民粹动员，赢得了广泛支持。他领导巴基斯坦获得了核武器，但这也引发了地区紧张局势。他的妇女权利运动推动了进步，但也引发了社会争议。他于2007年遇刺身亡，他的政治遗产至今仍充满争议。
PK-BHU-001.case_en: In 1971, Bhutto led the Pakistani people to win independence and became the first Prime Minister. He implemented Islamic socialism and populist mobilization, winning widespread support. He led Pakistan to obtain nuclear weapons, which also triggered regional tensions. His women's rights movement promoted progress but also caused social controversy. He was assassinated in 2007, and his political legacy remains highly controversial today.
PK-BHU-001.cross_cultural_impact: Islamic socialist model, women's rights movement, nuclear proliferation in South Asia

PK-ZIA-001.name_zh: 齐亚：伊斯兰化/阿富汗圣战/军政/沙里亚法制/军情局/核计划
PK-ZIA-001.name_en: Zia-ul-Haq: Islamization/Afghan Jihad/Military-Government/Sharia Law/Military Intelligence/Nuclear Program
PK-ZIA-001.description_zh: 齐亚是巴基斯坦的长期领导人，1924-1988年，他领导巴基斯坦实施了全面的伊斯兰化改革，建立了军事政府，加强了国家安全。齐亚支持阿富汗圣战组织，输出了大量武器和资金，帮助阿富汗人民抵抗苏联占领。齐亚建立了强大的军事情报机构，控制了巴基斯坦的政治和经济。他领导巴基斯坦获得了核武器，成为核国家。
PK-ZIA-001.description_en: Zia-ul-Haq was a long-term Pakistani leader from 1924 to 1988, who led Pakistan to implement comprehensive Islamicization reforms and establish a military government, strengthening national security. Zia supported the Afghan Mujahideen, providing substantial weapons and funding to help the Afghan people resist Soviet occupation. Zia established a powerful military intelligence agency that controlled Pakistan's politics and economy. He led Pakistan to obtain nuclear weapons, becoming a nuclear state.
PK-ZIA-001.reason_zh: 齐亚领导巴基斯坦实施伊斯兰化改革，但他的军事独裁统治引发了国内反对。他支持阿富汗圣战，但这也引发了地区紧张局势。他的军事情报机构控制了政治，导致权力滥用。他的核计划引发了国际社会的担忧。他的统治结束后，巴基斯坦陷入了政治动荡。
PK-ZIA-001.reason_en: Zia led Pakistan to implement Islamicization reforms, but his military dictatorship sparked domestic opposition. He supported the Afghan Mujahideen but also triggered regional tensions. His military intelligence agency controlled politics, leading to power abuses. His nuclear program raised international concerns. After his rule ended, Pakistan descended into political turmoil.
steps_zh: 学习齐亚的领导艺术和军事策略，理解在冷战背景下国家安全的必要性
研究巴基斯坦伊斯兰化改革的历史背景和实施过程，掌握在专制环境下推行意识形态改革的方法
分析阿富汗圣战的历史背景和国际影响，掌握区域安全合作的复杂性
探讨齐亚的军事情报机构和权力控制，理解权力机构的风险
总结齐亚的经验教训，阐述在专制环境下推行改革的风险和挑战
steps_en: Study Zia-ul-Haq's leadership art and military strategies, understand the necessity of national security during the Cold War
Study the historical background and implementation process of Pakistan's Islamicization reforms, master methods for implementing ideological reforms in authoritarian environments
Study the historical background and international impact of the Afghan Mujahideen, master the complexity of regional security cooperation
Explore Zia-ul-Haq's military intelligence agency and power control, understand the risks of power institutions
Summarize Zia-ul-Haq's experiences and the challenges of implementing reforms in authoritarian environments
PK-ZIA-001.expected_zh: 掌握齐亚的领导艺术和军事策略，熟悉巴基斯坦伊斯兰化改革的历史背景和实施过程，理解阿富汗圣战的复杂性，分析军事情报机构和权力控制的风险，培养学生对在专制环境下推行改革的理解和认识。
PK-ZIA-001.expected_en: Master Zia-ul-Haq's leadership art and military strategies, be familiar with the historical background and implementation process of Pakistan's Islamicization reforms, understand the complexity of the Afghan Mujahideen, analyze the risks of military intelligence agency and power control, cultivate students' understanding and awareness of implementing reforms in authoritarian environments.
PK-ZIA-001.case_zh: 1980年，齐亚领导巴基斯坦向阿富汗圣战组织提供武器和资金，支持其抵抗苏联占领。巴基斯坦还建立了强大的军事情报机构，控制了政治和经济。齐亚推行了全面的伊斯兰化改革，建立了军事政府。1988年，齐亚在飞机失事中遇害，巴基斯坦陷入了政治动荡。
PK-ZIA-001.case_en: In 1980, Zia-ul-Haq led Pakistan to provide weapons and funding to the Afghan Mujahideen, supporting their resistance against Soviet occupation. Pakistan also established a powerful military intelligence agency that controlled politics and the economy. Zia-ul-Haq implemented comprehensive Islamicization reforms and established a military government. In 1988, Zia-ul-Haq was killed in a plane crash, and Pakistan descended into political turmoil.
PK-ZIA-001.cross_cultural_impact: Afghan Mujahideen support, nuclear proliferation in South Asia, Islamic governance models

PK-MUS-001.name_zh: 穆沙拉夫：军政转型/反恐同盟/核扩散管控/卡吉尔/民主倒退
PK-MUS-001.name_en: Musharraf: Military-Political Transition/Anti-Terror Alliance/Nuclear Proliferation Control/Kargil/Democratic Regression
PK-MUS-001.description_zh: 穆沙拉夫是巴基斯坦的长期领导人，1944-2023年，他领导巴基斯坦从军事独裁走向民主转型，推行了反恐合作政策，与美国建立了紧密合作，共同打击恐怖主义。在卡吉尔地区，巴基斯坦和印度爆发了冲突，穆沙拉夫领导巴基斯坦进行了军事行动。穆沙拉夫推行了核扩散控制政策，但也引发了国际社会的担忧。他的统治结束后，巴基斯坦陷入了政治动荡。
PK-MUS-001.description_en: Musharraf was a long-term Pakistani leader from 1944 to 2023, who led Pakistan from military dictatorship to democratic transition, implementing anti-terrorist cooperation policies and establishing close cooperation with the United States to combat terrorism. In the Kargil region, Pakistan and India engaged in armed conflict, and Musharraf led Pakistan in military actions. Musharraf implemented nuclear proliferation control policies but also raised international concerns. After his rule ended, Pakistan descended into political turmoil.
PK-MUS-001.reason_zh: 穆沙拉夫领导巴基斯坦实现了从军事独裁到民主的过渡，但他的反恐政策引发了国内反对。他的军事行动导致地区紧张局势加剧。他的核政策引发了国际社会的担忧。他的统治结束后，巴基斯坦陷入了政治动荡。
PK-MUS-001.reason_en: Musharraf led Pakistan to achieve a transition from military dictatorship to democracy, but his anti-terrorist policies sparked domestic opposition. His military actions triggered regional tensions. His nuclear policies raised international concerns. After his rule ended, Pakistan descended into political turmoil.
steps_zh: 学习穆沙拉夫的领导艺术和外交策略，理解在冷战结束后国家安全的必要性
研究巴基斯坦的反恐政策和国际合作，掌握在全球反恐背景下的外交策略
分析卡吉尔冲突的历史背景和国际影响，掌握区域安全合作的复杂性
探讨穆沙拉夫的核扩散控制政策，理解在国际环境下推行核政策的挑战
总结穆沙拉夫的经验教训，阐述在专制环境下推行改革的风险和挑战

PK-MUS-001.expected_zh: 掌握穆沙拉夫的领导艺术和外交策略，熟悉巴基斯坦的反恐政策和国际合作，理解卡吉尔冲突的复杂性，分析核扩散控制政策的风险，培养学生对在冷战结束后推行改革的理解和认识。
PK-MUS-001.expected_en: Master Musharraf's leadership art and diplomatic strategies, be familiar with Pakistan's anti-terrorist policies and international cooperation, understand the complexity of the Kargil conflict, analyze the risks of nuclear proliferation control policies, cultivate students' understanding and awareness of implementing reforms after the Cold War.
PK-MUS-001.case_zh: 2001年，穆沙拉夫领导巴基斯坦与美国建立了紧密合作，共同打击恐怖主义。2001年至2005年，巴基斯坦在国内实施了反恐行动，但也引发了国内反对。2004年，巴基斯坦和印度在卡吉尔地区爆发了冲突，穆沙拉夫领导巴基斯坦进行了军事行动。2008年，穆沙拉夫在国内政治动荡中下台，巴基斯坦陷入了政治动荡。
PK-MUS-001.case_en: In 2001, Musharraf led Pakistan to establish close cooperation with the United States to combat terrorism. From 2001 to 2005, Pakistan implemented anti-terrorist actions domestically but also sparked domestic opposition. In 2004, Pakistan and India engaged in armed conflict in the Kargil region, and Musharraf led Pakistan in military actions. In 2008, Musharraf was forced to step down in the face of domestic political turmoil, and Pakistan descended into political turmoil.
PK-MUS-001.cross_cultural_impact: Anti-terrorist cooperation, nuclear proliferation control, military-led political transitions

PK-KHA-001.name_zh: 伊姆兰汗：体育名流入政/慈善国家/反腐民粹/不信任投票/军政博弈
PK-KHA-001.name_en: Imran Khan: Sports Star Turned Politician/Charity State/Anti-Corruption Populism/No-Confidence Vote/Military-Political Game
PK-KHA-001.description_zh: 伊姆兰汗是巴基斯坦的著名板球运动员，2007-2022年，他从体育明星转型为政治家，领导巴基斯坦实施了多项改革。他推行了反腐运动，赢得了广泛支持。他在2022年面临不信任投票，但成功保住了权力。他执政期间，巴基斯坦的体育和政治关系得到了加强。他领导巴基斯坦在国际事务中发挥了重要作用。
PK-KHA-001.description_en: Imran Khan was a famous Pakistani cricket player from 2007 to 2022, who transitioned from sports star to politician, leading Pakistan to implement multiple reforms. He implemented an anti-corruption movement and won widespread support. In 2022, he faced a no-confidence vote but successfully retained power. During his tenure, the relationship between sports and politics in Pakistan was strengthened. He led Pakistan to play an important role in international affairs.
PK-KHA-001.reason_zh: 伊姆兰汗从体育明星转型为政治家，但他的反腐运动引发了国内反对。他的执政期间，巴基斯坦的政治和经济关系得到了加强。他的领导艺术得到了广泛认可，但他的政治生涯充满争议。他的执政结束后，巴基斯坦陷入了政治动荡。
PK-KHA-001.reason_en: Imran Khan transitioned from sports star to politician but faced domestic opposition to his anti-corruption movement. During his tenure, the relationship between sports and politics in Pakistan was strengthened, and his leadership art was widely recognized. However, his political career was full of controversy. After his tenure ended, Pakistan descended into political turmoil.
steps_zh: 学习伊姆兰汗的领导艺术和政治动员能力，理解在现代社会中推动改革的必要性

His leadership art was widely recognized, but his political career was full of controversy. After his tenure ended, Pakistan descended into political turmoil.
PK-KHA-001.cross_cultural_impact: Anti-corruption movement, sports star turned politician, Pakistani political transformation

BD-RAH-001.name_zh: 拉赫曼：语言民族主义/世俗建国/解放战争/谢赫精神/孟加拉身份
BD-RAH-001.name_en: Rahman: Language Nationalism/Secular Nation-Building/Liberation War/Sheikh Spirit/Bangladeshi Identity
BD-RAH-001.description_zh: 拉赫曼是孟加拉国的国父，1903-1975年，他领导孟加拉国人民争取独立。拉赫曼推动了语言民族主义运动，领导了孟加拉语解放运动。拉赫曼推动了世俗建国，领导了孟加拉国解放战争，建立了独立国家。他倡导谢赫精神，强调文明多样性和宗教和谐。他的领导艺术和民族主义思想为孟加拉国独立和现代化奠定了基础。
BD-RAH-001.description_en: Rahman was the father of Bangladesh from 1903 to 1975, who led the Bangladeshi people to fight for independence. Rahman promoted language nationalism and led the Bengali language liberation movement. Rahman promoted secular nation-building and led the Bangladesh Liberation War, establishing an independent country. He advocated Sheikh spirit and emphasized civilizational diversity and religious harmony. His leadership art and nationalist thought laid the foundation for Bangladesh's independence and modernization.
BD-RAH-001.reason_zh: 拉赫曼领导孟加拉国人民赢得独立，建立了独立国家，推动了语言民族主义和世俗建国。他的谢赫精神倡导文明多样性和宗教和谐，但他的领导艺术和民族主义思想也引发了宗教冲突。他的政治遗产至今仍充满争议。
BD-RAH-001.reason_en: Rahman led the Bangladeshi people to win independence and establish an independent country, promoting language nationalism and secular nation-building. His Sheikh spirit advocated civilizational diversity and religious harmony, but his leadership art and nationalist thought also sparked religious conflicts. His political legacy remains highly controversial today.
steps_zh: 学习拉赫曼的领导艺术和民族主义思想，理解在殖民时代国家建国的历史必然性
研究孟加拉语解放运动的历史背景和过程，掌握语言民族主义的外交策略

Explore Rahman’s Sheikh spirit and civilizational diversity, understand the necessity of promoting harmony in multi-religious environments
Summarize Rahman’s experiences and the challenges of national independence during colonial times
BD-RAH-001.expected_zh: 掌握拉赫曼的领导艺术和民族主义思想，熟悉孟加拉语解放运动和孟加拉国解放战争的历史背景，理解谢赫精神和文明多样性的重要性，培养学生对在殖民时代国家建国的理解和认识。
BD-RAH-001.expected_en: Master Rahman’s leadership art and nationalist thought, be familiar with the historical background of the Bengali language liberation movement and Bangladesh Liberation War, understand the importance of Sheikh spirit and civilizational diversity, cultivate students' understanding and awareness of national independence during colonial times.
BD-RAH-001.case_zh: 1952年，拉赫曼领导孟加拉人民开展了语言革命，要求使用孟加拉语进行官方文件和教育。1956年，拉赫曼领导孟加拉国人民赢得独立，建立了孟加拉国。他倡导谢赫精神，强调文明多样性和宗教和谐。他的领导艺术和民族主义思想为孟加拉国独立和现代化奠定了基础。
BD-RAH-001.case_en: In 1952, Rahman led the Bengali people to launch the language revolution, demanding the use of Bengali for official documents and education. In 1956, Rahman led the Bangladeshi people to win independence and establish Bangladesh. He advocated Sheikh spirit and emphasized civilizational diversity and religious harmony. His leadership art and nationalist thought laid the foundation for Bangladesh's independence and modernization.
BD-RAH-001.cross_cultural_impact: Language nationalism movement, liberation war model, civilizational diversity advocacy

AF-AMA-001.name_zh: 阿曼努拉：阿富汗现代化/阿曼努拉改革/伊斯兰现代化/部落平衡/流亡国王
AF-AMA-001.name_en: Amanullah: Afghanistan Modernization/Amanullah Reform/Islamic Modernization/Tribal Balance/Exiled King
AF-AMA-001.description_zh: 阿曼努拉是阿富汗的国王，1919-1939年，他领导阿富汗实施了全面的现代化改革，包括教育、交通、司法和行政制度的现代化。阿曼努拉推行了伊斯兰现代化改革，但与保守的部落势力发生了冲突。他领导阿富汗与周边国家建立了良好的关系，推行了部落平衡政策。1939年，阿曼努拉在政治动荡中被迫退位，流亡国外。他的改革思想和现代化努力对阿富汗产生了深远影响。
AF-AMA-001.description_en: Amanullah was the King of Afghanistan from 1919 to 1939, who led Afghanistan to implement comprehensive modernization reforms, including education, transportation, justice, and administrative systems. Amanullah implemented Islamic modernization reforms but clashed with conservative tribal forces. He led Afghanistan to establish good relations with neighboring countries and implemented tribal balance policies. In 1939, Amanullah was forced to abdicate in the face of political turmoil and went into exile abroad. His reform ideas and modernization efforts had a profound impact on Afghanistan.
AF-AMA-001.reason_zh: 阿曼努拉推行了全面的现代化改革，但与保守的部落势力发生了冲突。他的改革思想和现代化努力对阿富汗产生了深远影响，但他的统治结束了，阿富汗陷入了政治动荡。
AF-AMA-001.reason_en: Amanullah implemented comprehensive modernization reforms but clashed with conservative tribal forces. His reform ideas and modernization efforts had a profound impact on Afghanistan. However, his reign ended, and Afghanistan descended into political turmoil.

AF-AMA-001.expected_en: Master Amanullah's leadership art and reform thinking, be familiar with Afghanistan's tribal balance policies and ethnic integration, understand the challenges of Islamic modernization reforms, analyze the importance of diplomatic policies and regional cooperation, cultivate students' understanding and awareness of推行现代化 in traditional societies.
AF-AMA-001.case_zh: 1919年，阿曼努拉领导阿富汗赢得独立，建立了阿富汗国。他推行了全面的现代化改革，包括教育、交通、司法和行政制度的现代化。阿曼努拉推行了伊斯兰现代化改革，但与保守的部落势力发生了冲突。1939年，阿曼努拉在政治动荡中被迫退位，流亡国外。他的改革思想和现代化努力对阿富汗产生了深远影响。
AF-AMA-001.case_en: In 1919, Amanullah led Afghanistan to win independence and establish the state of Afghanistan. He implemented comprehensive modernization reforms, including education, transportation, justice, and administrative systems. Amanullah implemented Islamic modernization reforms but clashed with conservative tribal forces. In 1939, Amanullah was forced to abdicate in the face of political turmoil and went into exile abroad. His reform ideas and modernization efforts had a profound impact on Afghanistan.

BD-YUN-001.name_zh: 尤努斯：微金融赋能/女性经济/社会企业/诺贝尔/格莱珉模式
BD-YUN-001.name_en: Yunus: Financial Inclusion/Women's Economic Empowerment/Social Business/Nobel/Pioneer Banking
BD-YUN-001.description_zh: 尤努斯是孟加拉国的银行家和企业家，1940-至今，他领导孟加拉国建立了格莱珉银行，推行了微金融服务，赋能了广大妇女。他推行了社会企业模式，倡导企业在追求利润的同时承担社会责任。尤努斯赢得了诺贝尔和平奖，他的微金融理念被世界广泛认可。他的领导艺术和创新思维为孟加拉国的经济发展和妇女赋权做出了重要贡献。
BD-YUN-001.description_en: Yunus is a Bangladeshi banker and entrepreneur from 1940 to the present, who led Bangladesh to establish Grameen Bank and implement microfinance services, empowering a large number of women. He implemented a social business model, advocating that businesses should pursue profits while assuming social responsibilities. Yunus won the Nobel Peace Prize, and his microfinance concept is widely recognized worldwide. His leadership art and innovative thinking have made significant contributions to Bangladesh's economic development and women's empowerment.
BD-YUN-001.reason_zh: 尤努斯推行了微金融和妇女赋权，但他的创新银行模式引发了国际社会的争议。他的社会企业模式虽然得到了广泛认可，但其可持续性仍受到质疑。他的诺贝尔奖获奖为孟加拉国赢得了国际声誉，但也引发了国内争议。他的领导艺术和创新思维为孟加拉国的经济发展做出了重要贡献。
BD-YUN-001.reason_en: Yunus implemented microfinance and women's empowerment, but his innovative banking model sparked international controversy. His social business model, while widely recognized, faces sustainability challenges. His Nobel Prize win brought international acclaim to Bangladesh but also sparked domestic debate. His leadership art and innovative thinking have significantly contributed to Bangladesh's economic development.

BD-YUN-001.case_zh: 1983年，尤努斯创立了格莱珉银行，推行了微金融服务，赋能了孟加拉国广大妇女。尤努斯的微金融理念被世界广泛认可，赢得了诺贝尔和平奖。他的社会企业模式得到了广泛认可，推动了孟加拉国的经济发展和妇女赋权。他的领导艺术和创新思维为孟加拉国的经济发展和妇女赋权做出了重要贡献。
BD-YUN-001.case_en: In 1983, Yunus established Grameen Bank and implemented microfinance services, empowering a large number of Bangladeshi women. Yunus’s microfinance concept is widely recognized globally and he won the Nobel Peace Prize. His social business model gained widespread recognition and promoted economic development and women’s empowerment in Bangladesh. His leadership art and innovative thinking have made significant contributions to Bangladesh’s economic development and women’s empowerment.

BD-HAS-001.name_zh: 哈西娜：数字孟加拉/气候脆弱/罗兴亚难民/强人政治/女性领袖
BD-HAS-001.name_en: Hasina: Digital Bangladesh/Climate Vulnerability/Rohingya Refugees/Strongman Politics/Female Leader
BD-HAS-001.description_zh: 哈西娜是孟加拉国的长期领导人，1947-至今。她领导孟加拉国实施了多项改革，包括数字孟加拉计划，推动了孟加拉国的数字化转型。哈西娜在执政期间面临了气候变化带来的挑战，包括海平面上升和极端天气事件。2017年，发生了罗兴亚难民危机，约100万罗兴亚难民逃到了孟加拉国。哈西娜在执政期间被称为"强人政治"，但她也推动了女性赋权和民主制度。
BD-HAS-001.description_en: Hasina is a long-term Bangladeshi leader from 1947 to the present. She led Bangladesh to implement multiple reforms, including the Digital Bangladesh Plan, promoting the country's digital transformation. Hasina faced challenges from climate change during her tenure, including sea level rise and extreme weather events. In 2017, a Rohingya refugee crisis occurred, with approximately 1 million Rohingya refugees fleeing to Bangladesh. Hasina has been referred to as a "strongwoman" during her tenure, but she also promoted women's empowerment and democratic systems.
BD-HAS-001.reason_zh: 哈西娜领导孟加拉国实施了多项改革，但她的强人政治引发了国内反对。2017年罗兴亚难民危机引发了国际社会的关注。气候变化带来的挑战也威胁着孟加拉国的稳定。她的执政结束了，孟加拉国陷入了政治动荡。
BD-HAS-001.reason_en: Hasina led Bangladesh to implement multiple reforms, but her strongwoman politics sparked domestic opposition. The 2017 Rohingya refugee crisis drew international attention. Climate change challenges also threatened Bangladesh's stability. After her tenure ended, Bangladesh descended into political turmoil.

BD-HAS-001.expected_en: Master Hasina's leadership art and reform thinking, be familiar with Bangladesh's climate change challenges and response measures, understand the impact of the Rohingya refugee crisis, analyze strongwoman politics and women's empowerment, cultivate students' understanding and awareness of implementing reforms in developing countries.
BD-HAS-001.case_zh: 2017年，发生了罗兴亚难民危机，约100万罗兴亚难民逃到了孟加拉国。哈西娜领导孟加拉国实施了多项改革，包括数字孟加拉计划，推动了孟加拉国的数字化转型。2019年，哈西娜面临了不信任投票，但成功保住了权力。2024年，哈西娜在政治动荡中下台，孟加拉国陷入了政治动荡。
BD-HAS-001.case_en: In 2017, a Rohingya refugee crisis occurred, with approximately 1 million Rohingya refugees fleeing to Bangladesh. Hasina led Bangladesh to implement multiple reforms, including the Digital Bangladesh Plan, promoting the country's digital transformation. In 2019, Hasina faced a no-confidence vote but successfully retained power. In 2024, Hasina stepped down in the face of political turmoil, and Bangladesh descended into political turmoil.
BD-HAS-001.cross_cultural_impact: Digital transformation model, climate change response, refugee crisis management

AF-MAS-001.name_zh: 马苏德：潘杰希尔狮子/反苏圣战/反塔利班/北方联盟/马苏德精神
AF-MAS-001.name_en: Massoud: Panjshir Lion/Anti-Soviet Jihad/Anti-Taliban/Northern Alliance/Massoud Spirit
AF-MAS-001.description_zh: 马苏德是阿富汗的长期领导人，1953-2001年，他领导阿富汗人民抵抗苏联侵略，赢得了反苏圣战。马苏德领导了北方联盟，建立了强大的军事力量。他领导阿富汗人民反抗塔利班，建立了民主制度。2001年，马苏德在反对塔利班的战斗中遇刺身亡，他的牺牲巩固了反塔利班联盟。他的领导艺术和民族主义思想对阿富汗产生了深远影响。
AF-MAS-001.description_en: Massoud was a long-term Afghan leader from 1953 to 2001, who led the Afghan people to resist Soviet invasion and win the anti-Soviet jihad. Massoud led the Northern Alliance and established a strong military force. He led the Afghan people to resist the Taliban and establish democratic systems. In 2001, Massoud was assassinated in the fight against the Taliban, and his sacrifice consolidated the anti-Taliban alliance. His leadership art and nationalist thought had a profound impact on Afghanistan.
AF-MAS-001.reason_zh: 马苏德领导阿富汗人民抵抗苏联侵略，反抗塔利班，但他的领导艺术和民族主义思想也引发了争议。他的牺牲巩固了反塔利班联盟，但他的统治结束后，阿富汗陷入了政治动荡。
AF-MAS-001.reason_en: Massoud led the Afghan people to resist Soviet invasion and the Taliban, but his leadership art and nationalist thought also sparked controversy. His sacrifice consolidated the anti-Taliban alliance. However, after his rule ended, Afghanistan descended into political turmoil.
steps_zh: 学习马苏德的领导艺术和军事策略，理解在反殖民时代国家建设的必要性
研究阿富汗的反苏圣战和反塔利班斗争，掌握在复杂环境下推行改革的方法

AF-MAS-001.case_zh: 1996年，马苏德领导北方联盟，建立了强大的军事力量，反抗塔利班。马苏德领导阿富汗人民抵抗苏联侵略，反抗塔利班，建立了民主制度。2001年，马苏德在反对塔利班的战斗中遇刺身亡，他的牺牲巩固了反塔利班联盟。他的领导艺术和民族主义思想对阿富汗产生了深远影响。
AF-MAS-001.case_en: In 1996, Massoud led the Northern Alliance and established a strong military force to resist the Taliban. Massoud led the Afghan people to resist Soviet invasion and the Taliban and establish democratic systems. In 2001, Massoud was assassinated in the fight against the Taliban, and his sacrifice consolidated the anti-Taliban alliance. His leadership art and nationalist thought had a profound impact on Afghanistan.

AF-KAR-001.name_zh: 卡尔扎伊：阿富汗建国/部落联邦/美国盟友/选举政治/塔利班回归
AF-KAR-001.name_en: Karzai: Afghanistan Independence/Tribal Federation/American Ally/Electoral Politics/Taliban Return
AF-KAR-001.description_zh: 卡尔扎伊是阿富汗的长期领导人，1960-至今，他领导阿富汗赢得独立，建立了阿富汗国。卡尔扎伊推行了部落联邦制，尊重了阿富汗的部落传统。卡尔扎伊与美国建立了密切的同盟关系，但这也引发了国内争议。卡尔扎伊推行了选举政治，但这也引发了国内政治动荡。他的统治结束后，阿富汗陷入了政治动荡，塔利班重新掌权。
AF-KAR-001.description_en: Karzai was a long-term Afghan leader from 1960 to the present, who led Afghanistan to win independence and establish the state of Afghanistan. Karzai implemented tribal federation systems, respecting Afghanistan's traditional tribal structures. Karzai established close alliances with the United States but this also sparked domestic controversy. Karzai implemented electoral politics but this also sparked domestic political turmoil. After his rule ended, Afghanistan descended into political turmoil and the Taliban returned to power.
AF-KAR-001.reason_zh: 卡尔扎伊领导阿富汗赢得独立，但他的美国盟友政策引发了国内争议。他的选举政治导致国内政治动荡。他的部落联邦制虽然尊重了传统，但也引发了争议。他的统治结束后，阿富汗陷入了政治动荡，塔利班重新掌权。
AF-KAR-001.reason_en: Karzai led Afghanistan to win independence but his American alliance policy sparked domestic controversy. His electoral politics led to domestic political turmoil. His tribal federation system, while respecting tradition, also sparked controversy. After his rule ended, Afghanistan descended into political turmoil and the Taliban returned to power.

AF-KAR-001.expected_en: Master Karzai's leadership art and diplomatic strategies, be familiar with Afghanistan's tribal federation system and ethnic integration, understand the significance of the alliance with the United States and electoral politics, cultivate students' understanding and awareness of推行国家建设 in post-independence contexts.
AF-KAR-001.case_zh: 2001年，卡尔扎伊领导阿富汗赢得独立，建立了阿富汗国。他推行了部落联邦制，尊重了阿富汗的部落传统。卡尔扎伊与美国建立了密切的同盟关系，但这也引发了国内争议。卡尔扎伊推行了选举政治，但这也引发了国内政治动荡。2009年，卡尔扎伊在政治动荡中下台，阿富汗陷入了政治动荡，塔利班重新掌权。
AF-KAR-001.case_en: In 2001, Karzai led Afghanistan to win independence and establish the state of Afghanistan. He implemented a tribal federation system, respecting Afghanistan's traditional tribal structures. Karzai established close alliances with the United States but this also sparked domestic controversy. Karzai implemented electoral politics but this also sparked domestic political turmoil. In 2009, Karzai stepped down in the face of political turmoil, and Afghanistan descended into political turmoil and the Taliban returned to power.
AF-KAR-001.cross_cultural_impact: Tribal federation model, American alliance, post-9/11 Afghanistan reconstruction

ES-ASU-001.description_en: José María Aznar (1953-) Spain PM (1996-2004), PP leader, drove Spain NATO/EU integration, post-11M Madrid bombings hardline counterterrorism, Catalonia autonomy expansion vs separatism game, staunch Atlanticist supporting Iraq War.
ES-ASU-001.reason_zh: 阿苏纳尔代表中右翼如何在后佛朗哥时代完成西班牙现代化融入西方，展示了恐袭如何重塑反恐政治与公民自由平衡，其大西洋主义与欧盟一体化双轮驱动确立西班牙南欧核心地位。
ES-ASU-001.reason_en: Aznar represents how center-right completed Spanish modernization and Western integration post-Franco, demonstrating how terror attacks reshape counterterrorism politics and civil liberties balance, his Atlanticism and EU integration dual-wheel establishing Spain as Southern Europe core.

ES-CHA-001.description_zh: 查理五世 (1500-1558) 哈布斯堡王朝，继承西班牙/尼德兰/奥地利/新大陆领土，构建日不落帝国，面对宗教改革/奥斯曼扩张/法西冲突多线作战，1555奥格斯堡和议确立教随国立，1556退位分割帝国予腓力二世/费迪南德一世。
ES-CHA-001.description_en: Charles V (1500-1558) Habsburg dynasty, inherited Spain/Netherlands/Austria/New World territories, built sun-never-sets empire, faced Reformation/Ottoman expansion/Franco-Habsburg wars multi-front wars, 1555 Peace of Augsburg established cuius regio eius religio, 1556 abdicated dividing empire to Philip II/Ferdinand I.
ES-CHA-001.reason_zh: 查理五世代表个人联合如何构建跨大陆帝国，展示了宗教改革如何迫使帝国在信仰与政治双重维度分裂，其奥格斯堡和议确立了早期现代欧洲宗教共存法律框架，帝国分割奠定西班牙/奥地利双轨命运。
ES-CHA-001.reason_en: Charles V represents how personal union constructs transcontinental empire, demonstrating how Reformation forced empire split on both faith and political dimensions, his Augsburg Peace established early modern European religious coexistence legal framework, empire division laying Spanish/Austrian dual-track destinies.

ES-FER-001.name_zh: 费尔南多/西班牙/伊莎贝拉/统一/宗教裁判/哥伦布/大航海
ES-FER-001.description_zh: 费尔南多二世 (1452-1516) 阿拉贡国王，与伊莎贝拉一世联姻统一西班牙，完成收复失地运动攻陷格拉纳达，建立宗教裁判所维护天主教正统，资助哥伦布航海开启大航海时代，奠定西班牙帝国全球霸权基础。
ES-FER-001.description_en: Ferdinand II (1452-1516) King of Aragon, married Isabella I unifying Spain, completed Reconquista capturing Granada, established Inquisition defending Catholic orthodoxy, funded Columbus voyages inaugurating Age of Discovery, laying foundation for Spanish Empire global hegemony.
ES-FER-001.reason_zh: 费尔南多与伊莎贝拉代表王朝联姻如何实现民族国家统一，展示了宗教裁判所如何作为意识形态控制工具服务政治中央集权，其资助哥伦布开启了欧洲殖民扩张与全球化进程。
ES-FER-001.reason_en: Ferdinand and Isabella represent how dynastic marriage achieves nation-state unification, demonstrating how Inquisition served as ideological control tool for political centralization, their Columbus funding launching European colonial expansion and globalization.

ES-FRA-001.name_zh: 佛朗哥/西班牙/内战/独裁/中立/奥普斯/胡安卡洛斯/转型
ES-FRA-001.description_zh: 弗朗西斯科·佛朗哥 (1892-1975) 西班牙内战民族主义阵营领袖，1939年建立独裁政权，二战保持中立避免卷入，奥普斯·戴技术官僚推动经济奇迹（1960s），指定胡安·卡洛斯为继任者，1975年逝世后和平过渡民主。

PT-HEN-001.description_zh: 恩里克王子 (1394-1460) 葡萄牙阿维什王朝，萨格雷斯航海学校奠基人，系统性推动非洲西海岸探索，发现马德拉/亚速尔/佛得角群岛，开启大西洋奴隶贸易，葡萄牙大航海时代奠基人。
PT-HEN-001.description_en: Prince Henry (1394-1460) Portuguese Aviz dynasty, Sagres navigation school founder, systematically drove West African coast exploration, discovered Madeira/Azores/Cape Verde islands, initiated Atlantic slave trade, Portuguese Age of Discovery founding father.
PT-HEN-001.reason_zh: 恩里克代表王室成员如何通过制度化探索推动地理大发现，展示了萨格雷斯航海学校如何将航海技术/制图/天文观测系统化，其非洲探索与奴隶贸易开启了欧洲殖民扩张与跨大西洋贸易体系。
PT-HEN-001.reason_en: Henry represents how royalty institutionalizes exploration driving Age of Discovery, demonstrating how Sagres navigation school systematized navigation/cartography/astronomy, his African exploration and slave trade launching European colonial expansion and transatlantic trade system.

PT-SAL-001.reason_en: Salazar represents how authoritarianism persisted forty years through neutrality and colonial insistence, demonstrating how New State used ruralism/Catholicism/anti-communism as ideological pillars, African wars drained economy triggering Carnation Revolution, decolonization completing Portuguese modernization.

PT-VAS-001.description_zh: 瓦斯科·达·伽马 (1460s-1524) 葡萄牙探险家，1498年绕过好望角抵达印度卡利卡特，开辟欧洲直达亚洲海上香料航线，打破威尼斯/奥斯曼垄断，葡属印度首任总督，奠定葡萄牙海上帝国亚洲霸权。
PT-VAS-001.description_en: Vasco da Gama (1460s-1524) Portuguese explorer, 1498 rounded Cape of Good Hope reached Calicut India, opened European direct sea spice route to Asia, broke Venice/Ottoman monopoly, first Governor of Portuguese India, established Portuguese maritime empire Asian hegemony.
PT-VAS-001.reason_zh: 达伽马代表单次航行如何重塑全球贸易版图，展示了海上航线如何打破陆路垄断重构东西方交换，其印度航线确立葡萄牙作为首个全球海上帝国的地位，香料贸易财富支撑葡萄牙黄金时代。
PT-VAS-001.reason_en: Da Gama represents how single voyage reshapes global trade map, demonstrating how sea route broke land monopoly restructuring East-West exchange, his India route establishing Portugal as first global maritime empire, spice trade wealth funding Portuguese Golden Age.

GR-VEN-001.reason_en: Venizelos represents how liberalism balances territorial expansion and institutional modernization in nation-building, demonstrating how Asia Minor Catastrophe reshaped Greece into mono-ethnic nation via population exchange, his National Schism and Lausanne Treaty dual legacy defining modern Greek political spectrum.

CO-BOL-001.description_en: Simon Bolivar (1783-1830) Venezuelan/Colombian/Bolivian military leader, led anti-Spanish independence wars, established Greater Colombia Republic, overthrew colonial rule, achieved Latin American independence, implemented constitutional dictatorship, promoted pan-American integration, known as 'Liberator', Bolivar Dream laid foundation for Latin American geopolitical structure.

CO-BOL-001.reason_en: Bolivar represents how Latin American independence wars reshape geopolitical landscape, demonstrates how anti-colonial struggle establishes new nation systems, his Greater Colombia experiment embodies pan-American integration ideal, his constitutional dictatorship model influences post-colonial Latin American state-building, his Liberator myth constructs shared Latin American identity.

CO-GAV-001.reason_en: Gaviria represents Colombia's transition from violence to peace, how constitutional reform rebuilds nation, how drug war economics redefines national positioning, and diplomatic mediation role in peace process, embodies Colombia's modern transformation.
